In our research, we explore the Resummation effects in the search for the Standard Model (SM) Higgs Boson at Hadron Colliders. The key idea behind our study is to use the most recent advances in theoretical calculations of higher-order corrections in perturbative Quantum Chromodynamics (pQCD). We employ effective field theory techniques combined with leading logarithmic resummation within the Higgs-EFT framework to address the uncertainties in the SM Higgs production rates. 

The driving motivation of our work is the need to improve the accuracy and precision of measurements of the Higgs boson properties. Despite its discovery, the properties of the Higgs boson remain elusive, and it is essential to determine its mass, coupling strengths, and radiative corrections accurately, to study new physics beyond the SM. 

Our theoretical analysis reveals that the Resummation effects in the SM Higgs boson production cross-sections are significant in the highly boosted Higgs regime. We predict that the Higgs-electroweakino associated production process at the Large Hadron Collider (LHC) probe new physics beyond the SM. Our results, which are consistent with the recent experimental data from the ATLAS and CMS collaborations at LHC, provide further support for the use of this approach to improve the accuracy in Higgs physics measurements at future high-energy colliders. 

In conclusion, our research demonstrates the usefulness of the Resummation techniques in probing new physics beyond the SM at the LHC and provides insights into the properties of the Higgs boson. These results are crucial for future studies aimed at elucidating the fundamental laws of nature.

Слабо представяне за свободняците на Европейското по борба до 23 години 

В последните години стана много ясно, че младите свободняци, плащащи присъствие на Европейското по борба до 23 години, имат доста задължителства - тяхното представяне на страната им, пред съюзниците и противниците. Това е не достатъчно да се твърди, че всеки е в право да бори за царевицата, тъй като той трябва да бъде достатъчно грамотен, информиран, мотивиран и командваем добре. Има много пъти, по които свободняцът може да представи своята страна в най-добрия възможен начин. 

В първо място, най-важното е да се разбере самата борба. Тяхното представяне и защита на страната им ще бъде по-добра, ако те могат да представят идеята на борбата на конкретния начин. Това изисква на свободняците да се разберат за правилата и войнен артилерия, а също така да разберат за своя армейски мотив. Те също трябва да разберат и ще работи - да играят ролята си в група, да следват командването и да са мотивирани ​​да строят добра слава за своята страна. Ако не са предприели такъв подход, то това може да доведе до изгубени битки и злополуки. 

Второ, е важно да разберете, че техният вклад е ценен. Свободняците трябва да го понасят на вниманието на целия свят, научавайки и заслужавайки много. Това не само ще даде на всеки възможност да покаже властта си и да спечели царска похвала и възнаграждение, но и ще даде на страната им повече представители и гoлямо предимство в последствие. Това би помогнало и благодатите на свободняците да достигнат високи рангове.

На крайна сметка, е важно да не забравим, че идеята за добри свободняци за Европейското по борба до 23 години трябва да пълни с мъдрост. Без мотивация, знания и властта да се бори до последната мерцающа милиция - свободняците няма да представят своята страна на най-добрия начин и могат да се срещнат с техните мотиви на борба по противоположното. След инициативата тя може да моделира свободняците за царевицата надясно и рядко.

Jakarta, CNN Indonesia -- Hari ini, warga Saudi merayakan kemerdekaan baru bagi perempuan di negara tersebut. Untuk pertama kalinya dalam sejarah Saudi Arabia, perempuan diperbolehkan mengendarai mobil. Untuk memperingati momen penting ini, Habiba Ghuloom, seorang perempuan Saudi, memilih untuk merayakannya dengan cara yang unik dan ekstrim: dengan mengendarai mobil Formula 1 (F1) di sirkuit terkenal di Jeddah. Ghuloom, yang berumur 35 tahun, adalah seorang pebisnis sukses yang telah sukses merintis beberapa perusahaan teknologi di Saudi Arabia. Ia mengatakan bahwa ia sudah lama bercita-cita untuk dapat mengendarai mobil F1 dan terus menjalani latihan dengan intensif. "Saya begitu senang dan bangga dengan perubahan yang terjadi di negara saya. Saya sekarang dapat melakukan hal-hal yang sebelumnya terlarang bagi perempuan di sini, termasuk mengendarai mobil," ujar Ghuloom. Menurut Ghuloom, ia merasa percaya diri saat mengemudi mobil F1 di sirkuit yang ia sukai. Meskipun mobil atau balap F1 lebih sering diidentikkan dengan olahraga yang didominasi oleh pria, Ghuloom tidak merasa terhalang untuk mengejar mimpinya. "Saya ingin menunjukkan pada generasi muda dan perempuan di Saudi Arabia bahwa semua orang dapat berjuang untuk meraih cita-cita mereka, termasuk olahraga yang secara tradisional dianggap lebih cocok bagi pria." Ghuloom juga membagikan pengalamannya di media sosial dan menerima tumpukan dukungan dari pengguna internet, tidak hanya di Saudi Arabia, tetapi juga di seluruh dunia. "Kami sangat bangga dengan pencapaian perempuan Saudi ini. Ini merupakan momen sejarah bagi Saudi Arabia, dan saya yakin banyak anak perempuan di sini yang akan terinspirasi oleh perjuangan Ghuloom," ujar salah satu pengguna media sosial. Sejak perempuan di Saudi Arabia diperbolehkan mengemudi pada bulan Juni tahun ini, banyak perempuan di negara tersebut merayakan kebebasan baru mereka dengan mengemudikan mobil mereka sendiri. Pada awalnya, banyak perempuan yang merasa khawatir tentang peraturan lalu lintas yang berbeda, beragam peraturan perbankan dan keamanan yang kompleks, namun hal itu tidak menghalangi mereka untuk merayakan kemerdekaan baru mereka. Melalui kisah perjuangan dan keberhasilan Habiba Ghuloom, para perempuan di Saudi Arabia kembali terbuka lebar untuk meraih cita-cita dan impian mereka yang sebelumnya terhambat. Diharapkan momen positif ini akan bertahan lama dan semakin menginpirasi perempuan-perempuan di seluruh dunia.

Турските избиратели с имиграционен статус извън границите на страната бяха много активни в последните дни да изпратят на дому глас си за референдума за конституционна реформа. Съгласно положение на Закона за избирателните права, гласът им може да бъде изпратен чрез по поща, суйване, факс или изпращане по електронен път.

На 20 май, откриваше се все повече граждани турци с пребиваване или работа в чужбина, дори и до баба на 70 години, която имаше гласуване в три различни места. Те са се отдалечили за да гласуват в референдума, посветен на конституционна реформа, което води до по-голямо право за съдебната система. 

Сред избирателите, които са дошли да гласуват извън границите на Турция, е и литвинът Gulcin Kibar Rutkovsky. "Нашата роля е да изпълним важна стъпка по пътя за Турция да стане демократична, свободна и ултрасоциалистична," каза тя.

Във всички страни по света има неравности в достъпа до шансовете на турските граждани да поучастват в парламентарни избори и референдуми. Турция е неизключителна. Много граждани не могат да посетят страната си, за да гласуват или по причина на дреболиите по преминаването на границите, или защото нямат достатъчно пари за да си позволят такава пътуване.

Но избирателите, които са се съсредоточили и гласуваха зад граница, изразиха влияние и представляват силна символична енергия за турците за демократия. Високата присъствие на масово гласуване зад граница показва доверието им към демократията и отпуснатостта към процеса на гласуване. Публиката по цял свят, призната и подкрепила тези избиратели, чрез делини на различни медии и социални платформи, като признаване, че гласа им има сила.

Das Forstmuseum dient der Bewahrung und Verbreitung der Kulturgeschichte des Waldes und der forstwirtschaftlichen Arbeit. Es ist ein Museum, in dem Geschichte, Technologie, Volkswirtschaft und Leben des Waldes (Flora und Fauna) und des Menschen in Relation zum Wald gezeigt werden.

Das Forstmuseum besteht aus mehreren Ausstellungsbereichen. Im ersten Bereich erfahren die Besucher die Geschichte des Waldes seit der letzten Eiszeit. Der zweite Bereich zeigt die Bedeutung der Wälder für die Menschen in Bezug auf Landwirtschaft, Jagd und Konflikte. Der dritte Bereich vermittelt sowohl Kenntnisse der Waldpflanzen und -tiere als auch Informationen über Konzepte der Forstwirtschaft. Der vierte Bereich wird näher auf die menschliche Arbeit im Wald eingehen. Eine spezielle Ausstellung wird der Rolle des Waldes in der Industrie gewidmet.

Das Museum präsentiert eine Menge an Werkzeugen und Maschinen, die für Waldarbeiten genutzt wurden. Um den Besuchern eine Vorstellung davon zu geben, wie die Arbeit mit den Werkzeugen stattfand, können Besucher einige Werkzeuge sogar selbst ausprobieren. Durch digitale Technologien und interaktive Elemente können Besucher des Museums die Geschichte und die modernen Technologien der Forstwirtschaft kennenlernen. 

Das Forstmuseum hat das Ziel, die Bedeutung eines nachhaltigen Waldmanagements im Hinblick auf den Erhalt des Ökosystems und die Sicherung des wirtschaftlichen Nutzens in die breite Öffentlichkeit zu bringen. Des Weiteren dient es als Plattform, um relevante Themen im Bereich der Forstwirtschaft zu diskutieren. 

Das Museum ist ein wichtiger Bezugspunkt für Touristen, Schüler, Wissenschaftler sowie Fachleute im Bereich der Forstwirtschaft. Es ist auf jeden Fall einen Besuch wert.

European Imperialism in Africa began in the fifteenth century when various European powers began establishing coastal trading posts and later missionaries arrived. After World War II, the Imperial powers withdrew from their African colonies. The newly independent states were often ill-prepared for independence, lacking administrative skills and political experience. This led to instability, especially in countries where different ethnic groups were vying for power. The Imperial powers were often blamed for the instability that followed. However, it should be noted that instability often preceded Imperial rule and that other factors such as the Cold War and post-colonial conflicts were also to blame. European Imperialism played a significant role in the development of modern Africa, but it was not the sole cause of the continent's problems.

Some sea creatures breed in synchrony. This means that they all spawn their young at the same time and in the same place. This increases the chances that their young will find a mate and that the adults will be able to disperse their genes. This strategy works well when conditions are stable, but when the environment changes, it can leave the species vulnerable. For example, if the temperature in the water changes, and the plankton that the young sea creatures eat are no longer available, then the whole generation can die. Sea creatures that use this strategy include some coral, some sea worms, and some sea snails.

Another strategy is to breed continuously, as many land animals do. This allows the adults to disperse their genes over time, and allows their young to adapt to changing conditions. However, it means that adults and young are not in the same place at the same time, so the young have to be able to find their way to a place where they can meet other members of their species. This is a particular problem for animals that live in deep water, where the currents can be complex. Sea spiders, which live on the seafloor, have a very long larval stage. Some deep-sea octopuses also have long larval stages, and they also have complex ways of finding their way back to their parents.

Arthur M. Sackler Gallery ist ein Kunstmuseum in Washington, D.C., USA, das asiatische Kunst öffentlich zeigt. Die Galerie ist Teil des Smithsonian Institution und wurde 1987 eröffnet. Der Name der Galerie erinnert an Arthur M. Sackler, einen Geschäftsmann und Philanthropen, der große Sammlungen asiatischer Kunst besaß. Einige seiner Kunstwerke wurden später von seinem Bruder und seinen Erben an die Galerie übergeben. Das Museum arbeitet auch eng mit der Freer Gallery of Art, dem National Museum of African Art und dem Hauptgebäude des Smithsonian zusammen, um die asiatischen und afrikanischen Sammlungen zusammen zu präsentieren.
Das Museum umfasst etwa 10.000 Kunstwerke aus China, Japan, Korea, Südasien, Südostasien sowie den Nahen Osten und Nordafrika. Gruppen von Kunstwerken, die in der Galerie zu sehen sind, umfassen archäologische Funde, Gemälde, Skulpturen, Keramik, Textilien, Waffen, Schmuck, Teppiche und Möbel. Einige der bekanntesten Ausstellungsstücke in der Galerie sind die japanische Teeset-Kollektion, koreanische Lockenwickler, indischer Goldschmuck, islamische Kunstwerke, chinesisches Porzellan und sakrale Kunstwerke aus Tibet.
Im Jahr 2007 erwarb das Museum Berühmtheit nach einer spektakulären Erweiterung. Das Gebäude wurde komplett renoviert und in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Architekturbüro Gluckman Mayner eine moderne Innenarchitektur gestaltet. Die Erweiterung umfasste ein neues Besucherzentrum sowie eine unterirdische Verbindung zur Freer Gallery of Art. Die Galerie ist bekannt für ihre unterhaltsamen und interaktiven Ausstellungen, zu denen auch Führungen, Vorträge, Filmvorführungen und Performances gehören. Die Galerie ist ein wichtiger Anziehungspunkt für Touristen in der Region Washington, D.C. und ein wichtiges kulturelles Zentrum in den Vereinigten Staaten.

Multiple pattern matching: A Markov chain approach. We consider the problem of multiple pattern matching, i.e., given two or more patterns, find the positions at which they match to each other. We propose a general technique that combines dynamic programming with Markov chains to obtain an efficient solution to this problem. Our technique is based on the observation that the problem can be reformulated as a sequence alignment problem, which can then be recast as a Markov chain alignment problem. We show that this recast problem can be solved efficiently by a dynamic programming algorithm, based on the observation that the Markov chains of the two patterns to be matched have a certain structure that can be exploited by the dynamic programming algorithm. We evaluate the performance of our algorithm through a series of experiments, and show that it scales sublinearly in the number of patterns and that it is competitive with other multiple pattern matching algorithms in terms of execution time.

Jakarta, CNN Indonesia -- Perang dagang antara Amerika Serikat (AS) dan China semakin memanas sejak awal tahun 2019. Di tengah ketegangan tersebut, Indonesia berhasil memberikan kabar baik: ekspor Indonesia tetap tumbuh. Menurut data dari Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS), nilai ekspor Indonesia pada Januari dan Februari 2019 mencapai USD 27,9 miliar. Jumlah ini meningkat 3,09 persen dibandingkan periode yang sama tahun lalu, di mana total ekspor hanya sebesar USD 27 miliar. Peningkatan ekspor Indonesia tersebut tampaknya tidak terpengaruh oleh perang dagang antara AS dan China. Padahal, mengingat AS sebagai pasar utama bagi ekspor Indonesia, perang dagang tersebut seharusnya memberikan dampak negatif terhadap ekspor Indonesia. Namun, Indonesia mampu kompetitif di pasar global. Ekspor non-migas Indonesia tercatat tertinggi ke beberapa negara, seperti Cina, Amerika Serikat, Jepang, India, dan Singapura pada Januari-Februari 2019. Ekspor ke Cina misalnya tetap tumbuh sebesar 7,80 persen dibanding periode tahun lalu. Hal ini membuktikan bahwa ekonomi Indonesia semakin tangguh di tengah ketidakpastian pelemahan ekonomi global. Meskipun ekspor nonmigas masih didominasi oleh bahan mentah dan komoditas, kini pemerintah fokus untuk memprioritaskan upaya diversifikasi ekspor dan mengekspor barang tambahannya yang mempunyai nilai tambah lebih tinggi. Menteri Perdagangan, Enggartiasto Lukita, menyatakan bahwa pemerintah telah berusaha meningkatkan kualitas produk dan memperluas pasar ekspor. Dia juga menyatakan bahwa pemerintah akan terus melanjutkan upaya untuk meningkatkan nilai tambah ekspor Indonesia agar semakin meningkatkan pertumbuhan ekonomi. Ketika ekspor Indonesia tetap tumbuh, beberapa ekonom memperkirakan peluang Indonesia untuk menjadi alternatif bagi impor AS dan China. Namun, mereka juga mencatat bahwa Indonesia masih harus menyelesaikan beberapa masalah di dalam negeri, seperti infrastruktur yang kualitasnya bervariasi di daerah-daerah dan regulasi yang sulit untuk dijalankan oleh para pelaku usaha. Sebagai kesimpulan, meskipun AS dan Cina tengah berseteru dalam perang dagang, ekspor Indonesia tetap tumbuh. Hal ini membuktikan bahwa Indonesia mampu beradaptasi dan bersaing di pasar global. Namun, tetap ada tantangan yang harus dihadapi pemerintah dan para pelaku usaha untuk terus meningkatkan ekspor Indonesia dan mendiversifikasikannya agar mampu memberikan nilai tambah yang lebih besar bagi perekonomian Indonesia.

This article investigates the characteristics of transition objects (objects consisting of both an optically thin inner disc surrounded by an optically thick outer disc) and their associated disc masses (Mdisc) and stellar accretion rates (Mdot). We examine the demographic differences between accreting T Tauri stars with the same age, compared to the transition objects. We observe that transition objects possess a significantly lower Mdot at the same Mdisc, with a median Mdisc being 4 times greater than those of non-transition single stars in Taurus. These demographics may support theories of planet formation and disc accretion. An analysis of the Mdot-Mdisc plane suggests that transition objects form a distinct demographic group, which, when separated out, leads to a close relationship between Mdisc and Mdot with a slope close to the value of one anticipated in simple disc accretion theories.

Riccardo Illy (Italian: [rifuˈcchjko Ilˈli]) [1] is an Italian fashion designer. He was born in Savona, Italy on February 14, 1942. Illy started his career at the age of 15, when he designed his school's flag. His career took off when he was 17 years old, when he presented his first collection. From then on he has been known for his creativity and unique style. He has created several trends, such as the maxi dress and the midi skirt. Illy has been influential in many ways. He was one of the first designers to introduce strict quality controls, even creating his own private laboratory in the 1980s. He is also a dedicated environmentalist, using ecologically friendly materials and development methods from the beginning of his career. He closed his atelier in 2012, and turned 85 years old in February 14, 2013. Despite his success, Illy has remained relatively unknown for most of his life. He always denied interest in publicity, being interested only in his work. In 2016, he started collaborating with reality television show, Project Runway, producing one of the challenges. The victory made him gain more attention, and he was invited to host a fashion program on Canale 5, Che tempo che fa. His daughter Lara Alberto is also a well-known fashion designer. He is noted for creating the maxi dress and the midi skirt. He was awarded the Giorgio Spaventa prize in 1977, the Compasso d'Oro in 1983, the Italian Golden billion-dollar award in 1984, the Silver Blue Angel award in 1986, the Prince of Wales' award in 1987, the Honor of Design award in 1988, the Purple Rose of Cairo award in 1989, the Bravo award in 1990, the Vogue Italia award in 1992, the Jumio Prize in 1994, the Christian Dior honorine in 1995, the Valentino fashion house's muse award in 2000, the Premio Componenti Style 2006, the red dot award for product design 2017 and the prize of excellence ADI in 2019. He is survived by his wife, Marcella, two daughters Lara Alberto and Alessia, and four grandchildren. After his son Enzo died suddenly in 1987, Riccardo founded the Riccardo Illy Foundation, devoted to assisting young people starting careers in the fashion industry. He was made Cavaliere del Lavoro in 1989, Cavaliere della Repubblica in 2000 and awarded the honor of Marche region in 2001. In 2014 he opened the Illy Couture Museum in his birthplace of Savona, Italy, which has become a popular attraction. In 2018, he was admitted to the Italian Group of fifteen research center. He is featured in the 2019 documentary film Metello, Mezzo Cento Mani. Works [1]

Special Suppressive Antiterrorist Unit The Special Suppressive Antiterrorist Unit (Ειδικό Αντιτρομοκρατικό Μονάδα, EAEM) is the elite special operations unit of the Hellenic Police, under the direct command of the Chief of Police. The unit was founded in 1978, following a decision of the National Police Directory, in order to combat terrorism and handle hostage crises. The unit's first mission was to release the hostages in the Turkish embassy in Greece. The unit is composed of 32 officers. Most of them are officers of the Hellenic Police's Department of Special Services, while some are drawn from the army's special forces (i.e. the Greek Special Forces, the Special Parachute Unit and the Counter-Guerrilla Service). The unit's missions include: - Counter-terrorism - Handling hostage crises - Suppressing civil unrest - Executive protection - Covert operations The unit's main objective is to respond to terrorist attacks and hostage crises. To this end, the unit has been equipped with the latest technology and trained in the best facilities both in Greece and abroad. The unit's officers have been deployed in the NATO SFOR in the past, and they have also been sent to Iraq, Afghanistan and the Palestinian Territories in order to provide protection to the GreekEmbassies and Consulates, as well as to participate in special operations alongside their international counterparts. In 2008, the unit was awarded the Gold Cross of Honor for its contribution to the antiterrorist effort.

Der Bahnhof Berlin Wuhletal ist ein Bahnhof im Osten der Stadt Berlin in Deutschland. Er ist ein wichtiger Haltepunkt an der Berliner S-Bahn-Linie 5. Der Bahnhof Berlin Wuhletal liegt im Stadtteil Marzahn im Bezirk Marzahn-Hellersdorf, ungefähr 2 km östlich vom Berliner Stadtzentrum entfernt. Eine Besonderheit ist, dass sich im Bereich des Bahnhofs Berlin-Wuhletal ein bedeutendes Waldgebiet befindet, das zu Erholungszwecken genutzt werden kann. Neben der Berliner S-Bahn-Haltestelle befindet sich hier auch ein Busbahnhof, der von mehreren Buslinien des öffentlichen Personennahverkehrs, der Berliner Verkehrsbetriebe und regionalen Busgesellschaften angefahren wird. Der Bahnhof ist barrierefrei erreichbar und bietet eine Anschlussmöglichkeit zu verschiedenen Straßenbahn- und Buslinien. Die Bahnhofsmission, ein Service für sozial schwache Menschen, ist hier auch vertreten. Die S-Bahn-Station wurde im Jahr 1989 eröffnet und bietet eine Verbindung in Richtung Stadtzentrum und nach Strausberg. Sie ist daher eine wichtige Anlaufstelle für Pendler in den umliegenden Orten. Im Jahr 2016 hat der Bahnhof Berlin Wuhletal einen neuen Anstrich erhalten, der von einem internationalen Graffiti-Künstler aufgebracht wurde. Die Säulen am Bahnsteig wurden mit farbenfrohen Motiven verziert. Darüber hinaus bietet der Bahnhof Berlin Wuhletal verschiedene Dienstleistungen und Einrichtungen wie ein Parkhaus, WC, Fahrkartenautomaten, Kioske sowie Fahrradabstellplätze.

Jakarta, CNN Indonesia -- Puluhan ribu anggota Banser Siaga atau Barisan Ansor Serba Guna Siaga dari wilayah Jawa, Bali, Sulawesi dan Nusa Tenggara Timur, sepakat untuk menggelar aksi demonstrasi ke markas Pengurus Besar Nahdlatul Ulama (PBNU) pada bulan depan. Para demonstran akan memprotes serangkaian rencana dan kebijakan pihak PBNU, khususnya terkait lawatan Gus Yahya. Kuasa hukum perwakilan pengadu, Asad Wahyudi, mengungkapkan bahwa demonstrasi tersebut akan dilakukan pada tanggal 15 Juni 2021. "Rencananya pembacaan surat keputusan serta pidato dan orasi dari sejumlah tokoh akan dimaksud dalam aksi tersebut", kata Asad kepada CNN Indonesia pada Kamis (27/5). Mereka yang hadir di depan markas PBNU nantinya juga akan membawa sejumlah spanduk dan poster dengan sejumlah tuntutan. Di antaranya menolak segala bentuk penindasan dan penganiayaan kepada anggota Banser Siaga, menuntut PBNU menghentikan kebijakan yang merugikan Banser Siaga seperti penghapusan alokasi anggaran dan pemutusan program seperti bantuan sembako dan pendistribusian obat gratis. Banser Siaga sendiri merupakan ormas pelopor program bakti sosial Nahdlatul Ulama. Sejak awal pandemi, Banser Siaga sudah terlibat dalam penanganan Covid-19 dengan memberikan bantuan sembako, obat-obatan dan masksr secara gratis kepada masyarakat terdampak. Dalam hal ini, perwakilan pengadu menyampaikan bahwa tuntutan aksi demonstrasi para Banser Siaga masih relevan. "Selain itu, tuntutan untuk menghentikan lawatan Gus Yahya juga menjadi salah satu tuntutan dalam aksi yang akan datang," jelas Asad. Sebagaimana diketahui, PBNU merencanakan kunjungan Gus Yahya setelah sebelumnya ser serangkaian kegiatan baik internal dan eksternal PBNU harus tertunda karena pandemi. Lawatan Gus Yahya dapat menjadi momen yang penting bagi gerakan Banser Siaga, terutama depan jajaran pengurus NU pusat. "Mereka akan menyoroti kembali kebijakan-kebijakan PBNU yang dinilai merugikan Banser Siaga," tandas pengacara tersebut. Soal rencana demonstrasi ini, PBNU mengaku akan membuka dialog dengan para pengunjuk rasa. Wakil Ketua Umum Jam’iyah Ahlith Thariqah Al-Mu’tabarah An-Nahdliyah, H Achmad Yasin, mengatakan bahwa PBNU siap menerima tuntutan Banser Siaga. "Kami tentu akan membuka ruang dialog ataupun komunikasi dengan para pengunjuk rasa. PBNU sebagai induk ormas banser akan berupaya agar tuntutan mereka tertampung secara tersedia atau terukur," kata Achmad. Namun, hingga kini belum ada kejelasan soal izin aksi demonstrasi ini dari Kepolisian. Kepala Bidang Hubungan Masyarakat Polda Metro Jaya, Komisaris Besar Polisi Yusri Yunus, mengatakan belum menerima pemberitahuan resmi dari Banser Siaga terkait aksi demonstrasi mereka.(*RF)

MN1 (gene) The MN1 gene also known as Menin 1 is a protein-coding gene that plays a crucial role in embryonic development, hematopoiesis, and nervous system function. It is located on chromosome 22 and encodes for a protein known as menin that functions as a transcriptional regulator. Structure The MN1 gene is made up of 22 exons and spans over 96 kilobases of DNA. Its protein product, menin, is a 610 amino acid protein that contains two nuclear localization signals, a DNA-binding domain, and numerous protein-protein interaction domains. Function The MN1 gene is widely expressed during embryonic development and is essential for proper development of the central nervous system, hematopoiesis, and formation of the pancreas. In adults, the gene is found in a broad range of tissues and is involved in numerous cellular processes. It functions as a transcriptional regulator, controlling the expression of a wide variety of genes involved in cell cycle regulation, apoptosis, and DNA repair. Role in Cancer Mutations in the MN1 gene have been reported in several types of cancer, including acute myeloid leukemia (AML), pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors, and gliomas. The mutations have been shown to confer a proliferative advantage to cancer cells by deregulating cell cycle progression and promoting tumor cell survival. In addition, the menin protein has been found to interact with other cancer-associated genes, such as the oncogene MLL, and may play a role in the development of several types of cancer. Clinical significance Several studies have suggested that abnormal MN1 expression or mutations in the gene may serve as biomarkers for cancer diagnosis or act as therapeutic targets in cancer treatment. For example, small molecule inhibitors of the menin protein are being investigated as potential cancer therapeutics. Conclusion The MN1 gene is a crucial regulator of embryonic development and adult cellular processes such as cell cycle regulation, DNA repair, and apoptosis. Mutations in this gene have been linked to several types of cancer, highlighting the importance of understanding its function in human biology and disease.

The troubadour or trobador was a courtly singer and a minstrel in the middle ages. The name derives from a small bagpipe. The Troubadour style of singing is characterized by its simplicity and directness, the use of plain and clear diction over involved word-spinning and complex rhyme. It is considered a fundamental style in European musical history. Some notable troubadours included Angevin courtly singer JEAN DE VIVES, medieval Spanish minstrel RAOUL OF BARLAVIA and Italian singer/songwriter GUY BERKMAN. The form a widespread into the Renaissance and into the early modern period. The form returned in popularity in the 20th century, first with Singers such as Constantin Stanislavski and Madame Yvonne Arnaud, then with the establishment of song academies in Eastern Europe and later in the United States and Italy. The American Academy of Lyric Arts (AALA) and the American Songwriter's Academy are two such institutions that provide structured courses in the Troubadour style. In the 21st century the Troubadour style has been championed by Acclaimed Songwriter, Neil Larsen whose compositions feature consistently high rankings in Songwriting Contests. His book "The Songwriting Journey" is the first comprehensive treatment of the style. A sample stanza from "The Miller's Son" demonstrates the style: Count your coins and stop your plucking, Sing of girlish grace and trusty rifles, And of how you spotted a single chiding grain of wheat, When all around was drought and mounting chapman's sky.

In this paper we apply a wavelet analysis on the sphere to galaxy survey data in order to extract cosmological information. The wavelet transform, with its multiscale and multifrequential properties, is ideally suited to capture features on different scales and in different frequency domains. We apply the technique to the LasDamas I survey and a mock galaxy survey produced with N-body simulations. We use three different cosmological parameters constrained by the spherical wavelet coefficients: the density parameter Ω, the equation of state parameter w and the amplitude A of the initial conditions power spectrum. We find that, with current galaxy surveys, Ω and A can be determined with a accuracy of 5% or better, while w cannot be determined within the current errors. However, the estimation of w could be significantly improved using a larger survey or a combination of surveys. We also develop methods to estimate the errors on the spherical wavelet coefficients, and test them on the LasDamas I survey. The methods we propose show that the errors on the wavelet coefficients are not Gaussian distributed, and hence provide a more realistic estimation of the errors. We demonstrate that, by combining the wavelet coefficients with other techniques, such as a Gaussian approximation to the posterior distribution of w, we can significantly reduce the errors on w. We apply our technique to the LasDamas I survey, and find that the combination of the spherical wavelet analysis with other analysis techniques results in an accurate determination of Ω and A, and an upper limit on w of -0.9 at 2σ confidence level. Finally, we forecast the errors on Ω, w and A that could be achieved using future galaxy surveys like DES, EUCLID and SKA. In addition to a significant increase in volume, these surveys will have significantly better redshifts and higher photometry, leading to a much more accurate determination of Ω and A, and the possibility of determining w with high precision.

Jakarta, CNN Indonesia -- Xiaomi, produsen smartphone asal China, kembali mengeluarkan produk-baru mereka di pasar Indonesia. Sindora tonkinensis, commonly known as the Tonkin fishwood or rau đè, is a tree species belonging to the family Fabaceae. It is native to Southeast Asia, specifically in Vietnam and Thailand. The tree is popular in traditional medicine and is also used for its timber and resin. Description Sindora tonkinensis is a tall tree that can grow up to 30 meters in height. Its trunk is straight and can grow up to 60 cm in diameter. The bark of the tree is smooth and gray, while its leaves are arranged in a pinnate pattern and can grow up to 20 cm long. The tree produces fragrant flowers that are pink to red in color, which are then followed by legume fruits that contain seeds. Uses Sindora tonkinensis is widely used in traditional medicine in Southeast Asia as it is said to have various medicinal properties. It is believed to be effective in treating fever, cough, and sore throat. The tree's leaves, bark, and resin are used for their therapeutic properties. The timber of the tree is also used for carpentry and furniture-making. The wood is hard, heavy, and durable, making it an excellent choice for construction materials. Its resin, which is known as Tonkin gum, is used in various industries such as varnish, glue, and lacquer production. Conservation Sindora tonkinensis is currently facing threats to its survival due to deforestation and habitat loss. The increase in commercial logging and land development has decreased the population of the tree in the wild. It is currently listed as a vulnerable species by the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN). Efforts are being made to conserve the tree species, such as through seed collection and propagation in nurseries. Efforts are also being made to raise awareness about the value of this species and the need to conserve it for future generations. In conclusion, Sindora tonkinensis is an important tree species in Southeast Asia. With its medicinal properties, durable timber, and versatile resin, the tree is an essential part of traditional medicine, carpentry, and various industries. It is important to conserve this species to ensure its survival and the benefits it provides to society.

The average temperature of space is 2.7 kelvins (−455.4 degrees Fahrenheit). That's pretty close to absolute zero, which is the point at which all motion in the particles of matter stops (−459.67 degrees Fahrenheit). Space is so cold because it contains very little matter. The sun, on the other hand, is very hot. The sun's surface temperature is about 5,500 kelvins (9,941 degrees Fahrenheit). The sun is so hot because it's full of matter (mainly hydrogen and helium) that gives off a lot of energy. If you traveled toward the sun, the space around you would get hotter and hotter. Eventually, it would be the same temperature as the surface of the sun — but you wouldn't be able to get that close to the sun without burning up!

Haboku sansui is Japanese for "house cleaningoplasma". It is a state of blissful exhaustion that can come from completely scrubbing all surfaces in a room, most notably kitchen and bathrooms. The idea is to clean to a point where you feel like you could pour yourself a glass of water and drink it. The cleanest places in a home are usually hallways and kitchen cabinets. Once you start cleaning these spaces you become emotionally saturated and almost cleaning chases away any sense of exhaustion. In Japanese culture there is a long history of "Haboku" where people will ritually cleanse their homes. The word haboku comes from habutabaru which refers to a 3rd century period in Japan where people would ritually purge their homes of all impurities. During this time there was a contraction of germs and disease which left Japan at the time experiencing a period of rice shortages and therefore food shortages. The act of completely cleansing your home is difficult to explain. It feels great but it is very time consuming. Some people will use cleaning sheets to organize their work of tidying up. These are sheets of material that are typically pink or blue and have images of dogs, children, babies on them. These are often given as gifts or printed for advertisements. However, using these types of materials only helps for so much. It takes mental and physical energy to completely scrub all surfaces in a space. You have to scrub the kitchen sink, the cabinet doors, the toilet bowl, the faucets, the grout between tiles, the backs of appliances, and the tops of windows. You also have to scrub a full range of emotions, from being angry that the dishwasher isn't empty to having that sinking feeling that you may have missed a spot. Some people feel that haboku feels euphoric but it is also exhausting. It feels great but can also lead to insomnia because you are so exhausted. Some people will try to complete haboku in under an hour. Others will spend days on it. It is a ritual that only people who have lived in a space for a long time really understand.

In practice, the Soviet Union did not always follow the Deep Battle theory. For example, in the early 1960s, the Soviet Union launched a limited-scale attack against Cuba, and in the late 1980s, the Soviet Union launched a large-scale attack against Afghanistan. In both cases, the Soviet Union was not able to achieve a quick and decisive victory.

Jakarta, CNN Indonesia -- Fashion selalu menjadi salah satu hal yang menarik perhatian dari setiap orang. Bisa dibilang, dia adalah salah satu pesepak bola yang tidak hanya piawai dalam lapangan hijau, namun juga dalam dunia fashion. Koleksi fashion Ozil memang selalu menarik perhatian. Baginya, penampilan yang baik juga membawa dampak bagus pada mental serta performa di lapangan. Tidak jarang, Ozil bahkan berkonsultasi dengan stylist untuk menentukan busana yang tepat untuk digunakan dalam acara tertentu. Meskipun terkenal dengan penampilannya yang fashionable, Ozil tidak gagal dalam mempertahankan sisi maskulin dalam setiap pilihan fashion-nya. Dia kerap terlihat menggunakan setelan jas yang elegan namun tetap simpel dan klasik. Selain itu, Ozil juga memperlihatkan gaya fashion yang athleisure dalam parade busana karyanya sendiri. Bagi penggemar fashion, pasti tidak mengherankan jika Ozil kerap menjadi bahan perbincangan dalam hal fashion. Banyak penikmat fesyen yang mengaku terinspirasi melalui penampilan Ozil yang selalu tampil stylish. Memiliki passion pada fashion, Ozil juga tak ragu untuk membagikan penampilannya di akun Instagram miliknya. Dalam setiap unggahannya, dia terlihat percaya diri dan memberi inspirasi bagi pengikutnya. Itulah tadi koleksi fashion dari Mesut Ozil yang selalu menarik perhatian. Selain merupakan pemain sepak bola yang sukses, dia juga memiliki gaya fashion yang unik dan stylish. Semoga dengan keunikannya ini, pria yang saat ini membela klub Turki, Fenerbahce ini terus memberikan inspirasi bagi para penggemar fesyen.

Thomas Martin (born 19 December 1979) is a British Conservative politician who has been the Member of Parliament (MP) for North West Norfolk since 2010. He was educated at Boots High School, Gresham’s School and Girton College, Cambridge. He went on to work for the Conservative party as a Policy Adviser and Head of the Policy Unit. Martin has been very vocal in the House of Commons and has spoken on a various range of topics, such as deregulation, digital infrastructure, housing and immigration. He has been a member of the Public Administration and Constitutional Affairs Committee, the Environmental Audit Committee and the Public Accounts Committee. He has also regularly spoken on behalf of the government in the House of Commons, supporting the Prime Minister on Brexit-related issues and issues relating to infrastructure, particularly rapid rail. In terms of wider community engagement, Martin has been a long-term supporter of the arts and is a strong advocate for education, regularly speaking on the importance of investing in the next generation. In 2020, he was appointed as the UK Representative to the World Youth Congress, a group of global young leaders who work to improve the lives of young people. As a backbencher, Martin has remained an active campaigner on key policy issues and in parliament he frequently voted in favour of greater welfare spending, higher taxes and tighter gun control. In 2017, he was part of the Sustainable Growth Group which attempted to push the Conservative party to adopt a number of green policies and take the lead in tackling global warming. Most recently, in January 2021, Martin was appointed as a Government Whip in the Johnson ministry, a role in which he will work to ensure the success of Johnson’s legislative agenda. He is set to play an important role in the government during this period of change, particularly in the upcoming Brexit negotiations. Overall, Martin has been a consistent defender of the Conservative party and a keen proponent of the Prime Minister’s vision for the UK. He has shown a willingness to speak out on various issues, and his appointment to the Government Whip position is likely to see him have a big role in the Prime Minister’s future plans.

The environmental impact of World War II was most evident in the areas where the fighting took place. In Europe, the war left a trail of ruined cities, industrial complexes, and transportation networks. The environmental damage was also severe in the Pacific, where the fighting was often fought over small islands.

The environmental impact of World War II was also felt in the United States. The war effort consumed large quantities of natural resources, and the industrial activity associated with the war led to air and water pollution. We study a model of collaborative communication systems where the underlying channel is time-varying and the receivers are allowed to make use of a noisy and inexpensive clock synchronization protocol. We show that a lack of symmetry in the channel may drastically degrade the performance of the synchronization protocol, and consequently the performance of the communication system, in terms of achievable throughput and delay. We propose a simple technique which, under certain assumptions, can improve the performance of the communication system by means of a clocked cooperative communication protocol. Our technique is based on the idea of turning the channel into a symmetric-like channel by appropriately designing the communication schedule. We show that under our assumptions, the proposed technique can achieve a performance close to that achievable by a protocol designed for a symmetric channel, in terms of delay and throughput. We complement our theoretical analysis with simulation results.

Jakarta, CNN Indonesia -- Komisi Perlindungan Anak Indonesia (KPAI) tengah melakukan penyelidikan terkait video viral yang menunjukkan seorang anak kecil sedang menghisap rokok yang diberikan oleh orang tuanya. Video tersebut pertama kali muncul di media sosial dan menjadi viral setelah diunggah oleh salah satu netizen. Dalam video yang berdurasi beberapa detik tersebut, terlihat seorang anak kecil yang masih mengenakan baju tidur sedang duduk di sofa sambil memegang sebatang rokok. Kemudian, seorang wanita yang diduga sebagai ibunya memberikan api pada rokok tersebut sebelum anak tersebut mulai menghisapnya dengan penuh semangat. Video tersebut menuai kecaman luas dari masyarakat karena menganggap tindakan orang tua tersebut sangat tidak bertanggung jawab dan mengancam kesehatan anak tersebut. Setelah mengetahui keberadaan video viral tersebut, KPAI langsung mengambil tindakan untuk mengecek kebenarannya. Kepala Divisi Investigasi KPAI, Jasra Putra mengatakan bahwa pihaknya akan melakukan penyelidikan lebih lanjut dan meminta bantuan dari pihak kepolisian untuk mengidentifikasi orang tua dan anak dalam video tersebut. "Kami sudah menerima laporan adanya video yang memperlihatkan anak kecil di bawah umur menghisap rokok yang diberikan oleh orang tuanya. Kami akan mencari tahu kebenarannya, apakah itu benar terjadi atau hanya rekayasa semata. Jika memang benar, tindakan orang tua tersebut sangat bertentangan dengan hak-hak anak," tegas Jasra. Menurutnya, tindakan orang tua yang memberikan rokok pada anak kecil sangat merugikan kesehatan dan hak-hak anak. Selain itu, tindakan tersebut juga melanggar undang-undang yang mengatur perlindungan anak di Indonesia. "Dalam Undang-Undang Perlindungan Anak, anak memiliki hak untuk mendapatkan perlindungan dari tindakan kekerasan, diskriminasi, eksploitasi, dan pengabaian serta hak atas hidup, tumbuh kembang, dan pendidikan yang baik. Tindakan tersebut sangat bertentangan dengan hal tersebut," ujarnya. Jasra menjelaskan bahwa pihak KPAI akan berkoordinasi dengan pihak kepolisian untuk menemukan orang tua dan anak dalam video tersebut guna memastikan keadaan anak tersebut dan memberikan perlindungan yang sesuai. Jika terbukti benar, orang tua tersebut bisa dijerat dengan Undang-Undang Nomor 35 Tahun 2014 tentang Perlindungan Anak yang mengatur bahwa orang tua atau wali yang melawan kewajibannya untuk melindungi anak dapat dipidana dengan pidana penjara maksimum 15 tahun. "Kami mengimbau kepada seluruh masyarakat untuk bersama-sama melindungi hak-hak anak dan melaporkan segala tindakan yang merugikan anak kepada pihak yang berwenang," pungkas Jasra.

We study the remnants produced by merging two CO WDs with different masses and spin configurations, using fully general relativistic hydrodynamic simulations. We find that for most cases studied here (except when one WD is very massive), the merger product will be an ellipsoidal object surrounded by a thick disk-like structure. The final mass of this merged system ranges between 0.6-1.1 M⊙ depending on the initial conditions. For some systems we also observe the formation of a thin accretion disk around the central core. In addition to these results, we show that there are several possible outcomes in terms of the amount of material ejected during the merger process. Depending on the total mass of the binary system, the merger can produce either no or significant amounts of ejecta ranging up to 10−2M⊙. Finally, we discuss how our results compare with previous studies as well as future prospects. 
 
 Keywords: White dwarfs

We show how to construct, for any countable group $G$, a type II_1 factor $M$ with fundamental group $G$. We do this by constructing, for any such $G$, a counterexample to the statements that (1) every type II_1 factor is homeomorphic to a bouquet of circles and (2) every type II_1 factor has a unique essential subgroup.

The construction of type II_1 factors with prescribed fundamental group was originally given by Plaza and Teleman [Pla90]. Their construction was based on the theory of twisting sheaves; their counterexamples were type II_1 factors which, in the stable range, twisted a certain sheaf of germs of modules in a certain vector space. Recently Varmark has given a construction of type II_1 factors with prescribed fundamental group using the theory offunctors [Varm97].

We give a construction of type II_1 factors with prescribed fundamental group which is based on the theory of L-categories. We show that our construction produces a counterexample to (1) above. As a by-product of our construction, we produce a counterexample to (2) above.

We propose to use the IceCube detector at South Pole for probing new physics beyond Standard Model (SM) by searching for deviations in the energy spectrum and angular distribution of atmospheric muon neutrinos produced in cosmic ray showers on Earth atmosphere, due to possible non-standard neutrino-nucleus scattering processes mediated by heavy particles such as WIMPs or axions. The proposed search is complementary to other searches performed using solar, reactor and accelerator neutrinos.  We show that this method can be used to probe cross sections down to 10^(-41) cm^2/GeV for neutral current elastic scattering off nuclei induced by light dark matter candidates like Majorana neutrinos and Kaluza-Klein gravitons. For heavier dark matter candidates we find that the sensitivity decreases rapidly but still remains competitive compared to direct detection experiments. The supposed idea that we lost the ability to create concrete with the fall of Rome is not entirely correct. The use of concrete was widespread in other cultures and civilizations that existed simultaneously with Rome and even before it. For instance, the Egyptians used concrete in their structures as early as 2500 BC.

However, the quality of concrete used by the Romans was significantly superior and more refined than the rest. The Roman concrete, also known as Opus Caementicium, was a mixture made up of volcanic ash, lime, and chunks of broken rocks. The uniqueness of the Roman concrete was its superior strength, durability, and resilience, which kept their monuments and structures standing for thousands of years.

After the fall of the Western Roman Empire, the use of Roman concrete gradually declined, and the recipe for creating it was lost. The reasons for this are not clear, but some scholars suggest wars, invasions, and the consequent loss of skilled masons and architects who had an in-depth understanding of the craft.

Moreover, with the rise of Christianity, there was a general shift away from the use of concrete, as it was associated with Roman paganism. This shift led to the loss of knowledge of the Opus Caementicium recipe, and as a result, concrete was replaced with other building materials like wood and brick.

It wasn't until the 19th century that interest in Roman concrete was rekindled, and researchers identified the primary ingredients of the Opus Caementicium. With new technological advancements, concrete production became more efficient, and the Romans' recipe is now used as a base for modern concrete.

In conclusion, the fall of Rome didn't cause the loss of the ability to create concrete. Instead, other factors like wars, invasions, and the rise of Christianity caused a decline in the use of Roman concrete and ultimately led to the loss of knowledge of the recipe.

We study the evolution of solitary waves and undulations on a gradually sloping beach by solving numerically the fully nonlinear Boussinesq equations for water wave motion, including both surface tension effects and bottom friction. The numerical results show that the amplitude of the leading soliton decreases as it propagates along the beach due to energy dissipation caused by bottom friction; meanwhile, its speed increases slightly because of the decrease in depth. As a result, the trailing part of the soliton becomes steeper than the front part. When the leading soliton reaches the shoreline, it breaks into several smaller solitons which then propagate further up the beach. In addition, we find that the breaking point is determined mainly by the initial amplitude of the soliton rather than by the initial phase difference between the two components of the soliton. Finally, we present some experimental data obtained at the University of Hawaii's Waimea Bay Laboratory showing good agreement with our theoretical predictions.

Kue cubit is a popular street food snack in Indonesia, particularly in Jakarta, Depok, Tangerang, and Bekasi. The name "kue cubit" means "pinch cake" in Indonesian. When the batter starts to rise, the cook pinches the top of the batter with a pair of tongs to create a small, rounded shape and flips the kue cubit over to cook the other side. The finished product is small, fluffy, and slightly crisp on the outside. There are many variations of kue cubit, from the original plain version to the more creative and colorful ones. Flavors such as chocolate, cheese, pandan, and strawberry are popular among Indonesians, especially among young generations. Some vendors even offer toppings like sprinkles, chocolate chips, and condensed milk to complement the taste. Kue cubit has become a favorite among Indonesians of all ages, particularly as a snack for children. It is sold in many places, including traditional markets, street vendors, and malls. In this study, we present a model that explores the polarimetric variability of hot star winds, which is caused by the clumping of ionized gas in the wind. This phenomenon leads to strong polarization signals that can be observed with polarimeters, providing valuable insights into the dynamics and structure of hot star winds. We developed a Monte Carlo radiative transfer code that takes into account the non-spherical shapes of clumps, as well as their internal properties such as density, temperature, and ionization fraction. Our model predicts the polarization spectrum of a clumped wind, from the UV to the near-IR spectral range, and accounts for the effects of geometric projection, selective absorption, and electron and dust scattering.

The results obtained from our model show that clumping-induced polarization signals are highly sensitive to clump properties such as size, filling factor, and velocity dispersion. The polarization angle also varies significantly with wavelength and depends on the clump geometry. We compare our model predictions with observational data of hot star winds, such as the O-star HD 163758, and find good agreement with the measured polarization angles and degree of polarization.

The motivation for this research lies in the need to understand the complex and often poorly understood physics of hot star winds. By modeling the polarization properties of clumped winds, we can gain insight into the clump formation process, wind variability, and the interaction between the wind and its environment. Our results provide a useful framework for interpreting future polarimetric observations of hot star winds and improving our understanding of these intriguing astrophysical environments.

In this research paper, we work on the Lagrangian quantum field theory (LQFT) in the momentum picture with a focus on the commutation relations for free fields. The central problem we attempt to solve is the lack of a clear understanding of the operators that describe the quantum fields and their properties. This paper provides insight into the way these operators behave and their interrelations with each other.

To investigate these properties, we use the framework of the LQFT and adopt the Fourier transformation of the fields. We then obtain the commutation relations among the annihilation and creation operators using the Hamiltonian and the field equations. We analyze the commutators in different regions of the momentum space, including a detailed study of the ultraviolet and infrared regimes, and the limit of coinciding points.

The results obtained are significant for understanding quantum field theories, especially in relation to the behavior of free fields. Our findings indicate that the operators that describe the fields obey the fundamental commutation rules, which are crucial in quantum mechanics. These results provide a firm mathematical foundation for further research on the LQFT and related subjects. Moreover, our work provides valuable guidance for practitioners to avoid interpretational contradictions in the quantization of fields.

We present an analysis of ellipsoidal oscillations induced in main-sequence stars by their substellar companions, and discuss prospects for detecting such signals with the Kepler mission. We find that these effects are detectable over a wide range of orbital periods (from 1 to 1000 days) and companion masses (0.1-10 MJ). The amplitude of the signal is proportional to the square root of the mass ratio between the star and its companion; it can be as large as 0.1% of the total flux at optical wavelengths. For typical parameters expected among planet-hosting systems, we estimate that this effect should produce a peak-to-peak variation in brightness on the order of 10 mmag or less. This level of precision will require several months of continuous observations using the Kepler spacecraft's photometer. However, if detected, the presence of such a signal would provide strong evidence for the existence of a low-mass stellar or planetary companion orbiting the primary star. 
 
 Keywords: Ellipsoidal variations, Planetary system

George Thomson, Baron Thomson of Monifieth (7 May 1921 – 24 January 2006) was a British newspaper executive and Labour politician. Thomson was born in Aberdeen, the son of George Thomson, a journalist, and his wife Helen, née Smith. He was educated at Aberdeen Grammar School, the University of Aberdeen and the London School of Economics. He served in the Royal Army Ordnance Corps from 1942 to 1945. After the war, he became a journalist, working on the Aberdeen Journal and then becoming a sub-editor on the Daily Express in London. In 1950 he joined the Daily Mirror, where he became a feature writer and then a leader writer. He was appointed assistant editor in 1954, and then editor in 1961. He remained in this position until the early 1970s, when he became managing editor. He was also a director of the newspaper's parent company, Associated Newpapers Ltd., from 1962 to 1974. In 1976, he became chairman of the board of Mirror Group Newspapers, serving in this position until 1983. He was also chairman of the International Press Institute from 1978 to 1982. In the 1960s, Thomson was a member of the committee of the Society of Editors. He was also a member of the board of governors of the London School of Economics from 1965 to 1971, and a member of the council of the Royal Society of Arts from 1973 to 1978. In 1974, he was a member of the committee of the Press Gallery Dinner. He was also a member of the advisory committee on the teaching of journalism at the University of Wales from 1974 to 1975, and a member of the board of governors of the British Film Institute from 1975 to 1980. In the 1970s, Thomson was a member of the executive committee of the British National Institute for Economic and Social Research. He was also a member of the advisory committee on the development of a Scottish national newspaper, the committee on the review of the press and broadcasting and the committee on privacy in the press. In 1976, he was a member of the committee on direct grants to industry. In 1975, Thomson was awarded an honorary Doctor of Laws by the University of Aberdeen. He was made a Knight Bachelor in 1976 and created a life peer as Baron Thomson of Monifieth, of Monifieth in the county of Angus, on 17 January 1983. He was a member of the House of Lords for twenty-two years, until his death. Lord Thomson of Monifieth married twice. He married his first wife, Elizabeth, in 1947 and they had three sons and one daughter. After her death in 1983, he married his second wife, Diana, in 1986.

While the bar has been set very low for America's Founding Fathers when it comes to being a good general, Washington was easily one of the best. He was a military man at heart and grew up fighting off Indians in the Ohio Valley. He was an expert at warfare from a young age and at 17, he became a farmer to fund his own military training. After many campaigns in the New York and New Jersey area, he caught the eye of the British, who offered him a commission as a Colonel in the British Army. Washington turned it down, instead choosing to command a small militia group in Pennsylvania. It was there that he won the hearts of the American people, defeating the French at Fort Necessity. This pivotal victory bought time for other militia leaders to join forces with Washington, and after a number of battles, he was able to drive the British from the territory that would become the United States. This incredible victory earned him the nickname, "The Father of His Country", as well as enough political power to become the first President of the United States. He continued to lead troops throughout the war, including a crucial victory over the British at Yorktown. After the war, he retired from political life, only returning for two terms as President. He died in 1799 at the age of 67. While he had many faults, including his inability to tolerate loss, he was still one of America's greatest Founding Fathers and one of the best military commanders in history.

In this article we consider two closely related notions of information density defined in the context of finite state automata (FSA). The first, used for instance in the Kolmogorov complexity theory, is based on the length of the shortest program needed to generate a string. This density is always greater or equal to the second density, related to Lempel-Ziv compression, and often much greater. Both definitions coincide for FSA with a unary input, but in the general case they are different and sometimes vastly so. For example, the pushdown automaton with one pushdown symbol having two internal states generating binary sequences of length 2n has bounded pushdown dimension 1, but Lempel-Ziv information density 2n. We also show that for every real number x there exists an automaton having bounded pushdown dimension 1 but Lempel-Ziv information density at most x. Overall, the relation between pushdown dimension and Lempel-Ziv information density is highly nontrivial and, as far as we are aware, has not been previously noted.

Casablanca (novella) is a novella written by Edmonde Charles-Roux and published in 1961. How to Prepare Yourself for a Horse Show
Attending a horse show is a fun and exciting event, but it can also be nerve-wracking if you are not adequately prepared. Making sure that you and your horse are both set and ready to go for the show is important to ensuring success. Here are a few things to keep in mind while you’re preparing yourself and your horse for the show.

Make a list of all of the things that you and your horse need to take to the show. This should include items like tack, grooming supplies, show clothes, and protective gear. Make sure to review this list and add or remove things as you think of them. This will help you ensure that you have everything you need and nothing gets forgotten.

As part of this list, take a look at the list under the section “Things You’ll Need”. This section will give you details about items such as a shoe rack, grooming box, grooming supplies, and other items you will need for the show.

When it comes to the day before the show, make sure that everything is packed in the car and ready to go. Don’t forget to clean all of the items properly with the right cleaner so that nothing becomes ruined during the show. It can also be beneficial to come up with a plan for where to store the items, such as in your tack box or a spare room in the house, so you can easily access them as needed.

In addition, do not forget to bring your work saddle and show saddle, as well additional halter and lead ropes. You should also have an under pad, bucket hangers, and a grooming box. Additionally, make sure to bring more than one hoof pick, have your show clothes and makeup packed in garment bags, as well as plenty of fly spray, all of the bathing items, and make sure your show mane bands match your horse’s mane color.

On the day of the show, make sure you have enough hay and water for your horse in the event of a hot morning or long ride. In addition, make sure your horse is outfitted with the appropriate protective gear when trailering. Planning to leave early is also important in the event of accidents or heavy traffic. When you arrive, you may need assistance with set up and other tasks, so it’s important to have someone who can help make sure you and your horse are both ready to go.

Before you enter the show ring, make sure your horse is adequately fed at least 1 ½-2 hours prior and have the two of you cleaned up. It’s also essential that you don’t be late for any of your classes, otherwise you can risk forfeiting your chance of placing. Lastly, try not to panic while in the show ring should you run into any difficulties. Keep your head and stay focused until the final bell.

Overall, preparing yourself and your horse for a horse show is an important task prior to attending the show. Make sure to make a list of all the things that you need, review the list of “Things You’ll Need”, and have your horse and yourself clean and ready to go for the show. Pack the items the day before and leave early the day of the show. Remain calm and focused while you are competing, as well as follow the rules and regulations. Following these steps should help ensure that you and your horse have a successful horse show.

The present work is devoted to the study of quantum mechanics in polymer chains, which are modeled as one-dimensional systems with nearest-neighbor interactions between particles.  We consider two different models for such systems:  The first model describes an ensemble of interacting fermions on a chain; it can be viewed as a generalization of the Hubbard model (which corresponds to spinless fermions) to include spin-dependent hopping amplitudes and repulsive interaction terms.  In this case we show that there exists a critical value U_c of the interaction strength above which the ground state energy per particle becomes negative.  This result implies that the ground state of the system undergoes a phase transition at U = U_c from a metallic-like phase into an insulating phase.   The second model considered here consists of bosons moving along a ring subject to periodic boundary conditions.  Here we prove rigorously that the ground-state energy per particle converges to zero when the number N of particles tends to infinity.  Moreover, we provide upper bounds on the rate of convergence towards the limit.  These results imply that the ground state of our system exhibits superfluid behavior.

This article re-examines the magnetic fields of stars of the upper main sequence, focusing on those with precise Hipparcos parallaxes and accurately determined longitudinal magnetic fields. We observe that stars with masses below 3 M_sun concentrate closer to the main-sequence band, while those above 3 M_sun tend to be closer to the Zero Age Main Sequence (ZAMS). From study of stars in nearby open clusters, we find that higher temperatures, younger ages, larger masses and shorter rotation periods are associated with increased magnetic fields strength. We also note that while the magnetic flux remains constant during the star's main sequence life, the distribution of obliquity angles beta appears to be random at first but then when the star is observable on the H-R diagram, either 0 or 90 degrees is more common for stars of mass lower than 3 M_sun. Though there is a hint of increases in beta with effect of the main sequence passage for stars with a mass higher than 3 M_sun, no such trend is established in stars with lower masses.

The Swiss Mercenaries of the 16th century were seen as a formidable force, and one of the most effective military styles of their time. They were renowned for their pike formations and their ability to move quickly and decisively on the battlefield. Swiss soldiers were known for their expertise in close-quarters combat; they had mastered a type of fighting known as thrusting and hacking with pikes, halberds, and longswords. Swiss training emphasized weapon-use and close-quarters fighting. As a result, Swiss mercenaries were known for their excellence in hand-to-hand combat and their ability to face heavy infantry in battle. 

The Landsknechte, on the other hand, were much more versatile than the Swiss. While they also emphasized hand-to-hand combat and pike formations, they also placed an emphasis on firepower provided by heavy artillery and firearms. Landsknechte were renowned for their expertise in mobile fighting, as they could maneuver quickly and efficiently on the battlefield. Landsknechte also relied less on formation drilling, which allowed for much more flexibility in battle. 

The Landsknechte's tactics and training made them a preferable choice after the Battle of Pavia in 1525. This was due to their better skills in maneuverability, their ability to respond flexibly to a changing battlefield, and their superior firepower. The Swiss, on the other hand, had largely relied on pike formations and close-quarters combat, both of which had become increasingly inadequate in the face of the new musket weaponry of the 16th century. As a result, the Landsknechte became the mainstay of European armies in the 16th and 17th centuries, while their Swiss counterparts eventually faded away.

Do you suspect that your boyfriend or girlfriend might be cheating on you? Trust and honesty are essential components of any healthy relationship, so it's important to address these concerns as soon as possible to avoid any long-term damage. Here are some helpful tips on how to tell if your partner is cheating:

1. Pay attention to changes in their normal routine.

Has your boyfriend or girlfriend suddenly started acting differently? Do they constantly come home late or make excuses for being unreachable? Changes in their normal routine might be an indicator that something is amiss.

2. Decide if they've become moody suddenly, and eager to start fights.

Cheating partners often become irritable or defensive when their infidelity is exposed or suspected. If your boyfriend or girlfriend is suddenly picking fights or seems more easily set off than usual, this could be a sign that they're feeling guilty about something.

3. Think about whether your partner has stopped talking to you.

If your partner suddenly seems disinterested in talking to you or engaging in conversation, this could be a red flag. Cheating partners might be less communicative with their significant other in an attempt to avoid getting caught.

4. Consider whether your partner smells different when they come near you.

Has your boyfriend or girlfriend's scent changed recently? A different perfume or cologne could be a sign that they've been spending time with someone else.

5. Pay attention to changing interests.

Have their political views, musical tastes, or other interests shifted recently? Significant changes in these areas could be a sign that your partner is moving away from you and toward someone else.

6. Examine the trust in your relationship.

Do you feel like you can rely on your partner to be honest and faithful to you? If there are any trust issues between the two of you, this could be contributing to suspicions of infidelity.

7. Notice if they leave the room to take calls.

If your boyfriend or girlfriend constantly leaves the room to take phone calls or receive text messages, this could be a sign that they're trying to hide something.

8. Watch for unwillingness to accept you without notice.

If your partner is unwilling to let you come over or spend time with them without notice, this could be an indicator that they're hiding something.

9. Pay attention to whether they have to "clean up" before letting you into their house, room, or car.

If you notice that your partner is suddenly obsessive about cleaning up before you visit, this could be a sign that they're trying to hide any evidence of infidelity.

10. Notice if your partner is constantly putting someone else down.

If your boyfriend or girlfriend is constantly putting someone else down, this could be a sign that they're trying to justify their own behavior or transfer their own guilt onto someone else.

11. Catch them in a lie.

If you catch your partner in a lie about something small, this could be a sign that they're not being truthful with you about other, more major issues.

12. Watch for unexplained bills, receipts for meals, etc.

If your partner is suddenly spending more money than usual or you notice that there are unexplained bills or receipts lying around, this could be an indication that they're spending time with someone else.

13. Find out whether your partner has additional email accounts or other online accounts.

Cheating partners might create new email accounts or social media profiles to communicate with the other person.

14. Notice whether their friends are acting differently towards you.

If your partner's friends are suddenly acting differently toward you or seem hesitant to spend time with you, this could be a sign that something is going on.

15. Notice whether they're suddenly buying you gifts out of nowhere.

If your boyfriend or girlfriend is suddenly showering you with gifts or praise, this could be a sign that they're trying to make up for something or preparing you for a potential breakup.

16. Listen to how your partner explains their behavior.

If you confront your partner about suspected cheating, pay attention to how they respond. Do they seem sincere or defensive? Do they react calmly or with anger?

17. Notice the response.

After a few moments of silence and once the story has finished, recall one of the details that stuck out to you. How do they react?

18. Do it again with another detail-oriented question.

If you feel like you're not getting a straight answer, try asking another question that requires specific details. This could help you catch your partner in a lie or expose any inconsistencies.

19. Expect to be questioned back.

If your partner is cheating, it's likely that they'll become defensive and attempt to turn the conversation back on you. Be prepared for this and stick to your guns.

20. Ask yourself, did you insinuate that they were hiding something?

If you're looking for answers that prove that your partner is cheating on you, you might be more likely to interpret their behavior through that lens. Make sure to keep an open mind and approach the situation objectively.

In conclusion, if you suspect that your boyfriend or girlfriend is cheating, it's important to address the issue openly and honestly. Keep these tips in mind to help you determine whether your suspicions are warranted and to approach the situation in the healthiest way possible.

Jade plants are beautiful and easy to care for succulents. However, as they grow, they will eventually outgrow their container and need to be transplanted. Transplanting a jade plant can be a bit intimidating, but with the right tools and knowledge, it can be done successfully. Here’s how to do it in early spring.

Step 1: Select the Right Container

When choosing a new container for your jade plant, make sure it's a heavy clay, terra cotta, or ceramic pot. These materials will help to regulate the temperature and water levels in the soil. Ensure that the container has at least one drain hole in the bottom to allow excess water to escape. A container that is only 1 to 2 inches deeper and wider than the old container is recommended.

Step 2: Prepare the Potting Mix

Use a peat-based potting mix with extra coarse builder's sand or perlite added in. This will provide proper drainage and airflow for the plant’s roots to grow. Add the new potting mix into the container at a depth of 1 to 2 inches.

Step 3: Remove the Jade Plant from Its Old Container

To remove the jade plant from its old container, gently turn the pot upside down and tap on the bottom. If the plant doesn’t come out easily, use a knife to loosen the soil around the edges of the container. Be careful not to damage the roots.

Step 4: Trim the Roots

Disinfect a pair of sharp scissors with a household disinfectant like Lysol. Then, trim off any roots that are much longer than the root mass and any that are damaged or dead.

Step 5: Plant the Jade Plant in the New Container

Place the jade plant in the new container and fill it with the potting mix. Gently press the soil down around the plant to make sure it's secure. Water the jade plant with room-temperature water until it drains from the bottom.

Step 6: Care for the Jade Plant

Take special care of the jade plant for four weeks after transplanting it. Water the plant with room-temperature water when the top of the potting mix begins to dry. Don't overwater the plant, as this could cause it to rot. Avoid giving the plant any fertilizer while the root system is recovering. Keep the plant out of direct sunlight, as it can stress the plant while it's recovering.

With these steps, you can transplant your jade plant successfully and ensure that it continues to thrive. Remember to follow these tips to maintain a healthy and happy plant for years to come.

Merrill D. Peterson (born July 7, 1922) is an American historian, academic, and author. Peterson was born in Cambridge, Massachusetts, and grew up in Boston. He is a 1942 graduate of Harvard University and a 1943 graduate of Harvard Law School. From 1956 to 1957, he was a fellow at the Center for Advanced Study in the Behavioral Sciences. In 1964, he joined the faculty of the Department of History at the University of Virginia as an associate professor, and became a full professor in 1970. He specialized in the history of Europe, with a particular interest in the history of Russia. He also served as the director of the center for Russian and Eurasian Studies at the university. He retired from the University of Virginia in 1990. Peterson's works include The Great Transition: Political and Economic Origins of the New World Order (2008), The Freedom Project: History of the Civil War (2002), The Adams Chronicles: Four Generations of Greatness (2002), and several other books. He also edited a four-volume collection of the writings of Albert Einstein. Peterson received a Guggenheim Fellowship in 1976. In 1982, he was a recipient of the National Endowment for the Humanities, National Humanities Medal. Peterson is married to the former Marilyn McCue, a retired professor of law at the University of Virginia.
