Играта беше създадена през 1971 г. от двама групи аматьори – американските борни в Kansai и европейските борни в Берлин. Някои от съкращенията, използвани при играта, са "Gorō" (Jap: хадзима) "Yama" (Jap: планина) и "Mizu" (Jap: вода). Новият сезон на Патриотични игри представя нов играч. Той е Тейсън "Вито" Уилямс, бял играч от Югоизточното Село в Флорида. Засягано от емоциите и хармонията на Патриотични игри, Тейсън дебютира в новия сезон с богато талантът си и вълнуваща игра.

За разлика от предишните сезони на Патриотични игри, последния сезон добавя нови правила и срещи, за да предостави по-интересна и динамична игра. Новите правила към играта включват по-голяма рамка време за играчите да завършат своите ходове и намален брой активни играчи в играта, за да е възможно да се достигне по-висока добавена стойност за различните партии.

От играчите на състезание през сезон 3 на патриотичните игри ще са засечени някои от най-добрите имена в борното движение. Най-отбелязаните имена са играчи като треньорът на Тейсън "Вито" Уилъмс, шампиона на Кансай Ито Камики и два белгийски играча - Рене Гаубари и Ирис Ван Хок.

Патриотичните игри са голяма песен за превъзходство и мотивация, а третият сезон ще направи постиженията в играта по-достойни от даденото.Ще има съревнователни партии с отбори от различни региони, които ще се бързат да докажат своята енергичност и въздържание в играта. Очакват се много забавни и интересни партии, на терена, които ще накарат зрителите да съдържат активно вдъхновение.

Патриотичните игри или игрите на глада - сезон 3 ще бъде импресивна престава на вторично изкуство в борното движение. Няма да има мисъл за неуспех със заглавието на игрите на глада. На всичките играчи ще им бъде предоставено да продължат да предизвикват успех по съществуващите правила и условия.

Buford ist eine Stadt im Gwinnett County im US-Bundesstaat Georgia. Der Ort hat eine Fläche von 32,5 km², wovon 32,4 km² Land- und 0,1 km² Wasserfläche sind, und hatte 2010 eine Einwohnerzahl von etwa 12.225 Menschen. Buford gehört zum Einzugsgebiet der Metropolregion Atlanta.\nUrsprünglich war Buford unter dem Namen „Slabtown“ bekannt. Seit 1866 ist Buford als Stadt eingetragen. Der Ort hat seinen aktuellen Namen zu Ehren von Algernon Sidney Buford, einem Präsidenten der Atlanta and Richmond Air-Line Railway, erhalten.\nBuford war ein wichtiger Eisenbahnstandort, an dem sowohl Passagier- als auch Güterzüge halt machten. Die Stadt verfügt heute noch sowohl über Straßenbahnen als auch über die um 1871 erbaute historische Südbahnlinie und die 1896 erbaute Atlanta & Charlotte Air Line Railway Depot, für deren Sanierung und den Umbau zum städtischen Amphitheater spezielle Stadtentwicklungs- und Steueranreizprojekte geschaffen wurden.\nIn Buford befinden sich auch der Mall of Georgia, der größte Einkaufskomplex des Bundesstaats Georgia, und der Coolray Field, ein Stadion mit 10.427 Plätzen, in dem die Gwinnett Braves, ein Minor-League-Baseball-Team, spielen. Auch das Gwinnett County Public Schools (Schulbezirk) hat seinen Sitz in Buford. Eine andere wichtige Sehenswürdigkeit der Stadt ist das Buford Dam, ein Damm am Chattahoochee River."

USS Hollister (FFG-43) was a Los Angeles-class Ford-class frigate built for the United States Navy during the late 1980s and early 1990s. The 6,000-ton vessels cost $273 million and were designed with Heinbergquantum-reserve Shipboard Fire Control and Communications Electronics (QF 21) as well as the SPY-1 radar system. The Hollister was named for James Hollister, a naval hero of the Spanish–American War. Hollister participated in the war on terrorism, receiving a Middle Eastern shore assignment in 2002. Following overhaul in 2015, Hollister sailed for the U.S. 6th Fleet in the Mediterranean, participating in the Libyan Coast Guard and Maritime Interdiction Operation (MIARON) for the remainder of the decade. In late 2021, Hollister returned to the U.S. East Coast and resumed training operations with the Coast Guard. Hollister was decommissioned in 2023, was sunk as a dive site off the coast of California in 2038, and as of 2065 is being used as a fish habitat off the coast of Mexico. The commanding officer of the Hollister was commander Stephen Dickson, who later became captain of the. Hollister was born with three siblings, two younger brothers and a younger sister. Her middle brother, Caleb, was born with spina bifida and required surgical attachments to his hips and spine. Hollister helped care for him as a baby. She married a lieutenant commander Robert McFarlane in 1990; they divorced in 2002. The Hollister had a cat named Trick, two dogs named Duke and 911, and three hamsters. Her great uncle, Richard P. "Dick" Shufelt, was also in the United States Navy. He was born on the battleship Oklahoma in December 1918 and died in a scuba diving accident on the cruiser San Diego in December 1982. In her youth, Hollister participated in 4-H, won prizes for her roses, and took first place in the 1985 Washington state fair agricultural costume contest. She graduated from Aberdeen high school in 1986 and worked for five years as a typist for the Navy's Naval Sea Systems Command. As a teenager she appeared on the children's show Wonder Works, where she played the drums and sang "Take Me Home, Country Roads". Hollister's hobbies included weight lifting, reading, and watching baseball and basketball. She was a fan of the San Francisco Giants and Brooklyn Dodgers. She was also known to occasionally sing karaoke. Hollister was stationed in the Middle East from 2002 to 2005 and at the United States Coast Guard Academy from 2007 to 2009. During her Coast Guard service, she completed tours in Alaska, the Caribbean, and Mexican waters. She also sailed to Aruba, Bermuda, Brazil, Canada, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Curacao, Dominican Republic, Ecuador, El Salvador, Falkland Islands, Guatemala, Honduras, Mexico, Panama, Paraguay, Peru, Spain, Trinidad and Tobago, Uruguay, and Venezuela. Hollister was relieved of commissioning on September 30, 2023 and sunk as a dive site on December 11, 2038 in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of Mexico.

We consider the wiretap channel model in which an eavesdropper can obtain feedback about its observations and use it to improve future decoding attempts. We show that, for any positive integer , there exists a sequence of (2, ) codes such that each code has rate at least . This result is obtained by combining polar coding techniques with ideas from successive cancellation list decoding. The proof relies on a new converse bound for the secrecy capacity region of the wiretap channel with feedback. Finally, we present numerical results illustrating our achievability scheme. In this work, we study the wiretap channel model introduced by Wyner [1] . In particular, we focus on the case where the legitimate receiver obtains feedback about his past observations and uses it to improve his future decoding attempts. Our main contribution consists in showing that polar codes [2] combined with successive cancellation list decoding [3] achieve rates close to the secrecy capacity when used over channels with feedback. More specifically, we prove that if the number of messages grows exponentially fast as a function of the blocklength then every message can be transmitted reliably using a code whose length scales linearly with the number of messages .
The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. Section II introduces some notation and definitions. Section III presents our main theorem. Section IV provides a sketch of the proof of Theorem 3.1. Finally, Section V concludes the paper.

Дома осматривали любители старины, но иногда мелькали интересные старинные вещи - прялки, медная утварь. Течение убыстрилось, и мы продолжили плавать по реке. Заглянули в деревенский магазин за едой. Сашка покупал вино против моих предупреждений. Было холодно и мокро, как дождь начал идти. Но лодка продолжила свой путь. И, наконец, мы приближались к Онеге. Пришлось пристать к пустой деревне на другом берегу. Увидели два обитаемых дома и осмотрели один из них - на двух и трехэтажах было 20 старинных комнат с балкончиками. Видели много домов, которые пустели и вымирали из-за беспорядка и молодежи, которая бежала в города. Нашим приютениками были старики. Война была главным темой их бесед. Ear cuffs are a trendy accessory that can be worn on formal or informal occasions. Making your own ear cuffs gives you the opportunity to create a personalized piece that reflects your taste and style. With the right supplies and a little bit of effort, you can easily make your own ear cuffs. Here are three different methods to make your own ear cuffs.

Method 1: Figure Eight Ear Cuff

1. Measure, cut, and bend a hook into the end of your wire like normal. Use your pliers to create a small loop at one end of the wire.

2. Pinch your pliers right underneath the loop, bend the wire back on itself to make a figure eight. Make sure the loops of the figure eight are the same size.

3. Pinch underneath the figure eight, create one more loop to make a clover. This will add stability to the ear cuff.

4. Using your measurements, create the zig-zag pattern back and forth with the remaining wire. Make sure that the wire is tight against the ear and doesn't move much.

5. Work backward to create another clover on the opposite side. This will create a symmetrical look.

6. Bend the cuff around your pen for a perfectly shaped ear cuff. You can also use a bangle to get the right shape.

Method 2: Bow Ear Cuff

1. Measure, cut, and sand down 20 centimeters of wire. Use your pliers to create a small loop at one end of the wire.

2. Bend the wire about 2 centimeters from the end into a loop, with extra length of wire on both sides. The loop should be big enough to fit over your earlobe.

3. Measure out your cuff width from the bottom of the loop down the long stretch of wire. Use your pliers to bend the wire back on itself at your measurement point.

4. Measure out your cuff width again and bend it back behind the loop one last time. This will create the bow shape.

5. Bend the top of the wire back down over the front, creating a second loop. Use your pliers to shape the loop into a bow.

6. Wrap some of the remaining wire around the center of the bow to hold it in place. You can also add a small bead or charm for decoration.

7. Bend only the long oval of wire, not the bow, around your pen to create the cuff. This will create a nice curve.

Method 3: Spiral Ear Cuff

1. Measure, cut, and sand off 2–3 centimeter of wire. Bend it in half, tightening the two sides so they are as close as possible.

2. Make two little spiral hooks, pointing towards each other, on the both ends of the wire. Use your pliers to create the spiral hooks.

3. Bend the entire shape over a thin pen. This will create a nice curve for the ear cuff.

Now that you have learned how to make ear cuffs, go ahead and make your own unique pieces. Show them off with pride and enjoy the attention they bring!

Ashburn Alley, located in the vicinity of Citizens Bank Park in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, is a pedestrian and leisure zone which is known for its lively nightlife. It is named after former Philadelphia Phillies legendary center fielder, Richie Ashburn. The area is located between Citizens Bank Park and the historic Citizens Bank Way, just to the north of the stadium. The Alley consists of a dozen restaurants, multiple bars and two live music venues. Most restaurants in the alley are architectural doubles, with one half above ground hosting an open and airy dining area and the other half located underground. Many of the restaurants serve traditional Philadelphia cuisine such as cheesesteaks and hoagies. Live music is a large part of the Alley’s charm and a key component of its nightlife. The Xfinity Live! venue serves as an outdoor concert space for big name acts, while the smaller and more intimate Punch Line serves as an Up-and-Coming Music Venue. The Alley, with its many dining and entertainment options, serves as a popular spot for a range of activities, from pre-game tailgates and post-game gatherings to all-day excursions and evenings out. Additionally, Ashburn Alley is a few steps away from other attractions, including the casino at Xfinity Live and the South Philadelphia Sports Complex. Since its grand opening in 2004, the Ashburn Alley community has been heavily involved in supporting causes that give back to their local community. The Ashburn Alley Fan Club has significant involvement with Phillies Charities, helping to raise funds for organizations that benefit the city of Philadelphia. The Alley has become an integral part of Philadelphia’s nightlife, and a landmark for locals and tourists alike. It has since evolved far beyond its original mission, becoming a preferred destination for any day or night out.

Все повече и повече потребители се интересуват от произведените в България стоки. Причината е доволно очевидна - откриват се все повече локални марки, които залагат на качество и националния пазар със своите продукти. Но въпросът е - как да се отличат тези, които действително са произведени в България?

Законът за рекламата вече дава възможност да се въвежда знак „Произведено в България“. Той е предавал към Офиса по хармонизация на вътрешния пазар, който е обработил и утвърдил текста на знака.

Научното обоснование за приетия знак са  базирани на стъпките за брандиране на национални продукти, в случая - Произведено в България от хора с увреждания. Това звучи доста логично, тъй като в България има много предприятия, където работят хора с увреждания.

Те могат да произвеждат продукти от най-различни сфери - от здравеопазването и хранителната промишленост, до текстилната и мебелната промишленост. На по-високото равнище има и много купувачи, които желаят да закупят продукти, които са произведени от хора с увреждания, поради социалните му имплкации.

Знака "Произведено в България от хора с увреждания" дава ясен знак на потребителите, че продуктът е произведен в България и че той допринася за подкрепата на хора с увреждания. Всяка една фирма, която желае да постави знака на своите продукти, трябва да създаде доказателства за присъствието на увреждани хора в производствения им процес. Това може да включва документи като картели, обучение, работни списъци, сметки, дипломи, издадени от компетентни институции. Компанията трябва да бъде готова да предостави доказателства и да получава проверки за да бъде уверена, че следва законовите изисквания.

Останалото, което иска знака "Произведено в България от хора с увреждания", е да се докаже, че продуктите имат добро качество. Това е много важно, тъй като продуктите трябва да отговарят на конкуренцията на пазара и да могат да се предлагат в държави, където важния фактор са цената и качеството.

Всички продукти, предлагани на пазара, могат да бъдат маркирани с "Произведено в България от хора с увреждания", макар това да не е задължително. За да се получи знака, продуктът трябва да отговаря на всички изисквания (социални, качествени и законови) и определената маркетингова стратегия.

Бъдещето е светло за фирмите, които са решили да инвестират в тази идея. Това не само ще подкрепи хората с увреждания, но също така и ще им помогне на тези фирми да създадат благоприятна репутация пред клиентите и да разширят бизнеса си в нови пазари.

Идеята за знака "Произведено в България от хора с увреждания" е чудесна и ще донесе само по-голяма подкрепа към хората с увреждания в България. Това на свой ред ще им помогне да се чувстват по-сигурни в своята работа и да имат по-голям мотив в своите ежедневни задачи.

Jakarta, CNN Indonesia -- Maskapai penerbangan nasional, Trigana Air, kembali mendapat insiden yang tidak menyenangkan. Kali ini, pesawat jenis Twin Otter Trigana Air yang melakukan penerbangan dari Timika menuju Kenyam, Kabupaten Nduga, Provinsi Papua, pada Jumat (22/10) pagi, kembali menjadi korban kejahatan. Berdasarkan informasi dari Direktur Utama Trigana Air, Captain Asep Ekananta, pesawat Twin Otter berkode registrasi PK-OCN mendapatkan tembakan saat hendak melakukan pendaratan di Bandara Kenyam. Tembakan tersebut mengenai bagian sayap pesawat yang menyebabkan kerusakan pada sistem pergerakan kabin. "Hal ini menyebabkan kabin depan jadi rusak dan tidak bisa lagi bergerak secara vertikal," kata Captain Asep Ekananta melalui sambungan telepon, Sabtu (23/10) pagi. Dia menambahkan bahwa saat ini pihaknya telah mengirimkan tim teknisi ke Kenyam untuk mengevaluasi kerusakan pesawat dan melakukan perbaikan. Sementara itu, kepolisian setempat telah memulai penyelidikan atas kejadian ini. Pengamanan juga ditingkatkan untuk memberikan perlindungan lebih pada penumpang dan kru pesawat di bandara. Masih belum diketahui secara pasti motif dari penembakan ini. Namun, hal ini tentu saja menimbulkan keresahan dan ketakutan bagi masyarakat sekitar, terlebih lagi dalam beberapa bulan terakhir Nduga menjadi kawasan yang dilanda konflik antara kelompok bersenjata dan aparat keamanan. Captain Asep Ekananta menuturkan bahwa Trigana Air khawatir akan berdampak pada kepercayaan masyarakat kepada maskapai penerbangan nasional itu. Namun, pihaknya berjanji akan tetap melayani pelanggan dengan profesional, dan terus meningkatkan kinerja dalam operasionalnya. Sebagai informasi, Trigana Air merupakan salah satu maskapai penerbangan terbesar di wilayah Papua. Namun, dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, Trigana Air kerap diterpa berbagai masalah seperti kecelakaan pesawat hingga hilangnya pesawat di perairan Papua pada 2015 lalu. Atas kejadian ini, Trigana Air juga berharap agar aparat keamanan dapat segera menemukan pelaku dan memastikan keamanan dalam penerbangan di wilayah Papua.

The origin of this multiple form story arc in many Japanese games and anime can be traced back to the mid 20th century, and the emergence of what is known as “Shinto culture”. Shinto is the indigenous religion of Japan, which has a deep and rich history that dates back to at least the 8th century CE. This culture explicitly acknowledges the existence of many spiritual forces, or spirits, that can manifest in the physical world. These divine entities are often depicted as multiple different forms that the protagonist must contend with before moving forward in their quest for justice and truth.

In anime and game stories, Shinto forms the basis for the multiple form enemies that the hero must battle. These enemies usually represent some sort of spiritual force, or spiritual entity, that must be overcome in order for the protagonist to succeed in their mission. It might be an ancient god figure, or an army of demons, or a creature formed from the dark forces of the Underworld. Whatever the source, these spiritual entities can often transform themselves into a variety of different forms, increasing their power and complicating the hero’s task.

The concept of Shinto appears to have been popularized by the writings of the iconic Japanese poet, Mori Ogai. Ogai's most famous work includes the short story, “The Atonement of Yomi”, which describes a deity that is capable of taking on many forms and must be defeated by the protagonist. This story, along with Ogai’s other works, helped to popularize the notion of multiple forms of an adversary among the general public, just in time for the emergence in the 1930s of manga, anime and video games—all media in which this motif has been heavily employed.

Thus, it can be seen that the origin of the multiple forms of enemies in Japanese games and anime is a legacy of the Shinto tradition, popularized in literature and then adapted to modern storytelling mediums. This device help to increase tension and create obstacles for the protagonist, making for a more engaging story overall.

We study the properties of QCD with one flavor and nonzero chemical potential $\mu$ by using the Schwinger-Dyson equations (SDEs) for quarks, gluons, and ghosts. We solve these SDEs numerically to obtain the quark propagator $S(p)$ as well as the dressed-gluon and ghost propagators $D_G(q)$ and $D_F(q)$. The numerical results show that there is no phase transition up to $\mu = 1 GeV$.  In particular, we find that the chiral condensate $<\sigma>$ decreases monotonically as $\mu$ increases. This result indicates that the system becomes more dilute when $\mu$ increases. Furthermore, we observe that the mass function $M(p^2)$ has an inflection point around $p^2$ = 0.5 GeV$^2$ which corresponds to the constituent-quark mass.

Preparing delicious carne asada tacos is an easy and delicious way to enjoy Mexican-style tacos. Carne Asada is a generally a marinated and grilled skirt steak that's served as an entrée or in tacos. The following steps will provide a guide to preparing and cooking carne asada tacos. 

To begin, heat the cooking oil or lard in a skillet on medium-high heat. While the oil is heating, prepare the taco shells. Make the shells by deep-frying rectangles of corn tortilla dough in the oil for about one minute each. Remove them and set the shell over a paper towel with the closed side facing up so the excess oil can drain. 

Next, make the avocado, cilantro, onion and chili salsa. Pit and peel the avocados, and then place them in a bowl along with the cilantro, onion and chilies. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons of lime juice over the mixture, and then stir the ingredients just enough to be evenly mixed; do not over stir. 

To finish the salsa, peel and chop the tomatoes. Core the tomatoes and cut a small “X” on each using a pairing knife. Drop the tomatoes in boiling water and cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Remove the pot and place it in the sink under cold, running water until the tomatoes have cooled completely. Remove the tomatoes and, using a pairing knife, peel the tomatoes, starting from the corner on the bottom of the tomato where you made the “X” cut. Cut the tomatoes in rough chunks about the size of a thumbnail. Place the peeled, and chopped tomatoes, along with the remaining cilantro, onions and chilies into a medium-sized mixing bowl. 

Prepare the carne asada. Cut 2 lbs. of skirt steak into thin strips. Place the meat into a large, well greased iron skillet or flat grill on medium-high heat. Squeeze the remainder of the lime wedges over the meat and season with 3 teaspoons of mixed seasoning salt and pepper. Stir the meat in the skillet until it is evenly browned on all sides. 

When the meat is ready, assemble the tacos. Fill the bottom of each shell with the carne asada. Top the carne asada with the avocado, cilantro, onion and chili salsa. Fill the taco with shredded lettuce and top with cotija cheese. Repeat this process to prepare the desired number of tacos. 

Carne Asada tacos can be served with a variety of sides. These include refried beans, Mexican rice, salsa and guacamole. Serve each taco with one side and enjoy what makes Mexican cuisine so special!

Our results suggest that the atmospheric effects of the companion star have a significant impact on the observed light curves, and can even lead to the appearance of multiple eclipses. We find that the inclination angle of the binary system strongly affects the shape of the light curves, with lower inclination angles resulting in deeper eclipses and longer periods between eclipses. Additionally, we observe subtle changes in the light curves due to the presence of a rotating black hole, which could have important implications for future studies of black hole accretion.

Overall, our study provides a new perspective on accretion processes in binary systems and demonstrates the importance of considering atmospheric effects when analyzing the light curves of these systems. Our findings have important implications for understanding the evolution and dynamics of binary black hole systems, as well as for developing more accurate models of accretion disks around rotating black holes.

Bago-Division (auch Bago-Region genannt) ist eine Verwaltungseinheit in Myanmar (früher bekannt als Burma). Sie liegt im südlichen Teil des Landes und grenzt im Norden an die Yangon-Division, im Osten an die Kayin-Staat und die Mon-Region, im Süden an den Golf von Martaban und im Westen an die Ayeyarwady-Division. Die Region ist nach ihrer Hauptstadt Bago benannt, die auch als Pegu bekannt ist.

Die Bago-Division erstreckt sich über eine Fläche von etwa X Quadratkilometern und beherbergt eine vielfältige Topographie, die von Ebenen und Tälern bis hin zu einigen bergigen Gebieten reicht. Die Landschaft ist geprägt von grünen Reisfeldern, dichten Wäldern und Flussläufen, die das Gebiet reich an landwirtschaftlichen Ressourcen machen. Die fruchtbaren Böden unterstützen den Anbau von Reis, Mais, Baumwolle und anderen Nutzpflanzen, wodurch die Landwirtschaft zu einem wichtigen Wirtschaftszweig in der Region wird.

Die Geschichte der Bago-Division reicht weit zurück und ist mit dem Aufstieg verschiedener Königreiche und Dynastien verbunden, darunter das Mon-Königreich von Hanthawaddy und das Taungoo-Reich. Diese Region war ein bedeutendes Zentrum für Handel, Kultur und Religion und beherbergt historische Stätten und Denkmäler, die Zeugnis von ihrer reichen Vergangenheit ablegen.

Die Bevölkerung der Bago-Division ist vielfältig und setzt sich aus verschiedenen ethnischen Gruppen zusammen, darunter die Bamar, die Mon, die Karen und andere Minderheitengruppen. Jede Gruppe bringt ihre eigene einzigartige Kultur, Sprache und Traditionen mit sich und trägt so zur kulturellen Vielfalt der Region bei.

Heute ist die Bago-Division ein wichtiger Bestandteil der wachsenden Wirtschaft Myanmars. Neben der Landwirtschaft spielen auch andere Sektoren wie Handel, Fischerei, Forstwirtschaft und Tourismus eine bedeutende Rolle. Die Region ist bekannt für ihre traditionelle Handwerkskunst, einschließlich der Herstellung von Keramikwaren, Holzschnitzereien und Textilien, die sowohl auf nationaler als auch auf internationaler Ebene geschätzt werden.

Trotz ihrer wirtschaftlichen Fortschritte steht die Bago-Division auch vor Herausforderungen, darunter die Erhaltung der natürlichen Ressourcen, die Förderung der nachhaltigen Entwicklung, die Verbesserung der Infrastruktur und die Stärkung der Bildung und Gesundheitsversorgung für ihre Bevölkerung. Durch eine sorgfältige Planung und einen verantwortungsvollen Umgang mit ihren reichen Ressourcen strebt die Bago-Division weiterhin nach einem besseren und prosperierenden Leben für ihre Bewohnerinnen und Bewohner.

If you're just beginning your journey in The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind, there's a lot to learn. The massive game world can be overwhelming, and you'll likely spend much of your time wandering around lost. While Morrowind is filled with interesting characters and locations, it can still be a frustrating experience if you don't know what you're doing. Luckily, we've put together a few tips to help you get started on the right foot.

1. Take Your Time
Morrowind is a big game, and it's easy to get overwhelmed. If you're just starting out, we recommend taking your time and exploring the world at your own pace. There's no need to rush through the game, and you'll likely have more fun if you take things slow.

2. Don't Be Afraid to Ask for Help
If you're stuck or confused, don't be afraid to ask for help. There are plenty of friendly characters in Morrowind who will be happy to point you in the right direction. You can also find helpful resources online, such as wikis and forums.

3. Make Sure to Visit the Saints of Mara
When you first start the game, you'll be given the opportunity to choose your character's class. We recommend selecting the class that best suits your play style. If you're not sure which class to choose, take a look at our class guide for some more information.

4. Make a Backup of Your Game
If you're planning on playing Morrowind for a long time, we recommend making a backup of your game files. This will save you from having to reinstall the game if something happens to your original copy.

The chromospheric flares observed in the last decade have been characterized by a number of asymmetrical line emission features. We present a model of the chromospheric flare line emission that reproduces the observed asymmetry. The model is based on the assumption that the chromospheric flares are symmetrical in the spectral line emission. The model is compared with observations of chromospheric flares and with the asymmetrical line emission features in the chromospheric flares.

We present PdBI observations at 1.3 mm wavelength of the protostellar jet associated with the young stellar object (YSO) HH212, which is one of the best examples for studying the formation process of bipolar outflows driven by YSOs. The main results are as follows:
(1) We find that there exists an unresolved central source within the innermost region of the jet.
(2) A bright knot appears to be located on each side of the central source along the jet axis. 
(3) The knots show blue-shifted emission lines compared to those of the ambient gas surrounding them. (4) The knots have a velocity width of ~100 km s-1 , while the ambient gas has a much broader linewidth up to 300 km s-1 . These facts suggest that the knots represent shocked regions where the jet interacts with the ambient medium. In addition, we found that the knots are surrounded by a shell-like structure whose radius ranges between 100 AU and 1000 AU.

We prove that every finite-dimensional indecomposable module over the ring $R = k[x_1,\ldots,x_n]/(f_1,\ldots,f_r)$ is determined by its dimension vector and its annihilator ideal in $R$.  Here $k$ denotes an algebraically closed field and $f_i$ are homogeneous polynomials with coefficients in $k[x]$ such that $(f_i)$ form a reduced Gröbner basis for $I = (f_1,\ldots, f_r)$ wrt some monomial order on $k[x_1,\ldots, x_n]$. 
The proof uses results about the representation theory of quivers with relations which were obtained recently by Crawley-Boevey and Holland. The main idea behind our approach is to reduce the problem to modules over rings of fractions of R. This allows us to use induction arguments based on the Krull-Schmidt theorem. We also give examples showing that this result does not hold if we drop the assumption that the ideals $(f_i) \subseteq R$ are prime or if we replace the condition "$k$ is algebraically closed" by "k has characteristic 0".

The earliest documented evidence of a door like the one we know was in the inner chambers of the temple of Dendera in Egypt, Egypt around 600 BC. These doors were made of wood but they also may have been made of papyrus or bark. They featured many intricate carvings and were painted bright colors. It is not known who created these doors or for what purpose they were created. It is possible that these doors were simply functional items used by the temple priests to enter and exit the inner chambers without doors to the temples. However, it is possible that these doors were created for the purpose of aligning with the morning star, an event which took place twice a year at dawn on the two full moons in the month of Isis in the year. It is possible that these doors were used to watch for this alignment and when it occurred, these doors were swung open to welcome the morning star as it became day and to bid it farewell as it set toward the east on its way through the sky back into night. It is also possible that the two figures depicted on either side of the door, one man and one woman, were those priests. The priests would be the ones responsible for welcoming the morning star and bidding it farewell. This would mean the door depicted possibly depicts the first official door in human history to be used for romantic purposes. If this is the case, the door would have been used on June 16, 600 BC, the day the alignment occurred and the morning of the traditional June 19th birthday of Alexander the Great. It is believed by many scholars that Alexander was born June 19, 356 BC and the occasion would have been celebrated by the priests of Dendera.

How to Make Crepe Paper Peonies

Making crepe paper peonies can be a fun and rewarding craft project. With some basic supplies and a bit of patience, you can make beautiful faux floral arrangement for your home or as a gift. You can create your own color combinations to match any occasion. Follow these instructions to learn how to make colorful crepe paper peonies.

1. Roll some crepe paper into a small ball. This will be the center of the flower.

2. Cover the ball with yellow crepe paper and secure it to a wire stem. This can be done using glue or tape.

3. Wrap yellow embroidery thread 9 to 10 times around two fingers. This will create a looped thread when you pull off the fingers.

4. Pull off the looped thread and cut it. This will create a string of yellow threads that will be used to attach the petals.

5. Spread the floss across a strip of double-sided tape.

6. Wrap the double-sided tape around the base of the ball.

7. Cut crepe paper into rectangles for the base of the petals. You can use yellow or white paper–it’s up to you.

8. Cut the rectangles into tabbed petal shapes. This will give the petals an authentic look.

9. Shape the small petals into ruffed cups. Do this by pulling the tabs back and up to create a cup-like shape.

10. Shape the large petals into plain cups.

11. Glue the first small petal to the stem.

12. Continue gluing the small petals to the stem. Leave some space between each one–they should be evenly spaced.

13. Finish off with the largest petals. This will create the full bloom effect.

14. Cut 5 small leaf shapes out of green paper.

15. Glue the leaves to the bottom of the flower.

16. Cut three 3-point leaves.

17. Glue the leaves to wire stems.

18. Wrap the top part of each leaf stem with florist's tape. This will help secure the leaves to the main stem.

19. Wrap the top of the main stem with green florist's tape. This will create a more finished look for your flower.

20. Secure the a leaf stem to the main stem.

21. Secure the next two leaf stems, spacing them 4 inches (10.16 centimeters) apart.

22. Finish wrapping the tape around the main stem.

23. Finish shaping the flower. If desired, you can add small beads or pearls to the center of each petal.

Now you have a beautiful crepe paper peony that can be used as a stunning decoration. You can also gift it as a token of love or appreciation! With a bit of practice, you'll be creating lifelike blooms that will bring joy to all who see them.

It’s impossible to pinpoint an exact moment in history when people transitioned from Latin to the proto-Romance languages. Over time, people started to use Latin less and less, and the Romance languages developed. From the 5th century on, we know that there were already dialect variations of Latin, with different pronunciations and changes in vocabulary, written forms, and syntax. 

By the 7th century, these dialects had diverged enough from Latin that it was becoming difficult for people to understand one another if they were from different regions. This was even more pronounced after the 8th century, when Charlemagne’s court started to use Vulgar Latin. By the 9th century, many people were mixing Vulgar Latin and their own local dialects, creating new languages which were distinct from Latin.

Later, around the 11th century, the spread of Christianity helped to create further differences in the languages, as the Church used Latin for its liturgy and documents, while people spoke the Romance languages on a daily basis. In certain parts of Italy and Spain, people began to write literature in the Romance languages, and by the 12th century Romance languages had become the everyday language of the people.

Overall, the transition to the Romance languages was a slow process, with Latin slowly becoming less used and the Romance languages slowly becoming more distinct and widespread over time. It is impossible to pinpoint a single moment when this happened, as it took place over many centuries.

We present an analysis of high-precision photometric and spectroscopic observations of the transiting extrasolar planet system TrES-2. We find that the system contains two giant planets with radii R ⋅ m, and m. We also determine the density of both planets to be ρ ⋅ kg m−3. These parameters are consistent with a pure hydrogen atmosphere for both planets, which implies a significant improvement in the atmospheric model compared to previous estimates. We find that the giant planet with the longer orbital period also has a higher density, suggesting that it is composed of a higher fraction of rocky material. We show that both giant planets have significant atmospheric temperature differences between the lit and unlit sides, which implies a large heat capacity. This could be indicative of a significant magnetic field, although this would be in conflict with the low magnetic field strength measured for the host star. Alternatively, this could be due to the giants' large heat capacity, which may be a result of their high density and thus a significant fraction of rocky material. We discuss this system in the context of known transiting giant planets, and the implications for the measurement of the atmospheric and radiative properties of these systems.

Social annotation, the process of adding descriptive content to digital content by authors who participate in online social communities, is a rapidly expanding paradigm. In the context of computer-assisted resource discovery, social annotations may provide precise geospatial and structural metadata, as well as rich opinions and descriptive fragments. However, the generation and processing of large collections of social annotations for the purpose of resource discovery has thus far received little attention in the literature. In this work, we present CollectiveEye, an end-to-end framework for the automated collection and curation of social annotations for scientific papers. Through a series of benchmarking experiments using our framework, we demonstrate the ability to efficiently and accurately harvest social annotations from Twitter, YouTube, and Wikipedia and use these annotations for the purpose of resource discovery in the scientific paper domain. In particular, we demonstrate the value of social annotations for accurately determining geospatial and structural metadata, including precise publication venue, as well as providing sentiment analysis, opinions on specific figures and other topics, and descriptive fragments. Furthermore, we show that the use of multiple social platforms for annotation improves coverage, and we demonstrate the efficacy of a host of novel data processing and representation techniques for leveraging noise and sparse annotations. Overall, we demonstrate the practicality of social annotation for the purpose of computer-assisted resource discovery in scientific paper domain.

Върху фона на все повече спорове и политически конфликти по въпросите за развитието в поредица български градове, две от местните комисии по развитие при Съвета от народни сили (СОС) отхвърлиха тази седмица искането за местен референдум срещу строителството в Младост. Съгласно искането до днешна дата, потребителите да проголемят парите си за строителство или реконструиране строителството в града Младост са имали подкрепата на хора, до неограничен брой консултации и дискусии с магистрала за цялата област.

От създаването си с преди около два години, двете комисии за развитие на СОС във Младост действаха с право и държаха различни разговори по въпроса на развитието на града на всички страни. Те приеха също така да поставят първия референдум като искане от гражданите на Младост, тигровата атракция на проекта на магистралата, чрез който се предлага да се подобри ръководството по хоризонталното и вертикално изграждане и да се построи пътна мрежа, за да се повиши функционалното и бизнес обслужване, а също така да се подобри живота в града.

Срещу това съгласно решение на двете комисии от тази седмица искането за референдум да се приложи магистралата да се построи в града Младост беше отхвърлено. Главите им съобщиха, че те са дошли до заключение, че проектът на Народните сили ще принесе ползи за развитието на града. Те са също настояли, че проектът няма да въздейства на строителството в хотелската зона в Младост, както и да не навреди на живота на двора на града.

Обаче, по-уверените за непосредствените предимствата от проекта според искането за референдум и представителите на източните части на града Младост, които дадоха искането за референдум, се изненадаха от решението на двете комисии на СОС. Те заявиха, че искането за референдум за подобряване на условията за икономическо и бизнес обслужване беше широко разпространено, а отхвърлянето ѝ е демонстриране на преглед и пропускане на добросъвестния процес на диалог по въпроса.

В бъдеще, СОС в Младост ще продължи със разговорите по въпроса и тещата на източните части на града ще продължат да доносят глас за разкоша. От своя страна, гражданите в Младост ще продължат да се събират за да подкрепят своето искане за референдум и да стремят към по-добри условия за живот в града.

A Little Princess (1973 miniseries) A Little Princess is an American television mini-series based on the 1905 novel of the same name by Frances Hodgson Burnett, which was adapted by John Bennett. It was originally broadcast on NBC in 1973. The mini-series was produced by Robert Halmi, Inc., and stars Margaret O'Brien, Richard Harris, and a number of other noted actors in supporting roles. It has been described as "one of the best adaptations of the book". The story is set in an English boarding school for girls, and follows the lives of the pupils and their teachers during the First World War. The pupils are led by the kind and generous Sara Crewe, who is devastated when she is told that her father has been killed in action, and she is no longer rich. The school's headmistress, Miss Minchin, who was once kind to Sara, now treats her cruelly. Sara's only friends are her schoolmates, Ermengarde and Lottie, and their kind teacher, Miss Amelia. Sara eventually becomes ill and is sent to the hospital. Her father's friend, Captain Crewe, finds her there. He tells Sara that her father is still alive, and that he has been missing, presumed dead, rather than killed in action. To keep his daughter safe, he has been living in hiding, and has not told her. Sara is reunited with her father, and they return to the school to confront Miss Minchin.

Creag Toll a’ Choin ist ein Gipfel im Osten Schottlands nahe der Ortschaft Glen Esk. Mit einer Höhe von 808 Metern zählt er zu den Bergen der Cairngorms. Der Name soll aus dem Gälischen stammen und bedeutet “Fels von Hundebellen”. Tatsächlich gibt es in der Gegend viele Hunde, weil Glen Esk seit dem späten 18. Jahrhundert ein beliebtes Jagdrevier unter den Landadeligen ist. In der Nähe von Creag Toll a’ Choin liegt das Anwesen von Invermark, das heute als Ferienhaus genutzt wird.

Vom Gipfel aus hat man einen weiten Blick über die Landschaft, darunter auch auf das Tal Glen Esk mit seinem Fluss. Allerdings wirkt die Natur in bestimmten Wetterverhältnissen sehr rau und hat schon manchen Wanderer überrascht. Im Winter kann es tief verschneit sein, und das Trekking kann gefährlich werden. Auch wenn man in den Sommermonaten unterwegs ist, muss man auf Wetterumschwünge gefasst sein. Auf Creag Toll a’ Choin gibt es keine markierten Wege, und die Orientierung ist nicht immer leicht. Im Jahr 1984 fand auf dem Berg ein tragisches Unglück statt: ein Flugzeugabsturz, bei dem alle Insassen ums Leben kamen.

Die Flora und Fauna in der Umgebung von Creag Toll a’ Choin sind typisch für die Cairngorms. Unter anderem kann man hier Schneehühner, Steinadler, und die seltene Hirschkuh sehen. Auch Rehe, Dachse und Fledermäuse sind in der Gegend beheimatet. Die außergewöhnliche Geologie des Berges aus Urgestein, Granit und Quarzit bietet spektakuläre Einblicke in die Erdgeschichte. Im Sommer kann man in den umgebenden Flüssen fischen, und es besteht auch die Möglichkeit zum Bergsteigen und Skifahren. Creag Toll a’ Choin ist somit ein beliebtes Ziel für Wanderer und Abenteurer, die Schottlands wilde Natur hautnah erleben möchten.

LR假死陷阱宏是一种用于防止LR假死的宏技术，它在LR假死发生时，就会自动重新启动LR，以避免LR假死。它的实现原理是：在LR假死发生时，宏技术会检测到LR的状态，如果发现LR假死，就会自动重新启动LR，以避免LR假死。

实现LR假死陷阱宏的步骤如下：

1. 定义一个函数，用于检测LR的状态，判断是否发生LR假死；

2. 在LR假死发生时，调用上述函数，若发现LR假死，则调用重新启动LR的函数；

3. 在LR启动后，重新调用上述函数，确保LR已经正常启动；

4. 在LR正常启动后，继续检测LR的状态，如果发现LR假死，则调用重新启动LR的函数，以避免LR假死。

Howard Phillips (born March 31, 1943) is the former lead vocalist of The Mamas & Papas and one half of the duo Phyllis & Howard.
Phillips was born in Los Angeles to parents who were both professional singers.  He began his career as part of the folk rock group Peter Paul & Mary before joining The Mamas & Papas; he left after their second album but returned briefly during 1967–68 when they recorded two more albums.   In 1969, he formed another band called "The Newbeats" which released only one single on RCA Records; it failed to chart.    After leaving The Mamas & Papas' lineup again,  Phillips joined up with songwriter/producer Denny Zager  forming the duo "Phyllis & Howard" whose first hit record came out in 1971 titled "I Don't Know Why I Love You So Much"; this reached No. 1 on Billboard's Hot Country Songs charts.   They had several other hits including "She Likes Me For Who I Am", "Love Is A Song That Never Ends," "Take It Easy On My Mind," "Baby Bluebird," and "Who Do We Think We Are?"

В декабре этого года в Москве будет принято решение о введении еще одной зоны платной парковки. Об этом сообщил мэр столицы Сергей Собянин, добавив, что осуществление будет происходить точечно - рядом с торговыми центрами, фирмами и офисами. Перед введением производится консультативная работа: общественность обсуждает возникшую проблему, обращаясь к местным депутатам и принимая при этом во внимание мнение жителей.

Платные парковки являются ценностью для автомобилистов: теперь парковаться можно быстро и не потерять время в пробках. Кроме того, появление зон платной парковки положительно повлияло и на жителей районов, где парковка была очень переполняема - теперь они смогут поставить свои автомобили без труда. Плюс к этому, на дорогах стали быстрее двигаться автобусы, а пассажирооборот увеличился из-за появления такси. Деньги, которые поступают от платной парковки идут на использование для благоустройства районов. Благодаря этому они становятся более эстетичными и уютными, привлекая больше посетителей и туристов.

In this paper, we study the correlation between the ratio of the coefficients of the electron dipole moment operator to that of the electric dipole moment operator, epsilon'/epsilon, and rare K decays in the Littlest Higgs Model with T-parity (LHT). We find that new contributions from the LHT model enhance the coefficient of the epsilon'np term, and suppress that of the epsilon'nt term in the kaon decays, and the correlation between epsilon'/epsilon and rare K decays in the LHT model is largely strengthened. The possible constraints on the LHT parameter space from the epsilon'nt term of kaon decays and epsilon'np/epsilon are discussed. [ Dongdong Liang, Chong S. Chau, and Tsung-MW Yan]{} epsilon'nt and epsilon'np terms in kaon decays are induced at one-loop level in the Littlest Higgs Model with T-parity. The current upper limits on epsilon'nt and epsilon'np from BaBar and Belle collaborations give severe constraints on the LHT parameter space.

Начальник ГУВД Москвы Владимир Пронин подтвердил, что вечером 27 декабря на Манежной площади сработало самодельное взрывное устройство. В оболочке из пластика находилась начинка взрывчатки, включающая множество компонентов - среди них была и селитра. Владимир Пронин заявил, что скорее всего взрыв был устроен из хулиганских побуждений и нанести серьезный ущерб пострадавшим не предусматривалось. Связь между инцидентом на Манежной площади и взрывом на Черкизовском рынке в 21 августа 2006 года из-за которого погибли 11 человек, также не может быть исключена. За два года после аварии по делу о манежном инциденте возбуждено обвинение в адрес нескольких молодых людей с подозрением в состоянии националистической молодежной экстремистской организации. Согласно начальнику ГУВД, в дни судебных заседаний по этому делу получали информацию о возможных угрозах подрыва борта. По предположению источника в оперативной группе, расследующей инцидент на Манежной площади, смесь, использованная для обоих взрывов, была идентичной - она включала магний, марганец, селитру и триперикиси ацетона. Взрыв с мощностью до 150 граммов в тротиловом эквиваленте произошел около 18 часов вечера и стал причиной разбития плафонов уличного освещения и отколота гранитной плитки. К счастью, люди на Охотном ряду были эвакуированы заранее и никто не пострадал.

يعتبر المكدس من بنى البيانات الشائعة والمتداولة في علوم الحاسوب وعلوم البيانات. ويمثل المكدس تنظيماً هرمياً للبيانات يسمح بإضافة وحذف العناصر من القمة أو الأسفل. حيث يشار إلى العناصر المضافة إلى المكدس باسم "الدخول" ويتم الوصول إليها من خلال آخر عنصر تم إضافته، بينما يشار إلى العناصر المحذوفة باسم "الخروج". يستخدم المكدس في العديد من التطبيقات، مثل تحويل التعبيرات الرياضية إلى صيغة عكسية، وإيجاد المسار الأمثل في حل مسائل الذكاء الاصطناعي والذكاء العام، إضافة إلى استخداماته المتعددة في برمجيات الحاسوب ، من أبرز خصائص هذا البناء أنه يعمل بمبدأ "Last In - First Out"، ويتم التحكم بالتغييرات داخل المكدس باستخدام ثلاث عمليات أساسية وهي "Push" لإضافة عنصر جديد إلى المكدس، و"Pop" لحذف العنصر الأخير المضاف، و"Peek" لعرض العنصر الأخير من دون حذفه. يتم تنفيذ هذه العمليات بكفاءة عالية وبصورة سريعة عن طريق استخدام مؤشر على العنصر الأخير المضاف، حيث يتم تعديله بتغيير قيمته كلما تم إضافة عنصر جديد أو حذف عنصر من المكدس. يستخدم المكدس في العديد من تطبيقات الحاسوب، مثل برامج الحاسوب وتطبيقات المواقع الإلكترونية، حيث يتم استخدامه في تنفيذ عمليات الإضافة والحذف والتعديل على البيانات والدخول إلى مستودعات البيانات. كما يستخدم المكدس في البرامج الخاصة بالتواصل بين الأجهزة الإلكترونية ونقل البيانات بينها، حيث يتم تخزين البيانات المرسلة في المكدس ثم نقلها بشكل متتالي إلى الجهاز المستقبل. إن أهمية المكدس في الحاسوب تأتي من قابليته لتنفيذ العديد من العمليات بكفاءة وبسرعة عالية، واستخدامه في العديد من التطبيقات المهمة.

Union Deposit, Pennsylvania is a census-designated place (CDP) in Dauphin County, Pennsylvania, United States. The population was 9,879 at the 2010 census. It is part of the Harrisburg–Carlisle Metropolitan Statistical Area. It was formerly named Union Depot, and was the location of a Union Army hospital during the Civil War. The community was the site of the first rural post office in the United States to be granted a ZIP Code in 1943. Union Deposit is located at 40°14′59″N 76°38′59″W (40.244352, -76.630510), just west of the capital of Pennsylvania, Harrisburg. According to the U.S. Census Bureau, the CDP has a total area of 1.8 square miles (4.6 km2), of which, 1.6 square miles (4.1 km2) of it is land and 0.1 square miles (0.26 km2) of it (6.67%) is water. The community is located along the east bank of the Susquehanna River. As of the census of 2000, there were 9,451 people, 4,121 households, and 2,137 families residing in the CDP. The population density was 5,739.9 people per square mile (2,211.5/km²). There were 4,3321 housing units at an average density of 2,582.1/sq mi (1,003.0/km²). The racial makeup of the CDP was 92.68% White, 5.45% African American, 0.07% Native American, 1.39% Asian, 0.02% Pacific Islander, 0.41% from other races, and 0.63% from two or more races. Hispanic or Latino of any race were 1.69% of the population. There were 4,121 households out of which 27.4% had children under the age of 18 living with them, 41.3% were married couples living together, 10.1% had a female householder with no husband present, and 45.2% were non-families. 37.9% of all households were made up of individuals and 9.3% had someone living alone who was 65 years of age or older. The average household size was 2.17 and the average family size was 2.97. In the CDP, the population was spread out with 21.1% under the age of 18, 9.3% from 18 to 24, 39.8% from 25 to 44, 18.8% from 45 to 64, and 13.6% who were 65 years of age or older. The median age was 36 years. For every 100 females, there were 96.9 males. For every 100 females age 18 and over, there were 96.2 males. As of 2009, the median income for a household in the CDP was $41,451, and the median income for a family was $60,268. Men had a median income of $31,032 versus $27,122 for women. The per capita income for the CDP was $23,017. About 2.4% of families and 5.3% of the population were below the poverty line, including 4.5% of those under age 18 and 3.9% of those age 65 or over. Union Deposit is home to a number of small businesses, many of which are located along Union Deposit Road. The largest business in the area is the Union Deposit Shopping Center, which includes a Giant supermarket, a Wal-Mart, a Home Depot, a Lowes, a Best Buy, a PetSmart, a Five Below, a Sleepy's, a BB&T bank, a Pizza Hut, a McDonald's, a Burger King, a Panera Bread, a Chipotle Mexican Grill, a Pollo Tropical, a Waffle House, a Royal Farms convenience store, a Tim Hortons, a TD Bank, a Dollar Tree, and a Big Lots. The Union Deposit area is served by the Lower Paxton Township Police Department, the Pennsylvania State Police, and the Lower Paxton Township Fire Department. It is also served by the West Shore School District. There are two bridges that cross the Susquehanna River at Union Deposit. The first is the Union Deposit Bridge, which carries U.S. Route 22 and U.S. Route 322. It is a four-lane bridge that was built in 1967 and is upstream (west) of the community. The second is the John Harris Bridge, which carries Pennsylvania Route 39. It is a two-lane bridge that was built in 1935 and is downstream (east) of the community. The Union Deposit area is served by the Capital City Airport, which is located just outside the CDP.

The short answer is: no one knows.  

If you think about it, it's impossible to know how frequently any mental illness occurred in the past, because people in the past didn't have our modern psychological vocabulary.  

So, even if we did have solid records from the middle ages or ancient Greece, no one would know how to interpret them.  

All we can do is look at modern hunter-gatherer societies, where people have pretty much the same psychology we do, and see how common mental illness is now.  

And in modern societies, mental illness is very common.  

For example, in the United States, the National Institute of Mental Health estimates that in 2016,   about  one in five  adults  experience  mental illness  each year.  

If we take depression as an example, the World Health Organization estimates that "... depression is the leading cause of disability worldwide, and is a major contributor to the overall global burden of disease." 

In fact, by 2020, depression is projected to be the second leading contributor to the global burden of disease, after ischemic heart disease.  

Now, all of these estimates are based on self-reported data, which is not always accurate, but there's no reason to think the real numbers are much different.  

Hunter-gatherers are, by definition, not very well-documented, but there's no reason to think that their rates of depression are any lower than ours.  

If anything, they may be higher, because they lack many of our modern sources of psychological comfort.  

The bottom line is, if you're looking for a time and place where depression was uncommon, the best evidence suggests that you should be looking at modern, wealthy, industrialized societies, not hunter-gatherers, or ancient Greece, or the middle ages.

Когато обяснил на родителите си от къде е, те останали без думи!

Когато съм бил малък, родителите ми ме посредстваха за осиновяване от американско семейство. От това време и до днес, живея в САЩ и имам американско гражданство. Въпреки, че аз съм българин, а моите родители са американци, никога не съм изпитвал усещането за чужбина, защото ме приеха в семейството, където бях отгледан и обичан като собствен син.

Петнадесет години по-късно, реших да разкрия моето произход на родителите ми. Бях получил много информация за българската култура и история и реших, че е време те да знаят истината. Но не очаквах реакцията, която получих.

Седнах родителите си на една маса и им разказах за моята история, за усещането за чужденец по време на обучението ми в университета, за недостатъчността си като човек, защото не знам моята история. Внезапно започнах да плача, а родителите ми попрепълниха от състрадание и се опитаха да ме успокоят.

И след като успях да се овладея, им разказах за усещането ми за чужбина, защото не знам моята история, ако и то е моето минало. Тогава родителите ми ме прекъснаха за да ми кажат, че не разбират защо се чувствам така, тъй като са ме приели като свой и никога не са ме разглеждали като чужденец. Но все пак бях убеден в идеята си да хвърля светлина върху моята възможна история и минало.

Когато ги попитах как знаеха да ме приемат, без да знаят точно кой съм, родителите ми ми разказаха, че вярват в едно просто нещо: за тях е важен характерът на човека, а не произходът му. Те ми казаха, че могат да видят кой съм като личност и когато ме приеха в семейството си, видяха какъв човек съм и беше им наистина все едно, че съм им роден син.

Сега, след като им разказах за моите български корени и наследство, те останаха без думи. Но след малко, майка ми се усмихна и ми каза, че докато съм аз техен син, те са ми родители и нищо не може да промени това.

Това обсъждане ме научи на няколко много важни неща. Първо, че наистина не е важно къде си роден, а кой си като личност. Второ, че семейството не включва само кръвна родина и генетика, а и връзки, които се формират от любов и приемане. Накрая, осъзнах, че е важно да знам своето минало, но не е необходимо то да ме дефинира като личност. Аз съм това, което правя в живота си и как представям себе си, не произходът ми.

Така че, истина е, че колкото по-рано знаеш от къде идваш, толкова по-рано можеш да се определиш към кого искаш да станеш. Но както моите родители ми казаха, аз вече съм техен син и нищо не може да промени това. Те ме приеха в семейството си, когато бях само един малък момче и оттогава до момента на този наш разговор, нямаше и няма никаква разлика в това. Макар и да имам български корени, никак не ми е чуждо усещането на дом и принадлежност, защото имам семейство, което ме обича и приема точно такъв, какъвто съм.

An examination of why the term “stolen” is used in reference to Indian land and not “conquered” like other civilizations is essential to understanding the US’s fraught relationship with its native population. Although there are many interpretations of the reasons behind this linguistic choice, many revolve around the lack of recognition and respect afforded to Native Americans and the history of their suffering and mistreatment.

To begin, the term “conquered” implies a certain level of mutual respect and understanding between the parties involved and suggests that one group was victorious in battle, fully engaged in a conflict. For Native Americans whose ‘land’ was taken from them, and whose people were sometimes killed as a result, the ‘conquest’ metaphor does not fit the true narrative of the relationship between Native Americans and European settlers. Settlers came to the Americas and laid claims on existing land and resources, with Native Americans often left with no choice but to fight a battle that had already been lost.

Further, the term ‘conquered’ itself can be problematic due to its association with colonialism and imperialism. This was an era of history when many nations rose to power through the forceful subjugation of other people and nations. Such language can be aspirational in nature and encourage the same behaviour in other countries and contexts, including in the US. For example, use of the term “conquer” might lead to illegal land acquisition and the continuation of a colonial mindset in the US today.

By contrast, use of the term “stolen” is entirely in keeping with the reality of what happened. It is also an opportunity to honour the struggle of the native people, as stolen is a term that speaks to an ongoing battle against injustice.

Deutsche Naval Yards GmbH (DNY) ist ein Unternehmen, das 2013 gegründet wurde und aus der Insolvenz von SSW Schichau Seebeck Shipyard hervorgegangen ist. Der Wirtschaftszweig des Unternehmens ist Schiffbau. Deutsche Naval Yards hat seinen Hauptsitz in Kiel und betreibt auch Werften in Tabarz/Thüringen, Wolgast/Mecklenburg-Vorpommern und Rendsburg/Schleswig-Holstein.

Deutsche Naval Yards zählt zu den größeren Schiffsbauern in Deutschland und ist einer der wenigen privaten Schiffbauer in der maritimen Wirtschaft. Das Unternehmen entwickelt und produziert Schiffe, darunter Fregatten, Korvetten, Handelsschiffe und Megayachten. Deutsche Naval Yards ist insbesondere in den Bereichen Design, Engineering und Projektmanagement tätig.

Nach der Gründung baute deutsche Naval Yards in Rekordzeit einen Rumpf für eine korvette, welcher im April 2016 an ThyssenKrupp Marine Systems ausgeliefert wurde. Die Korvette erhielt den Namen "K130 Hermes" und ist nach der Fregatte "Sachsen-Anhalt" das zweite Schiff,das von Deutschland an die Marine der Republik Singapur ausgeliefert wurde.

Im Januar 2019 verkündete ThyssenKrupp Marine Systems, dass man mit DNY in Gesprächen stehe, um ein Angebot für das Zusammenwachsen von beiden Unternehmen zu formulieren. Ein paar Monate später gab ThyssenKrupp Marine Systems bekannt, dass die Gespräche zwischen den Unternehmen zu keinem endgültigen Ergebnis geführt hätten, es jedoch weiterhin Verhandlungen gäbe. Im Juni 2020 konnte dann letztendlich ein Durchbruch erreicht werden und die Übernahme von Deutsche Naval Yards erfolgte durch ThyssenKrupp Marine Systems.  Damit hat sich das Unternehmen einer größeren Gruppe angeschlossen und sich den Herausforderungen der maritimen Wirtschaft besser stellen können. Deutsche Naval Yards betreibt derzeit unter dem Dach von ThyssenKrupp Marine Systems weiterhin seine eigenen Werften. 

Deutsche Naval Yards verfolgt das Ziel, im Wettbewerb mit anderen Schiffswerften wettbewerbsfähig zu bleiben und weiterhin seine eigene Position im Schiffbau-Markt zu stärken. Deutsche Naval Yards ist Teil einer größeren maritimen Gruppe und profitiert von dem globalen Netzwerk der ThyssenKrupp Marine Systems. Deutsche Naval Yards plant auch in der Zukunft weitere innovative Entwicklungen in der Schiffbau-Industrie.

الترفورين أو الزنبور المتحجر (بالإنجليزية: Trilobite)، هو عبارة عن حيوان بحري متحجر يعود إلى ما قبل التاريخ، ويتكون من ثلاث مخاريط تشكل جسده المسطح الشكل، وهو من اللافقاريات التي عاشت على نطاق واسع في المحيطات حتى اختفت في الجزء الأخير من العصر البرمائي وهذا بسبب ظروف بيئية تغيرت بشكل كبير، بالإضافة إلى الظروف الجيولوجية التي أدت إلى انقراضها. يتميز الترفورين بواجهة الرأس المخروطية المتقادمة و ثلاث قسم ظهرية ينتهي بفجوة ظهرية عريضة تشكل “حوض الفم” و يتميز ب طبقات الدرع خارج جسده و التي تحميه من الأعداء وبعض الزوابع البحرية. كما يحتوي بعض الأنواع من هذا الحيوان على عدسات بصرية كاميرا وكان لها وظيفة في التحكم في ضوء البيئة وإظهار الصورة باضطراب أقل. تعد الترفورين من أكثر الحيوانات البرمائية الغامضة والرومانسية حيث تتواجد عدة آراء بخصوص عمر هذه الحيوانات واساسها تعتبر قديمة. يعتبر الترفورين الحيوانات المتحجرة الأكثر اكتشافا في التطور البيولوجي للأرض، حيث ترجع إلى أكثر من 500 مليون سنة وتعد واحدة من الكائنات الحية الأقدم التي انتشرت على وجه الأرض، كما أنها تعتبر من الحيوانات المهمة في الأبحاث الجيولوجية. وتتنوع أشكال الترفورين في الطول والعرض والألوان، وكانت تطفو على سطح المحيطات بغرض البحث عن الغذاء والانتقال. يوجد الكثير من الأنواع المختلفة من الترفورين ويتقاطع بينها في النظام العلمي، وقد وجدت بعض الأنواع منها في العصور الجيولوجية الأولى، وتشكل الآن عينات متحجرة هامة للغاية لدراسة تطورات الحياة الأولى والظروف الجيولوجية في تلك الفترات. على الرغم من فترة وجودهم البالغة 270 مليون سنة، لا يزالون يثير حتى الآن اهتمام الكثيرين في العالم، وتم اكتشاف آلاف النماذج من هذا الكائن الغامض في جميع أنحاء العالم، وتساعد هذه النماذج في فهم أساليب الرؤية والتقنيات البصرية المستخدمة في تلك الفترة وغيرها من أنماط و سلوكيات هذا الكائن المتحجر.

While it’s certainly possible that coffee brewing techniques and the availability of cream and sugar would different across the time periods, it’s also possible that you would enjoy the coffee. Coffee in it’s most basic form is a bean and water ceremony and while the Coffee plants growth and ripening are more complex biological processes the end result is still just hot water and coffee beans. The revolutionary era in America was a time where innovation and changes were happening rapidly, and while the speed of those changes may have been too rapid for you to fully appreciate the process and understand the reasoning behind it, the end result should have been a tasty cup of coffee. While coffee drinking was commonplace during the revolutionary era, the availability of cream and sugar would have been relatively new. Americans drank coffee black because it was unknown and a mystery. While the water was boiling and the coffee was being brewed, it was also an important part of the discovery process as seeing if the caffeine would make people more active and able to function as they needed to. The people of the revolutionary era loved their coffee and were willing to try almost anything, so if the coffee was a turn-off it’s likely they would have simply said the coffee didn’t “taste good” and passed it off. As a modern-day beverage, coffee has had hundreds of years of trial and error to optimize the process, allowing for better coffee brewing techniques, more consistency in brewing, and more options when it comes to ingredients. Jakarta, CNN Indonesia -- Malcolm X, aktivis dan pemimpin pergerakan hak-hak sipil Amerika Serikat, baru-baru ini dilaporkan sangat tersentuh dengan pengalaman melakukan ibadah haji di Mekkah, Arab Saudi. Malcolm X memiliki nama asli Malcolm Little, dan dia dikenal sebagai pemimpin gerakan hak-hak sipil di Amerika Serikat pada dekade 1950-an dan 1960-an, khususnya dalam memperjuangkan hak-hak orang kulit hitam. Meskipun, Malcolm X dulunya adalah seorang Muslim, namun dia memutuskan untuk meninggalkan agamanya selama beberapa tahun. Setelah dia dihukum penjara pada tahun 1946, ia memiliki banyak waktu untuk membaca dan memperdalam pemahaman agama Islam kembali. Akhirnya, ia kembali menjadi seorang Muslim dan bergabung dengan Nation of Islam. Namun, setelah terpengaruh oleh belajar Islam yang lebih luas dan perjalanannya ke Mekkah, Malcolm X meninggalkan organisasi tersebut pada tahun 1964. Setelah menjadi seorang Muslim Sunni, dia dijuluki sebagai Al-Hajj Malik Al-Shabazz setelah menyelesaikan perjalanannya ke Tanah Suci Islam pada tahun 1964, dan menjadi lebih melihat kesamaan antara Muslim dan orang-orang Afrika, menyebabkan dia menjadi lebih terbuka pada orang lain. "Ibadah haji adalah pengalaman yang luar biasa. Selama bertahun-tahun, saya pergi dari satu negara Muslim ke negara Muslim lainnya, terus mempelajari tentang kelompok-kelompok, tentang migrasi mereka, tentang Islam di masing-masing negara." ujar Malcolm X dalam sebuah wawancara setelah kembali dari Tanah Suci. Malcolm X menggambarkan perjalanannya ke Mekkah sebagai titik balik dalam hidupnya. Pengalamannya di Tanah Suci Islam dikenang sebagai perjalanan penting dalam perjalanan ke arah kebijaksanaan dan toleransi. Setelah kembali ke Amerika Serikat, dia mempertajam pesannya tentang kesatuan dan perdamaian antara semua bangsa dan keyakinan. Ritual haji di Mekkah, Arab Saudi, adalah salah satu dari lima rukun Islam. Setiap tahun, sekitar dua juta Muslim dari seluruh dunia datang ke Mekkah untuk melaksanakan ritual ini. Ibadah haji, yang mencakup langkah-langkah seperti thawaf (berjalan mengelilingi Ka'bah) dan sai (berjalan menuju bukit Safa dan Marwah), dipercayai sebagai jalan untuk memperbaharui komitmen setiap Muslim dengan agama mereka dan juga sebagai momentum untuk memperkuat ketakwaan mereka. Kisah Malcolm X yang tersentuh dengan ritual haji menunjukkan betapa kuatnya kekuatan rohani yang dapat merubah pandangan seseorang tentang dirinya dan dunia sekitarnya. Perjalanannya ke Mekkah telah mengubahnya menjadi sosok yang lebih terbuka dan toleran, dan itu adalah pesan yang sangat relevan di dunia kita saat ini, di mana dialog antarbudaya sangat diperlukan untuk mewujudkan keberagaman dan persatuan.

The alpha-helical structure is one of the most common secondary structures in proteins, and it plays an important role in protein folding/unfolding processes.  In this work we analyze the results obtained by applying two different theoretical approaches to predict the stability of alphahelices against unfolding induced by temperature changes or chemical denaturants (urea). The first approach consists on using molecular dynamics simulations at constant pressure with explicit solvent molecules. We have performed these calculations for three peptides that contain between four and six amino acids per turn. Our results show that the presence of urea destabilizes the helical conformation more than increasing the temperature does. This effect can be explained as due to the preferential solvation of the peptide backbone by water molecules when compared to the side chains. The second method used here relies on statistical mechanics concepts applied to lattice models. These models are able to reproduce some features observed experimentally such as the dependence of the melting temperatures on the number of residues per turn.

Native Americans were able to resist slavery in North America in a number of ways. The resistance was often a combination of direct opposition, escapism, silent protest, and other resistance tactics. For instance, the Cherokee tribe actively fought against the Trans-Atlantic slave trade, with some members joining groups to resist and eventually end it.

In addition to direct opposition, Native Americans also used a variety of other tactics to resist enslavement. Some Native American tribes sent their members away to avoid capture. Others went on the run, living and working in hiding in cities and small towns. Native Americans might even disguise themselves as non-Native and blend into the population to avoid being caught and enslaved.

Native Americans also used more subtle means to resist enslavement. The Iroquois, Choctaw, and other tribes used silent protest by refusing orders, refusing to work for their slave holders, or shunning their captors whenever possible. Additionally, some Native Americans formed secret societies to organize and support those who were planning to escape or oppose the enslavement of Native Americans.

The cost of importing slaves from Africa was enormous, and it ensured that there were few people who could afford to enslave Native Americans. Additionally, there were already plenty of slaves already living in North America, and many Native American tribes were unwilling to be subjugated. Furthermore, Native Americans had a developed sense of their own identity and were determined to preserve their unique cultures and freedom. For these reasons, the enslavement of Native Americans was not widespread.

Seidr is an Old Norse term for a form of pre-Christian Norse magical practice. Seidr is almost exclusively thought of as a feminine practice, and there is a good reason for this. In Nordic culture, women were seen as more connected to nature and natural forces, which were often associated with magic. Women were also considered to possess special powers that allowed them to manipulate forces, such as the power of prophecy and manipulating luck and weather.

Since paganism was a nature-based religion and magic was seen as a connection to the natural order, it became associated with women in Viking culture. Women were seen as more receptive to spiritual currents, capable of understanding the hidden order of nature, and more likely to have contacts to other realms. Women were also seen as the source of magical knowledge. This reverence for female magic was so strong that in some regions anyone practicing magic was considered female, regardless of their sex.

There is evidence that seidr practitioners often took the form of wizened old women. This could represent a symbolic method of representing the wisdom and power associated with women in Viking culture. Old women were seen as channelling inherited knowledge, as well as having deeper access to natural forces. This connection to the past was very important in a culture that had many elements of oral tradition.

Like many aspects of Viking culture, seidr was characterised by paradox. Male and female practitioners alike were believed to have queer magical powers that could be used for good, or evil. The connection between magic and femininity was seen as particularly strong, and women were seen as experts in the manipulation of natural forces. This helped explain why seidr was generally seen as a woman's domain in Viking culture.

Throughout history, comedy and satire have been powerful tools to persuade and inform not only absolute monarchies, but also other forms of authority. The role of the jester, or court fool, was not only to provide entertainment, but also to offer critical commentary and advice to the monarch. This was done through the use of humor, irony, and parody.

In medieval Europe, the jester was often the only person in the court who could speak the truth to the king without fear of retribution. While the monarch and other members of the court were bound by strict social norms and protocols, the jester was free to speak openly and candidly. This gave the jester a unique position of influence, as their witty comments and observations could shape the monarch's decisions and actions.

However, it wasn't just jesters who used comedy and satire to influence those in power. During the Enlightenment period, philosophers such as Voltaire and Montesquieu used satire to critique the absolute monarchies of their time, challenging the idea of divine right and supporting the ideas of individual freedom and democracy. Their works were influential in shaping the political landscape of the time and paving the way for modern democracies.

In modern times, comedians and satirists continue to use their platforms to offer political commentary and criticism. Shows such as The Daily Show and Last Week Tonight with John Oliver have become popular for their ability to inform and engage audiences while exposing flaws in the political system.

In summary, while the jester's role in speaking truth to power may have been more literal in medieval times, comedy and satire have been used throughout history as powerful tools to persuade and inform those in positions of authority. Their influence has shaped our political and social structures, and our continued use of them reflects their enduring power.

We present photometric observations of the brown-dwarf eclipsing binary 2MASS J05352184-0546085, which show a surprising reversal of temperatures in the primary and secondary components. The system consists of a +62°C brown dwarf with a mass of 73 MJup, and a −34°C brown dwarf with a mass of 50 MJup. We observe the system in photometric twilight, when the brighter object is occulted by the cooler object. The system has been observed with the 2MASS survey, the Magellan Telescopes, and the Very Large Array. We find that the masses of the two brown dwarfs are too close to be explained by a single mass model in which the masses are equal. This suggests that the system must have formed through the fragmentation of a single object, with the two fragments having very different temperatures. This is the first system in which a significant change in temperature between components has been detected, and the first demonstration that brown-dwarf binaries can be formed by the fragmentation of a single object.
