Гост в студиото на „София Ден и Нощ“, съпредседателят на партията Красимир Ганчев показа една много специфична перспектива.

"Имам чуството, че всичко в България е цирк, но когато говорим за цирка на "Армията", то това е наистина ниво. Толкова се замесиха, че не можеха да разберат кой би бил най-добрият начин да видят маймуната на голям екран, ала пък да не го наранят," сподели Гачев.

Политикът заяви, че е обезпокоен от начина, по който някои поставиха себе си над закона и позволиха да злоусползват целия процес. "Имаха достъп, всеки се прави на маймуна и никой не спря да разсъждава за отговорността, която трябва да поеме всеки от нас като граждани на България," засегна Ганчев.

Когато беше попитан дали има надежда за по-добро управление на този вид обществени дейности, политикът заяви, че първо трябва да се направи разграничение между различните функции на държавните органи и частните фирми.

"В България имаме често проблем с пресичане на интереси и взаимни ползи, затова трябва да укрепим мерките за контрол на хора, които разбират само от новини и оплаквания, а не от управление," приключи Красимир Ганчев.

Spider is a type of pulp fiction magazine that centres around the exploits of a particular protagonist. It appeared in the United States during the early twentieth century, between 1944 and 1949, with a brief revival in the form of a paperback series in the 1970s. The original Spider magazine was created by award-winning pulps publishers Popular Publications. It initially used the pseudonym Grant Stockbridge for its authors, although later issues did feature appearances by some famous authors such as Robert E. Howard, Robert Bloch, and Norvell Page. The stories for each numeral featured a vigilante anti-hero named The Spider, whose true identity was never disclosed, who solved problems with his special brand of justice. The Spider was given a few superhuman abilities, such as a superhuman intuition and the ability to create chemical weapons. His real name was Richard Wentworth, although most of his antagonists addressed him as The Spider. The Spider first appeared in issue number 1 (October 18th, 1944) and quickly gained an audience of fans devoted to crime-fighting stories that were fast-paced and action-packed. He was the feature character in 66 of the next 78 issues before the magazine was discontinued in 1949. This magazine was referred to as "Spicy Detective" in the early issues and "The Spider Magazine" in late issues, due to its content being considered to be ‘spicy’ by the standards of its time. The stories followed The Spider's adventures as he fought criminals from all types of crime: from gangsters to mad scientists, alien monsters to Nazi spies. Over the years, The Spider was shaped into a vigilante figure, with stories becoming even more violent and risque than in the original run. In 1970, a paperback series was published that reprinted collected Spider stories from early issues. The stories, which had been extensively edited for the new audience, were a moderate success but the series was short-lived and by 1974, it had vanished again. Due to its long absence and lack of exposure, The Spider and the magazine he personified are all-but forgotten among new generations of readers. While the magazines were never part of the popular culture, they had a powerful influence on the genre of superhero and vigilante stories, and The Spider will always remain a nostalgic bit of pulp fiction history.

The Mohican (or Mahican) people are a Native American tribe located primarily in New York and Michigan in the United States and Ontario in Canada. They are a subgroup of the Munsee branch of the Algonquin and are members of the Iroquois. The word “Mohican” was a term used by colonists to falsely refer to the tribe. It is said to be derived from a mischoice of the tribe’s traditional self-ascription Mahikander, which translates to “the people of the great river” as they originated in areas adjacent to the Hudson river. Mohicans historically spoke the Munsee dialect of Algonquian language. Through European colonization and contact, the Mohican descended into poverty and dispersed around the United States and Canada. By the late 19th century, most of their language and customs were gone due to assimilation. Due to their move of location, the Mohicans have many similarities with their Munsee and Lenape counterparts. Historically, the typically semi-nomadic tribes had villages of longhouses which were clustered around the area of the Hudson Valley, stretching from present-day New York to Berkshire County, Massachusetts. As well as these, other villages were known to have been built in Vermont and southern New Hampshire. Culturally, the Algonquian-speaking Mohicans largely based their beliefs around nature and their environment, paying homage to their doctrines in the woods and rivers, thus creating a spiritual bond between both. Traditionally, they were known to have hunting and fishing rituals, using apparel and weapons made from materials such as stone, flint, and animal pelts. The iconic image of the Mohican is heavily linked to the colonial novel Last of the Mohicans written by James Fenimore Cooper in 1826. The novel, which has been adapted into a film and a miniseries, has helped gave the tribe a type of celebrity status and appreciation, particularly in the United States. Moreover, the Mohicans have since began to heavily reconverge in the state of Wisconsin. The Mohican Nation of Wisconsin Federal Court decision in 1994 established the tribe's political autonomy, allowing them to set up tribally-owned lands, implement their own laws and guidelines, and self-identify as Native Americans. In modern day, the Mohican are still recognized as a Federally-recognized tribe, having maintained their status as citizens throughout many major changes in American history. Today, the Mohicans are celebrated as a cultural group, being known for their advocacy of environmental causes, their participation in pow-wows and other ceremonies, and preserving the culture and language of their ancestors for future generations. 胆囊炎是指胆囊内壁发生炎症的疾病。其症状包括：

1.上腹部疼痛：疼痛程度不同，有些人只是不适，有些人则会感到严重的疼痛。

2.恶心、呕吐：胆囊炎患者常伴有恶心、呕吐等症状，特别是吃油多的食物或者一些刺激性食物时。

3.发热、畏寒：由于炎症导致体内有毒物质生成，患者常常会发热和出现畏寒的情况。

治疗方法：

1.药物治疗：可以使用消炎、镇痛和解痉等药物来缓解症状。

2.手术治疗：对于胆囊炎病情较为严重或是已经失去功能的胆囊，需要进行手术切除。

3.饮食调节：建议适量减少油腻食物的摄入，尽量减轻胆囊的负担。

总的来说，在发现胆囊炎的早期症状时，应该及时就医，接受专业的治疗和指导，以避免病情进一步加重和迅速恶化。

The low carbon abundance of I Zw 18 has been a puzzle for decades. Using the SWIFT X-ray Telescope, we measure the gas phase oxygen abundance in the interstellar medium of I Zw 18. We find 12 + log(O/H) = 7.95 ± 0.07, 1σ, significantly lower than the inferred oxygen abundance in its large-scale interstellar medium hydrogen envelope (22.78 ± 0.15), and much lower than the average 12 + log(O/H) for star-forming galaxies. The discrepancy could be due to recent chemical enrichment, abnormal nucleosynthetic origins for some elements, or unusual dust depletion patterns, but we consider an alternative explanation that some of the standard assumption for TSV models are not applicable to I Zw 18. This research was presented in a paper titled "SWIFT X-ray Telescope Detection of Oxygen in the Interstellar Medium of I Zw 18" by J. Brinkerink et al., which can be found at https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.00069

Child abuse is a serious issue that affects millions of children worldwide. It is a form of trauma that can have long-lasting effects and can even be fatal in severe cases. If you suspect that a child is a victim of abuse, it is crucial to take action and report it to the appropriate authorities. In this article, we'll discuss how to identify a victim of child abuse and recognize its symptoms.

Recognize Symptoms of Physical Abuse

Physical abuse involves the use of physical force that results in bodily injury, such as hitting, kicking, or burning a child. These are some of the signs to watch out for:

- Unexplained bruises, welts, or other marks on the child's body
- Burns or scalds
- Broken bones or fractures
- Unexplained injuries that the child tries to explain away or blames on others
- Reluctance to remove clothing in public
- Shyness or flinching when approached by adults

Watch for Symptoms of Emotional Abuse

Emotional abuse is another type of abuse that can have long-lasting effects on a child's mental health. It involves deliberate acts or omissions that cause emotional harm, such as constant criticism, rejection, or bullying. Here are some of the symptoms you might see:

- Low self-esteem or self-worth
- Chronic depression or anxiety
- Fearful or withdrawn behavior
- Aggressiveness or anger toward others
- Suicidal behavior or talk
- Difficulty trusting others

Look for Symptoms of Sexual Abuse

Sexual abuse refers to any unwanted sexual contact with a child or exposure to sexually explicit content. It can cause long-term psychological damage and can be difficult to detect. Here are some of the symptoms you might see:

- Unexplained physical symptoms such as pain or bleeding in the genital area
- Difficulty walking or sitting
- Engaging in sexual behaviors that are inappropriate for their age
- Nightmares or bedwetting
- Unexplained fear or aversion to certain people or places
- Suicidal thoughts or talk

Identify Signs of Neglect

Neglect involves the failure to provide for a child's basic needs, such as food, shelter, or medical care. It is sometimes called "passive abuse" and can be just as damaging as physical or emotional abuse. Here are some of the signs you might see:

- Malnourishment or lack of food
- Dirty or unclean clothing
- Poor hygiene or dental care
- Lack of supervision or abandonment
- Chronic health problems that are left untreated
- Poor academic performance or missed school days

Watch for Any Behavioral Changes

Child abuse can cause significant changes in a child's behavior. Here are some of the changes you might notice:

- Sudden mood swings or changes in temperament
- Nightmares or trouble sleeping
- Separation anxiety or clingy behavior
- Aggressiveness or violent behavior
- Difficulty concentrating or paying attention
- Increased risk-taking behavior

Consider Changes in the Child's Social Interactions

A child who is being abused or neglected may also have changes in their social behavior. Here are some of the signs you might see:

- Changes in friendship patterns or social groups
- Fear or reluctance to go to school or participate in extracurricular activities
- Refusal to speak or interact with certain people
- Excessive need for attention or affection
- Inappropriate sexual behavior
- Running away from home

Watch for Any Changes in the Child's General Mood

Child abuse can also affect a child's emotional wellbeing. Here are some of the signs you might see:

- Changes in eating or sleeping patterns
- Low energy or motivation
- Lack of interest in activities they used to enjoy
- Apathy or hopelessness
- Irritability or easily triggered anger
- Withdrawing from family or friends

Notice Changes in School Attendance or Performance

A child who is being abused or neglected may frequently be late to class or miss school entirely, and may have trouble focusing on classes. Here are some of the signs you might see:

- Excessive absences or tardiness
- Difficulty completing assignments or homework
- Decreased participation or involvement in school activities
- Drop in grades or academic performance
- Complaints from teachers about changes in behavior or academic achievement

Look for Self-Destructive Behaviors

Child abuse can also lead to self-destructive behavior. Here are some of the signs you might see:

- Self-injurious behavior such as cutting or burning
- Substance abuse or addiction
- Risk-taking behavior such as excessive partying or dangerous driving
- Disregard for personal safety or well-being
- Suicidal thoughts or talk

Realize That It May Not Be Obvious

Child abuse can be difficult to detect, and many victims may not exhibit any clear signs or symptoms. It is essential to be aware of the possible indicators, but it's also important to trust your instincts and report any concerns you may have.

Check for Physical Health Problems

Child abuse can also have physical health consequences, such as:

- Chronic headaches or stomachaches
- Difficulty sleeping or insomnia
- High blood pressure or other cardiovascular problems
- Chronic back or neck pain
- Substance abuse or addiction

Pay Attention to Mental Health Problems

Child abuse can also lead to mental health problems, such as:

- Anxiety disorders or panic attacks
- Depression or suicidal thoughts
- Post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD)
- Substance abuse or addiction
- Difficulty forming and maintaining relationships

Consider Criminal History and Violent Behavior

Parents or caregivers with a history of criminal activity or violent behavior may be more likely to abuse or neglect their children. Keep an eye out for any red flags, such as a criminal record or involvement with law enforcement.

Look for Social Disconnection or Isolation

While some people are natural loners and may not prefer to socialize much, someone who was abused as a child may be more likely to reject social advances from others, have a history of broken relationships, or be unmarried and live alone.

Watch for Abnormal Stress Responses

Child abuse can trigger abnormal stress responses in children, such as:

- Trouble sleeping or insomnia
- Nightmares or flashbacks
- Physical symptoms such as headaches or stomach aches
- Withdrawal or avoidance behavior
- Increased risk-taking behavior or self-destructive behavior

Know When to Call for Help

If you suspect that a child is being abused or neglected, it's essential to take action and report your concerns to the appropriate authorities. Contact your local law enforcement or child protective services agency, or dial 911 if you believe the child is in immediate danger.

Learn About the Different Types of Child Abuse

Child abuse can take many different forms, including physical, emotional, sexual, and neglect. It's essential to educate yourself about the different types of abuse and how to recognize their symptoms.

Understand Misconceptions About Child Abuse

There are many misconceptions about child abuse, such as the belief that it only happens in low-income families or that all abusers are strangers. It's essential to understand these misconceptions and learn the facts about child abuse.

Research the Effects of Abuse on Children

Child abuse can have significant and long-lasting effects on a child's mental and physical health, as well as their behavior, academic performance, and social skills. It's important to research the effects of abuse on children and understand the impact it can have on their lives.

In conclusion, it is essential to be aware of the possible indicators of child abuse and to take action if you suspect that a child is being abused or neglected. By recognizing the signs and reporting your concerns, you may be able to prevent further harm and help a child get the support and care they need.

مرض الصرع، المعروف بـ "التشنج"، هو اضطراب عصبي مزمن يؤثر على وظائف الدماغ ويؤدي إلى حدوث تشنجات في العضلات وفقدان وعي وتغير في المشاعر والحالة المزاجية. يعتبر الصرع من أكثر الأمراض العصبية شيوعًا في العالم، ويصيب حوالي 50 مليون شخص في جميع أنحاء العالم. وقد يحدث في أي عمر بدءًا من الولادة وحتى الشيخوخة. تحدث الأزمات الصرعية بسبب تشوه في إلكترونيات الدماغ، إذ تنتج تلك التشوهات فعالية كهربائية شديدة في المخ، وهو ما يؤدي إلى التشنجات المفاجئة. تختلف الأزمات الصرعية في كثافتها والمدة الزمنية لحدوثها، وعادة ما تكون مرتبطة بعوامل معينة، مثل التوتر والإجهاد والنوم المفرط وعدم الالتزام بالأدوية. تتضمن الأعراض الأساسية لمرض الصرع التشنجات العضلية، وفقدان الوعي، وتغير في الحالة المزاجية والمشاعر، وتأثيرات على الوظائف الذهنية، مثل الذاكرة والانتباه والتركيز. وعلى الرغم من أنه لا يوجد علاج نهائي لمرض الصرع حاليًا، تتوفر العديد من العلاجات المختلفة للحد من الأعراض وإدارة المرض. وتشمل العلاجات الشائعة لمرض الصرع الأدوية المضادة للصرع المختلفة، والتي تعمل على تقليل تكرار الأزمات الصرعية وتحسين نوعية الحياة للمرضى. كما يتوفر أيضًا العلاج الجراحي الذي يهدف إلى إزالة أجزاء الدماغ التي تسبب الأزمات الصرعية في بعض الحالات. ويمكن تعزيز جودة الحياة للمصابين بمرض الصرع من خلال العلاج السلوكي المعرفي والعلاج النفسي ودعم المجموعة وحماية الحقوق.

Physical Sciences-Oncology Centers A Physical Sciences-Oncology Center (PS-OC) is a research center that brings together physicists, engineers, and oncologists to integrate physical science (e.g., physics, chemistry, engineering) approaches with oncological research to better understand, and ultimately to control, cancer. There are currently nine Physical Sciences-Oncology Centers in the United States. The Physical Sciences-Oncology Centers program was initiated in 2009 by the National Cancer Institute (NCI) with the goal of bringing innovative technologies and unique perspectives of physical scientists to the fight against cancer while training the next generation of physical science researchers. Each PS-OC is a partnership between a physical sciences institution and an oncology institution. The physical sciences institution may be a university, college, or research institution with faculty and facilities dedicated to the study of physics, chemistry, or engineering. The oncology institution may be a university, college, hospital, or research institution with expertise and facilities in basic, translational, and/or clinical cancer research. The Physical Sciences-Oncology Centers program is built on the premise that the physical sciences have unique and powerful methods for attacking problems that are difficult, yet critical, to the oncologist. The physical sciences include many subdisciplines that make use of state-of-the-art experimental, computational, and theoretical methods to achieve a deep understanding of physical systems. The methods and perspectives of the physical sciences can be applied to many important problems in oncology that are not easily addressed by traditional means. The Physical Sciences-Oncology Centers program supports research projects that address important problems in cancer research. Each project consists of a team of investigators from the physical sciences and oncology institutions in the PS-OC. The teams are led by a principal investigator from each institution. The projects are intended to be highly interactive and multidisciplinary, with investigators contributing their unique expertise and perspective to the project. Projects are expected to have a strong potential for technological innovation with potential impact on cancer biology or clinical oncology. In addition to supporting research, the Physical Sciences-Oncology Centers program supports the training of predoctoral and postdoctoral trainees in the physical sciences and oncologic sciences. The goal of the training program is to prepare the next generation of physical and oncologic scientists to work together to solve the most challenging problems in cancer research.

Anis Matta (born December 22, 1958) is an Indonesian politician and former Chairman of the Prosperous Justice Party (PKS). He was a member of the People's Representative Council (DPR) from 2014-2017 for West Java's 7th electoral district. Matta was born in Baturaja, South Sumatra, and graduated from the Faculty of Agriculture at Bogor Institute of Agriculture (IPB) in 1985. He later earned a master's degree in strategic studies from the National Defense Institute of Indonesia (Lemhannas). Matta was a founding member of the PKS and served as its chairman from 2004 to 2015. During his tenure, the party grew rapidly and became the fifth-largest party in the DPR. Matta was known for his conservative Islamic views and advocacy for a more Islamic-based government. Under his leadership, the PKS faced several controversies, including allegations of embezzlement and corruption. In 2015, Matta resigned as the party's chairman due to the scandal. Matta also served as the Chairman of the National Campaign Team for Joko Widodo and Jusuf Kalla in the 2014 Indonesian Presidential election, which they won. After leaving the PKS, Matta founded a new party called the New Indonesia Movement (GRINDO) in 2017. However, the party failed to gain significant support and was dissolved in 2019. Aside from his political career, Matta is also a writer and has published several books, including Kunci Kebahagiaan (The Key to Happiness) and Islam Inspiratif (Inspirational Islam). In 2019, Matta was arrested by the Corruption Eradication Commission (KPK) on charges of corruption related to his time as the chairman of the PKS. He denied the allegations and claimed he was being targeted for his political views. Matta's controversial political career has made him a polarizing figure in Indonesian politics, with some admiring his conservative Islamic views while others criticize him for corruption and alleged misuse of power.

Великая пятница — день, которым закончился длинный, тяжелый и мучительный разговор в вечер четверга с Н. Удивительно, но он полностью не понимал себя и искал смысла в жизни. Этот человек постоянно отказывался принимать во внимание любое чужое мнение, из-за этого он приходил в тупик и разговор превращался в кошмар. Виной всему был гордынский подход к христианству. В то же время, есть максимализм, догматизм и морализм, которые превращают весь мир в жуткое, искаженное зеркало. Он живет в иллюзии, что на «изучение Бога» можно потратить всю свою жизнь, но ничего не понять. Корень всех трудностей — в изначальном выборе метода для «изучения» Бога. Когда между ними стоит методика, то Бог выглядит нереальными глазами. Таким образом, метод — это изначальная гордыня человека, его попытка навязать Богу свои категории, создать божественного идола.

The 2016 FIBA Under-17 World Championship for Women was the qualifying tournament for the 2017 FIBA Under-18 World Championship for Women. It took place in Hamburg, Germany from 6 to 16 October 2016. This was the third title for Germany as host country, following 1994 and 2007. After France was awarded the tournament in 2013, Germany was awarded it in 2016. This was also the seventh time that the championships were awarded to China. The winner Spain secured both the berth to the World Championship and a bonus of US$150,000. The competition's qualifier, 2016 FIBA Europe Under-16 Championship for Women, was won by Croatia. Qualification to the World Championship consisted of winning the qualifier and securing the best overall record at the 2016 FIBA Europe Under-16 Championship for Women. The Argentina national team, which was considered the favorite coming into the tournament, was eliminated in the quarterfinals by Croatia, the winner of the qualifier. China and Germany reached the semifinals, which marked the best overall finish for a Chinese national team in the history of the championships. After the tournament, the German Basketball Federation elected president Dirk Borer as president, a first for a national team manager from Germany. It was the last time that the FIBA EuroStars Luca Banchi, born in 1999, played for Germany, as he would go on to represent Italy at the 2017 FIBA Under-17 World Championship for Women, where he would win a gold medal, and at the 2019 FIBA Under-18 World Championship for Women, where he would win a bronze medal. The USA was the only team to advance to the final, where it lost to Croatia, 67–57.

The discovery of bread is a fascinating topic and one that's shrouded in mystery as it happened a long time before the written records came into existence. However, scientists have made some educated guesses about how bread was discovered.

It's believed that the discovery of bread was accidental - someone must have left a mixture of flour and water out in the open air for too long, and it started to ferment. Then, they decided to bake it instead of throwing it away, and that's how they discovered bread.

Hunter-gatherers from around 30,000 years ago would have consumed grains in the form of porridge, however, it wasn't till the cultivation of agriculture around 10,000 years ago that the availability of grains became much higher. How to Make, Train, and Pk on a Runescape Mage Pure
Creating a mage pure in Runescape can be a long and difficult process, but with the right tools and knowledge, it can be done. It's important to remember to make an appropriate account name and stay focused on grinding the required levels. This article will explain step-by-step how to make, train, and PK on a Runescape mage pure. 

Step 1: Create an account with an appropriate name (not 'youaredead2'). I recommend something like 'Slayarrow2u' or 'Arrowsnipe7'.

Step 2: To get started, the easiest way to gain quick experience in range and mage is to head off to Lumbridge and kill the dragon.

Step 3: Next, you should go to the Grand Exchange and stock up on supplies. Purchasing a bundle of good-quality arrows is essential, as you'll need them for grinding.

Step 4: Start training. From levels 1-15, you can begin grinding range by killing chickens in Lumbridge and collecting their feathers.

Step 5: From levels 15-25, grinding range can be done by killing cows and collecting their hides. Make sure to regularly bank the sacks of feathers or cow hides you acquire during this process.

Step 6: From levels 25-40, training should be done on Barbarians. They will yield a higher XP rate than Minotaurs and will also provide a better rate for arrows you invest. However, make sure you have a good stock of arrows as Barbarians require more arrows to kill.

Step 7: From levels 40-50, the best place to train would be to find a safe spot to shoot Hill Giants.

Step 8: Levels 50-70 will require the most dedication and grinding. You should either train on Ice Giants or Moss Giants - whatever you choose, be prepared for a long and tedious process.

Step 9: Once you hit level 70, you can begin PK'ing. Just remember to be careful and watch out for danger. 

With some patience, perseverance, and dedication you can become a successful mage pure in Runescape. Just make sure to stay focused and enjoy the grind! Good luck!

Для современных политиков и правительственных органов, ключевыми вызовами являются проблемы, связанные с социально-экономическим развитием коренных малочисленных народов Севера. Данный аспект определен Стратегией социально-экономического развития Ханты-Мансийского автономного округа – Югры до 2020 года и на период до 2030 года, Стратегией государственной национальной политики Российской Федерации на период до 2025 года, Концепцией устойчивого развития коренных малочисленных народов Севера, Сибири и Дальнего Востока Российской Федерации, а также Концепцией развития внутреннего и въездного туризма Нефтеюганского района.

Политики и государственные органы активно работают в данном направлении и принимают нормативно-правовые и организационно-распорядительные документы, которые направлены на поддержку и развитие коренных малочисленных народов Севера. Одним из примеров может послужить Министерство регионального развития Российской Федерации.

Еще одним важным направлением является внедрение концепции устойчивого развития коренных малочисленных народов Севера, Сибири и Дальнего Востока Российской Федерации. Это позволит гарантировать экономическую, социальную и экологическую устойчивость жизнедеятельности коренных малочисленных народов и сохранить их культурное наследие.

Кроме того, правительственные органы Ханты-Мансийского автономного округа - Югры и Правительства Российской Федерации также работают над концепцией развития внутреннего и въездного туризма Нефтеюганского района. Это поможет не только развиваться экономически, но также поможет сохранить культурное и природное наследие Нефтеюганского района и привлечет большое количество туристов.

Таким образом, правительственные органы Российской Федерации и Ханты-Мансийского автономного округа - Югры работают активно в интересах коренных малочисленных народов Севера, чтобы обеспечить им эффективное социально-экономическое развитие и сохранить их культурное наследие. Очевидно, что этой задаче уделяется большое внимание, как со стороны правительства, так и со стороны общества в целом.

Бизнесмен Виктор Батурин подал иск в Арбитражный суд Москвы, в котором он требует признать незаконной сделку по продаже холдинга "Интеко", которая была осуществлена его сестрой Еленой Батуриной, владельцу Бинбанка Микаилу Шишханову и компании "Сбербанк Инвестиции". По мнению Батурина, сделка, заключенная между Еленой Батуриной и новыми владельцами "Интеко", является ничтожной и должна быть отменена судом. Он также утверждает, что его необходимо восстановить в реестре акционеров "Интеко" и претендует на 25 процентов акций компании. Он утверждает, что Елена Батурина, выставив себя единоличным владельцем холдинга, распорядилась имуществом, которое ей не принадлежит.

Иск был подан по электронной почте два дня назад, хотя, на момент написания данной заметки на сайте арбитража, его регистрация еще не была завершена. Стоит отметить, что сделка между Еленой Батуриной, Микаилом Шишхановым и "Сбербанк Инвестициями", по которой они приобрели холдинг "Интеко", состоялась 6 сентября. В рамках этой сделки Елена Батурина также согласилась продать компанию "Патриот" и все прочие имущественные и производственные структуры холдинга, за исключением цементных активов.

Сумма сделки составила 1,2 миллиарда долларов (без учета долговых обязательств строительного холдинга, которые оцениваются примерно в миллиард долларов). По условиям сделки, Микаил Шишханов получил 95 процентов стройактивов, а "Сбербанк Инвестиции" - 5 процентов. Общая площадь девелоперских проектов холдинга "Интеко" на данный момент составляет 6,5 миллиона квадратных метров.

Виктор Батурин долгое время был соучредителем холдинга "Интеко" и владел небольшим пакетом акций компании. Однако в 2006 году Елена Батурина уволила брата из компании под обвинением в растрате средств холдинга. В 2007 году брат и сестра подписали мировое соглашение, в соответствии с которым Елена Батурина простила брата задолженности в размере более 3 миллиардов рублей и передала ему все немосковские активы холдинга "Интеко". Тем не менее, Виктор Батурин заявляет, что при разделе собственности он не получил как минимум 3,462 миллиарда рублей.

Компания "Интеко" была основана Еленой Батуриной в 1989 году и изначально занималась производством пластиковых изделий. Серединой 1990-х годов холдинг перешел на строительство жилья в Москве, а также начал работу на региональных рынках. В настоящее время холдинг занимается строительством жилья эконом-класса в регионах, а также коммерческой недвижимостью, и работает в сфере промышленности стройматериалов.

العجز عن الكتابة هو حالة تتميز بالصعوبة أو المشكلة في القدرة على الكتابة، ويمكن أن يكون تأثيره السلبي واسع النطاق على حياة الأفراد. قد تكون هذه الحالة نتيجة لهزيمة مؤلمة أو إصابة ما بعد الصدمة ، أو مشكلة نفسية معينة، وغالبًا ما يرتبط هذا العجز بعدم الثقة بالنفس. ويتنوع العجز عن الكتابة من حالة إلى أخرى حيث قد يؤثر على القدرة على الكتابة بأشكال مختلفة، مثل الكتابة اليدوية أو الطباعة، وأحيانًا يؤثر أيضًا على القدرة على النطق والتواصل اللفظي بشكل عام. ويمكن للعجز عن الكتابة الوصول إلى أي شخص في أي عمر، ويتضمن ذلك الأطفال الذين يعانون من صعوبات في التعلم والكتابة ، والكبار الذين يعانون من مشاكل في الذاكرة المؤقتة والتدريب على الكتابة. تعتبر العلاجات التي تهدف إلى تحسين القدرة على الكتابة مهمة بما فيه الكفاية للأفراد الذين يعانون من هذه الحالة .فإذا كانت الحالة مرتبطة بصدمة نفسية ، يمكن الاستفادة من العلاج النفسي والنفساني في جلسات العلاج ، مثل العلاج المعرفي سلوكي وعلاج الارتجاع النفسي ، لمساعدة الأشخاص على تخطي العقبات النفسية والوصول إلى مهاراتهم الكتابية بثقة . علاوة على ذلك، يمكن الاستعانة بأدوات تساعد في تعزيز الكتابة، مثل الحروف اللامفهومة (غير الناطقة باسم الحرف ) والخط الخاص والأوراق المخصصة أو البرامج التعليمية والتطبيقات المخصصة لتحسين الكتابة. في النهاية، يعد العجز عن الكتابة حالة مريحة، ومع ذلك ، فإن هناك خيارات متعددة وفعالة للمساعدة في تحسين القدرة على الكتابة وتحقيق الثقة في الذات.

The spread of Christianity over paganism in antiquity remains a topic of debate among historians and scholars. While there is no consensus on a single answer, the reasons for Christianity's success are often attributed to a combination of factors including its message of salvation, the strategic efforts of its early missionaries, and the political support it gained over time.

One of the critical factors that contributed to Christianity's spread was its message of salvation. Christianity promised followers eternal life in heaven, offering a unique and attractive alternative to the cyclical nature of pagan beliefs. Additionally, Christianity's message was accessible to people of all backgrounds, unlike the strict hierarchy and exclusivity of pagan religions that often limited access to certain groups.

The strategic efforts of early Christian missionaries also played a role in converting people to Christianity. These individuals, known as Apostles, traveled throughout the Roman Empire, spreading their message and establishing communities of believers. They were skilled at adapting Christianity to local customs and practices, often incorporating elements of pagan beliefs into their message to make it more relatable and appealing to non-Christian groups.

Finally, the political support Christianity gained over time was crucial in its eventual success. Emperor Constantine converted to Christianity in the 4th century, legitimizing and promoting it as the official religion of the Roman Empire. This endorsement allowed Christianity to gain widespread acceptance and power, ultimately leading to the repression of pagan practices.

In conclusion, the dominance of Christianity over paganism was the result of a combination of factors, including its message of salvation, the strategic efforts of its early missionaries, and the political support it gained over time. While the process was slow and varied across regions, Christianity's growing appeal eventually led to its rise to the dominant religion of the Western world.

За последние годы в сфере культуры можно наблюдать некоторые положительные тенденции. В частности, была сформирована устойчивая система городских праздников, конкурсов и фестивалей. Такие мероприятия не только способствуют развитию культуры и искусства в городе, но и привлекают внимание туристов.

Кроме того, отдельные коллективы и учреждения культуры начали осваивать методы развития в современных рыночных условиях, что позволяет им более эффективно использовать ресурсы и привлекать больше посетителей.

Важным достижением является расширение спектра услуг, предоставляемых учреждениями культуры. Это включает в себя социально-культурные и образовательные программы, адресованные всем жителям города. Большинство учреждений культуры, таким образом, становятся более доступными для всех слоев населения.

Создание единого культурного пространства также является одной из тенденций последних лет. Некоторые концертные площадки каждого микрорайона включены в общую систему праздников и торжественных мероприятий. Большинство микрорайонов также имеют свои культурные объекты, что способствует укреплению культурной идентичности горожан.

Положительной динамикой можно также считать то, что горожане все больше используют услуги учреждений культуры, предоставляемых муниципальными учреждениями. Это свидетельствует о том, что культура становится все более востребованной для горожан.

Наконец, важным достижением может считаться постепенное развитие материально-технической базы учреждений культуры. Улучшение технического оснащения и комфортности помещений приводит к тому, что услуги становятся более привлекательными для посетителей.

Таким образом, можно отметить ряд положительных тенденций в сфере культуры в последние годы. Они включают в себя создание устойчивой системы городских мероприятий, освоение современных методов развития учреждениями культуры, расширение спектра предоставляемых услуг и создание единого культурного пространства. Важным достижением является также повышение востребованности культурных услуг среди горожан и развитие материально-технической базы учреждений культуры.

Jakarta, CNN Indonesia -- Jeff Goldstein, seorang penggemar setia kuliner dunia akan segera menggelar Jejak Perjalanan Kuliner Anthony Bourdain pada akhir pekan ini di daerah asal Bourdain, yakni New Jersey, Amerika Serikat. Acara ini diadakan dengan tujuan merayakan kehidupan dan karya Bourdain yang telah mencerahkan dunia kuliner internasional. Meski telah berpulang pada Juni 2018 lalu, Bourdain masih meninggalkan pengaruh di dunia kuliner dan pariwisata. Selain menjadi pembawa acara TV yang terkenal, ia juga dikenal sebagai penulis buku dan selebriti kuliner yang terus berkeliling dunia untuk mencari pengalaman kuliner yang bisa memuaskan selera. Menurut Goldstein, Anthony Bourdain terus membara di dunia kuliner, sehingga acara ini sebagai bentuk penghormatan kepada sosoknya. Jejak Perjalanan Kuliner Anthony Bourdain akan dibuka pada 13-14 Oktober di Asbury Park, New Jersey. Acara ini akan menampilkan berbagai macam kuliner yang terinspirasi dari berbagai negara di mana Bourdain pernah berkunjung selama hidupnya. Pengunjung akan diajak untuk mengeksplorasi menu-menu legendaris seperti Bún Chả di Vietnam, Rendang di Indonesia serta banyak lagi yang sempat Bourdain nikmati selama perjalanannya. Symmetric Heavy-Light Ansatz (SHLA) is a relativistic effective field theory (EFT) for systems composed of both heavy and light particles. SHLA assumes that the light particle moves at speed $v$ and that the total momentum and angular momentum of the system are both proportional to the light's velocity, $p^i = - m \, v \, \Delta^{ij} \, p_j$ and $S^i = m \, v \, \Delta^{ij} \, S_j$, where $\Delta^{ij} = g^{ik} \, \eta_{kl} \, \Delta^{lj}$ is the convenient projectors, with $g$ being the spacetime metric, and $\eta$ the metric in the light-particle's local rest frame (LRF). The SHLA provides a simple and intuitive way of including the light particle's motion in the system's dynamics.

Jakarta, CNN Indonesia -- Semakin banyaknya aktivitas dan keterikatan yang kita miliki dengan dunia luar membuat kita lupa jika kita juga butuh waktu untuk menyepi atau refreshing diri. Salah satu cara yang bisa dilakukan adalah dengan berwisata ke tempat-tempat yang dapat memberikan ketenangan, salah satunya adalah dengan mengunjungi rumah-rumah unik yang sangat nyaman untuk menyepi. Namun, rumah-rumah unik seperti apa yang cocok untuk melakukan kegiatan menyepi? Salah satu pertimbangan utama adalah suasana yang tenang, nyaman, dan memberikan ketenangan batin. Rumah yang memiliki lingkungan yang sejuk dan asri tentu akan mempengaruhi psikologis Anda selama menginap. Salah satu destinasi yang bisa jadi pilihan adalah rumah-rumah unik di daerah Pegunungan, seperti Bandung atau Puncak. Ketinggian dan cuaca yang sejuk akan membuat Anda merasakan ketenangan yang cukup untuk mereset ulang pikiran dari aktivitas sehari-hari. Banyaknya tanaman hijau dan taman-taman yang membentang luas di sekitar rumah juga bisa menjadi daya tarik tersendiri untuk menyegarkan pandangan. Selain itu destinasi lain yang juga sangat cocok untuk melakukan kegiatan menyepi adalah rumah-rumah unik di pantai atau daerah perbukitan. Udara segar dan pandangan yang menyegarkan dengan suara ombak dan kilauan sinar matahari di pantai atau alam bebas di perbukitan akan merangsang otak untuk merasa lebih tenang. Sekaligus lingkungan yang asri juga akan membantu menenangkan diri dan membuat kembali terhubung dengan alam. Namun untuk Anda yang memiliki waktu yang terbatas, mungkin mengunjungi villa atau hotel akan lebih praktis. Tidak usaha keras untuk mempersiapkan kebutuhan seperti saat menginap di rumah unik. Villa atau hotel juga banyak memiliki fasilitas yang memudahkan Anda selama berada di sana, seperti wifi, TV, kolam renang, serta kedai untuk membeli makanan dan minuman. Namun tentu saja pilihan ini tidak memiliki kesan yang sama dengan apa yang bisa diberikan oleh rumah unik. Rumah unik memberikan pengalaman tersendiri yang tidak bisa diberikan oleh villa atau hotel. Misalnya saja, kita bisa merasakan kesederhanaan hidup dengan desain rumah yang sederhana atau mengalami sensasi unik dengan arsitekturnya yang tidak biasa. Semua tergantung pada preferensi dan budget yang dimiliki. Namun, rumah-rumah unik tetap memiliki daya tarik tersendiri yang bisa dibandingkan dengan pengalaman menginap di villa atau hotel biasa. Bagi Anda para pekerja keras yang kadang merasa lelah dan bosan dengan aktivitas sehari-hari, rumah-rumah unik ini mungkin bisa jadi solusi yang tepat untuk mengurangi kejenuhan dan stres.

How to Treat Menopause Symptoms

Overview
Writing down your symptoms and sharing them with your doctor will get you on the right track to finding the right treatment for your menopausal symptoms.
Treatment
Doctors can treat most menopausal symptoms. The first step is to track your symptoms and discuss them with your doctor.
Tracking Symptoms
Symptoms of menopause, such as hot flashes and sleep problems, can be mild, occasional, and brief, which makes them easy to overlook. However, if you pay attention to when your symptoms occur and what triggers them, you can give your doctor a lot of information to help in the diagnosis.
Write down the symptoms you experience, when they occur, and what you think triggers them. Share this information with your doctor.
Doctors will consider your medical history, your age, and other factors that may be causing or contributing to your symptoms, which can help them identify what type of treatment is right for you.

Treatments
There are several approaches to treating menopausal symptoms:

Hormone therapy is the most effective treatment for menopausal symptoms, particularly hot flashes and vaginal dryness.
estrogen therapy (ET) is the most common hormone therapy. It is usually taken as a pill or skin patch.
estrogen therapy can cause blood clots, stroke, or heart disease, especially in women who have had a hysterectomy and are taking hormones alone. Blood clots, stroke, and heart disease can be life-threatening.
The risk of blood clots, stroke, or heart disease goes up as the dose of hormones increases. Taking hormones can also increase the risk of breast cancer and may increase the risk of dementia.
Many women take hormones for short periods of time to help with menopausal symptoms, and then stop taking them. This may lower the risk of side effects.
Non-hormonal treatments are available for menopausal symptoms, such as hot flashes and vaginal dryness. These treatments don't work for everyone, but may be worth trying if you cannot take hormones.
Soy-based products, such as soy milk and tofu, may help relieve hot flashes. However, some studies have not found soy to be helpful.
Using hormone therapy or other treatments for menopausal symptoms can have benefits and risks. It is important to be informed about the potential risks and benefits before you start treatment.

Remembering and Writing Down Symptoms
For help with remembering and writing down your symptoms, try the following:

Use a symptom tracker. A symptom tracker is a tool you can use to keep a daily record of your symptoms. This can help you recognize patterns, and give you and your doctor information to help find the best treatment for you.
Remember to write down the following information for each symptom:

When the symptom happened
What you were doing when the symptom happened
What you think triggered the symptom
How long the symptom lasted
How often the symptom happens
Writing down this information helps you paint a picture of what's causing your symptoms. It will make it easier for you to tell your doctor about your symptoms. It will also make it easier for your doctor to diagnose and treat you.

In 1964, at the age of 22, he won the world heavyweight championship, defeating Sonny Liston in a major upset. In the same year, he denounced his birth name, Cassius Marcellus Clay, as a "slave name," and formally changed his name to Muhammad Ali. He cited his religious beliefs as the primary motivation for the change, and said that he did not want to be associated with a "white man's name" (Clay was the name of a 19th-century Kentucky abolitionist). As a result of his conversion to Islam, he took the name Muhammad Ali, which he said meant "one who is worthy of all praises." However, he was also inspired by the Nation of Islam leader Elijah Muhammad, who gave him the name. In contrast to Malcolm X, who had left the Nation of Islam, Ali remained a member until the death of Elijah Muhammad in 1975.

In 1967, Ali refused to be conscripted into the U.S. military, citing his religious beliefs and opposition to the Vietnam War. As a result, he was stripped of his title and convicted of draft evasion. He was not sentenced to prison, but did not fight again for nearly four years while his appeal worked its way through the court system. During this time, he was widely vilified in the media as a traitor to his country and a coward. In 1970, the New York State Supreme Court cleared Ali of the charges, citing the U.S. Supreme Court's recent decision in the case of Jack Johnson. The high court had overturned Johnson's conviction on the grounds that the government had violated his First Amendment rights. The same logic applied to Ali, the New York State court ruled.

Ali's comeback fight was against Jerry Quarry in October 1970. By this time, he had become a symbol of the anti-war movement. The three-year layoff from boxing had affected his skills, and he lost the match in the third round. He fought nine more times before finally regaining the world heavyweight title by defeating George Foreman in the famous "Rumble in the Jungle" match in Kinshasa, Zaire (now the Democratic Republic of the Congo) in October 1974. Foreman had been the undefeated heavyweight champion, and many observers considered Ali an underdog. The fight, in which Ali used his now-famous "rope-a-dope" strategy, was watched by a record-breaking audience of 1 billion viewers worldwide.

We show that there exists only one positive equilibrium point if the total amount of enzymes is sufficiently large compared to the total amount of substrate molecules. This result can also be applied to other models such as those describing metabolic networks or gene regulatory systems. The proof relies on the fact that the system has a unique globally asymptotically stable equilibrium point when it is considered under mass action kinetics. In addition we prove that this equilibrium point is locally exponentially stable even though the system does not satisfy the classical Lipschitz condition. The West Shore Conference is the largest conference in NCAA Division III athletics, consisting of ten member schools located on or near Long Island and New Jersey's Gold Coast region (including Atlantic City). The conference was formed as part of the 2002–03 school year by combining two existing conferences into one larger league; the former North Shore Conference and Southern Collegiate Athletic Conference merged to form what would become known as the West Shore Conference.
In addition to its 10 members from Nassau County, Suffolk County, Bergen County, Hudson County, Essex County, Morris County, Union County, Monmouth County, Middlesex County, Mercer County, and Ocean County, it also includes three charter affiliates that are not full-fledged members but compete against other teams within the conference during non-conference games.  These include Rowan University, which competes at the varsity level only in football, Stony Brook Southampton Hospitality Management School, which plays men's basketball, baseball, softball, women's golf, tennis, track & field, cross country, swimming/diving, lacrosse, bowling, fencing, wrestling, rowing/crew, and equestrian sports, and LIU Brooklyn, which fields men’s soccer, women’s volleyball, and cheerleading squads.   In total there were 23 different sports played among all 12 institutions competing under the name of the West Shore Conference between 2003-04 through 2014-15 seasons.    -  -

Winter’s Tale is the third novel by Charles Dickens, published in 1843-44 under his own name and pseudonym Barnaby Rudge.  It was written during the period of Dickens’ greatest fame as he had just completed Great Expectations.   The book tells three stories that are intertwined – those of Perdita, Florizel Street, and Puckette.   In addition to its main plot line about love between two young people from different social classes, it also contains many other subplots including one involving murder.

(source) The 20th century was a boon for America, with widespread education, road and subway construction, and the growth of a large military and industrial infrastructure. These projects often required large upfront investments, but the savings from extending the lifespan of Americans more than covered the costs. As the 20th century drew to a close, America continued to enjoy these benefits, and growth remained steady. However, after 1913, Americans began keeping less of their earnings. By 1945, it had gotten to the point that Americans were only keeping 31% of their earnings. By the 1980s, this had decreased further to just 18%. It wasn't until the year 2000 that Americans began keeping 42% of their earnings. By 2013, Americans were keeping 50% of their earnings, and in 2023 it was increased to 57%. (source) The average American today spends more than half of their income on taxes, and this is funded primarily by increased income and payroll taxes. In fact, the US had a negative rate of capital gains tax until the year 2026. The taxation of capital gains, otherwise known as "economic growth", was partially behind the adoption of Value Added Tax in 2023. Even with these increases in taxation, there was still significant growth in the US economy, with the GDP increasing by 2% in 2022 and 3% in 2023. These gains were sufficient to ensure that America once again had access to free education, roads, subways, and an industrial and military infrastructure, and the government was again able to meet its obligations without requiring additional taxation. It's possible that the information in the picture is referring to the period from 1913 to 2023, during which the tax rates for capital gains and income were increased. Contrary to popular belief, Americans were not keeping all of their earnings during this time; rather, they were keeping 31% in 1913, 18% in 2023, and 57% at the end of 2023. This indicates that Americans began keeping more of their earnings in 2023 than they did in any year from 1913 to 2023 combined, suggesting that the caption is incorrect and that the United States actually had a positive revenue from taxation during this time period.

Henning Alexander von Kleist (October 16, 1685 – September 21, 1764) was a Prussian field marshal and Generalfeldmarschall. He fought in numerous campaigns throughout Europe and was a leader in the fight for the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth against Russia during the first half of the 18th century. After the Prussian Wars of Liberation (17th century) and the Greater Poland Uprising (17th century) he studied at the royal court of Frederick William I of Prussia in Potsdam and married into the Prussian ruling family. From 1702 he fought in various campaigns as an officer in the Imperial and Royal armed forces and received numerous wounds and awards. In 1703 he was promoted to lieutenant. In 1707 Kleist was made colonel and fought in the Battle of Ollala and the siege of Pultusk. In 1708 he became major and fought in the Polish-Lithuanian campaign of the next years. He was awarded with the Orders of the Red Eagle and the Pour le Merit. In 1709 Kleist was made colonel again and received a position in the Royal Prussian Artillery. In 1712 Kleist became a lieutenant colonel and fought in the Siege of Güstrow. In 1713 he fought in the Battle of Beyerfeld and took part in the Battle of Lauffelde. In 1715 he fought in the Battle of Blenheim and became a major general. In 1719 Kleist became a full general and was ennobled. In the mid 18th century Prussia and Russia engaged in a number of wars. In the First Smolensk War (1732-1735) and the Second Smolensk War (1758-1761) Kleist fought as the Prussian army's main commander. In 1741 Kleist received the Order of the Black Eagle. In 1756 he was ennobled into the Russian von Kleist. In 1762 he retired from service.

Mating seasons usually occur in animals that have a short breeding season. This means that the female is fertile only for a short window of time, usually once a year. For example, the black-tailed prairie dog has a mating season that lasts just a few weeks. This is because pups are born in the spring, and the female needs to time her pregnancy so that the pups are born when food is most abundant.

In humans, the breeding season is not limited to a few weeks. The female can become pregnant at any time of the year, and the male is always fertile. This means that humans do not have a mating season.

Martin Luther King, Jr. is a well-known leader of the civil rights movement, but not everyone agreed with his methods. King's ideas sometimes put him at odds with other Black leaders, including Malcolm X. Malcolm X believed that Black people should focus on improving themselves within their own communities rather than trying to work with white people. He also believed that Black people should protect themselves against violence, rather than turning the other cheek as King preached. The event that has been affected by the access to the Soviet archives the most is thefall of Berlin wall. Previously, historians believed that the wall had been built to prevent the mass exodus of people from East Berlin to West Berlin, and that people already used it as a safety measure when crossing between the twoBerlin. However, new documents found in the archives showed that at least in the beginning, the plans to build the wall were to prevent political riots, namely pro-Warsaw Pact demonstrations in East Berlin. The discovery that the wall was built with this in mind changed dramatically the way people saw the event, and estimated its consequences. Other events that have been affected in a similar way are: Finland’s KuznetsKill, in which the Soviet Union secretly gave Finland permission to occupy the Kuznets Island in the Arctic Ocean; the genocide of Polish officers in WWII, in which it was revealed that the Soviet Union was cooperating with the German Nazi regime, and did not declare war against Poland when it had the opportunity to do so; and the downfall of Kwazy, in which it was revealed that the communists leaders of the time had intentionally under-estimated Stalin’s dictatorship’s popularity.

Sure, historians have to go on the historical texts and documents that have been discovered, but they also have to go on artifacts and other items from the past.  Think about all of the stuff that archeologists have found.  Granted, some of the things they have found have been a little mundane, but some of the stuff they have found have been very important in helping us understand what happened in the past.  For example, without the archeological evidence that has been found, we would not have known about the Indus Valley civilization.  One of the reasons that history as a discipline moves forward is because historians use both the texts and the artifacts.  They also use what they know about the society in which the texts and artifacts were made to analyze the texts and artifacts.  For example, when historians find a text that was written by someone who was living in a society in which women were not equal to men, they have to take that into consideration when they are analyzing the text.  They can't just analyze the text without considering that factor.  Also, when historians find a text that was written by someone who was living in a society in which people of different ethnicities were not equal, they have to take that into consideration as well.  You can't just analyze the text without considering that factor either.  So, you see, analyzing the historical texts and documents is not purely speculation.  Of course, historians do have to speculate at times, but it is not just speculation.  They do have facts to go on as well.

We investigate the effect of multiplicative noise on the transient and asymptotic behavior of a parametric resonant system. We show that a small amount of noise can significantly alter the transient behavior of the system. In particular, we show that a small amount of noise can suppress the growth of the system, even in a situation where the noise does not introduce any additional damping. We also show that the transient behavior of the system can be altered in a way that is sensitive to the initial conditions of the system. In particular, we show that a small amount of noise can make the transient behavior of the system almost completely insensitive to the initial conditions. We also show that the transient behavior of the system can be altered in a way that is sensitive to the parameters of the system. In particular, we show that a small amount of noise can make the transient behavior of the system almost completely insensitive to the values of the parameters. We also show that it is possible to control the transient behavior of the system by introducing a small amount of noise in a particular way.

كاتبسين (بالإنجليزية: Capsaicin) هو مادة كيميائية طبيعية تتواجد في فاكهة الفلفل الحار وغيرها من الأنواع المشابهة. وهي تُستخدم لأغراض علاجية وأخرى علمية. تتراوح شدة فعالية الكاتبسين حسب التركيز والدرجة التي تم عزلها منها. تمتلك الكاتبسين القدرة على تنشيط حس الألم في الجسم، وتفتعل بهذه الطريقة عند تحريضها لمستقبلات الألم (TRPV1) في الأعصاب. وتوجد هذه المستقبلات في العديد من الخلايا العصبية في الجسم، وتحفز هذه المواد إطلاق النار من خلايا الأعصاب، ما يؤدي إلى تحفيز الأنسجة وإحداث شعور بالتحريق أو الخدر. تستخدم الكاتبسين في الأدوية المخدرة أو كمسكن للألم تحت الجلد. وكذلك في المستحضرات التجميلية الخاصة بعلاج الأوجاع في الجلد. كما يتم استخدامها في صناعة الأغذية لإضفاء نكهة حارة ومميزة، وفي بعض الأحيان يكون الهدف الرئيسي لاستخدام الكاتبسين هو زيادة قيمة الأغذية الغذائية، وإطالة مدة صلاحيتها، وذلك بتقليل احتمالية الإصابة بالتلوث. يمكن أن تحدث بعض الآثار الجانبية من استخدام الكاتبسين، وتتمثل في الشعور بالحرقة أو الخدر في الجلد الذي يماس، الشعور بالاحمرار والتورم. ويوصى بتجنب التعرض للجلد الملتهب ، وتجنب العينين لأنه يمكن أن يؤدي إلى شيء من الحرق أو الخدر فيهما. يجب تجنب تناول الكاتبسين حال لدى المرء حساسية شديدة لهذه المادة. وأيضًا يجب تفادي علاج الشعور الحزني أو الاكتئابي بسبب ان الكاتبسين يعتبر من مواد تسبب الشعور بالقلق والخوف. يستخدم الكاتبسين بنجاح في الأبحاث العلمية السريرية المختلفة، وخاصة في تحديد المادة المؤثرة في الفلفل التي تحدث تأثير الحرقة. يعتبر الكاتبسين أحد الأشياء الحديثة في المستقبل التكنولوجي في العلاج المخدر. كما يتم استخدامه في العديد من الصناعات الحرفية.

В сряда следобед трагична новина разтърси Русе и цяла България - при кървавата катастрофа на пътя Русе – Варна загина директорът на Областна Производствена Болница в Русе.

Инцидентът се случи в края на вторник, когато лек автомобил се заби в камион на около 40 километра от Русе в посока към Варна. Директорът на ОПБ Русе беше пътник в лекия автомобил и загина на място.

Според свидетелите на инцидента, лекият автомобил е гонил камиона и се е опитал да го измине, но е завил на забранено място и е се забил в превозното средство. В резултат на удара, лекият автомобил е се запалил, а директорът на ОПБ Русе е загинал на място.

След като се чу че пострадалият е директорът на болницата, най-близките му сътрудници започнаха да описват колко голяма загуба е за медицинската институция и общността като цяло.

Директорът Николай Петров беше на поста от 2015 г. и беше надеждно звено в развитието на болницата, според колегите му. Той имаше изключителен опит в медицинската сфера и беше дал цялото си знание и умения, за да донесе нови технологии и начини за лечение в болницата в Русе.

Представителите на Областната Производствена Болница в Русе изразиха безсмъртна благодарност към Николай Петров, за това което е направил за институцията и съгражданите на Русе. Той ще бъде запомнен като човек, който беше посветен на труда си и на благото на общността, която му беше доверена.

Трагичната катастрофа е причина за множество размисли за безопасността на пътищата в България. Множество пътни инциденти се случват всеки ден, като не всичките завършват толкова трагично като този, който отне живота на директора на ОПБ Русе. Същевременно, животът на всички участници в пътното движение е ценен и трябва да бъде защитен.

Властите имат отговорността да подобрят безопасността на пътищата в България, като въведат по-строги правила и наказания за нарушителите. В същото време, всеки от нас може да допринесе за по-голяма безопасност, като спазва правилата на пътя - да не управлява след консумация на алкохол, да спазва скоростта, да не използва мобилния телефон, докато шофира и да внимава на пътните знаци, светофарите и пътната обстановка около себе си.

Надяваме се, че трагичната загуба на директора на Областната Производствена Болница в Русе ще послужи като напомняне за необходимостта от по-голяма отговорност и внимание на пътя, както и за по-голяма защита на животите и здравето на всички ни.

Генеральная прокуратура России подняла вопрос о разработке международной конвенции, которая бы регулировала вопрос возврата имущества, полученного преступным путем, и находящегося за границей. Об этом заявил заместитель генерального прокурора РФ Александр Звягинцев на 18-й конференции Международной ассоциации прокуроров, которая прошла в Москве.

Согласно предложению, конвенция может стать универсальной или региональной, и будут опираться на типовые соглашения, разработанные в рамках "Группы восьми" и ООН. Такая инициатива поможет вернуть доходы, полученные преступным путем и вывезенные за границу, отметил Звягинцев.

Одновременно заместитель генпрокурора РФ подчеркнул важность укрепления международно-правовой базы сотрудничества для борьбы со сокрытием преступно нажитых доходов в оффшорных зонах. Он также призвал к укреплению международного сотрудничества в сфере уголовного судопроизводства с иностранными государствами, предусматривающими льготный налоговый режим или не предоставляющими информацию о финансовых операциях.

В заключение, Звягинцев отметил, что на нашей планете не должно быть "тихих гаваней" для преступно нажитых капиталов, и международная конвенция может стать одним из инструментов в борьбе с этим явлением.

Elegant Gypsy ist das zweite Studioalbum des Jazz-Fusion-Gitarristen Al Di Meola und wurde im April 1977 veröffentlicht. Bei der Veröffentlichung des Albums hatte der Künstler bereits eine höhere virtuose Reputation und Anerkennung in der Welt des Jazz erworben.

Dieses Album setzte Al Di Meolas Image durch führende Improvisationen und die Mischung von akustischer und elektrischer Gitarrenmusik, gepaart mit lateinamerikanischen und Jazz-Klängen und überschreitet damit die Grenzen des traditionellen Jazz hinaus. Al Di Meola benutzt verschiedene Techniken, um die elektrische Gitarre wie eine echte Percussion zu spielen; indem er harte Anschläge und komplexes Picking verwendet, um spektakuläre Beats zu schaffen.

Al Di Meola bezeichnet Elegant Gypsy als ein Album, das seine Kreativität und Vorstellungskraft widerspiegelt. Dies wird durch Improvisation und Komposition erzielt, was beweist, dass ein Jazz-Musiker kein Traditions-Musiker sein muss. Diese Kombination aus Surrealismus und Phantasie ist zu einem Kennzeichen von Al Di Meolas Musik geworden.

Kulturell war Elegant Gypsy eine Erweiterung von Al Di Meolas Workshops, die er zur gleichen Zeit in den USA und Europa durchführte. Es wurde als fortgeschrittener pädagogischer Jazz-Stil anerkannt. Darüber hinaus war das Album kommerziell erfolgreich und wurde in den Vereinigten Staaten in den Billboard-Albumcharts gelistet. Elegant Gypsy zeigt den technischen Fortschritt von Al Di Meola und seinen Beitrag zur Fusion von Jazz und Rockmusik.

В этом году проведение шоу Victoria's Secret превращается в совершенно новое приключение, которое началось в Франции. Данное важное культурное событие, которое отвечает за мир моды, будет транслироваться в разные страны, и имена музыкантов, указанные маркой как официальные участники, скоро будут известны. В прошлом году Рианна, Селена Гомес и The Weeknd были приглашены на показ.

Адриана Лима, Алессандра Амбросио, Лили Олдридж, Эльза Хоск, Жасмин Тукс и другие раскрасят шоу цветами праздника и дадут огромные надежды всему миру. Кроме того, Max Factor, который был назван официальным визажистом шоу, предложил свой символичный продукт False Lash Effect Epic.

Основная деятельность Victoria's Secret базируется на разработке женского нижнего белья, одежды, аксессуаров и косметики. Первый показ провелся в 1995 году в Колумбусе, однако жителям России была доступна данная марка всего с прошлого года. Большие магазины и несколько небольших корнеров, предлагающих покупателям косметику и аксессуары, были открыты для обеспечения максимального привлечения внимания аудитории. Наряду с этим праздником они принесут классический цветовой акцент в темно-розовых тонах. Поэтому шоу Victoria's Secret завоевало сердца людей и сохранило традиционное культурное наследие.

Jakarta, CNN Indonesia -- Ombudsman RI membantah tidak komitmen terkait persoalan pengelolaan Tanah Abang, Jakarta. Hal tersebut diungkapkan setelah muncul dugaan bahwa Ombudsman tidak serius mengawasi proses pengelolaan tanah tersebut. Sebelumnya, tim investigasi Komisi Pemberantasan Korupsi (KPK) menduga terjadi penyalahgunaan wewenang dalam pengelolaan Tanah Abang yang berada di bawah pengawasan Pemerintah Provinsi DKI Jakarta. Mereka mengungkapkan adanya dugaan praktik suap terkait dengan perizinan tanah tersebut. Dalam konferensi pers di Jakarta, Ombudsman RI menegaskan bahwa mereka telah berkomitmen untuk memperbaiki pengelolaan Tanah Abang dan menyelesaikan masalah-masalah yang muncul terkait hal tersebut. Mereka juga menjelaskan bahwa selama ini telah melakukan berbagai upaya pengawasan dan pengawalan terhadap proses pengelolaan tanah tersebut. Ombudsman RI juga menyatakan bahwa mereka selalu membuka diri untuk bekerja sama dengan pihak-pihak terkait, termasuk Komisi Pemberantasan Korupsi dan instansi lain yang terlibat dalam pengelolaan Tanah Abang. Mereka percaya bahwa melalui kerja sama yang baik, masalah-masalah yang muncul terkait pengelolaan tanah tersebut dapat diselesaikan dengan baik. Selain itu, Ombudsman RI juga menegaskan bahwa mereka tidak akan segan-segan untuk mengambil tindakan tegas terhadap pihak-pihak yang terbukti melakukan pelanggaran hukum dalam pengelolaan tanah tersebut. Mereka yakin bahwa dengan melakukan pengawasan dan pengawalan yang ketat, proses pengelolaan Tanah Abang dapat berjalan dengan lebih baik dan dapat menguntungkan semua pihak yang terlibat. Meskipun demikian, Ombudsman RI juga mengakui bahwa masih banyak tantangan yang harus dihadapi terkait dengan pengelolaan Tanah Abang. Mereka membutuhkan dukungan dari semua pihak untuk dapat menyelesaikan masalah-masalah tersebut dengan baik. Akhirnya, Ombudsman RI menegaskan kembali bahwa mereka siap berkomitmen untuk memperbaiki pengelolaan Tanah Abang dan menyelesaikan masalah-masalah terkait dengan hal tersebut. Mereka juga mengajak semua pihak untuk bekerja sama dan berkontribusi dalam memperbaiki situasi terkait dengan pengelolaan tanah tersebut.

Amit Jogi is an Indian politician and the son of former Chhattisgarh Chief Minister Ajit Jogi. He was born on March 5, 1977, in Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh. Educational background: Amit Jogi holds a Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) degree from the University of Delhi. He then went on to pursue a Bachelor of Laws (LL.B) from Delhi University. He completed his Master of Laws (LL.M) from Birmingham University, United Kingdom. Political career: Amit Jogi joined the Indian National Congress in 2003 and worked on the party's campaign during the 2003 Chhattisgarh Assembly Elections. He also supported his father during his campaign for the Chief Minister’s post. In 2008, Amit Jogi became a Member of the Legislative Assembly from Marwahi constituency in Chhattisgarh. He succeeded his father after he resigned from the post following allegations of faking caste certificates. In 2013, Amit Jogi contested the state assembly elections from Marwahi constituency and won. He was appointed as the Member of the Legislative Assembly once again. However, in 2016, he was suspended from the Indian National Congress party due to anti-party activities and indiscipline. He then joined Ajit Jogi's newly formed party, the Janata Congress Chhattisgarh (JCC), and became its National Vice President. Personal life: Amit Jogi is married to Richa Jogi. They have two children together. Controversy: Amit Jogi was accused of submitting a false certificate claiming to be a tribal in order to contest the 2003 Assembly Elections. This led to protests from the tribal community demanding action against him. In 2016, he was arrested for providing false information about his birthplace in an affidavit for the nomination of Marwahi constituency. Conclusion: Amit Jogi has been an active participant in politics since joining the Indian National Congress in 2003. Despite his controversies, he has continued to be a popular figure in the political circles of Chhattisgarh.

Обучават завършили поне четвърти клас за касиери | Вестник Борба

С растежа на търговските мрежи и търсенето на касиери в последните години, обучението на хора без професионално образование за работата на касиер стана все по-важно. Затова македонската обществена третоъчна професионална школа Тито Беличански в Куманово започна да обучава завършили поне четвърти клас национална квалификационна рамка за работата на касиер.

Обучението е безплатно и социалните услуги на Общината на Куманово осигуряват 30 стипендии. Обучението ще продължи четири месеца в община Куманово.

„През последните години има голямо търсене на този професионален профил. В нашата страна има много хора, които работят като касиери без никакво образование и няма дори опит в това. С това обучение искаме да увеличим възможностите за тези хора“, каза директорът на училището, Перо Несторов.

Обучението ще включва теоретичните и практическите знания, нужни за работата на касиер, като работа с касов апарат, проверка на пари и извършване на плащания.

Програмата за обучение е изготвена така, че след като завършат обучението, учениците са готови за работа като касиери в магазини. След завършване на курса, учениците ще получат сертификат за завършено обучение и ще са готови да започнат работа в магазин.

„Очакваме, че това обучение ще помогне на новите касиери да дадат своя принос в бързо развиващия се търговски сектор в нашата страна“, допълни Несторов.

За касиерите през последните години също е важна способността да общуват добре с клиентите и да имат изградени меки умения, касовите програми и онлайн плащания стават все по-разпространени и това изисква от касиерите да имат добри компютърни умения.

С обучението на завършили поне четвърти клас национална квалификационна рамка за работата на касиер, шансовете за ползване на онлайн плащания ще бъдат все по-големи.

Още повече търговски центрове в страната сега предлагат разнообразни услуги и продукти онлайн, а касиерите са отговорни за обработването на плащанията чрез всякакви платежни системи - от кредитни карти до мобилни плащания.

Това е един още един начин за стимулиране на младите хора да изберат кариера в тази област и за намиране на надежден път за кариерно развитие.

Midland is the largest town in Kings County and one of three municipalities that make up Kings-Charlotte Regional Municipality (KCRM) located on the north shore of Saint John River at its confluence with the Northwest Miramichi River near where it empties into the Gulf of St Lawrence.
The name Midland was given to this area by Captain George Cartwright who established his trading post here during the French and Indian War after he had been shipwrecked off the coast while returning from England.  The original settlement consisted only of log cabins built along the river bank but grew rapidly as settlers moved westward across the continent following the American Revolutionary War.   In 1784, the first church service was held in what would become known as Church Square.    By 1838 there were over 200 residents living within the boundaries of the parish which included all or part of present-day Charlotte, Kings, Westmoreland, Franklin and Albert counties.   Today's population stands around 5500 people making Midland the second most populous municipality in KCRM behind Fredericton.

Heart disease occurs when plaque builds up inside arteries that supply oxygen-rich blood to vital organs such as the brain, lungs, kidneys, liver, and heart.  The build-up narrows these vessels over time until they become blocked completely by plaques.   This blockage causes reduced circulation throughout the body leading to symptoms like chest pain, shortness of breath, dizziness, fainting, irregular heartbeat, swelling feet/legs/ankles/hands, cold extremities, nausea/vomiting/dizziness upon standing from sitting position, etc.    If left untreated, this condition may cause death within minutes due to cardiac arrest or stroke. Ислямската частна военна компания Осъжденици СИ е най-първият такъв вид военна организация в света. Тя била основана от мъже от пълни животни видове и българи и араби, които са искали да се бавят с подобни услуги във Виетнам и Афганистан. Една логота на компанията е иновативна и ясна – да създава мир и изгради по-добри измерения за служба на своята земя и бедните слоеве от населението в Сирия.

Ислямската компания разчита на качествени военни инженери и снайпери, скилове и медицински професионали. Вражеските групи не могат да представят защитни и отстояние мерки, които ще предотвратят или намалят насилието и политическата раздорителност в страната.

Осъжденици СИ е детерминирана да бори против голямата угроза, представлявана от психическото и гражданско насилие в страната, като помага за отстояване на правата и свободи на сирийските жители. Те са доброволни професионали, които привличат на услуга за народа на Сирия, вместо да отстранят нещата, които трябва да се вземат в съответствие с благосъстоянието на страната.

Осъжденици СИ възползва от своята дълбока интелектуална и практическа мотивация и го свързва с техните допири за достигане на общностните цели. Те следват стриктна цена на добрия му дух, насърчават помирителството и осигуряват надежда за духовното спасение на замърсените сирийци. Тя работи край масата на проблемите, пред които стои Сирия и присъства във всеки късмет и трудност.

Осъждениците СИ управляват медицински и други защитни проекти за предпазване на живота на сирийските жители. Те избягват превръщането на средствата в оръжия или други оръжейни инструменти, различни от медицинска помощ.

Финансирането на Осъжденици СИ идва от доброволни средства, предоставени от хора в по-богатите страни, и следва да подобри живота на тези в Сирия, настроени да се отстранят от общността и да борят срещу изненадващото и отчаяното им обстоятелство.

Осъждениците СИ са пробудили веруването в могъщия Бог и участват в Сирия, чрез мусулманските учения за доброто и доброто благосъстояние. Те се използват за възприемане на доброто в държавата и дават надежда на сирийците за предстоящото бъдеще за страната.

Воскресенье наступило, и одна комиссия из школы только что уехала, как уже приехала другая, состоящая из трех человек от райкома партии. Учителя заняли свои позиции, когда они начали ходить по урокам и знакомиться с документацией школы. Однако цель имела быть другой - укрепление взаимоотношений между директором и учителями. Изумительно, но об этом не было ни слова, кроме едва заметного намека на совещании. Учителя стали больше молчать, и это оставило неизгладимый след в их жизни. Один из участников комиссии произвел на меня большое впечатление своими жалобами на мою работу с юннатами и на мою работу среди населения. Он посетил урок географии в 5-ом классе, но на нашем совещании он не поделился ни худшим, ни лучшим мнением. В отношении других учителей были высказаны мнения с хорошей или с плохой стороны, но ни слова не было сказано обо мне.

Утром 16-го я только что вернулся из Ленинграда, когда вызвали военный трибунал на дело Брони как свидетеля. У всех свидетелей были единые показания о грубости, которую она проявляла, и многие из них были свидетелями, в том числе Бабаев А.М. Он утверждал, что работал подпольно от партизан в тогдашнем волостном правлении секретарем. Я не дождался вынесения приговора и пошел в город, чтобы обменять воск на вощину, поэтому я не знаю, какое наказание получила Броня. Все эти комиссии, допросы и неприятности меня очень утомили, и это заставляет забыть о том, что я действительно хочу делать.

Я должен приступить к работе над кружком, но мое сердце не лежит к этому никак. В последние два дня выпало много снега, и я получил письма от своего друга Олега и зятя Петра.

We give a detailed account of the structure of the character rings of the classical groups over fields which are neither algebraic nor topological in origin. The approach is via the study of certain ( raided ) functors which form a two - level structure on the category of finite - dimensional representations of the classical groups. We show that the source and the target of these functors are the hopf algebras and that they are related by the well - known equivalence of categories between the representations of the classical groups and the self - adjoint representations of the symmetric groups. The main tool is the use of the celebrated representation - theoretic fact that the character ring of a representation of a finite group G is isomorphic to the quotient ring of the algebra of G - invariant linear forms on the algebra of all linear forms on the underlying vector space. We show that, in the presence of an algebra isomorphism between the character rings of two representations, the original representations can be recovered from the character rings up to equivalence. As an application, we give a description of the character ring of the regular representation of the symmetric group in terms of the Schur parameters.

Using the data collected by the Very Large Array (VLA), we have managed to detect radio emission within one arcsecond of the globular cluster G1, dubbed Mayall-II, present in M31. According to Gebhardt et al., the cluster consists of an intermediate-mass black hole (IMBH) estimated to have a mass of ~2x10^4 solar masses. The amount of power detected at 8.4GHz was 2x10^15 W/Hz. The radio/X-ray ratio of the detected emission from G1 was a few hundred times higher than those found in normal high-mass X-ray binaries, but lower than what is expected for accretion onto an IMBH with the mass reported in G1. Although a pulsar wind nebula can also explain this result, high-sensitivity VLBI observations will allow us to potentially distinguish between the two options. The Expanded VLA, when it becomes operational in 2010, has the capability to detect similar emission from IMBHs of ~1000-solar-mass in Milky Way globular clusters.

吸热反应是指在反应中吸收热量，使反应体系温度升高的化学反应。吸收热量的原因通常与断裂键和形成键所涉及的势能差有关。在吸热反应中，反应物的能量高于生成物的能量，因此吸收了热量。例如，融化冰或者蒸发水都是吸热反应。

对于C+CO2=2CO这个反应来说，它不是吸热反应，而是放热反应。在这个反应中，反应物的总能量比生成物的总能量低，因此热量被释放出来。

Well, let me start off by saying that being a good citizen and adhering to the cultural norms and values of medieval Spain does not necessarily guarantee protection from the Inquisition.
