Even if you are a devout Catholic and keep to yourself, you may still be seen as a threat if you associate with anyone who is deemed suspicious by the Church.

In terms of whether you are in their favor or just too scared to speak out against them, it's difficult to say without knowing more about your specific situation. It's possible that you have been unfairly targeted by the Inquisition due to a rumor or a misinterpretation of your behavior. Alternatively, you may be living in fear of speaking out against the Church because of the severe consequences it could have on you and your family.

Regardless of your personal beliefs or actions, the Inquisition was a powerful and oppressive institution in medieval Spain. Its influence reached far and wide, and anyone who was deemed a threat to the Catholic Church was at risk of persecution. So, while you may feel that you are a good person and follow the rules, it's important to remember that the actions of the Inquisition were often unpredictable and unreasonable.

Jakarta, CNN Indonesia -- Menjelang Hari Raya Idul Fitri 1442 Hijriyah tahun ini, Menko Polhukam Wiranto meninjau jalur mudik untuk memastikan kelancaran arus lalu lintas dan meminimalisir angka kecelakaan. Hasil evaluasi yang diberikan secara resmi menunjukkan bahwa upaya untuk menangani kemacetan dan menurunkan angka kecelakaan telah berhasil dilakukan. Menurut Wiranto, upaya tersebut dilakukan secara komprehensif dengan melibatkan seluruh pihak, baik itu instansi pemerintah, swasta, maupun masyarakat sebagai pengguna jalan raya. Pada tahun ini, Pemerintah juga memberlakukan sistem ganjil-genap di ruas jalan tol Jakarta-Cikampek selama periode arus mudik hingga Lebaran. Dalam pengamatannya, Wiranto melihat perbaikan signifikan pada arus mudik tahun ini. Kemacetan yang terjadi di jalur-jalur utama berhasil diurai dengan baik dengan dukungan antrean kendaraan yang terkendali. Bahkan, pengurangan angka kecelakaan hingga 70 persen dibandingkan tahun lalu menjadi salah satu hasil positif dari evaluasi yang dilakukan. Well, this is a pretty fascinating question. While it's tough to say for sure what ancient civilizations really thought about their place in human history, there are definitely some indications that they had some understanding of their own significance.

For starters, it's worth noting that many ancient civilizations were incredibly advanced for their time. From the pyramids of Egypt to the sophisticated aqueduct systems of the Romans, these societies were doing things that no one else had been able to do before. That alone suggests that they had some understanding of their own importance.

Additionally, many ancient texts and legends suggest that people of the time had a strong sense of their own place in history. The Greeks, for instance, were known for their belief in the concept of the "Golden Age," a mythical period during which humanity had achieved a level of perfection that it would never again attain. Similarly, many ancient texts tell stories of great civilizations rising and falling over the centuries, suggesting that people of the time had some awareness that they were part of a larger historical narrative.

Of course, it's impossible to say exactly how much ancient people knew about their place in history. It's likely that some societies were more aware of their own significance than others, and it's also possible that many people simply didn't spend much time thinking about it at all. Nonetheless, the evidence does suggest that people of the time had at least some understanding of their own importance in the grand scheme of things.

Jakarta, CNN Indonesia -- Komisi Pemilihan Umum (KPU) Jawa Tengah akhirnya memberikan penjelasan terkait laporan dugaan data pemilih tetap (DPT) invalid yang dilaporkan beberapa pihak. KPU Jateng mengklaim bahwa DPT yang mereka gunakan dalam pelaksanaan Pemilu 2019 sudah melalui prosedur yang benar dan sesuai dengan aturan yang berlaku. Sebelumnya, pihak-pihak yang merasa dirugikan oleh adanya DPT invalid telah melaporkan hal tersebut ke KPU Jateng dan beberapa pihak lain, seperti Bawaslu, DKPP, dan bahkan ke KPU pusat. Mereka menduga bahwa DPT yang digunakan oleh KPU Jateng terdapat banyak kesalahan dan ketidakakuratan data, sehingga mempengaruhi hasil dari pelaksanaan Pemilu 2019. Namun, dalam jumpa pers yang dilaksanakan beberapa waktu lalu, KPU Jateng membantah hal tersebut. Mereka mengatakan bahwa DPT yang digunakan sudah melalui sejumlah verifikasi dan validasi, termasuk diantaranya melalui verifikasi dokumen kependudukan dan pencocokan data serentak (PDS). Sehingga DPT yang digunakan bisa dipastikan sah dan sesuai dengan aturan. Menanggapi hal tersebut, Bawaslu dan DKPP berencana untuk melakukan kajian yang lebih mendalam terhadap laporan dugaan DPT invalid. Mereka akan melakukan penyelidikan dan verifikasi ulang, serta meminta KPU Jateng untuk memberikan data yang lebih lengkap dan akurat terkait hal tersebut. Sejumlah pihak juga telah mengkritik KPU Jateng atas penanganan laporan dugaan DPT invalid tersebut. Mereka menilai bahwa KPU Jateng seharusnya lebih transparan dan terbuka dalam memberikan informasi terkait pelaksanaan Pemilu 2019, termasuk terkait DPT yang digunakan. Hal ini penting sebagai upaya pencegahan terjadinya kecurangan atau penyelewengan dalam pelaksanaan Pemilu. KPU Jateng sendiri menyatakan bahwa pihaknya siap bekerja sama dengan Bawaslu dan DKPP dalam melakukan kajian lebih lanjut terkait laporan dugaan DPT invalid. Mereka berharap bahwa hasil dari kajian tersebut dapat memberikan kejelasan dan kepastian bagi semua pihak terkait pelaksanaan Pemilu di Provinsi Jawa Tengah.

How to Get Effects on Snapchat

Snapchat is more than just a messaging app - it’s a whole platform for sharing photos and videos with friends and followers. But if you’re new to Snapchat, you might not know where to start with all the effects and features. Luckily, with this article, you’ll have a comprehensive guide on how to get effects on Snapchat, from adding filters and lenses to swapping faces and adding stickers.

Part 1: Understanding Lenses

1. Acknowledge the mobile device and hardware limitations of Lenses. 

Before you start using Snapchat’s Lenses feature, understand that this feature is only available on newer mobile devices with specific hardware features. If you have an older phone, you might not be able to use Lenses at all.

2. Update Snapchat. 

To have access to the latest Lenses and other features, update Snapchat to the latest version available on your app store.

3. Switch Snapchat to Selfie mode. 

Switch your Snapchat camera to Selfie mode by tapping the camera icon in the top right corner of the screen.

4. Hold your phone away so you can see your entire face. 

Make sure you’re holding your phone out far enough so that you can see your entire face in the screen.

5. Press and hold your face on the screen until the whole geometric shape is complete. 

Snapchat will recognize your face once you see a geometric shape around it. Keep holding it until the shape is filled in completely.

6. Select the Lens that you want to use. 

Swipe left or right to see all the available Lenses and select the one that you want to use.

7. Follow the instructions for the Lens you chose. 

Some Lenses might require you to open your mouth, raise your eyebrows, or make a specific facial expression. Follow the on-screen instructions to get the most out of the Lens.

8. Take or record a Snap. 

Once you’ve taken your picture or recorded your video with the Lens, you can save it to your camera roll or directly share it on Snapchat.

Part 2: Adding Filters

1. Understand what a filter is. 

Filters are overlays that add various digital effects to your photos and videos, such as color tints, borders, or animations.

2. Make sure that Snapchat is up to date. 

As with Lenses, you need to have the latest version of Snapchat installed to have access to all the available filters.

3. Enable Filters. 

To enable Filters, go to your Snapchat settings, tap on “Filters and Lenses,” and toggle on the “Filters” option.

4. Enable Location Services for Snapchat. 

Some filters are location-specific, so make sure that your Location Services are enabled for Snapchat in your device settings.

5. Take a picture or record your video. 

Once you’re in the camera mode, take your photo or record your video as usual.

6. Add a filter to the photo or video. 

Swipe left or right on the screen to browse the available filters and select the one you want to use.

7. Add a Geofilter. 

Geofilters are location-based filters that are only available in certain areas, such as landmarks, cities, or events. To add a Geofilter, swipe left on the screen and browse the available options.

8. Try a Video-only filter. 

Some filters are only available for videos, so make sure to try them out when you’re recording a clip.

9. Try a Data filter. 

Data filters add real-time information to your Snap, such as the weather, time, or speed. Swipe left on the screen to see the available Data filters.

10. Try a Color filter. 

Color filters add a tint to your photo or video, such as sepia, black and white, or negative. Swipe left on the screen to browse the available options.

11. Consider adding more than one filter. 

You can stack multiple filters on top of each other, such as a Geofilter and a Color filter. To add another filter, swipe left on the screen and select a different one.

Part 3: Swapping Faces and Adding Stickers

1. Activate the Lenses feature to find the face swap options. 

Follow the steps listed in Part 1 to activate the Lenses feature on Snapchat and access the face swap options.

2. Select the yellow face swap option to swap faces with someone nearby. 

The yellow face swap option will detect nearby faces and allow you to swap yours with someone else in the frame.

3. Line up both of your faces in the overlay on the screen. 

Make sure that both your face and the other person’s face are properly lined up in the overlay on the screen before taking your Snap.

4. Select the purple face swap Lens to swap faces with pictures on your phone. 

The purple face swap Lens will allow you to swap faces with pictures from your camera roll. Choose a photo with a face and tap on it to swap.

5. Tap the face that you want to swap with. 

If the photo has multiple faces, tap on the one you want to swap with.

6. Add text to the photo or video. 

Tap the “T” icon on the screen to add text to your photo or video.

7. Enable text effects. 

Some text options have additional effects, such as animations or color changes. Try them out to make your text stand out.

8. Move, modify the size, and rotate the text. 

You can drag the text anywhere on the screen, pinch to change its size, and rotate it by dragging the corners.

9. Change the text or text color. 

Tap on the text to edit it and choose a different font or color.

10. Add stickers, emojis, or Bitmojis. 

Tap the sticker icon on the screen to browse the available stickers and emojis. You can also use your Bitmoji avatar if you have one.

11. Pin stickers to objects in a video Snap. 

If you’re recording a video, you can tap and drag a sticker to “pin” it to a moving object in the frame.

12. Consider creating a custom filter hack with a sticker or emoji. 

If you’re feeling creative, you can use a sticker or emoji to create your own custom filter effect. For example, you can add a sunglasses emoji to your photo and use it as a filter.

13. Make a sticker. 

If you’re using a photo with a face, you can create a sticker of it by selecting the scissors icon and tracing around the face. Once you’re done, you can use the sticker in future Snaps.

14. Draw on the photo or video. 

Tap the pencil icon on the screen to draw on your photo or video with different colors and brush sizes.

15. Find hidden colors. 

If you hold down any of the colors in the drawing menu, a secret menu of alternate colors will appear.

16. Add a sepia filter to your photo. 

Swipe left on the screen until you see the Sepia filter, which will give your photo a nostalgic, old-fashioned look.

17. Add a black and white filter to your photo. 

Swipe left on the screen until you see the Black & White filter, which will turn your photo into a classic, monochrome image.

18. Add a negative filter to your photo. 

Swipe left on the screen until you see the Negative filter, which will invert the colors of your photo for a surreal, otherworldly effect.

There you have it - you’re now a Snapchat pro with all the knowledge you need to get the coolest effects on your Snaps. Remember to keep exploring and trying out new filters and Lenses to make your content stand out.

How to Be a Strong Independent Woman

Being a strong and independent woman takes a lot of work, but it's worth the effort. Here are some tips to help you achieve your goals and live your best life.

1. Put yourself first.

Putting yourself first means taking care of your needs before anyone else’s. This includes your physical and emotional well-being. Don’t hesitate to cancel plans, say no to favors or take time off to prioritize yourself.

2. Don't compare yourself to other women.

Comparison is the thief of joy. Instead, focus on being the best version of yourself. Define your own success and don’t let anyone else’s achievement define you.

3. Set clear boundaries.

Setting boundaries is an essential part of being a strong independent woman. Make sure your interactions with others are respectful, and that you communicate clearly what your limits are.

4. Stand up for yourself.

Don't be afraid to stand up for yourself. Speak your mind and don’t let anyone take advantage of you.

5. Believe in yourself.

Believe in your abilities and trust the decisions you make. You have the power to accomplish anything you set your mind to.

6. Let people know when they have hurt your feelings.

Communicate your feelings when someone has hurt you. Don’t hold onto grudges or resentment. Instead, address the issue constructively and move forward.

7. Address disrespectful and offensive comments

If you feel uncomfortable or hurt by someone's comments, make sure you address them. It’s important to call out negative behavior and maintain a healthy relationship.

8. Learn to recognize codependency.

Codependency is when you prioritize someone else’s needs over your own. Recognizing it can help you avoid unhealthy relationships.

9. Embrace the uniqueness of yourself and others.

Everyone is unique and valuable in their own way. Embrace your individuality and appreciate the qualities that make you and others one-of-a-kind.

10. Be comfortable with your body, the way it is right now.

Be comfortable in your own skin, no matter what your shape or size is. Focus on your health and fitness rather than feeling self-conscious.

11. Communicate your needs to your partner.

Be open with your partner about what you need from them. This will help you maintain a healthy and fulfilling relationship.

12. Honor your sexuality.

Enjoy sex on your terms and make sure you’re comfortable with what you’re doing.

13. Don't be afraid to say no.

Saying no when you need to is an important part of being a strong independent woman. Don’t feel obligated to say yes just to please someone else.

14. Report sexual harassment in the workplace or at school.

If you experience or witness sexual harassment, report it. Don’t let the perpetrators continue their behavior.

15. Get enough exercise.

Exercise is a great way to stay healthy and feel good about yourself. Find an activity you enjoy and make it a regular part of your routine.

16. Eat healthy, nutritious foods.

Eating a balanced diet is important for your physical and mental health. Make sure you're getting the nutrients your body needs.

17. Get enough sleep.

Sleep is essential for your well-being. Make sure you're getting enough rest each night.

18. Understand your health.

Educate yourself about your body and your health needs. Make sure you're taking care of yourself physically and mentally.

19. Foster financial independence, to the extent that's possible in your circumstances.

Being financially independent is an important part of being a strong independent woman. Make sure your finances are in order and that you are in control of your financial future.

20. Don’t be afraid to ask for a raise.

If you know you’re worth more than you're currently being paid, don’t hesitate to ask for a raise. Be confident in your value and the contributions you make.

21. Study what you want to study.

Follow your passions and study what interests you. Don't let others influence your choices.

22. Become a lifelong learner.

Learning doesn't stop when you leave school. Continue to broaden your knowledge and skills throughout your life.

23. Embrace your own style.

Dress how you feel most comfortable and confident. Don't follow trends just because everyone else is.

24. Give to others.

Giving back can be a rewarding experience. Find ways to help others and contribute to your community.

25. Consider volunteering in your community.

Volunteering is a great way to get involved in your community and make a difference.

26. Practice random acts of kindness.

Small acts of kindness can have a big impact. Do something nice for someone else, without expecting anything in return.

27. Support other women.

Support your fellow womxn. Encourage and empower other women to reach their full potential.

28. Educate other women and girls about being strong and independent.

Share your experiences and insights with other women and girls. Help them become strong, independent individuals, too.

Петима служители на ДАИ са обвинени в корупция

Петима служители на Дирекция "Акцизи и Митници" (ДАИ) бяха обвинени в корупция след проведени проверки на инспекцията. Обвиненията са свързани с измами и нередности при възлагането и изпълнението на митнически услуги.

По данни на прокуратурата, служителите са били задържани преди няколко дни след операция на специализираната прокуратура. Според обвинителния акт, те са използвали длъжностното си положение, за да получат лична печалба от корупционни сделки.

Основните обвинения са свързани със злоупотреба с митнически марки, документи и разрешителни, както и с плащанията за митническите услуги. По думите на прокурорите, служителите са получили значителни суми пари от незаконни дейности, като са измамили клиентите на ДАИ, за да вземат допълнителни такси за услуги.

Специализираната прокуратура е взела мерки за окончателното прекратяване на дейността на обвинените служители на ДАИ. Издадени са заповеди за арест на трима от тях, а останалите двама са под кауция. Те рискат да бъдат осъдени на тежки наказания за корупционни действия, като е възможно да получат затворни присъди до 10 години.

От ДАИ посочиха, че са наясно с обвиненията и че ще помогнат на правосъдието в процеса на разследване. Те заявиха, че работят за укрепване на прозрачността и борбата с корупцията в институцията си, като вече имат наложени строги мерки за контрол и проверка на дейността на служителите.

"Ние сме решени да работим усърдно, за да изкореним корупцията от институцията си и да защитим интересите на гражданите на страната ни", коментираха от ДАИ.

Прокуратурата подчерта, че желае да изпрати ясно послание до обществото, че корупцията няма място в държавата и ще се бори срещу нея, без значение на мястото, където се явява.

Отново се потвърждава, че корупцията е сериозен проблем в България и често води до нарушаване на законите и правата на гражданите. Единственият начин за борба с нея е да бъде наложен строг контрол и никой да не остава ненаказан за корупционни действия.

Надяваме се, че тези обвинения ще бъдат изследвани и обвинените ще бъдат наказани, за да се изпрати ясно послание до всички, че корупцията няма място в демократичната държава.

Срещу мрачната фонова картина, предизвикана от карането на космически програми, NASA се завърта към изобретателните приложения на бъдещето - видео игри! NASA работи над нови проекти, използвайки технологиите от индустрията на видео игрите, за да подобри тренирането на астронавтите. Създаването на тези иновационни приложения е част от проект на NASA, който носи името Creative Application of Autonomous Learning Agent (CAALA).

Проектът на NASA ще се фокусира на развитието на умни агенти с предпочитания по развитие (learning/machine/AI agents). Проектът ще бъде разработен чрез използване на игровите движения и практическата им прилагане в процеса на трениране на астронавтите. Предимствата на тази практика са най-голямото изцяло потребителско удобство - упражненията, които биха могли да се осъществят доста по-лесно и по-интерактивно.

За целта, NASA ще начертае на базата на достигането от игрите, свързаните с космоса и екстрапланетарните срещи, да бъде автоматизирано и използвано за трениране на астронавти. Например, в NASA ще се използва играта Kerbal Space Program (KSP), за да учит астронавтите да работят с нови и сложни изпълнителни процедури, да го дефинират бързо и ефективно.

Това не е първото ползване на видео игри от страна на NASA. През последните години, агенцията използва Valve Corporation Game Development Platform (GDK) за създаване на виртуални астронавтски капсули и демонстриране на измеренията на тяхното движение. 

Технологията ще позволи на NASA да създава реалистични стимулиращи среди, които както астронавтите могат да се запознаят със средата в изпълнението на социално отговорните им задачи. 

За да се осъществи този проект, NASA привлича експерт в игровата индустрия, да го помгне да създаде агент, който ще работи на интелектуален анализ на виртуалната среда. Агентът ще бъде обучен да види тренировките на астронавтите и да предлага предпочитания за различни задачи. Така астронавтите ще могат да разберат пътя към предстоящите им мисии по-бързо и по-лесно.

Работата по проекта ще бъде постоянна, и следва да започне от началото на 2021 година. Ще има и други проекти, които ще са иновативни и ще подобрят процеса на трениране на астронавтите. NASA най-вече иска да използва видео игри, така че нов талант и иновации да бъдат впуснати в процеса на трениране и създаването на умни агенти!

Мы прибыли в Вильню вечером, когда уже стемнело, и окрестности города были еще необозримы. Хотя говорят, что они очень красивы, нам не удалось оценить это сразу же. Тем не менее, мы заметили холмы, покрытые сосновым лесом, сверкающие вдалеке огни дач, затуманенные деревьями в ущельях. Поезд, на котором мы прибыли в город, выезжал из ущелья и мчался по освещенным улицам к вокзалу. Это сходство с Тифлисом в тот момент поразило меня, и я удивилась его величию и поразительности. Я только надеялась, что эта новая поездка принесет нам много счастья.

После прибытия на вокзал нас встретил Иван. Он сообщил нам, что пока не получил вещи. Мы отправились в гостиницу и арендовали номер в трех комнатах, чтобы дать нашей маленькой собаке Таське возможность побегать. Однако на следующий день она заболела гриппом, поэтому я должна была уложить ее в кровать. Слава Богу, ее состояние не слишком осложнилось, но долго продолжалось. Я также почувствовала себя нездоровой, однако мне очень хотелось осмотреть квартиру, которую арендовал Иван. Мне понравились комнаты, они были просторными и светлыми. Лучшие две комнаты были полностью подсолнечными, что было очень важно для Таськи. Однако в квартире все еще пахло краской, грязью и сырыми обоями, а я не знала, когда мы сможем переехать туда из гостиницы, где стоимость нашего проживания была очень высокой.

Что касается самого города, я не смогла полностью оценить его. Хотя он был достаточно большим, он был грязным, из-за странной канализации. Весь мусор тек по ручьям вдоль тротуаров, что было просто отвратительно. Тем не менее, магазины в городе казались хорошими. Арапка отправилась в канцелярию, однако генерал-губернатора и директора канцелярии не было на месте, они были в отпуске. 

В общем, наша первая ночь в Вильне была довольно тяжелой, но я надеюсь, что это только начало и что мы найдем здесь счастье и успех.

В среду депутаты Законодательного собрания Петербурга приняли поправку в городской бюджет, предусматривающую дополнительное финансирование связанное с постройкой стадиона на Крестовском острове. Как сообщает "Интерфакс", будет выделено 4,3 млрд рублей на строительство стадиона, проект которого был отправлен на доработку после заявки на проведение ЧМ-2018.

По словам спикера петербургского парламента Вячеслава Макарова, увеличение затрат на строительство обосновано тем, что требования ФИФА к безопасности стали более жесткими, а в связи с макроэкономическими показателями меняются нормативы. Депутаты надеются, что дополнительных запросов на финансирование со стороны генподрядчиков и компаний, которые ведут строительство стадиона, не будет. Они готовы запустить стадион к Кубку Конфедераций 2017 года.

Увеличение сметы на строительство стадиона связано с изменением курса рубля и уточнением требований правоохранительных органов к обеспечению антитеррористической безопасности. Сумма, выделенная на строительство стадиона, вырастет с 34,9 млрд рублей до 39,2 млрд рублей.

We present an efficient algorithm for computing the sign function of a large sparse complex matrix, which is based on the Lanczos bidiagonalization process with partial reorthogonalization. The proposed algorithm can be applied to any Hermitian or non-Hermitian matrices without restriction. We apply this new algorithm to the overlap Dirac operator in lattice QCD simulations at finite density. In particular we show that our algorithm works well even when the quark mass becomes small compared to the inverse of the lattice spacing. This work was supported by Grants-in-Aid for Scientific Research (No. 20340040) from MEXT Japan. PACS numbers: 11.15.Ha, 12.38.Qk, 12.39.Fe, 14.20 .Dh  1 Introduction Lattice Quantum Chromodynamics(LQCD), as one of the most promising candidates for describing strong interactions among quarks and gluons, has been widely used to study hadronic properties such as masses and decay constants [1] . However, it suffers from the so-called "sign problem": the fermion determinant detDm=exp[-tr{Dm}lnm] changes its signs depending on the gauge configurations [2] , where Dm denotes the Wilson-Dirac operator [3] . Therefore, Monte Carlo methods cannot be directly employed to calculate physical quantities using LQCD because they require positive definite weight functions [4] .
In order to overcome this difficulty, several approaches have been developed so far [5] - [8] . Among them, the Taylor expansion approach [9] - [11] seems to be very powerful since it allows us to evaluate the expectation value of any observables accurately within statistical errors. It also enables us to perform calculations at high temperature and/or high density [12] - [14] . For example, the Taylor expansion up to O(a6) has already been performed successfully [15] .

София 2018 помага на онкоболни деца за Игрите в Москва – Новини от Силистра

В Силистра екипът на "София 2018" успя да събере значителна сума за подкрепа на българската делегация, която ще участва на Световните игри за онкоболни деца в Москва. Това заяви Михаела Бялкова, ръководител на кампанията, в телевизионно интервю.

За талантливите български спортисти участващи в Игрите, която ще се проведе от 18 до 26 август в руската столица, "София 2018" ще предостави финансова помощ в размер на 30 000 лева.

"София 2018" е кампания, която вече две години изгражда уникални спортни обекти, за да подготви града за Европейското в сферата на спорта. Преди малко кампанията се превърна в основен дарител на българските онкоболни деца, и по този начин министър-председателят Бойко Борисов подкрепи идеята за създаването на спортен лагер за онкоболните деца в България, за което вече работят представители на "София 2018".

"София 2018" ще продължи да поддържа онкоболните деца в България и след края на Световните игри в Москва, като предоставя много и различни проекти за деца, за да им помогне да забравят за болестта си и да се забавляват у дома, разказва Михаела Бялкова.

Малкият Боян и брат му Радослав, от Силистра, бяха част от кампанията за привличане на средства за участие на българската делегация в Москва, за която голяма част от цялата сума е събрана.

"Ние с напори на събития в Силистра и подкрепата на "София 2018" успяхме да съберем достатъчно средства, за да помогнем на нашите спортисти да участват в Световните игри за онкоболни деца", заяви братът на Боян.

Организаторите на кампанията се надяват, че всички онкоболни деца ще бъдат възнаградени за техния труд в Москва, когато се завърнат в България.

Световните игри за онкоболни деца в Москва са организирани от International Federation of Childhood Cancer в партньорство със Световна здравна организация и Руската международна детска фондация.

"Литекс Моторс", един от водещите доставчици на автомобилен оборудване в България, който съществува от 1998 г., подаде документи за фалит. Компанията, която се занимава с внос и дистрибуция на автомобилни гуми, аксесоари, масла и други предмети, обяви своята неспособност да изпълни задълженията си и иска отварянето на процедурата по неиния фалит.

"Литекс Моторс" е дължил над 1 милион лева на различни дружества, като задълженията му бяха увеличени с почти 400 000 лева през последните месеци. Компанията е имала сериозни проблеми с ликвидността и е оставала задължения над 90 дни, което е извън границите на закона.

Сред кредиторите на "Литекс Моторс" са големи фирми като "Български пощи" и "ДЗИ" АД. Въпреки това, предложението за възстановяване на дейността на компанията бързо беше отхвърлено, като фирмата се оказа без шансове за оцеляване.

В настоящия момент се очаква, че ще бъде избрана кантора за управление на активите на "Литекс Моторс", която ще прегледа всички документи и ще реши какво ще се случи с имуществото на компанията. Не е ясно дали ще бъдат запазени работните места на около 50 души, които работят за българската компания.

Директорът на "Литекс Моторс" Стоян Стоянов заяви, че компанията беше принудена да подаде документи за фалит, за да защити кредиторите и работниците си. Той призова медиите да спрат да публикуват лъжливи и дискредитиращи информации за компанията.

"Литекс Моторс" е била една от най-успешните автомобилни компании в България, която е имала добри връзки с международни производители на гуми и други аксесоари. Но с влизането на нови играчи на пазара, тя започна да губи позиции и накрая не успя да издържи конкуренцията.

Въпреки трудностите, "Литекс Моторс" остава една от най-известните марки на пазара за автомобилно оборудване в България, която има голям потенциал за развитие. Остава да се види каква ще бъде дългосрочната стратегия на компанията и какви ще бъдат резултатите от процеса по фалита.

Creating a photography portfolio is a great way to show off your skills and engage prospective clients, and it doesn’t need to be a difficult process. It is important to know what type of portfolio you are creating and who your desired audience may be. Consider the purpose of your portfolio, whether it is specifically to showcase your work or to even get hired. This will help you decide on the correct style and subject matter that should be included in the portfolio.

Once you have identified the purpose of your portfolio, choose a unifying theme that will appeal to your desired audience. This should be something that encompasses the subject and style of the images that will be in your portfolio. Consider the type of work you’ve been doing and the message you want your chosen audience to receive. This unifying theme will be the basis for the images included in your portfolio, so be sure to make it something that fits with what you want to convey.

Next, decide which format of portfolio is right for you. The most common formats are physical photo books and prints, digital portfolio sites and apps, PDF files, and online portfolios like websites and blogs. In most cases, it’s best to choose one format and stick with it, as this will help keep your portfolio consistent.

After you’ve settled on a format for your portfolio, carefully examine each photo that you plan on including. Carefully assess every photo to identify which images portray the unifying theme you’ve chosen, and how they could be best arranged in your portfolio. It is important to keep the photos consistent and to remove any flawed or repetitive images. Be sure to remove any images that are out of focus or that show visible flaws that could keep from selling the message you want to portray.

Once you’ve narrowed down the selection of photos to a manageable number, get a second opinion from someone you trust about which images should be kept and where they should be placed in the portfolio. It can be hard to be objective about your own work, so it is best to get somebody else’s opinion. Once you have received the other person’s opinion, settle on ten to twenty final images. 

When you’ve decided on your choice of images, adjust them as necessary. Make small changes to the color, lighting, and other details until the images fully represent your artist vision and reflect the theme you’ve chosen. You may also need to resize, crop, or add a border to the images to meet the requirements of your portfolio format. Lastly, organize the images into a particular sequence to help your audience understand how your portfolio narrates visually.

Once you have determined the format and images for your portfolio, be sure to use high quality materials when putting together the final product. For physical portfolios, make sure to use the highest quality photography paper available, as low-quality paper can be damaging to your images. For digital portfolios, use the strongest file format allowed by the chosen medium since using a lower quality could cause the images to appear distorted.

When your portfolio is complete, make sure to add the finishing touches. This can include a short biography, a resume of your photography experience, printed critiques from past exhibits, customer references, or any other type of additional information you think would be beneficial. You could also consider creating an online portfolio, which will make it easier for you to get your work out in front of a larger audience.

Creating a photography portfolio doesn't have to be difficult. By taking the time to determine the purpose of your portfolio, consider your audience, and choose a unifying theme, the images for your portfolio should work together to tell your story. With the correct materials and the right format, you will soon have a portfolio that will help you showcase your work in the best way.

The photonic flame phenomenon was first observed in a laboratory in 2006 by M. Tsubouchi and S. A. Dutta [1]. This effect is an instability of a light emitting and conical wire flame, which is triggered by slightly inhomogeneous heat convection. This instability manifests itself as thinning and branching of the flame, forming a complex pattern, which can be observed with naked eye in bright light. We have obtained three remarkable features of the photonic flame by means of high-speed camera observation. First, there is a short delay between the moment when the temperature gradient appears at the tip of the branch and the moment when this tip starts to emit light. Such behaviour can be observed in the videoclip linked in the text. Second, it is possible to trigger the flame branches by local heating from the nearby ignited wire. It is also observed in the videoclip. Third, if a stable flame tip is illuminated from behind by a sufficiently bright light, then this light can "reflect" from the front surface of the flame. This "out-of-planear" reflection is also visible in the video.

How to Make an Adult Blanket Sleeper

A blanket sleeper, sometimes called a footie pajama, is a cozy garment that can be worn in the winter or on chilly nights. If you're tired of buying expensive blanket sleepers or are looking for a custom fit, making your own may be the perfect solution. This article will guide you through the process of creating your own adult blanket sleeper.

Part 1: Creating the Pattern
1. Gather your materials. You will need a large sheet of tracing paper or wrapping paper, a measuring tape, a pair of scissors, and a pen or pencil.

2. Measure your body. Take accurate measurements of your waist, hips, chest, and inseam. Write down these measurements on a piece of paper.

3. Sketch your pattern. Using the measurements you took, draw a basic sketch of the blanket sleeper you want to make. It should include a front and back piece, sleeve pieces, foot pieces, and a neckline.

4. Refine the pattern. Once you have a basic sketch, refine the pattern by adding any necessary darts or adjustments that will ensure a comfortable fit. Trace your final pattern onto the tracing paper or wrapping paper.

Part 2: Cutting and Sewing the Sleeper
1. Gather your materials. You will need your pattern, fabric, scissors, a sewing machine, thread, and a zipper.

2. Cut out the pattern. Cut out the pattern pieces for both sides of the sleeper and the sleeve pieces from your fabric. 

3. Sew the body cavern pieces together. Place the front and back pieces with right sides together and sew the side seams and shoulder seams together.

4. Pin and sew your zipper on the garment. Following the manufacturer's instructions, place the zipper on the front of the garment, and then pin and sew it in place.

5. Pin both sides together and sew the inner leg, side and shoulder seams. Pin both sides of the sleeper together with right sides facing each other and sew the inner leg, side, and shoulder seams. 

6. Trace the sleeves onto more of the tracing paper/wrapping paper to make a pattern for the sleeves-area. Use your previous sleeve pattern as a guide and extend the outline to include the armhole.

7. Place your fabric for the sleeve on a flat surface and then place your pattern down and cut out the sleeve pieces out of your fabric. 

8. Pin and sew each arm side to the remainder of the body cavern around the armhole. Pin and sew each sleeve to the armhole of the garment.

9. Fold under and sew the neckline but be careful not to stretch the neckline otherwise you'll need to start over with more fabric for a new sleeper again.

10. Cut two elastic straps the size of your ankles. Place and pin and sew the elastics to the edges of the garment's ankle area.

11. Create the pattern for the sleeper's feet pieces (sometimes people call this area "the boot"). Use your remaining tracing paper to create a pattern for the feet/boot pieces.

12. Pin and sew the boot pieces to the garment so that the right sides are together directly to the pants. Pin and sew the boot pieces to the bottom of the garment to create the bottoms of the footie pajamas.

13. Trace your foot onto one last sheet of paper and cut out the pattern. Use the paper pattern to create the foot pieces out of your fabric.

14. Place the fabric down one last time and create the foot pieces. Place the bottom pieces with the right sides together and pin and sew all around the bottom for the foot pieces to the boot.

15. Attach some Jiffy Grip to the foot pieces if you feel you want a non-skid surface. Sew a piece of Jiffy Grip to the bottom of each foot to prevent slipping.

Now that you have completed all the steps your adult blanket sleeper is ready to use! Enjoy the warmth and comfort of your new creation.

Согласно сообщению источника знакомого с ситуацией, окончательное решение о сроках и месте проведения ремонта и модернизации тяжелого авианесущего крейсера "Адмирал Кузнецов" еще не принято. В ближайшее время состоится совещание с участием военных и представителей промышленности, на котором будут рассмотрены различные варианты по этому вопросу. Однако, один из рассматриваемых вариантов - отправить авианосец на ремонт только в 2018 году, вместо этого продолжать использовать его для боевой службы в текущем году. 

Основной причиной такого варианта является недостаток финансовых средств и возможное длительное время ремонта в текущем году. В то же время, на данный момент корабль "живой" и способен выполнять свои военные обязательства, дающие показательные результаты в ходе недавнего похода в Средиземном море. 

Одним из преимуществ отправки авианосца на ремонт в 2018 году, как было указано, будет возможность подготовки летной бригады, состоящей из 100-го отдельного корабельного истребительного авиационного полка Морской авиации Северного флота. Корабельная ударная авианосная группа (КУАГ) Северного флота отправилась в Средиземное море 15 октября 2016 года и вернулась обратно 9 февраля 2017 года. 15 ноября 2016 года было объявлено о первом в истории боевом применении палубной авиации "Адмирала Кузнецова". Палубные истребители были задействованы в нанесении ударов по целям террористов на территории Сирии. Politically, reactions in the Islamic world were mixed. Some welcomed Christopher Columbus as a great explorer, while others viewed him as a conquistador. Those who welcomed Columbus saw his discovery as an opportunity to explore and trade with the inhabitants of the New World. This was especially attractive to wealthy merchants, who saw the potential for great profits in the untapped American markets.

However, others were concerned that the discovery posed an existential threat to the Islamic world. Some feared that the arrival of European ships signaled the potential for a new wave of colonialism in the region. This was particularly true for the Ottoman Empire, a Muslim state that extended across three continents. They feared that land-based Christian forces could attempt to claim the Ottoman's territories in the New World and ultimately conquer its citizens.

Finally, the discovery of America in the Islamic world was also seen by some as evidence of a divine plan. A group of Muslim mystics argued that the discovery was part of God's will to bring humanity closer together. They believed that by uniting the East and West, human beings could come to a greater understanding of the natural order.

Thus, the discovery of America by Christopher Columbus in 1492 was viewed in the Islamic world both positively and negatively. From the spiritual perspective, some viewed it as a sign of their superiority. Politically, reactions ranged from those who welcomed Columbus to those who feared the new wave of colonialism he represented. Ultimately, the discovery of America was seen by many in the Islamic world as part of God's plan to create a closer, more understanding global community.

How to Protect Your Rare Maps and Manuscripts

Rarer and more fragile than printed books, maps and manuscripts require extra care and attention when it comes to preservation. Whether you have a few fragile items or a large collection of rare maps and manuscripts, the best way to ensure their long-term preservation is to understand how they are threatened and what you can do to protect them.

Determine the condition of your maps and manuscripts.
Rare maps and manuscripts can be in fragile condition for a number of reasons, including age, improper storage, and improper handling. In many cases, you can tell that a map or manuscript is in poor condition just by looking at it. If it's torn, creased, or otherwise damaged, it's probably in need of some tender loving care. Even if it's still in relatively good condition, it's a good idea to have it conserved to prevent further damage.

If you're not sure what condition your maps and manuscripts are in, take them to a professional conservator for an evaluation.

Even if you don't think your maps and manuscripts are in bad condition, it's a good idea to have them checked out every once in a while. Early detection of problems can prevent bigger issues down the road.

Transport maps and manuscripts with care.
If you're moving your maps and manuscripts from one location to another, it's important to do so with care. Even if you're just moving them from one shelf to another, be sure to use clean hands and to handle them gently. If you're transporting them long distance, it's best to hire a professional moving company that has experience in transporting fragile items.

Avoid exposing your maps and manuscripts to light, heat, and humidity.
Maps and manuscripts are particularly sensitive to light, heat, and humidity. Prolonged exposure to light can cause the ink to fade, and heat and humidity can cause the paper to deteriorate. It's important to store your maps and manuscripts in a cool, dry location that is free of direct sunlight.

If you're displaying your maps and manuscripts, be sure to use a light that is not too bright and that is directed away from the maps and manuscripts.

You should also avoid displaying your maps and manuscripts near any heat sources, such as a fireplace or heating vent.

Handle your maps and manuscripts with clean hands.
When handling your maps and manuscripts, be sure to use clean hands or wear gloves. Oils and acids from your skin can damage the paper, so it's important to handle them with care.

Don't write on your maps and manuscripts.
It may be tempting to make notes on your maps and manuscripts, but it's important to avoid doing so. Writing on them can damage the paper and make it more difficult to read. If you need to make a note, it's best to do so on a separate piece of paper that can be easily removed.

We explore the metal enrichment of the gas in minihalos which have become virialized at high redshift, as compared to that of the intergalactic medium. Using hydrodynamic simulations, we find that, at redshift z=10, the majority (up to 90%) of the high density gas, which has a density of more than 500 rhob, present in minihalos of mass 10^7 and 10^6 Msun, would remain with a metallicity lower than 3% of that of the intergalactic medium even when exposed to metal-enriched intergalactic shocks of velocities ranging from 10 to 100km/s up to redshift z=6. This suggests that gas in such virialized minihalos may, when incorporated into larger halos, be a plentiful supply of primordial gas that has the potential to enable the formation of metal-free Population-III stars at a much lower redshift than anticipated from the enrichment of the intergalactic medium.

In our work titled “Prompt Emission of High Energy Photons from Gamma Ray Bursts,” we aim to explore the problem of understanding the origins of high energy photons in gamma ray bursts (GRBs). GRBs are some of the brightest events in the universe that last only a few seconds but emit massive amounts of energy in the form of gamma rays. However, the mechanism behind the prompt emission of high energy photons in GRBs is still unknown. Our work attempts to tackle this problem by examining the key ideas surrounding the prompt emission of high energy photons in GRBs and proposing a methodology to uncover the mysteries behind their origin. 

To achieve this, we used high-resolution gamma-ray satellite telescopes to study the emission of GRBs on Earth’s atmosphere. Our focus was on the prompt emission with energies above 100 MeV, which is a largely unexplored energy regime for GRBs. We analyzed the data from the Fermi Gamma-ray Burst Monitor and Large Area Telescope to explore the correlation between the spectral properties of the prompt emission and the physical properties of the GRB phenomena. Our results suggest that the emission of high-energy photons originates from internal shocks within the jet, which is a critical discovery in understanding the prompt emission in GRBs.

In conclusion, our work contributes significantly to the understanding of the origin of high energy photons in GRBs, opening up new avenues for future research in the field of high-energy astrophysics.

We present an analysis of polar broad absorption line quasars (BALQs) that utilizes both the intensity and the velocity structure of the quasar absorption lines. The data set consists of 26 BALQs with high signal-to-noise ratio (S/N) spectra, acquired with the Hubble Space Telescope. We find that the quasar absorption lines in all cases display a positive velocity gradient, i.e., the lines are blue-shifted in the direction of the systemic velocity. The line-center velocities are systematically higher than the systemic velocities, except in the case of a peculiar broad absorption line source (BALS) with many narrowly spaced absorption lines. We discuss this finding in the framework of simple models in which the quasars are treated either as single-temperature objects or as multi-temperature objects with a distribution of temperatures. We find that in all cases the model predictions are consistent with the data, except in the case of the peculiar BALS, for which the model over-predicts the systemic velocity by a large margin. Our results suggest that the nature of the absorbing material in polar BALQs is different from that in classical non-polar sources: the absorbing material in polar sources is either (1) a large number of small clouds, each having a small velocity offset with respect to the systemic velocity, or (2) a small number of large clouds, each having a large velocity offset. We discuss this difference in the framework of the classical picture of a large rotating disk with a radiative core and an accretion disk, and suggest that this picture is not consistent with the observed velocity structure of the quasar absorption lines in polar BALQs.

How to Use a Rough Cut Mower
Mowing a large lawn or field doesn’t have to be hard work. With the proper equipment, you can make the job easier and get better results. One of the best tools for mowing large areas is a rough cut mower.

Rough cut mowers are designed to work in large fields, lawns, or areas with large amounts of heavy brush. Unlike regular lawn mowers which are used primarily on standard grass, rough cut mowers cut high and thick grass, weeds, and other heavy growth.

Before using a rough cut mower, there are a few steps you should follow. These steps are important to making sure your mower works safely and correctly.

Making Sure Your Tractor is in Good Operating Condition
First things first, make sure your tractor is in good operating condition. Start the engine and check if all of the fluid levels (i.e. oil, antifreeze, and fuel) are in check. Also check to make sure the brakes, tires, and other components are in good condition.

Using the Correct Mower
The second step is to use the right size and configuration of mower for your tractor. Depending on the size and power of your tractor, you may need a different mower than one which is suitable for a larger or smaller tractor.

Adjusting the Sway Chains/Stabilizers
The sway chains, or stabilizers, are designed to keep the mower from swinging too far when turning corners. Check that they are adjusted correctly every time you use your mower.

Checking the Condition of Your Mower
Next, make sure the mower (as well as the sway chains) is in good condition. This includes checking for sharpness of the blades, checking belts are not worn or cracked, and inspecting the housing for dents or other damage.

Hooking Up the Mower
Next, with the tractor off, you can hook up the mower and connect the PTO shaft. Make sure it is securely connected, and double check before turning on your tractor.

Engaging the PTO
Now it’s time to start the tractor. Engage the two-stage clutch and turn on the PTO switch. Only when both of these have been done can you move on to raising the mower.

Raising the Mower
It’s now time to raise the mower to the desired cutting height. Use the three-point hitch hydraulics to easily lift the mower. Make sure that the height is suitable for the job you’re doing before you start mowing.

Mowing
Now it’s time to mow! Choose a route in the area you’re mowing, whether it is rows or circles. When mowing, make sure you’re paying attention to the engine and the exhaust if you have a diesel engine. Keep an eye out for any obstacles or insects that may be in the way.

Other Measures to Keep in Mind
When mowing with a rough cut mower, there are a few other measures to keep in mind. Make sure the mower rails are not digging into the earth, and if you’re mowing under tree limbs or other overhead hazards, use extra caution. Understand the limits of your mower so that it can cut effectively. Finally, remember to enjoy the mowing job! 

Rough cut mowers are an effective way to mow large areas, but it is important to make sure you follow the proper steps when using one. Take your time and use caution to ensure that your mower works safely and correctly.

Decazes Island war ein ursprünglich unbewohntes Atoll im Pazifischen Ozean, das nach der Abholzung der Wälder zunächst vor allem als Kokosnussplantage genutzt wurde. In der Mitte des 19. Jahrhunderts wurde die Insel von französischen Entdeckern besucht und nach einem Theiländerersatzminister im Dienste der Bourbonenmonarchie und Unterstützer Napoleons I.., Élie, duc Decazes benannt.In der Folgezeit wurde das Atoll als Ankerplatz and geringfügiger Umschlagplatz für Passagiere und Fracht genutzt. Die Bewohner betrieben Imkerei, Fischerei und Kokospalmenplantagen, die Einfuhrsprudukte aber waren knapp und so lebten die meisten ein sehr bescheidenes Leben. Etwas bekannter wurde die Insel durch die Veröffentlichungen des französischen Forschers und Ethnologen Paul Ottino, der hier von 1947 bis 1949 lebte- Seine Ausführungen über die Kultur der Insulaner spielen eine bedeutende Rolle in der Forschung zur Entwicklung der indigenen Völker in der Südsee. Letzten Endes wurde die Insel, bedingt durch aufkommenden Meeresspiegelanstieg und Verschiebungen in europäischen Ernährungstrends, allmählich aufgegeben und in den 1960er Jahren vollständig evakuiert. Die letzten Bewohner wurden von einem französischen Kriegsschiff aufgenommen und auf das benachbarte Fufuti gebracht. Decazes Island wurde zunächst von niemandem weiter bevölkert und dient heute primär ökologischen Zwecken. Es leben lediglich einige Vogelarten auf der Insel, die vorwiegend aufgrund ihrer geographischen Lage bedeutend sind. Der Name Decazes Island ist heute ein Begriff für den Einsatz von Kolonialmacht in fernen Regionen, die damit verbundene ökologsiche Ohrfeige sowie die Be- und Ausnutzung von Einheimischen. Anfang 2008 ging eine Petition ein, die forderte, den Namen der Insel zu ändern. Der Antrag wurde allerdings nie formal verhandelt oder abgestimmt.  So bleibt Decazes Island ein Teil der Geschichte kolonialer Herrschaft und Ausbeutung in weit entfernten Regionen.

In this work, we investigate the control of mechanical systems on Lie groups and their application to ideal hydrodynamics. Our main objective is to develop a control strategy that preserves the geometric properties of the systems, while ensuring optimal behavior. Specifically, we focus on systems that evolve on Lie groups and are subject to external or internal perturbations. Such systems arise in various physical applications, including fluid dynamics, robotics, and spacecraft control. 

To address these challenges, we propose a novel approach based on Lie-algebraic techniques and the concept of optimal control theory. Our approach enables us to derive explicit control laws that naturally incorporate the underlying geometry of the system, resulting in a unique and effective control strategy. 

We evaluate our methodology by applying it to a simple model system, and demonstrate its superior performance in comparison to classical control techniques. Moreover, we show the applicability of our approach to ideal hydrodynamics, which confirms the generality of our method and its potential impact on various scientific domains. 

In summary, this work provides a comprehensive framework for the control of mechanical systems on Lie groups, with promising results in ideal hydrodynamics. Our approach is innovative and promising, leading to potential advances in control engineering, robotics, and fluid dynamics.

When the Greek Empire fell, it was a very difficult time for the Greek people. After Constantinople fell, the Greek Empire was in disarray and it was not possible to carry on ruling in the same way. The people of Greece, who had once been a powerful force in the Mediterranean, now found themselves in a position of great uncertainty. 

For many years after the fall, the people of Greece still thought of themselves as Roman. Even though the Empire had been greatly weakened, the culture, language and customs of the people of Greece still identified them as Roman. This was a time of great pride and loyalty, but the situation was slowly changing. 

Around the 8th and 9th centuries, there began to be a gradual change in the thinking of the Greek people. Slowly but surely, many began to look inward and solely identify with Greece. This change was largely driven by the Byzantine Empire, which was an attempt by the Roman Empire to reclaim its former glory. This led to the reintroduction of much of Greek culture, language and way of life.

Selling products from home can be a great way to make money and become your own boss. However, it’s important to know how to do it right. In this article, you’ll learn how to brainstorm what type of products to sell, how to determine the size and competitiveness of the market, how to make and test your product, and how to advertise and sell it. You’ll also learn how to offer refunds and exchanges, and how to branch out to new products as your business grows. 

Part 1: Brainstorm What Type of Products You Have Knowledge of and Could Succeed in Selling From Home

The first step to selling products from home is to identify what you know and what you can sell. This could be anything from handmade crafts to organic foods to vintage clothing. Think about your hobbies, interests, and skills, and consider what products you could create or source that would appeal to others. 

Part 2: Know What Makes Really Good Products

Not all products are created equal. To sell from home, you need to have products that people will want to buy. This means you need to know what makes a really good product. A good product should be unique, high-quality, and relevant to your target market. It should also fulfill a need or solve a problem for your customers. 

Part 3: Determine the Size and Competitiveness of the Market

Once you have an idea of what products you want to sell, it’s important to research the market to see if there is demand for your product and how competitive it is. You can do this by using online tools like Google Trends, Amazon sales data, and social media insights. You can also talk to friends and family, attend trade shows and fairs, and read industry magazines and blogs. 

Part 4: If You Can, Stock Up on the Product by Buying Wholesale

If you’re confident that there is demand for your product, you can consider buying wholesale. This means purchasing a large quantity of your product at a discounted price from a supplier. This allows you to keep your costs low and your profits high. 

Part 5: Start Making Your Product

Now it’s time to start creating or sourcing your product. If you’re making your own product, make sure you have the skills and resources to do so. You may need to invest in equipment, training, and supplies. If you’re sourcing your product from a supplier, make sure you carefully vet them to ensure they are reliable and provide high-quality products. 

Part 6: Test, Test, and then Test Some More

Before launching your product, it’s important to test it thoroughly. This means getting feedback from friends, family, and potential customers. You can also run small test campaigns to see how well your product sells. Use this feedback to make any necessary adjustments before launching your product. 

Part 7: Apply for a Tax Identification Number

Before you can start selling your product, you’ll need to apply for a tax identification number (TIN). This is a unique identifier that the government uses to track your business activity and ensure you pay taxes correctly. You can apply for a TIN through the IRS website. 

Part 8: Open a New Bank Account to Keep Your Business Earnings Separate from the Rest of Your Family Income

To keep your business earnings separate from the rest of your family income, it’s important to open a new bank account for your business. This will help you keep track of your income and expenses, and ensure you’re not mixing personal and business finances. 

Part 9: Purchase Business Software for Your Home Computer or Laptop That Will Allow You to Keep an Organized Database of Inventory, Invoices, and Accounting

To manage your business efficiently, it’s important to invest in business software. This could include tools for inventory management, invoicing, and accounting. There are many options available, so do your research and choose software that fits your needs and budget. 

Part 10: Advertise Your New Business and the Products You Are Selling

To attract customers to your business, you need to advertise it effectively. This could include using social media, paid advertising, content marketing, and influencer marketing. Choose the tactics that work best for your business and target market. 

Part 11: Experiment with, But Don't Rely Solely on, PPC or Social

While PPC or social media advertising can be effective, it’s important not to rely solely on them. Experiment with other forms of advertising, like email marketing and content marketing, to reach your target market. 

Part 12: Arrange a Way for Customers to Access and Buy Your Products

Make it easy for customers to access and buy your products. This could include setting up an online store, selling on third-party platforms like Etsy or Amazon, or offering local pickup or delivery. 

Part 13: Consider Creating Your Own Website

If you’re serious about selling products from home, you may want to consider creating your own website. This gives you more control over your brand, your website design, and your sales process. 

Part 14: Sell Your Product on eBay

eBay can be a great platform for selling products from home. It’s easy to set up an account and start selling, and there’s a huge audience of potential customers. 

Part 15: Sell on Amazon

Amazon is another popular platform for selling products from home. With Amazon, you can set up your own storefront, fulfill orders through their fulfillment centers, and reach a huge audience of customers. 

Part 16: Sell Your Product on Etsy

Etsy is a popular marketplace for handmade and vintage items. If you’re making your own product, or sourcing unique vintage items, Etsy may be a great platform for you. 

Part 17: If You're Adventurous, Consider Selling Door-to-Door

If you’re up for some adventure, you can consider selling door-to-door. This means going door-to-door in your local area and pitching your product to potential customers. It’s not for everyone, but it can be an effective way to get your product in front of people. 

Part 18: Ship the Product out Expeditiously

Once you have received an order, it’s important to ship the product out as quickly as possible. This ensures customer satisfaction and can help you build a positive reputation. 

Part 19: Offer Refunds and Exchanges

Mistakes can happen, and sometimes customers will want to return or exchange a product. Make sure you have a clear policy in place for refunds and exchanges. This will help you avoid disputes and maintain good customer relationships. 

Part 20: After a While, Branch out to New Products

As your business grows, you may want to consider branching out to new products. This could mean adding new products to your existing line, or exploring new markets or product categories. Keep testing, experimenting, and learning as you grow your business.

The Polvorín de Miraflores is an archaeological site of the Herrera culture, located in the Department of Ancash, Peru. It is situated on a rocky promontory on the left bank of the Rimac River, opposite the city of Lima. The site is dated to about 800–1450 AD, with the peak of occupation around 1100 AD. The site was first reported by the Polish scientist Julian Hochberg in 1927, who carried out a series of surveys and limited excavations in the early 1930s. It was not until the 1960s that the site was further investigated, this time by the Polish mission of the University of Warsaw, under the direction of Andrzej Zawadzki. In the early 1970s, the first large-scale excavations were made, under the direction of DNA Surís. This project was succeeded in the 1980s by the Proyecto Nacional Polvorín, directed by Luis Lumbreras. The site consists of four main areas, which are believed to have been used for different purposes. The largest and most important is the Sector Sur, which is the location of the principal occupation. This area is divided into three sub-sectors: the Acropolis, the Court of Honor, and the Funerary Hill. The second area is the Sector Norte, located on the northern tip of the promontory. This area is smaller and not as well-defined as the Sector Sur, and it is believed to have been used for residential purposes. The third area is the Sector Este, which is located on the eastern side of the promontory, opposite the city of Lima. This area is the location of a series of smaller occupation sites, including a number of rectangular structures that are believed to be domestic in nature. The fourth area is the Sector Oeste, which is located on the western side of the promontory, facing the Rimac River. This area is the location of a series of smaller occupation sites, as well as a number of ceremonial platforms and other structures. The Polvorín de Miraflores is one of the most important archaeological sites in Peru, and it has been designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

Aristotelia palamota, commonly known as mountain mahogany, is a plant species belonging to the Elaeocarpaceae family. The flowers are scarce and sweet-scented, producing small, white four-petaled blooms in late summer and early autumn. The fruit consists of dry, small, red achenes that rippen in clusters during autumn. Mountain mahogany is a popular choice for home gardeners and landscape architects. It has tough, green foliage that makes for a resilient tree that with is resistant to wind and frost. It also produces an attractive fractured bark similar to pepper plants. Aristotelia palamota prefers well-drained, nutrient-rich soils, although it is tolerant of most soil types. It does not do well in wet and heavy clay soils. Germination is usually rapid and the plant will grow and begin flowering within a couple of years. Although mountain mahogany is resistant to insect and disease damage, it can be subject to some fungal issues and mechanical damage. Abdul Ilah al-Khatib (alternative Schreibweise Abd al-Ilah al-Khatib oder Abd-al-Ilah al-Khatib; * 1. Januar 1951 in Nablus, Jordanisches Westjordanland; † 26. November 2020 in Amman, Jordanien) war ein jordanischer Diplomat und ein Friedensverhandler im Nahostkonflikt. Bis November 2017 war er der Sondergesandte der Arabischen Liga für Syrien. Anschließend wurde er zum Sondergesandten des UN-Generalsekretärs für Syrien ernannt; diese Funktion hatte er bis Oktober 2018 inne. Bis März 2018 war er auch UN-Sondergesandter für die syrische patriotische Opposition.

Leben

Abdul Ilah al-Khatib wurde in einer Familie von Intellektuellen und Rechtsanwälten geboren. Sein Vater, der 1971 die jordanische Regierung führte, war der Tuwat-Clan zugehörig. Seine akademische Laufbahn begann er mit einem Studium der Englischen und Arabischen Literatur an der Universität von Jerusalem von 1969 bis 1973. Es folgte ein Studium der Politik- und Geschichtswissenschaften an der Universität von Beirut von 1973 bis 1977 mit den Abschlüssen Bachelor of Arts und Master of Science.

Er hatte zahlreiche diplomatische Posten inne. Von 1992 bis 1999 war er Botschafter Jordaniens im Libanon und von 1999 bis 2005 Botschafter in Berlin. Im Jahr 2008 wurde er zum Generalsekretär des Jordantals ernannt, einer jordanischen Region mit über 300.000 Einwohnern.

Von 2009 bis 2011 war er Staatssekretär im jordanischen Außenministerium und leitete das Arbeitsgremium zur Vorbereitung der Friedenskonferenz von Annapolis. Von 2011 bis 2016 war er der Sondergesandte der Arabischen Liga für Syrien, bevor er im November 2017 zum UN-Sondergesandten für Syrien ernannt wurde.

Werk und Auszeichnungen

Er gilt als kenntnisreicher und erfahrener Nahost-Experte. Schwerpunkt seiner Arbeit waren Fragen des interkonfessionellen Dialogs, der Zusammenarbeit der Kulturen und der Verständigung zwischen palästinensischen und israelischen Gruppen. Für seine Vermittlungsbemühungen bei verschiedenen Konflikten im Nahen Osten erhielt er zahlreiche Auszeichnungen. Zu seinen wichtigsten Verhandlungserfolgen gehört der Bristoler Friedensvertrag von 2005 zwischen Serben und Albanern. Sein Wirken wurde 2012 mit dem Preis des Schweizerische Friedensrats gewürdigt.

Tod

Al-Khatib starb am 26. November 2020 im Alter von 69 Jahren an den Folgen einer COVID-19-Erkrankung im Krankenhaus in Amman, Jordanien. Sein Tod wurde von zahlreichen Politikern, Wissenschaftlern und Friedensaktivisten mit großer Betroffenheit betrauert.

The Awá, also known as Guajá, is the name of an indigenous group mainly distributed in the northeastern region of the Amazon forest in Brazil. The group has more or less 2,000 members of whom only 450 live in voluntary isolation. They have a high social sensitivity and maintain an organized community that is divided into many subgroups. Most of their social interactions are practiced for celebrations and rituals.
Originally, the Awá people survived on hunting and gathering. Today they incorporate some nutritional sources directly from the earth including brazil nuts, and cupuaçu. They also practice small scale farming. However, the development, which brought the settlers, loggers, and farmers, caused irreversible damages to the Awá landscape, watershed, and wildlife. The onset of industrial logging was one of the most significant threats in the history of this underrepresented group of people.
Policy programs such as National Indigenous Foundation (FUNAI)and the Ministry of Environment in collaboration with non-governmental agencies are supporting and developing programs for the well-being of this marginalized group. In 2012 following FUNAI's recommendations, Brazil’s Supreme Court ordered that cattle ranchers leave the Awá’s territory to protect them from further environmental hostility. FUNAI also runs a health clinic known as Madegro in the area near the Awá’s territory.
The public campaign #StopMataAtlântica was launched to draw attention to the issue and increase the pressure on related government agencies. The campaign, however, has failed to underpin the present administration. As of the end of 2018, Bolsonaro promoted measures endangering land rights for indigenous populations and removed environmental protections from protected regions, posing an imminent threat to the Awá's cultural and historical inheritance alongside the multitudinous environmental harms to the region. The Awá has inspired a larger movement in Latin America to support indigenous people's rights and establish necessary policy to protect them.

Manganites R_{1-x}A_{x}MnO_{3} (R is a rare-earth and A is a alkaline-earth element) are widely studied due to their interesting physical properties such as colossal magnetoresistance. There are two coupling mechanisms which are believed to be responsible for the colossal magnetoresistance effect in these materials: the double-exchange (DE) mechanism and the Jahn-Teller (JT) mechanism. The former assumes that the spins of the Mn ions are coupled through the double exchange and depends only on the spatial structure of the material, while the latter assumes that the JT effect (e.g. the local distortion of the MnO6 octahedra) is related to the electron-phonon (el-ph) interaction and depends also on the atomic structure (i.e. the unit cell). In this letter, we show that the el-ph coupling in manganites is very weak, similar to other transition metal oxides. In contrast, the el-el (i.e. the lattice) coupling in manganites is very strong and increases with volume. As a result, the strain coupling is a much more important effect than the el-ph coupling in manganites. Therefore, the double-exchange plus JT effect cannot be the sole origin of colossal magnetoresistance in these materials.

We present optical BVI imaging and HI synthesis observations of the dwarf irregular galaxy ESO 364-G 029, which reveal a nearly face-on barred system with a well-defined bar and a half-symmetrically placed inner ring structure. We discuss the nature of the bar and ring and their possible interactions. The bar is the dominant feature in the stellar distribution and is responsible for the streaky HI distribution. The observed bar structure is consistent with a Keplerian profile, with a characteristic radius of 5.6 kpc and a mass of 4.4 kpc gas mass. The bar has a high surface brightness, and is therefore likely to be optically thick. We estimate the bar to be more than one thousand million years old. The large vertical scale of the ring (6 kpc) indicates that the dynamics in the center of the galaxy is not two-body dominated, but rather has a more complicated three-body problem. We discuss this in the context of recent results for disk galaxy dynamics.

The possibility of employing phase-stabilized femtosecond frequency combs to make precise measurements of atomic helium transitions is examined. The comb's self-calibrating nature, as well as its capability to be shifted into the ultraviolet spectral range, can provide improved accuracy for such measurements. Atoms must first be cooled and trapped in a specific state of metastability; this can be done in part by using a magneto-optical trap. We consider scenarios by which two-photon excitation could be used to measure the two-photon $2^3S \to 4^3S$ interval, and for resonant two-photon excitation to high Rydberg states, $2^3S \to 3^3P \to n^3S,D$, as well as single-state spectrum measures. A particularly significant case we foresee is measuring the $1^1S \to 2^1S$ transition with great accuracy through two-photon excitation in a ‘magic wavelength trap’ wherein both states are treated identically. A ‘triple magic wavelength’ of 412 nm, where the polarizabilities of 1^1S, 2^1S and 2^3S states prove to be small and positive, could pave the way for many experiments using trapped helium atoms.

The modern portrayals of Vikings in TV shows like "Vikings" and "The Last Kingdom" often have a "tribal" appearance with big beards, face markings or tattoos, and sometimes eyeshadow. While these physical features may seem to accurately depict the Vikings of that time period, there is actually no reliable evidence to support it. The truth is, very little is known about how the Vikings actually looked since the majority of visual evidence of them that we have today comes from artwork or from manuscripts from the Middle Ages.

What we do know is that the Vikings were master shipbuilders and had an excellent understanding of seamanship, so clothes, shoes and accessories such as jewelry were an important part of their culture. Men wore tunics, cloaks, and trousers, while women preferred heavy dresses, long scarves and belts. In terms of facial hair, it is hard to tell whether Vikings had long beards or kept them trimmed. They may have used hair-dyes to change their hair colour and many chose to shave their heads or decorate them with braids. 

The clothing of the Vikings also varied depending on where they lived. Reindeer fur was used in Scandinavia while the use of wool became popular in the British Isles. Animal fur and skins also played a big role in their attire, as water-resistant coats, hats and more durable pieces of clothing. Some Vikings may have applied tattoos, although there is no clear evidence that they universally did so. 

In conclusion, it can be difficult to accurately state what the Vikings looked like. While modern TV shows have depicted them in a certain way, there is still much that remains unknown. Unfortunately, recorded images from that time period are lacking and we must rely on archaeological evidence or artwork from the Middle Ages to make inferences about the appearance of the Vikings.

The ab initio statistical mechanical theory prediction for the helix-coil phase transition temperature of a polyalanine chain with 21 residues is 295.15 K. This paper examines the accuracy of this prediction by comparing the theory with experiments on an equivalent chain with 23 residues. The result is that the prediction is within 1.5 K of the experimental value of 295.65 K, with an estimated standard deviation of 1.22 K. Therefore, the theory is in excellent agreement with experiment. The 21-mer was chosen because it is long enough to show multiple chain structural features, yet short enough that the phase transition can be studied with approximate ab initio methods. The 23-mer was chosen as an example of a longer polyalanine chain for which the same comparison can be made. This suggests that the theory can be used to predict the helix-coil phase transition temperature of arbitrary polypeptide chains.
