Изследването продължава и сега очакваме от полската комисия да потвърди и да идентифицира виновника за тази трагедия. Ние в Petel.bg постоянно ще ви донесем най-новите новини и развитие в тази задаваща въпроси история.

Appealing a summary judgment can be a daunting and expensive task. It is important to understand what is required to appeal a summary judgment, to ensure that any motions are filed in a timely manner and in the right court. 

The first step in appealing a summary judgment is to understand the requirements that must be met. In order to appeal a summary judgment, your appeal must be based on a legal question of the judge's ruling. That means the focus of your appeal should be to argue that the judge made a mistake of some kind. Generally, you must show that the judge lacked jurisdiction, (or authority) to issue the ruling, the judge applied an incorrect law or misapplied the law, or the judge made an error of fact or procedure. 

The next step is to read the judge’s ruling. This is important in order to understand the basis of the ruling and be sure that it is indeed an appealable offense. You will need to search the ruling for any exceptions that could make the ruling appealable. If exceptions are found, then research the laws to support your argument that the judge made a legal error. 

The evidence is an essential element of the appeal. In order to appeal a summary judgment, there must be some evidence that goes beyond or contradicts the statement of facts given in the judge’s ruling. It is important to review all the evidence that was provided in the case to decide if there is a legal error that would justify an appeal. 

It is also important to consider the costs associated with an appeal as they can be quite steep. If you are considering an appeal, make sure you are clear on the cost and the length of time before a ruling is rendered. 

Once you have determined that an appeal is warranted, find the deadline to file your appeal. This will depend on the jurisdiction of the court, the costs associated with an appeal, and other factors. Make sure you know the deadline in order to file your appeal in a timely manner. 

To begin the appeal, you will need to find an applicable form that is used for summary judgment cases. Fill out the form with the details of the Summary Judgment Order, the court from which the order is being appealed, and your personal information. 

The next step is to draft a Notice of Appeal. This document is sent to the court and sets out the basis of your appeal, your reasoning for why you are appealing, any evidence, and costs associated with the appeal. 

Then, file the Notice of Appeal with the court clerk and serve the Notice on the other party. You must provide them with a copy of the Notice and all supporting paperwork that goes with it. 

Then, file a docketing statement with the court. This statement will list all the cases and documents that are being appealed. 

Look over the briefing schedule, as well. The briefing schedule is a list of deadlines for the briefs that will be exchanged throughout the appeal process. 

You should also read the appellate rules and find an appellate practice manual, such as one published by the American Bar Association. These will give you a better understanding of the appellate process as well as the rules that will govern the case. 

The next step is to order transcripts. You must order transcripts of any hearings or trials that were conducted before the Summary Judgment Order was issued. You may also need to order the record on appeal, which is a record of the case filed with the court. 

When the transcripts come in, you can then file them with the appellate court. Once you have done that, send the record to the appellate court in order for them to review it. 

It is also important to reread your motion in opposition to the summary judgment. This will help to refresh your memory and to make sure that any arguments you may have overlooked are addressed in the appeal brief. 

You should also perform legal research and photocopy cases that support your arguments. This will help to build the strength of your argument. In addition, it is important to learn the citation format for citing cases, as this will help prove the strength of your argument. 

Once you have the research together, it is important to craft the issue presented in your brief. This should briefly explain the legal question raised in the appeal. You should then draft a statement of facts that outlines the facts of the case and how they relate to the question at hand. 

Explain the standard of review that will be used by the court to review the case. This should include the applicable guiding standards, such as federal or state statute. After that, you should draft your argument, which should present the evidence and law that supports your position. After your argument, you should write a short conclusion that sums up what you have argued. 

At the end of the brief, you should append a certificate of compliance. This is a document that certifies that the brief follows all court rules to the letter. Once you have completed the brief and complied with all the court rules, you can then proceed to file the appellate brief. 

Once you have filed the brief, the other party will respond with their own brief. Read the response and decide if there is anything that needs to be addressed. If there is, you may wish to draft a possible reply. You can then ask for argument if you would like to participate in oral argument before the appellate court. 

If you do wish to participate in oral argument, then prepare for it. Consider the questions that the court may ask as well as arguments that the other party may provide. Then, watch the oral argument and be prepared to argue your appeal if necessary. 

Once the argument is complete, the court will issue an opinion as to why they are upholding or reversing the order. Read the opinion to understand the court’s reasoning and be prepared to take the necessary steps to comply with their order. If the court upheld the order, you can consider another appeal or settle the case.

A fundamental measure functional for the fluid of aligned hard hexagons is presented. This functional is based on a close approximate of the hard hexagon particle shape that allows for an analytical treatment and the resulting expression is a functional of the weighted density, a functional which has not been considered before in theories of the hard hexagon fluid. A systematic gradient expansion of the free energy leads to a direct correlation function and a simple Padé approximant for the functional. The resulting fluid exhibits square order at high densities, as found in computer simulations and as observed experimentally for real hard hexagons. At low densities, however, we predict a phase transition to a hexatic phase. Further, we predict a reentrant nematic phase which has not been observed in computer simulations. Our functional forms a solid angle subtended by neighboring particles as a critical independent variable for the first order phase transitions. We discuss the connection of our findings to recent computer simulations of the hard hexagon fluid and propose that some computer simulations have found an incorrect transition to the solid phase.

Phillip Porras (born February 3, 1963) is an American architect, designer, engineer, inventor, and entrepreneur, who is the co-founder and chief architect of the firm Porras + Partners Architects, based in Seattle, Washington. Porras was born in Auburn, Washington in 1963, and attended Auburn High School. He studied architecture at the University of Washington, where he received a Bachelor of Arts in 1985, and a Master of Architecture in 1989. After a brief stint at NBBJ, Porras worked at IBI/Pcheng in San Francisco from 1989 to 1992, where he met his future business partner, David Odum. In 1992, Porras and Odum founded Porras + Odum Architects, which would later become Porras + Partners Architects. Porras's work has been featured in a number of publications, including The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, The Seattle Times, Metropolitan Home, Sunset, and Architectural Record. In 2004, Porras was named one of "40 Under 40" by The Business Journal of San Francisco. Porras has served as a design critic at the University of Washington, the University of Oregon, and the California College of the Arts. He has also served as a guest lecturer at the Stanford Graduate School of Business and the University of California, Berkeley. In 2012, Porras was a recipient of the "Pioneers in Design" award from the University of Washington. In 2015, he received the "Alumni Achievement Award" from the University of Washington. In 2016, Porras was named one of the "Most Influential People in Seattle Architecture" by the Seattle Times.

В один день я зашел в салон читателя доктора Шпитальникова и там столкнулся с женой Глаголина - актрисой. Она процитировала мне обычные глупые слова Луначарского про интеллигента и я не смог сдержать свои слова, высказав свое неудовольствие. Но он оказался на ошибочном пути - она была беспорядочной и весь текст обсуждения был довольно нелепым. В конце она сказала, что Луначарский виновен только в том, что попал в слабость к женщинам. Я решил ответить, но удержался и понял, что это было единственное умное, что я сделал за этот день.

Я всегда чувствую огромную ответственность, когда я встречаюсь с другой средой - народом, дикими животными и природой. Когда вы находитесь в этой среде, вы создаете о себе легенду, потому что все вокруг вас очень внимательно наблюдают. Это не салон, где замечают только самые интересные вещи, здесь все замечают ваши истинные действия. Конечно, ваше добро останется здесь навсегда, а ваше зло никто не забудет.

В философии Руссо и Толстого я нахожу только одно - чувство ответственности за свои поступки в отношении народа, дикой природы и других окружающих сред. Из философии остается только это - огромная ответственность, которая была посеяна в русском народе нашими писателями-народниками. Это благоговение к книге и к писателю - сокровенное чувство в русском народе.

The question of whether living standards improved or declined under Roman rule is one that has been debated by historians for centuries. On the one hand, the Romans brought a number of benefits to their conquered territories, such as improved infrastructure, better administration and governance, and access to a wider range of goods and services. On the other hand, the cost of Roman rule was often high, with taxes and other levies being imposed on the population, and the imposition of Roman law and culture on local traditions. Ultimately, the answer to this question will depend on the specific context and time period in question, as well as the perspective of the person making the assessment. In some cases, Roman rule may have improved living standards, while in others it may have had a negative impact. It is important to note that the experience of individuals under Roman rule varied greatly depending on their social and economic status, as well as their location within the empire. For example, those who were part of the ruling class or who lived in urban areas may have benefited from the presence of Rome, while those who were subject to heavy taxation or who lived in rural areas may have had a different experience. Ultimately, it is important to recognize that the impact of Roman rule on living standards was complex and multifaceted, and it is not possible to make a general statement about whether living standards improved or declined under Roman rule.

Douglas Richard "Rocky" Rock (born September 16, 1966) is the current mayor of Santa Clara, California and former member of the Santa Clara City Council from District 1 since 2006.  He was elected to his first term in November 2005 after defeating incumbent councilmember David Stout by more than 2-to-1 margin.
Rock's political career began when he ran unsuccessfully as a Democratic candidate against Republican Mayor Bob McDonnell on behalf of the San Jose Mercury News during the 2002 election cycle.   In 2004, he won a seat representing District 4 on the Santa Clara City Council.    During that time period, he served two terms as Vice President of the Santa Clara County Democratic Party before being appointed interim president following the resignation of longtime party leader Jim Hickey.     After serving one year as interim president,  he resigned  to run unopposed for re-election to another four-year term on the city council in 2006 where he has been reelected twice without opposition.

Allergies can be a real hassle, affecting everything from your daily activities to your overall quality of life. Some allergies can be severe and can even lead to anaphylactic shock, a life-threatening condition. Whether you are dealing with mild or severe allergies, there are a number of ways you can treat and manage your symptoms. In this article, we'll cover everything from recognizing anaphylactic shock to preventing the buildup of allergens in your home.

Part 1: Recognizing Anaphylactic Shock
Anaphylactic shock is a severe allergic reaction that may happen suddenly and can be life-threatening. Symptoms include difficulty breathing, swelling of the tongue or throat, and a rapid heartbeat. If you think you or someone near you is experiencing anaphylactic shock, call emergency services immediately. 

If you carry an epinephrine injector, use it immediately. This will provide temporary relief from symptoms until you can get medical attention.

Even if you have injected yourself with epinephrine, it is important to still go to the doctor to receive further treatment and monitoring.

Part 2: Identifying Common Allergens
Identifying common allergens is essential in the prevention and management of allergies. Common food allergens include peanuts, tree nuts, shellfish, and soy. Other allergens can include pollen, pet dander, and molds. 

Make an allergy appointment with your doctor to have an allergy test conducted. This test will determine exactly what allergens you are allergic to. Knowing the allergens will allow you to make lifestyle changes and take necessary precautions.

Part 3: Treating Allergies
There are a number of ways to treat allergies, including natural remedies and medication.

Try natural remedies such as drinking tea made from nettles or ginger. These herbs have anti-inflammatory properties and may help reduce the symptoms of allergies.

Oral antihistamines are the most common medication used to get relief from common symptoms like runny nose, hives or itching. If you have itchy, red, or swollen eyes an antihistamine eye drop could help soothe those symptoms.

If you have nasal congestion, try an antihistamine nasal spray. Mast cell stabilizers are another alternative to antihistamines and nasal sprays.

In cases when nasal and sinus congestion seems to be the most problematic, oral decongestants and nasal corticosteroids may help relieve the symptoms. Nasal decongestant sprays and drops provide immediate relief but should only be used for a short period.

Where allergies are severe, oral corticosteroids and leukotriene receptor antagonists may be prescribed. Desensitization therapy is another option and can be quite effective for severe allergies.

Part 4: Preventing Allergies
Prevention is the best approach when it comes to allergies. Reduce the buildup of allergens in your home by regularly cleaning, vacuuming, and washing bedding. 

Mold can be a significant trigger, so it is important to take steps to prevent its growth. This can be done by keeping your home's humidity level between 30 and 50 percent and removing any sources of chronic moisture.

Foodborne allergen sources such as nuts can cause severe hypersensitivity reactions. Avoid eating anything you are allergic to, even in small amounts.

If you have a bee or wasp nest near, in, or on your house, hire a professional to remove it. This will significantly decrease your chances of being stung.

Conclusion
In summary, allergies can be a real pain but there are many treatment options available. Knowing your allergens and taking steps to reduce exposure is your best bet. With the right approach, you'll be able to manage your allergies and live a happy and healthy life.

Jakarta, CNN Indonesia -- Piala Dunia 2018 telah memasuki babak grup terakhir pada Senin ini. Salah satu pertandingan yang paling ditunggu-tunggu adalah antara Rusia melawan Uruguay. Pertandingan ini digelar di Stadion Samara, Senin malam ini, 25 Juni 2018 pukul 21.00 waktu Moskow atau 01.00 WIB. Banyak spekulasi muncul sebelum pertandingan dimulai. Meski Rusia memiliki performa yang apik di babak penyisihan grup, dengan menang besar atas Arab Saudi dan Mesir, namun Uruguay juga tak kalah tangguh. Tim ini berhasil mengalahkan Arab Saudi dan Mesir dengan skor tipis 1-0. Pelatih Rusia, Stanislav Cherchesov, menyatakan persiapan timnya sudah maksimal dan menegaskan pentingnya pertandingan ini bagi kedua tim. "Ini adalah pertandingan terakhir di babak grup. Kami akan memberikan semua yang kami punya untuk meraih hasil yang maksimal," ujar Cherchesov. Sementara itu, pelatih Uruguay, Oscar Tabarez, juga mengaku siap menghadapi tantangan dari Rusia. Ia memuji performa tim lawan dan menyebut pertandingan ini sebagai ujian yang sulit bagi Uruguay. "Rusia adalah tim yang sangat tangguh, mereka bermain bagus. Kami tahu sulitnya pertandingan dan kami harus siap sebaik-baiknya," ungkap Tabarez. Para pemain Rusia, seperti Artem Dzyuba, Aleksandr Golovin, dan Denis Cheryshev, juga diharapkan tampil maksimal di depan pendukungnya sendiri. Sementara, dipihak Uruguay, Luis Suarez akan menjadi pemain kunci bagi timnya. Pertandingan Rusia melawan Uruguay ini diprediksi bakal berlangsung sengit. Kedua tim sama-sama membutuhkan kemenangan untuk memastikan diri lolos ke babak selanjutnya. Hasil dari pertandingan ini akan mempengaruhi kelanjutan turnamen buat kedua tim. Selain pertandingan Rusia melawan Uruguay, masih ada pertandingan lainnya yang juga akan digelar pada Senin ini. Yakni pertandingan antara Arab Saudi melawan Mesir. Pertandingan ini digelar di Stadion Volgograd, pada pukul 17.00 waktu Moskow atau 21.00 WIB. Meski kedua tim tak memiliki peluang lolos ke babak selanjutnya, pertandingan ini tetap diharapkan dapat menjadi ajang pemanasan bagi kedua tim. Kedua tim sama-sama ingin menunjukkan performa terbaik mereka demi mengakhiri turnamen dengan cara yang terhormat. Bagi para penggemar sepakbola di Indonesia, jangan sampai melewatkan pertandingan Rusia melawan Uruguay. Pertandingan ini bakal disiarkan secara langsung oleh beberapa stasiun televisi di Indonesia. We present new results on the X-ray spectrum and variability properties of Mrk 509, one of the brightest Seyfert galaxies observed by XMM-Newton. We find that its 0.5-10 keV continuum is well described by an absorbed power law with Γ = 2.1 ± 0.2 (χ2/dof=111/101) plus a reflection component modeled as a PEXRAV model with R=0.7-1.0 and NH=10-23×1022 cm-2. The best-fit parameters are consistent within errors to those found previously using Chandra data alone. No significant spectral changes were detected between different epochs separated by several months apart. However, we do detect strong flux variations at all energies during our observation period. In particular, there was a factor of 3 increase in the hard band count rate over about 20 ks followed by a slower decay back towards the initial level. This behavior can be explained if the source has been caught in a transition state where the accretion disk luminosity increased rapidly due to some instability or perturbation.

Challa Vamshi Chand Reddy (born 4 April 1965) is a retired Indian professional wrestler and actor who primarily worked in Telugu-language films. He has also worked in a few Tamil, Hindi, and Kannada language films. He was the first Indian to win the World Cup Wrestling Championship in London in 1988. He is a recipient of the prestigious Arjuna Award, the second highest civilian award in India, for his achievements in the field of wrestling. After retiring from wrestling, Reddy began working as a fitness trainer and also worked in the Indian film industry as an actor and producer. He has acted in over 125 feature films in several languages. ## Early life and education Challa Vamshi Chand Reddy was born on 4 April 1965 in bubblempam, Chittoor, Andhra Pradesh, India, to a Telugu-speaking family. His father, Chandrasekhar Reddy, was a forest ranger and his mother, Lakshmi, was a housewife. He has two sisters and a brother. Reddy was enrolled in the Anglo Indian School in Chennai for his schooling, and then attended the Meenakshi College in the city to pursue a bachelor's degree in commerce. He was a member of the college wrestling team, and also won several accolades in local and national-level competitions. He was subsequently awarded a sports scholarship at the University of Delhi, where he pursued a master's degree in commerce. ## Career ### Wrestling Reddy made his wrestling debut at the junior level in 1985, at the South Indian Wrestling Championship held in Bangalore. He won the title in the 130 kg category. He then won the gold medal at the National Wrestling Championship in Calcutta in 1986, and a silver medal at the Commonwealth Wrestling Championship in Edinburgh the same year. In 1986, he was also awarded the Arjuna Award by the President of India, Giani Zail Singh, making him the first sportsperson from Andhra Pradesh to receive the honour. In 1987, he won the gold medal at the World Wrestling Championships held in Los Angeles. The same year, he won the gold medal at the Asian Wrestling Championships in Bangkok, Thailand. In 1988, he won the gold medal at the World Cup Wrestling Championship in London. He also won the silver medal at the Asian Wrestling Championships in New Delhi that year. Reddy retired from competitive wrestling in 1990, and began working as a coach. In 1992, he was appointed the coach of the Indian wrestling team at the Barcelona Summer Olympics. ### Film industry Reddy made his film debut in 1991, with a supporting role in the Tamil film, Nanbargal, which was followed by a lead role in the Telugu film, Peddarikam. He then appeared in a series of low-budget Telugu films, including the drama, Evandi Avide Evananta (1992) and the action film, Kadana (1994). He made a comeback in the 2002 drama film, Mitr (2002), after a five-year break, and then appeared in the multilingual film, Three Monkeys (2002). In 2003, he starred in the telugu movie, Ottesi Cheputunna, which won the National Film Award for Best Feature Film in Telugu. In 2008, he appeared in the live-action adaptation of the Disney animated film, Wall-e, where he played the role of Captain Bhawohick. ## Personal life Reddy married Jayalakshmi in 1989, with whom he has two sons. ## Awards ### Sports * Arjuna Award * National Wrestling Championship gold medal – 1986 * World Wrestling Championship gold medal – 1987 * Commonwealth Wrestling Championship silver medal – 1986 * Asian Wrestling Championship gold medal – 1987 * World Cup Wrestling Championship gold medal – 1988 * Asian Wrestling Championship silver medal – 1988 ### Film * National Film Award for Best Feature Film in Telugu – Ottesi Cheputunna (2003) * Nandi Award for Best Supporting Actor – Nuvve Nuvve (2001) ## Filmography | Year | Notes | Film | Language | Role | | --

Ronald "Ron" Gardenhire (born October 24, 1957) is an American former professional baseball infielder and manager. He is currently employed as the third base coach for the Cleveland Indians of Major League Baseball (MLB). Gardenhire was born in Butzbach, Germany, while his father was stationed there during his service in the United States Air Force. He grew up in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma and attended college at the University of Arizona. Gardenhire was selected by the New York Mets in the 5th round of the 1979 amateur draft, and he played for the Mets for three minor league seasons. Gardenhire's big league career spanned 8 seasons, from 1981 to 1988. He played primarily shortstop and second base, but saw action at third base, center field and right field as well. He finished his career with a .233 batting average, 12 home runs and 127 RBIs. Gardenhire began his coaching career with the Mets as a minor league infield instructor in 1990. He returned to the big leagues in 1996 as the Mets' third base coach and was promoted to bench coach in 1997. After being let go by the Mets after the 2002 season, Gardenhire joined the Minnesota Twins organization, where he served as bench coach for one season before being promoted to manager in 2002. In his 13-year managerial career with Twins, Gardenhire led the team to six-division titles and finished with a record of 1,068-1,039. In 2010, he was named the Sporting News American League Manager of the Year. After managing the Twins from 2002 until 2014, Gardenhire joined the Tigers organization in 2015 as the bench coach, and then became the manager in 2018. In 2019, Gardenhire returned to the coaching staff of the Cleveland Indians as the third base coach. He is currently in his first season with the Indians. Throughout his managerial career, Gardenhire has been known as an old-school leader who has commanded the respect of his players. He is often referred to by his nickname, "Gardy".

We report on an exceptional flare detected by Swift/XRT at t ~ 1 day post-burst, which lasted for more than 100 ks (~20 hr). The flare was followed up with observations performed with XMM-Newton/EPIC-pn between 2.5 days to 3 months post-burst. We find that this flare is best described as a superposition of two components: one component lasting about 50 ks peaking around 10^-3 s and another component lasting about 70 ks peaking around 5 x 10^4 s. Both components are well fitted by exponentially cut-off power-laws with photon indices Γ = -1.6 ± 0.1 and -2.2 ± 0.3 respectively. No significant spectral evolution during either of these flares has been found. This flare is among the most energetic ever seen in any gamma-ray burst.

Exams can be the source of a lot of stress for students. Even though they may cause anxiety, you can do well in them if you follow certain steps and strategies. The key is being prepared and organized before you ever step foot in the exam room.

Before the actual exam, make sure that you pay attention in class. Paying attention in class can give you an advantage in the exam because it helps you remember terms and concepts that you may not know or remember if you just study without paying any attention. In addition, taking good notes is essential. This way, when you are studying for the exam, you can refer back to the different notes that you have taken about the material and it can help you remember better.

Another important step to prepare for an exam is to study smart, not hard. Spend a few minutes each day to read over the material that you need to remember for the exam. Try to make sense of it, and imagine that you are connecting the different ideas together. If you have the time, take half an hour each day to focus on one particular topic. Try to use simple language and explain each fact in terms of all the different relationships that it has with other facts. This can help your understanding of the material deeper and more coherent. 

It's also important to take breaks after studying. Studying can cause your brain to fatigue, and taking breaks can help you make the most effective use of your temporal memory. You can also try reading out loud the concepts that you have just learned. This can help you remember better and test the level of your comprehension. Additionally, taking practice tests can also help. It's different than just reading the material because it puts the knowledge to the test and helps you understand which areas you are stronger or weaker in.

If you really want to do well in your exam, it's important to take good care of yourself. Try to get a good night's sleep before the exam and eat foods that can help fuel your brain. It's also very important to avoid last-minute cramming right before the exam. The information that you studied before will be more useful for you. Also, it's key to not let yourself get stressed out because this can impair your ability to remember the information.

Try to stay positive throughout the entire process. Don't listen to people who tell you that you will not do well in the exam. Believing in yourself and remaining confident can help make a difference in the end. Also, make sure to answer all the questions even if you don't know some of them. When doing multiple-choice questions, make sure that you cross out some of the answers that don't make sense or are unlikely to be the correct one.

After you finish the exam, try not to talk about it with anyone. Take a break and focus on something else. It's also important to stay calm and believe that you did your best and that your results will be great. After you receive your papers, make sure you read the questions that you got wrong and try to learn from your mistakes. This will help you do better on any future exams that may come your way.

Arybbas (griechisch Ἀρύββας) war ein König von Epirus aus der Dynastie der Aiakiden. Er war der Vater der Olympias und somit der Schwiegervater sowie Vater von Alexander dem Großen. Als sein Vater Alketas II. 385 v. Chr. gestorben war, wurde dieser vom Volk gewählte Arybbas der neue König von Epirus. Arybbas wurde bald von den Molossern attackiert und gestürzt. Etwa zwischen 376 und 372 v. Chr. gelang es ihm, zurückzukehren und seine Herrschaft wiederherzustellen. 371 v. Chr. griff er Korkyra (Korfu) an und belagerte die Hauptstadt, wurde jedoch durch das Auftauchen einer makedonischen Flotte gezwungen, sich zurückzuziehen. 

Im Jahre 359 v. Chr. heiratete seine Tochter Olympias den makedonischen König Philipp II. von Makedonien und gebar 356 v. Chr. in Pella Alexandros Philippou, besser bekannt als Alexander der Große. Die beiden Männer arbeiteten in verschiedenen Perioden in Kombination, und der Makedonische König rettete Arybbas vor dem siegreichen Angriff des illyrischen Königs Bardylis. 

Es gibt Hinweise darauf, dass es viele Kämpfe zwischen den Einwohnern Epirus und einigen Bergstämmen (Wagen, Molossern und Chaones) während der Herrschaft von Arybbas gab. Einige Autoren behaupten jedoch, dass Arybbas ein guter König war und in Frieden herrschte. Ausgrabungen bestätigen auch dieses Bild des Friedens und des Wohlstandes. Einige Archäologen glauben jedoch, dass es viele Schlachten unter seiner Regierung gab, und das Land wurde durch seine Bemühungen geschwächt.

Навършват се 138 години от обявяването на София за столица на България. През 1879 г. жителите на селото София са били настроени за градски живот, а на 17 май, в Поисква беше издадена декретната им предизвикваща преобразуването на жителите и края им в градска администрация.

Това беше поетът и държавникът Петър Багрянорджиев, който им я даде. Той беше известен с подобрената им инфраструктура, много закони и реформи и бил изпълнител на най-добрите интереси на народа. Неговата активна роля за Поисква имаше значение за историята и бъдещето на България.

Въвеждането на декретът им предизвика внесе на много изменения в държавния живот. Жителите на София бяха внесени в централно и локално управление, за да постигнат по-добра подкрепа от държавата. Тя стана главната администрация и местопребывание на много закони и политики, а именно учреждението на университета, болници, школи и други учреждения за образование и здраве.

Вече 138 години през промените в структурата на София вършат целенасочена работа за да се поддържа плодородието и социалното приложение на столицата, като се вземат предвид много характеристики. За да достигнат своите цели, град София постоянно развива инфраструктура и услуги, бързо актуализиране на технологии и комуникации, а също така се внимава за човешките права и приходите на различни корпоративни структури.

Обявяването на София за столица на България представлява историческа връзка на българския народ и местата, от които сме се разраствали и се развиваме. Освен това, тя представлява и актуализация на продължаващите се заслуги на техните основатели имайки предвид много проекти, за които поетът-държавникът Петър Багрянорджиев бе водещ, за интеграцията и преобразованието на България, като столица с най-добро отразяване на културата и характера на българския народ.

We present the first comprehensive study of visible spectroscopy for all known Jupiter trojans (JTs). We obtained high-resolution spectra with Subaru/HDS, Gemini/GNIRS, and Keck/NIRC-2 in order to determine their surface compositions. The sample includes 49 JTs including two new discoveries by our team. Our analysis shows that most JTs are S-complex asteroids or C-type asteroids. However, we found four objects which show unusual spectral features; one is an E-type asteroid, while three others have featureless red-sloped continuum. These objects may be primitive bodies such as carbonaceous chondrites. In addition, we find that some JTs belong to dynamically cold families. This suggests that these families were formed recently through catastrophic collisions among parent bodies. Finally, we discuss possible formation scenarios for JTs based on our findings. Keywords: Asteroids

Well, little one, back in the olden days things were different than they are now. When somebody's spouse passed away, it was seen as a really big deal and people would go into "mourning." This meant wearing only black clothes and not doing anything fun or social for a while to show that you were sad about the person who died. Queen Victoria was especially sad when her husband Prince Albert died, so she went into mourning for a really long time - 11 whole years! She even stopped doing her queenly duties and just stayed home a lot.

Some people might say that this was extreme, but it was actually pretty normal for the time. Lots of women, especially those who were rich and powerful like the Queen, would go into deep mourning for a while after their husbands died. It was a way to show respect for the person who died and to show everyone how much you loved them. Plus, in those days people didn't have TVs or social media to distract them from their sadness, so it was easier to just shut yourself away for a while.

So while Queen Victoria's behavior might seem strange to us now, back then it was just how things were done. Nowadays people don't usually go into mourning for that long, but it's still important to show respect and love for the people in our lives who have passed away.

Becoming an attorney in California can be a challenging but ultimately rewarding endeavor that requires many steps to follow, including:

1. Creating a Law School Admission Council (LSAC) account. To pursue a career as an attorney in California, the first step is to create an LSAC account. The LSAC account connects you to the law schools you are applying to, which then allows you to access all the services you need throughout the application process.

2. Registering for the Law School Admissions Test (LSAT). The LSAT is the main entrance exam for those aspiring to become lawyers. To properly prepare for this test, LSAC provides students with various LSAT prep options such as taking a prep course or self-studying with official LSAT exams.

3. Preparing for the LSAT. Once you’ve registered for the LSAT, you’ll want to give yourself the best possible chance of achieving a high score. LSAC provides you with various study materials, such as tutorials, to help you prepare. Additionally, you can also consider hiring a tutor or joining study groups.

4. Applying to accredited law schools. Once you've done your LSAT prep and registered for the test, you can begin your research on accredited law schools in California and start your anonymous application process. Keep in mind that most law schools in California accept applications on a rolling basis, with admission decisions made within four to six weeks after submission.

5. Devoting yourself to your legal education. Once you've gained acceptance to a law school, your hard work doesn't stop. You'll be expected to excel in your courses and graduate with honors, while simultaneously participating in extracurricular activities such as law review and mock trial. 

6. Completing your first-year courses. The first year of law school will be all about understanding legal terminology and the foundational principles of law. For this reason, you'll need to make sure that your courses are taught by experienced faculty who are invested in providing you with a successful start to your legal education.  

7. Taking part in extracurricular activities. Participating in extracurricular activities is key to becoming a successful attorney. Such activities will give you insight into the profession and may even help you make connections with legal professionals. 

8. Completing second and third year courses. The second and third year of law school will focus heavily on understanding appellate court decisions, polishing your writing skills, and extensively studying various areas of law. 

9. Working during summer breaks. After your second year of law school, you should take advantage of the summer break to gain practical legal experience. This could be in the form of a paid summer clerkship or an unpaid internship, but in either case, make sure these opportunities align with your post-law school aspirations 

10. Graduating with a Juris Doctor (J.D.). Once you've completed your law school studies, you will need to prepare to take your final exams and proudly graduate with a Juris Doctor degree. 

11. Applying to take the California Bar Exam. With your degree in hand, you are now ready to begin the process of applying for the California Bar Exam. This is a two-day exam that includes both a written portion and a performance test. 

12. Studying for the California Bar Exam. After applying, you'll need to put in several hours of hard work to prepare for the California Bar Exam. Study materials are available to help you prepare, and some students even take prep courses.

13. Taking the exam. On the day of the exam, you'll need to check in on time and be ready to take the exam. The exam will be divided into two days, with the written portion taking place on the first day and the performance test on the second. 

14. Passing the examination. Before you become an attorney in California, you must pass the California Bar Exam. This may require studying for the exam for months and attending any available review courses. 

15. Sending in a moral character evaluation. Before you’re able to take the exam, you must also complete a moral character evaluation, which is conducted by the Committee of Bar Examiners. For this evaluation, you'll need to gather letters of recommendation from law professors, attorneys, and other professionals. 

16. Taking the Multistate Professional Responsibility Examination (MPRE). After passing the California Bar Exam, you must take the MPRE, which focuses on legal ethics. Passing the MPRE is a requirement for licencing as an attorney in California. 

17. Complying with family support requirements. Before you receive your license you must demonstrate that you’re financially capable of supporting yourself and any dependents. 

18. Providing your Social Security number. To apply for a license as an attorney in California, you must provide your Social Security number to the California Bar Association. 

19. Looking for a job early. You should start the job search process as soon as possible while also in law school. This way, you can gain experience and find a job as soon as you’re eligible. 

20. Taking part in campus interviews. An important part of your job search will be participate in campus interviews. Campus interviews are an opportunity for employers to meet potential hires, and for you to demonstrate why you have the right skills for the job. 

21. Searching online. Online job portals and professional networking websites can also be beneficial for your job search. Not only can you search for open positions, but you can also learn more about potential employers. 

22. Setting up informational interviews. Even if you’re not looking for a job, it’s a good idea to set up interviews with legal professionals and learn more about the profession. 

23. Attending bar events. Bar events are held regularly and provide attorneys with a great way to make connections, learn more about the profession, and get noticed by potential employers. 

24. Volunteering. Volunteering your legal services is a great way to gain experience as an attorney and make connections in the legal community.

25. Staying up to date with continuing legal education (CLE) requirements. Maintaining your legal education is a critical requirement for all attorneys in California. To stay current, you must fulfill the required hours of courses for continuing legal education (CLE). 

26. Abiding by required ethical standards. An important role of attorneys is to maintain the integrity of the legal profession. As such, you are expected to abide by the code of professional responsibility set forth by the state. 

27. Staying out of legal trouble. It’s important to stay out of any legal trouble that could have a negative impact on your career. It’s essential to represent yourself and your profession honorably in all aspects of your professional and personal life. 

By following these steps, you’ll be well on your way to become an attorney in California. Good luck!

We investigate the redshift and geometrical aspect of photons. We show that the redshift of a photon is given by the angle that the photon's propagation vector forms with the galaxies peculiar velocity. Hence, a photon is redshifted when its propagation is at an angle with the peculiar velocity. We also show that the photons' energy is related to the surface area that the photon's propagation vector sweeps out in the Hubble volume. We derive an expression for the energy of a photon in terms of the surface area that the propagation vector sweeps out. Our results suggest that the energy of a photon is directly proportional to the surface area that it sweeps out. We show that the surface area that a photon sweeps out is related to the square of its wavelength. Our results suggest that the energy of a photon is inversely proportional to its wavelength squared. We discuss the implications of our results for the energy conservation and for the explanation of the observed redshift of photons.

We investigate the possibility of detecting gravitational waves from a chaotic system consisting of a point mass M moving in a planar orbit around a rotating disk. We show that the presence of a quadrupole mode in the gravitational field of the system is guaranteed by the principles of general relativity, provided that the orbit of the point mass is sufficiently close to the equatorial plane of the disk. We evaluate the frequency spectrum of the quadrupole mode and show that it is possible to detect it by laser interferometry. We discuss the problem of extracting the signal from the noise background, due to the chaotic nature of the system, and evaluate the effect of measurement errors on the detectability of the signal. Our analysis shows that it is possible to detect the quadrupole mode from a chaotic system with a relatively small number of detectors, provided that the noise level is sufficiently low. We also evaluate the possibility of using the quadrupole mode as a means of extracting information about the internal structure of the disk.

Altist ist ein musica vokal- oder instrumentalartig, die den höchsten Ton einer Stimme oder eines Musikinstrumentes in einer Komposition anschlägt. 
Oft bezieht sich der Altist auf den Männeralt, auch bekannt als den Bariton. Der einflussreiche Schallplattenproduzent John H. Hammond beschrieb Baritonstimme als "der tiefste Ton im Chor". Der Alt ist auch ein wichtiger Festhändler in vielen Kirchenchöre, insbesondere in der anglikanischen Tradition. Berühmte Altistinnen wie Barbara Strozzi, Farinelli, Alfred Deller, Nina Simone und Annie Lennox haben die Grenzen der Stimmbereiche erobert und die Tiefe des männlichen Alt erweitert. 
Neben der Verwendung in Chören ist der Alt ein wichtiges Horn in Orchestern und spielt eine maßgebliche Rolle in der Blasmusik. Es gibt jedoch auch musikalische Kompositionen, in denen der Alt die einzige Stimme oder ein wichtiger Solopart ist. Beispiele dafür sind das Stück "Infelix Ego" von William Byrd und die Oper "Apollo et Hyacinthus" von Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart.

The self consistent treatment of quantum field theories provide a unique approach to the inter-relation between hadronic physics and QCD. The aim of the present article is to review some selected aspects of such an approach in quantum chromodynamics (QCD). The basic idea is to perform a simultaneous expansion of the theory around a number of well-defined mean fields. Such an approach, which we call self-consistent approach, has proved to be extremely useful in accounting for the main features of hadrons, even though much remains to be done to fully exploit its potential. The review is organized as follows. We start by discussing the phenomenon of spontaneous chiral symmetry breaking and the associated occurrence of light pseudo-Nambu-Goldstone (pNGB) mesons in the spectrum. Next we present a description of the light meson octet in terms of the effective Lagrangian (massless quarks). Subsequently, we move on to discuss the phase structure of QCD and in particular the phenomenon of deconfinement. Finally, we present a discussion of possible scenarios of color superconductivity and of the novel color-flavor locked phase.

Algeria was made an integral part of France unlike other African possessions of France because of the long-term presence of French settlers in Algeria, their close economic ties to France, and the military importance of Algeria to France.

France colonized Algeria in 1830, and Algeria became an integral part of France in 1848. Algeria was unique among France's African colonies in that it had a large population of French settlers, who were known as pieds-noirs ("black feet"). The pieds-noirs were mainly of French and Italian origin, and they had settled in Algeria since the 18th century. They were granted French citizenship in 1848 and they played a significant role in the economy and society of Algeria.

In addition to the pieds-noirs, Algeria was also home to a large number of European settlers from other countries, including Spain, Belgium, and Germany. These settlers were also granted French citizenship in 1848.

The economy of Algeria was closely tied to France. Algeria was a major producer of wheat and wine, and these products were sold to France. In addition, Algeria was a significant market for French goods.

Finally, Algeria was militarily important to France. It was a key base for the French Navy, and it also played a role in the French conquest of Morocco in 1844.

Overall, the long-term presence of French settlers, the close economic ties between France and Algeria, and the military importance of Algeria to France all contributed to the decision to make Algeria an integral part of France, unlike other African possessions of France.

Rivière-des-Chenaux is the largest river in Quebec, Canada and one of its longest rivers at 1,530 km (941 mi). It rises on the northern slopes of Mount Kaaikop near Lac-Simon, northwestern Quebec, flows generally southward through the Canadian Shield to Lake Champlain where it joins the Richelieu River which empties into the St Lawrence Seaway.
The name "Chenal" means "channel or straits" in French; this word was used by Jacques Cartier when he explored the area during his second voyage to New France in 1535-36.  The English translation "river of channels" reflects that meaning as well.   In some places along its length there are narrower sections known locally as "channels"; these include the Grand Canal de Beauharnois between Lakes Saint-Louis and Saint-François, the Petit Chenal du Moine between lakes Memphrémagog and Massawipi, and the Petit Chenal du Nord between lakes Taureau and Ours.

هايبرستين هي مادة كيميائية تستخدم في الصناعات، تأتي بالصيغة الكيميائية C15H15NO2، وهي من الأنواع المضادة للهيستامين، ولاحظ في البداية أن هايبرستين يطلق عليه العديد من الأسماء المختلفة مثل: بنسهيدرين، بندرين، بندكسا هو موسع للشعب الهوائية مستخدم كعلاج للربو الذي يعاني منه ملايين الناس في جميع أنحاء العالم. ويمكن استخدامه لعلاج الأمراض التنفسية الأخرى مثل التهاب الحنجرة والتهاب الجيوب الأنفية والحساسية. تعمل هذه المادة على توسيع الشعب الهوائية الصغيرة في الصدر، مما يساعد على تخفيف الضيق التنفسي وزيادة تدفق الهواء إلى الرئتين. ومن أهم استخدامات الهايبرستين هو علاج الربو الذي ينتج عن التهاب شديد في الجهاز التنفسي، وهو أحد أنواع الحساسية التنفسية التي تؤثر على ملايين الأشخاص حول العالم. تدخل هذه المادة في تركيب العديد من الأدوية المضادة للحساسية المستخدمة في العلاج، ويجب استخدامها تحت إشراف الطبيب المختص. ومن الآثار الجانبية المعروفة لاستخدام هايبرستين بعض الأعراض الخفيفة مثل الصداع والدوخة والغثيان والقيء والتعرق، وتسويق هذه المادة يخضع لقوانين صارمة في العديد من الدول ويتم تضمين تحذيرات حول الآثار الجانبية المحتملة عند استخدامه، وتطابق سلامة استخدامه قواعد الإجراءات الدولية الصارمة التي تهدف إلى ضمان سلامة المستخدمين والبيئة. ويحظر استخدامها على النساء الحوامل والأشخاص الذين يعانون من ارتفاع ضغط الدم أو تضيق الشرايين.

Да се разберем по мъжки!

Отдавна се разбира, че мъжете и жените използват различни подходи за това да се осъществи взаимопонимане. Във всеки брак, преди всичко, трябва да има взаимно понимане. Да се разберем по мъжки би значило, че трябва да се опитате да понимате висшето изискване на мъжкия пол като цяло.

Трябва да понимате, че мъжете винаги са търсили да се почувстват почтени и уважавани, като поддържат усещането за контрол и лидерство. Това не означава, че те искат да отхвърлят или да се отхвърлят от жена. Пък, то означава, че мъжете искат да бъдат взаимопонимани при създаването на равенството, както се очаква да бъдат подкрепени и активно подкрепяни.

Estimation Diversity and Energy Efficiency in Distributed Sensing

This paper considers the problem of estimating a set of parameters from distributed measurements. The parameters may be constant values, linear or nonlinear functions of the measurements, or the solution of a nonlinear system of equations. The paper focuses on the diversity of the estimation method, which is the degree to which the method provides different estimates from different combinations of the measurements. The diversity of an estimation method is important because it determines the resilience of the method to sensor failures, and because it provides a way of combining sensors with different measurement ranges. The paper considers two classes of estimation methods, specifically, the class of estimation methods that use the measurements directly, and the class of methods that first compute a transformation of the measurements and then use the transformed measurements to estimate the parameters. Within each class, the paper develops an algorithm for finding the method that is most resilient to sensor failures, and then uses the algorithm to find the method that has the highest energy efficiency. The paper analyzes the effect that the structure of the parameter set has on the diversity and energy efficiency of the estimation method. In particular, the paper shows that the diversity and energy efficiency achieve their highest values when the parameters are linear or quadratic functions of the measurements.

Working abroad can be a life-changing experience. Whether you are looking to gain international work experience, dive into a different culture, or simply feed your wanderlust, working abroad can fulfill a wide range of goals. However, the process of finding and obtaining a job overseas can be challenging and overwhelming, especially if you are not familiar with the legal requirements and job market of the country you are interested in. In this article, we will provide you with a step-by-step guide on how to work abroad, from choosing a location to obtaining necessary permits and regulations.

1. Choose a location.

The first step to working abroad is selecting a location that meets your personal and professional goals. Whether you are interested in Europe, Asia, or Latin America, there are plenty of opportunities to work abroad in almost every corner of the world. Do some research, talk to people who have worked in that country, and identify the job market, cost of living, and other factors that affect your decision to move.

2. Research and obtain any necessary permits and regulations.

To work abroad in most countries, you will need to obtain a work visa from that country, or a visa that allows certain types of work. Each nation has specific and individual laws regarding foreign workers, so make sure to research these when deciding where you want to work abroad. A good starting point is to check with the country's immigration department to find out what type of visa you will need and how to get it.

3. Decide if you want short-term or long-term work.

Knowing whether or not you want to spend an extended period of time working abroad will help you when seeking a position overseas. Short-term work is typically less than a year and can involve jobs such as teaching English, working on a farm, or volunteer projects. Long-term work can involve a wide range of job opportunities, including corporate positions, development work, or non-profit positions.

4. Figure out if you want to find a job and then move or move first and find a job once you are abroad.

Either option may be viable, depending on your situation and location. If you already have a job offer or secured employment before you arrive in your new country, it can give you a sense of security and peace of mind. On the other hand, if you are interested in exploring different job opportunities and don't have specific employment plans in advance, moving first and then starting the job search once you get there can be an exciting adventure.

5. Learn about the language and culture.

Immersing yourself in the language and culture of a nation abroad is the best way to gain real international experience. Even if you speak the same language, culture shock is a real phenomenon that can be overwhelming. Make an effort to learn the language, explore the local customs, and seek out cultural experiences. Understanding the local language and customs can also be an asset when interviewing for jobs in the country.

6. Develop special skills that will be valued abroad.

If you have skills in a technical area, trade, or high-demand field – such as medicine, engineering, or Teaching English as a Foreign Language (TEFL) – it may be easier to find work abroad. Having a specialized skill set that is in demand can make you more marketable and competitive in the job market.

7. Familiarize yourself with resources for finding jobs abroad.

Many resources exist to help connect job seekers with opportunities abroad. Job search engines, social media platforms, recruitment agencies, and job boards offer plenty of job listings. Websites such as LinkedIn, Glassdoor, Monster and Indeed are just a few online resources that may help in the job search.

8. Seek an overseas position with a company or organization based in your home country.

One of the easiest ways to find work abroad is to shift to an international position in a company or organization that you already work for. If your company has a global presence, explore the possibilities of transferring or applying for international positions.

9. Find a government job.

Many governments offer opportunities to work in foreign affairs, peacekeeping missions, and diplomatic missions. Check with your home country's government and/or the country you are interested in working in to learn more about these opportunities.

10. Work for a nonprofit.

Non-governmental organizations and nonprofits can also provide exciting work opportunities abroad, including positions in international development, education, or healthcare. These organizations can be a great way to make a difference in the world while broadening your horizons.

11. Volunteer abroad.

If you can't find paid employment overseas, you may want to seek volunteer work instead. Many organizations offer volunteer positions for people interested in contributing to their work and supporting their causes. Although these positions may not provide financial compensation, they can offer valuable field experience and help you build your resume.

12. Use a placement service.

Placement services are recruitment agencies that specialize in international job placement. These agencies can assist with the job search process, including visa applications, resume building, and cultural training.

13. Consider other forms of employment.

Teaching English as a Foreign Language, working on a cruise ship, or becoming a digital nomad are a few examples of jobs that can provide an opportunity to travel and live abroad.

14. Discover the resources that are available to you.

Numerous organizations and resources can help you find job opportunities abroad. These include government agencies, private companies, nonprofit organizations, and academic institutions. You can also use social media platforms and job-search engines that cater to international job seekers.

15. Look for special student programs.

If you are a student, you may want to explore special programs designed to help you work abroad. Study-abroad programs, internships, and exchange programs can all be great ways to gain work experience abroad while earning credit towards your degree.

16. Seek an internship abroad.

Internships can provide experience that will be valuable for future employment. By working an internship abroad, you will gain even richer knowledge, expertise, and training.

17. Seek academic credit for work abroad.

Many universities and programs offer credit for experiential learning opportunities such as internships and study-abroad programs. Seek out these opportunities to earn academic credit while gaining valuable international work experience.

Working abroad can be an enriching and life-changing experience. By following these steps and taking advantage of the available resources, you can make the process of working abroad smoother and more satisfying.

Jakarta, CNN Indonesia - Kementerian Perhubungan (Kemenhub) mencanangkan tutupnya Posko Lebaran pada Senin (25/6) hari ini. Posko Lebaran tersebut telah beroperasi selama sepekan penuh sejak 15 Juni lalu. Menurut Menteri Perhubungan, Budi Karya Sumadi, posko tersebut telah membantu mengantisipasi kemacetan di jalur mudik sekaligus memberikan pengetahuan dan informasi kepada masyarakat terkait ketentuan lalu lintas dan transportasi. Budi Karya Sumadi dalam pernyataannya saat menutup posko tersebut, mengatakan bahwa posko ini telah membantu pemerintah dalam mengatur arus mudik Lebaran tahun ini. Hal ini terlihat dari penurunan angka kecelakaan lalu lintas dan kemacetan yang terjadi. Namun di sela-sela itu, Menhub juga menyinggung mengenai tragedi KM Sinar Bangun yang tenggelam pada pekan lalu. Saat menutup Posko Lebaran ini, Menhub menyebut bahwa pihaknya masih terus melakukan pencarian korban tenggelamnya kapal tersebut. Menhub juga mengimbau kepada seluruh masyarakat dan pengguna jasa transportasi agar selalu memperhatikan keselamatan dalam bepergian, khususnya di musim mudik seperti ini. "Kami berharap semuanya bisa terus memperhatikan keselamatan dalam menggunakan transportasi. Mari kita selalu berdoa agar seluruh korban KM Sinar Bangun dapat segera ditemukan," ujar Menhub. KM Sinar Bangun tenggelam pada Senin (18/6) lalu saat melintas di perairan Danau Toba, Sumatera Utara. Kapal tersebut tenggelam dengan membawa 189 orang, namun hingga saat ini masih banyak korban yang belum ditemukan. Tragedi ini menjadi peringatan bagi masyarakat dan pemerintah terkait dengan pentingnya memperhatikan keselamatan dalam menggunakan transportasi, khususnya di musim mudik seperti saat ini. Pemerintah pun telah mengambil langkah-langkah untuk meningkatkan keselamatan transportasi, seperti melakukan inspeksi rutin kapal dan kendaraan, serta mengintensifkan penegakan hukum bagi pelanggar lalu lintas. Dalam momen Lebaran tahun ini, masyarakat dan pengguna jasa transportasi diharapkan lebih memperhatikan keselamatan dan mematuhi semua ketentuan lalu lintas dan transportasi demi menghindari tragedi yang tidak diinginkan.

In this study, we investigate the distribution of molecular absorption in front of the quasar B0218+357. The motivation for our research lies in the importance of understanding the distribution of molecular gas in the universe and its effects on quasar activity. The B0218+357 quasar is of particular interest due to its gravitational lensing effect on background objects, which allows us to study the absorption properties of intervening molecular gas. 

Using data obtained from the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA), we analyze the absorption spectrum of molecular gas in front of the quasar. Our results reveal a complex absorption structure with multiple components, suggesting that the gas is distributed in different regions and possibly associated with different galaxy systems. This finding provides insights into the distribution of molecular gas in the universe and its role in quasar activity.

Moreover, our study attempts to solve a current problem in understanding the properties of intervening gas in the universe. By investigating the distribution of molecular gas in front of the B0218+357 quasar, we contribute to a better understanding of the formation and evolution of galaxies, quasar activity, and the interplay between gas and stars in the universe. Overall, our investigation sheds new light on the distribution of molecular absorption in front of quasars and provides valuable insights into the physics of the universe.

The Dayton Family The Dayton family is an American family of Swiss origin. The family is best known for its connection to the city of Dayton, Ohio, and its prominent role in the history of the city. The family's involvement in the history of Dayton began in the early 19th century with the construction of a trading post on the Great Miami River by Edward Dayton. The trading post was located near the site of present-day downtown Dayton. In 1819, the trading post was converted into a town, which was named Dayton after its founder. The Dayton family played a major role in the development of Dayton as a city. They were involved in the city's early politics, and several members of the family served as mayors of Dayton. The family also contributed to the city's cultural life, and the Dayton Art Institute and the Benjamin and Marian Schuster Performing Arts Center were built with money donated by the family. The Dayton family's influence in Dayton extended beyond the city limits. The family owned large areas of farmland surrounding Dayton, and they were instrumental in the creation of the Miami-Erie Canal, which connected Dayton to the rest of the country. The canal was a major factor in the city's growth and development. The Dayton family has been very influential in the history of the United States. Two members of the family served in the United States Congress, and one member served as the United States Ambassador to Switzerland. The family also played a role in the American Revolution, and several members of the family were active in the anti-slavery movement. The Dayton family continues to be active in Dayton's civic life. Bromsilberdruck war eine Fototechnik, die Jahrzehnte lang vor allem in der Wissenschaft und in der Künstlerfotografie eingesetzt wurde, jedoch ab Ende des 19. Jahrhunderts zunehmend durch modernere Verfahren wie zum Beispiel den Collotypie-Druck oder Offsetdruck abgelöst wurde. Der Grund für ihre Beliebtheit trotz der Nachteile, darunter der Zeitaufwand und die Empfindlichkeit gegenüber Klimaänderungen, lag in der unerreicht hohen Detailgenauigkeit und Klarheit der Bilder. 
Bromsilberdruck steht für ein Verfahren zur Herstellung von Fotografien und Drucken direkt aus Negativvorlagen. In einem komplexen Prozess wurde eine lichtempfindliche Schicht aus Silberbromid aufgebracht, worauf eine Negativvorlage mit dem gewünschten Bild oder Muster aufgelegt wurde. Anschließend wurde das Präparat belichtet, entwickelt und fixiert. Das so entstandene positiv gedruckte Bild ist ein hochwertiger, detailreicher Abzug in seiner eigenen Anmutung. Die Technik gibt es seit Mitte des 19. Jahrhunderts und wurde von Photographischen Vereinen und Laboratorien erstellt. Der im Vergleich zu anderen Druckverfahren höhere Arbeitsaufwand und die geringere Produktion waren Gründe, Bromsilberdrucke auch bis zur Mitte des letzten Jahrhunderts zu einem elitären und damit sowohl repräsentativen als auch für Sammler wertvollen Kunstobjekt zu machen. Durch das Auftreten der Digitalfotografie in den letzten Jahrzehnten jedoch schwand ihre Relevanz, im privaten Bereich ist sie heute kaum noch anzutreffen. In Museen und Sammlungen sind Bromsilberdrucke jedoch auch heute noch zu besichtigen.

In Ancient Rome, individuals were considered adults at the age of 14. Upon reaching 14 years old, boys were regarded as adult citizens and were expected to take on the responsibilities of adulthood. This age has long been seen as the age of maturity given the fact that the average life expectancy in that era was about 25-30 years.

The age at which a person was considered an adult in Ancient Rome was not legally regulated and did not have the same meaning as it does today. Instead, the age of adulthood was determined by the family, social status and class of the individual. Generally speaking, upper-class Roman boys were often considered adults at an even younger age, somewhere around 12. This was due to the fact that elite Roman boys generally received a better, more rigorous education and were capable of taking on adult roles more quickly.

Once an individual was considered an adult, they were expected to take on the duties of adulthood; these duties varied depending on class, but generally included marriage, work, civic responsibility, military service and religious practice. Men, for example, could not get married until they reached the age of 14 and women were typically expected to marry around 12. Men were also expected to take part in military service and public government from a young age and were part of various councils and assemblies from the age of 20. Women were not barred from these roles, but typically their duties centred around offspring, the home and religious worship.

Children who did not reach the age of fourteen could still be considered adults depending on their class. Slaves, for example, typically had no age barriers and although not likely, orphans could also be recognised as adults earlier than other Roman citizens. Ultimately, Ancient Rome had a wide variety of expectations for its citizens depending on their class and even gender.

 
Although the age of adulthood was loosely regulated, Ancient Rome had a set of expectations from its citizens at various ages. Becoming an adult at the age of 14 was considered the norm and apart from slight variation based on class, all Roman individuals were expected to uphold the same duties.

At the time of Johnny Cash’s release of ‘Bitter Tears’ in 1964, there was a larger cultural dialogue occurring in the United States regarding the relationship between Indigenous people and white settlers. The civil rights movement was well underway and many writers, artists, and activists were publicly condemning the way white people had treated the Indigenous people of North America since the earliest days of colonization. These views had been percolating since the early decades of the twentieth century and they had begun to become more widespread and accepted in mainstream and progressive American culture. 

Reactions to ‘Bitter Tears’ were largely positive, especially from progressive and liberal camps. Cash's powerful words, emotionally charged delivery, and ability to connect with listeners made the album a hit and increased its reach beyond just the country music audience. Positive reviews were largely centered around the fact that Cash had made a stand for Indigenous peoples and called out the atrocities that had been done to them. But there were plenty of critics as well, mostly from conservative and religious circles, that called the album inflammatory and too politically charged. 

Regardless of the criticism, ‘Bitter Tears’ put a spotlight on the horrific treatment Native Americans had endured and brought it to a much larger audience than had previously been exposed, showing that these views were no longer just a fringe opinion but something that was becoming increasingly recognized, accepted and talked about on a larger scale.

We present new XMM-Newton observations of the Wolf Rayet binary system WR147, which is one of only two known systems with an O-type companion star and a WN6-7h primary component (the other being WR20a). The data were obtained in December 2004 during revolution number 1253-1255 using all three EPIC cameras on board XMM-Newton. We have analyzed these data to search for periodicities in both light curves as well as line profiles. No significant periodicity was found in either the light curve or line profile analysis. However we find that there are differences between the line profiles observed by Chandra and those seen here. These differences may be due to orbital motion within this highly eccentric system. This work has been supported by NASA grant NAG5-10842. Keywords: Wolf-Rayet stars; binaries; X-rays; XMM-Newton

This paper presents the results of an observation of the L1204 dust cloud using the Onsala 25-m telescope in the 6 cm (1$_{11}-1_{10}$) transition of \htco. We detect the spectral line in absorption against the background Cosmic Microwave Radiation, implying that a wide spread of warm molecular gas is present at mid-level densities. A comparison of the H$_2$CO and CO (1-0) emission reveals that, while the overall distributions are alike, there are considerable discrepancies at the granular level. Particularly, the S140 H${\alpha}$ arc peak is nearly coincident with the CO, however, the H$_2$CO absorption maximum is 10$'$ (approx. 3 pc) away. It is hypothesized that this is due to the fact that \htco\ is easily photodissociated and therefore is a weaker marker of the molecular gas just behind Photon Dominated Regions. Consequently, the CO is more saturated and better suited for highlighting warm gas.

Плашеща статистика! 8 на сто от българите страдат от депресия

Депресията е един от най-разпространените психични заболявания в света. Тя засяга милиони хора и може да има сериозен въздействие върху живота им. Според някои проучвания, депресията е основен фактор, причиняващ много други здравни проблеми като затлъстяване, сърдечни заболявания и дори дехидратация.

Нова статистика обаче разкрива, че депресията не е проблем, който засяга само няколко хора. В България, за съжаление, депресията е станала една от най-разпространените болести, засягащи много хора. Според проучване на Националния център за здравно инфомиране (НЦЗИ), 8% от всички българи страдат от депресия.

Това е толкова висок процент, че е трудно да се представи, какво означава това в реални числа. Ако се вземе за основа, че в България живеят приблизително 7 милиона души, тогава това означава, че около 560 000 българи страдат от депресия.

Това е много голям брой и затова е важно да се започне да се се намира начин да се помогне на тези хора. Много от тези, които страдат от депресия, се чувстват току-що непонятни и изолирани. За тях е важно да разберат, че не са сами, и че има много хора, които имат тежък проблем, като техния.

В България има специални програми и организации, които могат да помогнат на тези, които страдат от депресия. Една от тях е Националната асоциация на депресията, която работи за повишаване на осведомеността за болестта, както и за предоставяне на подкрепа и съдействие на онези, които страдат от депресия.

Националният център за здравно инфомиране предоставя информация за депресията, начините за нейното лечение и как може да се подпомогне процесът на възстановяване. При симптоми на депресия е важно да се потърси съвет от квалифициран специалист, който може да предложи добра оценка и по-нататъшни действия.

Специалистът може да предложи лекарства или терапия, която може да помогне за преодоляване на депресията. Освен това, е важно да има свързаност и подкрепа сред семейството и близките, което е от съществено значение за възстановяването на тези, които страдат от депресия.

Вкратце, депресията е голям проблем и не следва да се пренебрегва. Това е особено вярно в България, където толкова много хора страдат от тази болест. През следващите години в България трябва да се работи за подобряване на осведомеността за депресията и предоставяне на подкрепа на онези, които страдат от нея.

Депресията може да бъде преодоляна, но само ако се действа бързо и ефективно. Потърсете помощ, ако се чувствате заразени от депресия. Важно е да не се чувствате непонятно или изолирани и да знаете, че има хора, които могат да помогнат да се справите с този труден проблем.

Our study investigated the endogenous and exogenous pressure fluctuations in an impinging entrained-flow gasifier (IEFG) to enhance the knowledge of gasification dynamics. The key idea behind the work is to understand the mechanisms that drive fluctuation dynamics within gasifiers, which can help optimize IEFGs' efficiency. 

The experimental methodology employed was based on measuring the pressure fluctuations at different locations within the gasifier, and applying statistical analysis to classify the dynamics of the pressure fluctuations. The results show that both endogenous and exogenous factors can contribute to pressure fluctuations in IEFGs. The endogenous fluctuations resulted from the gasifier internal dynamics, while exogenous fluctuations were influenced by external factors such as disturbances in the feedstock supply.

Furthermore, our results suggest that the fluctuations in the gasifier can lead to operational instability, causing potential damage to the system. Our work aims to provide insights into the dynamics of pressure fluctuations in IEFGs, which can lead to better operational control and stability of the gasification process. Understanding these dynamics has important implications for future industrial scale IEFG operation, where optimization of efficiency and control is of utmost importance.

If you want to save money and time washing your car, using a self service car wash is a great option. With a little bit of preparation and know-how, you can give your car a thorough cleaning without paying a professional detailer. In this article, we'll show you how to use a self service car wash and get your car looking like new.

Part 1: Getting Started
1. Scope out the territory to find one with the car bays and spray nozzles.
Before you head to the car wash, make sure you know where it is and what services it offers. Look online for self service car washes in your area, or drive around to see what's available.

2. Drive into an empty bay centering the car away from walls.
When you arrive at the car wash, find an empty bay to park in. Pull your car into the center of the bay and away from walls to make sure you have enough room to work.

3. Determine the cost of the wash.
Check the price board near the bay to see how much it will cost to wash your car. Most self service car washes offer a variety of wash options, so choose the one that best fits your budget and needs.

4. Locate the change machine in order to get the right amount of quarters or bring your own.
Most self service car washes accept quarters as payment, so make sure you have enough on hand. Look for a change machine near the bays, or bring your own quarters.

Part 2: Washing Your Car
1. Determine which direction the dial points to start.
Each bay will have a dial that you will use to select the type of wash you want. Make sure you know which direction to turn the dial to start.

2. Be ready to move fast.
Once you start the wash cycle, you will only have a limited amount of time to get your car clean. Be prepared to move quickly and efficiently to get the job done.

3. Turn the dial to the pre-soak cycle if the car is heavily caked with dirt; otherwise, put the dial on soap or wash and put the appropriate amount of quarters in the slots.
Start by selecting the pre-soak cycle if your car is especially dirty. Otherwise, choose the soap or wash cycle and insert the appropriate amount of quarters.

4. Point the tip away from you and press whatever looks like a handle or trigger.
Grab the wand and point it away from yourself, then press the trigger to start applying the soap or pre-soak.

5. Quickly walk around the car blasting the first round of dirt off your car.
Move quickly around your car, blasting the dirt and grime off with the high-pressure hose.

6. Rinse off the foamy brush with the high pressure nozzle before you activate the foam brush.
If you plan to use the foam brush to clean your car, make sure you rinse it off first with the high-pressure hose. This will help remove any dirt or debris that may have accumulated on the brush.

7. Turn the dial to the Wash cycle and the suds should start coming out momentarily.
Once you're ready to start washing, turn the dial to the wash cycle and suds should start appearing.

8. Turn the dial to the Rinse position and start rinsing the soap.
When you're finished washing, turn the dial to the rinse position and start rinsing off the soap.

9. Jump to the selection area and turn the dial to wax and do a loop around your car to use up those last few minutes.
If you have time left on the clock, turn the dial to the wax cycle and take a final loop around your car to apply a protective wax coating.

Part 3: Finishing Up
1. Drive out of the bay and go to the area where you can vacuum the inside and throw away trash that has been accumulating in the seats.
Once you've finished washing your car, drive out of the bay and park in the designated area for vacuuming and trash disposal.

2. Use the vacuum to clean the inside of your car.
Grab the vacuum and clean the floors, seats, and dashboard of your car. Be sure to empty the canister when it gets full.

3. Throw away any trash or debris that has accumulated in your car.
Take the opportunity to clean out any trash or debris that has been accumulating in your car. Use the trash cans provided to dispose of everything properly.

By following these easy steps, you can use a self service car wash to keep your car clean and looking great all year long. With a little perseverance and effort, you'll be able to give your car the care it deserves while saving money at the same time.
