How to Become a Videographer
Becoming a professional videographer can be a fulfilling and rewarding vocation. It takes hard work, dedication, and a great deal of practice to become a successful videographer. Here is a step-by-step guide on how to become a videographer:

1. Get a high school education. To become a videographer, you will need to have a solid foundation in the basics of video production. Make sure to take classes in media, art, film, and computer-based production classes that allow you to explore and develop your skills. These foundational skills allow you to better understand and navigate the world of video production.

2. Get a college degree. If you want to be taken seriously as a professional videographer, it is important to get a college degree with a focus in Video Production. Not only will this provide the knowledge you need to be a successful video professional, but it will better equip you to apply for jobs or internships. The education you receive should include classes in camera work, lighting, sound production, scriptwriting, and post-production. 

3. Learn everything you can about video equipment and software. As a videographer, you will constantly be working with camera equipment and editing software, so it’s a good idea to start practicing with these right away. Take the time to learn about the latest technologies in gear, camera operation, and video editing.

4. Look for internships or apprenticeships. If you’re planning on making a career out of becoming a professional videographer, a great way to gain experience and knowledge is by taking on internships or apprenticeships. Not only will this help you learn more about the field, but it will provide invaluable industry connections. 

5. Become certified, if desired. If you’d like to become certified in videography, you can earn certifications from The Society of Professional Videographers, the National Institute of Video Arts, and the Royal Photographic Society. Although certification is not required, it can demonstrate your expertise within the field and help you garner more respect within the industry.

6. Plan before shooting. Spend some time sketching out your ideas before you film any subject. Planning ahead ensures that you’re able to capture the desired shots and content right off the bat. When planning, make sure to create a shot list of the angles and shots that you will need.

7. Practice taking different kinds of shots. Becoming a great videographer requires you to constantly practice taking different kinds of shots. This includes everything from close-up shots, wide shots, point-of-view shots, dusk shots, and more. Continue to practice and hone your technique to make sure to get the most effective shots. 

8. Utilize different camera moves. A stationary camera pointed at a single subject can be simple and effective, but it can also get a little boring. Incorporate different camera moves, like pans, tracking, and zooms into your videography to make your videos interesting and engaging.

9. Incorporate a variety of camera techniques. Getting creative with your camera techniques used to be necessary for a good video. Nowadays, more and more styles of shooting are becoming available, such as steady-cam, time-lapse, or drone shots. These types of shots require careful planning and skill, so practice as much as you can.

10. Practice using the “wide, medium, tight” method. This technique is a proven one to help you get good footage of many different kinds of subjects. Wide shots are generally used to establish the setting, while medium shots are used to add visual interest, and tight shots are used to focus in on a subject or object.

11. Experiment with editing. Utilizing the software and equipment that you have, try arranging your raw footage in various ways for practice. Learning about the basics of video editing will help you become a more well-rounded videographer and add an extra set of skills to your arsenal. 

12. Build a portfolio. Once you have started producing some strong, edited video footage, you should assemble a portfolio of your best work. This is a great way to show potential clients what level of quality you can provide and the type of projects you can create.

13. Join a professional organization. There are several professional organizations for videographers, such as the Guild of Television and Film Producers or the National Association of Broadcast Employees and Technicians. Joining and networking with other organizations can help you stay up to date on the latest developments in the industry.

14. Look for jobs. Start applying to local video production companies or looking for independent freelance videography jobs. You can also post your services on websites like Craigslist or advertise on social media.

15. Utilize social media to create a brand for yourself. Using social media to advertise your company or services as a videographer is key to getting clients. Create your own portfolio website, use platforms such as LinkedIn or Instagram to promote yourself, and create a niche for yourself.

16. Explore alternative careers. Not every person that is trained as a videographer becomes one, or remains one forever. There are several career paths you can take with a background in video production, including becoming a cinematographer, a filmmaker, an actor, or a media coordinator.

17. Attend conferences and professional meetings. Joining professional organizations can help you stay up to date on the latest developments in video production technology. Keep an eye out for conferences and workshops related to the field to make connections with other professionals and stay informed.

18. Take workshops. Workshops are a great way to immerse yourself in the world of video production and hone your technical skills. From getting the basics of shooting down to mastering advanced editing techniques, there are plenty of workshops to choose from that will help you become a better videographer.

19. Try to win contests and awards. The best way to catch the public’s attention is to win awards or get recognized in various festivals. Entering your best work in contests can help boost your reputation as a videographer and increase the recognition you get for your work.

20. Be creative. Above all, the most important thing to remember when becoming a professional videographer is to be creative. As a videographer, the sky is the limit. There are so many ways to approach a project and so many unique ways to showcase your talent. Keep an open mind, experiment, and have fun!

We present a novel coalition game formation model with cooperative transmission to alleviate the challenges associated with boundary nodes in selfish packet-forwarding wireless networks. The motivation behind this research is to leverage the benefits of cooperative transmission, while ensuring the self-interested behavior of nodes is accounted for, thus promoting the stability and efficiency of such networks. Our game model accounts for the dynamic formation of coalitions based on the network topology, with the aim of incentivizing boundary nodes to cooperate with their neighboring nodes.

We propose a distributed algorithm that enables nodes to join coalitions in an autonomous manner, while ensuring that the formed coalitions are stable and efficient. The algorithm uses a price-based mechanism to incentivize node cooperation and strategic coalition formation. Our simulation results demonstrate that our model and algorithm can successfully address the boundary node curse, ensuring high packet delivery rates, reduced delay, and better utilization of bandwidth resources. Additionally, our model enables nodes to optimize their utility and reduces the overall cost of cooperation.

The proposed coalition game model with cooperative transmission provides a promising solution to the challenges of boundary nodes in wireless networks, as the distribution of nodes and the topology of the network are dynamically accounted for. Therefore, our work contributes to the advancement of cooperative transmission in wireless networks and inspires future research on game theory methods for networking challenges.

САЩ и Великобритания призоваха Русия да освободи задържаните по време на протестите граждани. Двете държави призоваха Русия да зачита правата на своите граждани и да им осигури свобода на изразяване и мирни протести.

Протестите в Русия започнаха преди около месец, след като навалицата Навални беше задържан в Москва, където водеше кампания против руския президент Владимир Путин. Мнозина граждани на Русия се присъединиха към протестите, изразявайки своята недоволство от правителството на Путин.

По време на протестите, стотици граждани бяха задържани, включително много журналисти и активисти. Доста от тези задържани бяха обвинени в показна престъпност, която носи до 15 години затвор.

САЩ и Великобритания сега призовават Русия да освободи тези граждани, които са били задържани по незаконен начин и да ги защитава правата на своите граждани в бъдеще.

"САЩ ще продължи да настоява за почитане на правата на гражданите на Русия и за свободата на изразяване и събрания в страната", заяви представител на американското правителство. "Непропорционалното използване на сила срещу мирните протести и преследването на журналисти и активисти са неприемливи и трябва да престанат веднага."

"Великобритания се присъединява към призива за освобождаване на задържаните граждани в Русия, които са били задържани по незаконен начин и не са извършили насилствени актове," казва представител на британското правителство. "Също така ние призоваваме Русия да зачита правата на своите граждани и да им осигури свобода на изразяване и мирни протести."

Междувременно, правителството на Русия отхвърли призивите на САЩ и Великобритания, казвайки, че протестите са "незаконни" и че държавата има правото да защитава националната си сигурност.

Тези призиви от страна на САЩ и Великобритания идват във време, когато двата западни алианса продължават да бъдат изправени пред напрежение с Русия. Американският президент Джо Байдън неотдавна заяви, че Русия е главният стратегически противник на САЩ, а Великобритания все още е в процес на преговори с Русия за предстояща среща на високо равнище.

Безспорно е, че Русия ще трябва да поеме отговорност за действията си към своите граждани, особено при ограничаване на свободата на изразяване. Въпреки това общественото мнение в Русия е разделено, като някои граждани подкрепят правителството на Путин, докато други се борят за своите права и свободи.

Въпреки всичко, е ясно, че САЩ и Великобритания ще продължат да настояват за зачитане на правата на гражданите в Русия и за свободата на изразяване и протести, което е от съществено значение за демокрацията и свободата на всеки човек в света.

We study the relationship between two measures of complexity for infinite sequences, namely bounded pushdown dimension and Lempel-Ziv (LZ) information density.  We show that these two notions are equivalent in the sense that they agree on all computable sequences but disagree on some noncomputable ones.   In particular we prove that if an infinite sequence has finite LZ information density then it also has finite bounded pushdown dimension; however there exist noncomputable sequences with finite LZ information density which have unbounded pushdown dimension.    The results presented here were obtained while the author was at the University of California Santa Cruz as part of his Ph.D thesis under the supervision of Prof. David Harizanov. We develop a polymer quantum mechanics (PQM) where the fundamental variables are continuous twists on a non-compact group, whose Lie algebra is an infinite-dimensional Hilbert space. The Hilbert space of the quantum polymer is the space of sections of a vector bundle over the group with the standard fiber at the unit element, whose Lie algebra is identified with the abovementioned one. The coordinate algebra of the polymer is completed with respect to a natural invariant trace. This allows us to construct an invariant Schrödinger equation on the entire space of continuous twists. The quantum polymer is also shown to be continuously deformable to the standard (commutative) quantum mechanics, where the polymer-like features appear as a self-similar fine structure in the spectra of some exactly solvable models. We also show that the polymer quantum mechanics can be approximated by a corresponding sequence of ordinary quantum mechanics for increasingly large degrees of polymerization, with errors vanishing in the limit. The limit transition can be performed in two steps. In the first step, the continuous twists are replaced by a projective limit of finite-dimensional matrix groups with the normal subgroup that keeps only the diagonal elements and the corresponding subalgebras. In the second step, these matrix groups are replaced by their projective limits, which are the compact Lie groups. Finally, we show that the strong operator limit of the corresponding sequence of ordinary quantum mechanics corresponds to the commutative limit of the polymer quantum mechanics.

Департамент информации и печати МИД России опровергает сообщения, появившиеся в израильских СМИ, о том, что Россия предложила стать посредником в переговорах между Израилем и ХАМАСом. В заявлении МИД России подчеркивается, что никаких предложений со стороны России не делалось и не планировалось делать. Газета Ha'aretz сообщила о том, что глава МИД Израиля Ципи Ливни отвергла предложение спецпредставителя президента РФ на Ближнем Востоке Александра Салтанова о посредничестве. Однако в МИД России подчеркивают, что Салтанов не выступал с такими предложениями.

В заявлении МИД России отмечается, что участники конфликта на Ближнем Востоке проявляют большую заинтересованность в оценках и информации российской стороны, которыми она делится по просьбе партнеров. В регионе хорошо знают о потенциале России с учетом имеющихся у нее возможностей разговаривать со всеми игроками на Ближнем Востоке. Geylang Bahru MRT station is an underground Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) station on the Downtown Line in Singapore. The station is located at the junction of Geylang Bahru Road and Sims Avenue in the Geylang Bahru neighbourhood. The station serves the residents of Geylang Bahru, and parts of the Joo Chiat and Kembangan neighbourhoods. The station is between the Paya Lebar and MacPherson stations, and is a four-minute walk from the latter. The station has two platforms, and is fully underground. Like all stations on the Downtown Line, it is air-conditioned and has a glass canopy over the platforms. The station's interior design is themed after the traditional shophouses in the area, with a modern take on the traditional tile and wood motifs. The station was first announced in July 2008 as part of the Downtown Line Stage 1 (DTL1) extension beyond the original DTL1 stations, which comprises Bugis, Lavender, and MacPherson. The extension was planned to be completed by 2016, but was delayed to 2017 due to a shortage of materials. The station opened on 31 October 2017, together with the rest of DTL1. Geylang Bahru station is named after the road it is located at, Geylang Bahru Road, which in turn was named after the village it leads to, Geylang Bahru. The station's Chinese name, 歌廊白, was derived from the first two words of the road's Chinese name, 歌廊 (geylang). The station has two exits, one to the west along Geylang Bahru Road, and the other to the east along Sims Avenue.

A Three-Stage Search for Supermassive Black Hole Binaries in LISA Data.

We present a three-stage search for supermassive black hole binaries in data from the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA), a space-based gravitational-wave detector under development by the European Space Agency (ESA). In the first stage, we search for gravity waves (GWs) from asymmetric supermassive black hole binaries with compact objects (neutron stars or white dwarfs) using the simplest possible search method: a search for extreme events in the frequency domain. We find no evidence for such binaries in a data set corresponding to three years of LISA operation. In the second stage, we search for less asymmetric supermassive black hole binaries using a targeted search method. We find no evidence for such binaries in a data set corresponding to six years of LISA operation. In the third stage, we search for more symmetric supermassive black hole binaries using a full-sky search method. We find no evidence for such binaries in a data set corresponding to nine years of LISA operation. We conclude that supermassive black hole binaries are either (1) not present in the LISA frequency band, (2) present in the LISA frequency band but have black hole masses less than $10^6 M_{\odot}$, or (3) present in the LISA frequency band but have black hole-compact object mass ratios greater than 5:1.

Die Eingangsimpedanz (auch Mindesteingangsimpedanz) ist eine elektrische Größe, die in der Physik und Elektrotechnik verwendet wird. Sie gibt Auskunft darüber, welchen Widerstand der Eingang eines elektronischen Bauteils oder eines Messgeräts aufweist. Die Eingangsimpedanz hängt insbesondere von elektrischen Feststoffen wie Widerständen oder Kondensatoren sowie von der Geometrie des Bauteils und der anliegenden Wechselspannung bzw. Frequenz ab. Die Wahl der Eingangsimpedanz ist entscheidend für die Genauigkeit und die Verstärkung von Messungen, insbesondere in der Labormesstechnik, der Signalverarbeitung oder in der Hochfrequenztechnik.

In der Messtechnik wird beispielsweise mittels einer Brückenmessung mit Hilfe einer Eingangsimpedanzprüfung die Impedanz des Eingangs von Messgeräten wie Oszilloskopen oder Messverstärkern ermittelt. Diese Funktion kann auch zum Prüfen der Eingangsimpedanz von Impedanzanpassungen, wie etwa von Potentiometern, Lautsprechern oder Antennen, genutzt werden.

Die Eingangsimpedanz ist auch von Bedeutung in der Schaltungstechnik, insbesondere zur Anpassung von Impedanzen bei elektronischen Filterschaltungen. Hier kann die Auswahl der richtigen Eingangsimpedanz maßgeblich zur Leistungssteigerung beitragen.

In der Regel wird die Eingangsimpedanz in der Einheit Ohm oder mit einem einfachen Impedanzverhältnis dargestellt. Dabei gilt, dass eine höhere Eingangsimpedanz eine höhere Leistungseinbuße zur Folge hat, während eine niedrige Eingangsimpedanz zwar geringere Einbußen zu verzeichnen hat, aber auch weniger Präzision und Empfindlichkeit in den Messungen aufweist.

Nicht zuletzt hängt die Eingangsimpedanz auch vom Energieverbrauch des Elektronikgeräts ab: So kann ein höherer Widerstand des Eingangs eventuell den Bedarf an zusätzlicher Energie oder externen Verstärkern erhöhen. Deshalb ist bei der Wahl der Eingangsimpedanz eine sorgfältige Abwägung zwischen Genauigkeit, Empfindlichkeit und Energieeffizienz geboten.

In this study, we report on our search for gravitational-wave bursts in data collected by LIGO during its fourth science run. The main problem we aim to address is the detection of short-lived, high-frequency gravitational-wave signals that are challenging to detect using traditional techniques. These signals may originate from a range of astrophysical events, such as black hole mergers or supernova explosions, and may provide important information about the dynamics of the universe.

To address this problem, we employed a novel search algorithm that is based on a suite of time-frequency methods designed to identify coherent signals above the detector noise. The methodology involves the detection and characterization of short-lived transient events in the data using wavelet transforms and matched filtering. We also implemented a hierarchical follow-up procedure to reduce the number of false positives detected.

The motivation for this research stems from the desire to deepen our understanding of the universe and the physical processes that drive it. The detection of gravitational waves has opened up new avenues of exploration and has the potential to transform our understanding of fundamental physics. Our search for gravitational-wave bursts in LIGO data from the fourth science run represents a significant step forward in the ongoing quest to detect and characterize these elusive signals.

بريدنيزولون هو دواء ينتمي إلى فئة الستيرويدات القشرية، والتي تستخدم لعلاج العديد من الأمراض التي تتطلب تخفيض التهابات الجهاز المناعي. يتم استخدام الدواء في العديد من الأمراض، مثل الربو والتهاب المفاصل و التهاب الجيوب الأنفية و الجلدية والحساسية والتهاب الشعب الهوائية والعديد من الحالات الأخرى التي من الممكن أن تكون خطرة على الصحة العامة. يعمل البريدنيزولون على تقليل الانتاج الكيميائي للجسم الذي يسمى البروستاغلاندين، والذي يسبب الالتهاب والألم والحساسية، ومن خلال ذلك يؤدي الدواء إلى تخفيف حدة الأعراض المصاحبة للأمراض التي يتم استخدامه فيها. يجب تناول الدواء فقط تحت إشراف الطبيب المعالج ويجب إتباع جميع التعليمات التي تم إعطاؤها بناءً على حالة المريض وحالته الصحية المتغيرة. و يتم استخدام الدواء على شكل أقراص أو حقن، وكل منها له وقت وجرعة محددة من قبل الطبيب. من الآثار الجانبية الشائعة للدواء: ارتفاع ضغط الدم، اضطرابات اختلاط السكري، زيادة الوزن، والأرق، وخفض كثافة العظام، و زيادة نسبة الكوليسترول في الدم و العديد من الآثار الجانبية الممكنة. للحد من الأعراض الجانبية يمكن تناول الجرعة بشكل متدرج للمريض و خفضها بشكل تدريجي بناء على توصيات الطبيب المعالج. يجب عدم تناول الدواء أثناء الحمل أو الإرضاع، إلا بعد توصيات الطبيب المعالج. و لإنهاء الدواء يجب خفض الجرعة تدريجيا خاصة إذا كان المريض يعاني من ارتفاع ضغط الدم ولديه أمراض خطيرة مثل السكري ومرض القلب. يتوفر دواء بريدنيزولون في الصيدليات تحت أسماء مختلفة مثل ديلتا تون، كورتان، كورتان ديبو، والعديد من الأسماء الأخرى.

During the final years of the Second World War, as the German army suffered devastating losses in both the Eastern and Western fronts, the German media attempted to portray the retreats as strategic and tactical moves that were necessary for the eventual victory of the German forces. The German media, which was heavily controlled by the Nazi government and its propaganda apparatus, sought to maintain the morale of the German people and army despite the setbacks.

The coverage of the German retreats varied depending on the specific circumstances and the region in which they occurred. In general, the retreats were depicted as calculated maneuvers made by the German army to regroup and launch counteroffensives against the enemy. The media portrayed these moves as part of a larger strategy designed to exhaust the enemy and gain the upper hand in the war effort.

Despite the fact that the German retreats were often chaotic and disorganized affairs, the media sought to emphasize the bravery and heroism of the German soldiers who fought and died in these battles. Propaganda posters, newsreels, and newspapers depicted German soldiers as courageous and dedicated fighters who were willing to sacrifice all for their country and their cause.

However, as the war progressed and the German retreats became more frequent and catastrophic, the media's attempts to portray these events as strategic maneuvers became increasingly unconvincing. By the time of the Battle of Berlin in 1945, many Germans were disillusioned with the propaganda and saw through the government's attempts to downplay the devastating losses suffered by the German military.

In conclusion, the German media attempted to cover the extensive retreats of the German army in the last years of the Second World War as strategic maneuvers designed to eventually lead to the triumph of the German forces. However, the increasingly frequent and catastrophic nature of these retreats undermined the credibility of this propaganda effort, and many Germans became disillusioned with the government's attempts to downplay the reality of the situation.

Demetrios (altgriechisch Δημήτριος) war ein antiker Soldat, dessen Leben und Taten in der Zeit des Hellenismus stattfanden. Leider sind über seine Herkunft und frühen Jahre nur wenige Informationen verfügbar, was die Rekonstruktion seines Lebensweges erschwert.

Demetrios machte sich jedoch einen Namen als furchtloser Krieger und tapferer Anführer in verschiedenen militärischen Konflikten seiner Zeit. Besonders bekannt wurde er durch seine Beteiligung an der Schlacht von Issos im Jahr 333 v. Chr., in der Alexander der Große gegen das Perserreich unter König Darius III. kämpfte. Demetrios zeichnete sich durch außergewöhnlichen Mut und strategisches Geschick aus, was dazu führte, dass er in der makedonischen Armee schnell an Ansehen gewann.

In den folgenden Jahren begleitete Demetrios Alexander auf seinen Eroberungszügen durch Asien und spielte eine bedeutende Rolle in verschiedenen Schlachten und Feldzügen. Seine taktische Brillanz und Loyalität gegenüber Alexander wurden von Historikern der Zeit hoch gelobt und trugen zu seinen weiteren Beförderungen bei.

Nach dem Tod Alexanders im Jahr 323 v. Chr. fand Demetrios sich in den Wirren der diadochen Kriege wieder, als die Generäle des verstorbenen Eroberers um die Vorherrschaft stritten. Auch in diesen Auseinandersetzungen erwies sich Demetrios als entschlossener und unerbittlicher Krieger, der jedoch letztendlich nicht in der Lage war, die Einheit des Reiches aufrechtzuerhalten.

Obwohl viele Details über sein späteres Leben unklar sind, bleibt Demetrios' militärische Brillanz und sein Beitrag zur Geschichte des Hellenismus unbestreitbar. Sein Vermächtnis als Soldat und Anführer hat die Erinnerung an seine Tapferkeit und Opferbereitschaft bis in die moderne Zeit überdauert und inspiriert auch heute noch Menschen auf der ganzen Welt.

Atlas V (rakete) Überblick: Atlas V ist eine amerikanische Rakete, die von Lockheed Martin entwickelt wurde und auf eine große Vielfalt an Missionen spezialisiert ist. Bis 2019 hatte der Atlas V 79 erfolgreiche Starts durchgeführt, darunter das Sentinel-6 Michael Freilich-Observatorium, das Atlas V Startwerkzeug (AVS), AEHF-6- und der AEHF-6-Kommunikationssatelliten, die der US-Luftwaffe gehören, verschiedene Starts des GPS-III-Systems sowie der nächste Start des Boeing Starliner-Raumschiffs und der Perseverance-Rover und Mars 2020-Hubschrauber.
Die aktive Atlas V-Rakete von United Launch Alliance (ULA) kann Nutzlasten für wissenschaftliche, zivile und nationale Sicherheitsmissionen starten und garantiert zuverlässige Missionen. Ihr modularer Ansatz ermöglicht ihren Aufbau als ein- oder zweistöckige Version, je nach Bedarf der Nutzlast, und kann mit bis zu fünf Boostern an ihren Kern angehängt werden.
Zusammensetzung und technische Daten: Die Atlas V-Rakete besteht aus verschiedenen Stufen und Düsen, die für eine schnelle, zuverlässige Zündung und eine effiziente Treibstoffzufuhr ausgelegt sind. Die erste Stufe umfasst den Common Core Booster (CCB), der aus einem RD-180-Flüssigkeitsbrennstoffmotor mit einer Leistung von bis zu 914 kN besteht. Die zweite Stufe ist der Centaur-Oberstufentreibstofftank und -motor, der eine Kombination aus flüssigem Stickstoff und flüssigem Wasserstoff verwendet und eine Leistung von bis zu 102 kN hat. Der ATLAS V ist mit verschiedenen Booster-Konfigurationen erhältlich, darunter der bis zu fünf Sterling-Feststoff-Boostern und der zweistufigen RL10-Motor-Konfiguration, die speziell für den Transport schwerer Nutzlasten entwickelt wurden. Die Abmessungen der Rakete variieren je nach Booster-Konfiguration und Nutzlast, aber die Atlas V hat eine maximale Höhe von 29 m und kann Nutzlasten von bis zu 20 t befördern.
Geschichte: Atlas V wurde erstmals am 21. August 2002 gestartet und hat seitdem eine Fülle von Missionen durchgeführt. Obwohl der Atlas V eine der zuverlässigsten Raketen auf dem Markt ist, wird er auf lange Sicht durch modernere Technologien und fortschrittlichere Raketen wie Falcon 9 und Falcon Heavy von SpaceX ersetzt werden.
Die Spezifikationen und technischen Details der Atlas V-Rakete sowie ihre umfangreiche Liste von erfolgreichen Missionen haben sie zu einem wichtigen Werkzeug für wissenschaftliche, zivile und nationale Sicherheitsmissionen gemacht. Als Spitzenleistung des modernen Raketenbaus wird die Atlas V weiterhin eine wichtige Rolle in der Welt der Raumfahrt spielen.

Сотрудники МВД и ФСБ совместно с представителями службы безопасности Сбербанка пресекли деятельность организованной группы фальшивомонетчиков, из-за которой несколько крупнейших российских банков были вынуждены приостановить прием пятитысячных купюр через банкоматы. В соответствующем официальном сообщении МВД отмечается, что задержанными подозреваемыми оказались семеро граждан Узбекистана, чьи имена не разглашаются. Кроме того, в отношении подозреваемых возбуждено уголовное дело по статье "Изготовление, хранение, перевозка или сбыт поддельных денег или ценных бумаг".

По данным МВД, только за последние две недели злоумышленники сбыли через банкоматы и платежные терминалы более 8,5 миллиона фальшивых рублей. При инкассации банкоматов в Москве и Подмосковье были обнаружены поддельные пятитысячные купюры на сумму более 15 миллионов рублей. Следует отметить, что визуально фальшивые купюры заметно отличались от подлинных, но программное обеспечение использованных в банкоматах устройств неспособно идентифицировать подобного рода подделки. Однако, согласно обнародованным данным, бандиты выполнили подделки на однослойной бумаге, без водяных знаков, и напечатали их на струйном принтере.

Ситуация с фальшивыми пятитысячными купюрами в России привела к тому, что несколько крупных банков, включая Сбербанк и Альфа-банк, временно приостановили прием таких купюр через свои банкоматы. Сбербанк пояснил, что заменяет программное обеспечение, необходимое для защиты от фальшивых банкнот номиналом в пять тысяч рублей. В свою очередь, председатель Банка России, Эльвира Набиуллина, в интервью телеканалу "Россия 24" сообщила, что возможно, некоторые банки не озаботились установкой на всех своих банкоматах и терминалах устройств, позволяющих определять подлинность купюр.

Тем не менее, банки ожидают, что защиту от фальшивых купюр в ближайшее время удастся обновить и все пятитысячные банкноты вернутся в оборот. Стоит отметить, что в начале 2015 года Центральный банк России сообщил, что пятитысячные купюры стали самыми подделываемыми на территории страны. Количество фальшивых купюр этого номинала превысило количество фальшивых тысячных банкнот. В связи с этим, ЦБ России призвало банки принимать все необходимые меры для защиты своих клиентов от подобного рода мошенничества.

This is a list of New Testament minuscules (also known as scribal abbreviations and manuscript numbers) from 2501 to 2600. Minuscule 2501, designated by siglum \mathfrak{M}2501, is a Greek minuscule manuscript of the New Testament, written on parchment. Palaeographically it has been assigned to the 11th century. The codex contains a complete text of the four Gospels on 220 parchment leaves, with some lacunae (John 16:24-18:7). The text is written in one column per page, 23-24 lines per page. Minuscule 2502, designated by siglum \mathfrak{M}2502, is a Greek minuscule manuscript of the New Testament, on parchment. Palaeographically it has been assigned to the 12th century. It has marginalia. Minuscule 2503, designated by siglum \mathfrak{M}2503, is a Greek minuscule manuscript of the New Testament, written on parchment. Paleographically it has been assigned to the 12th century. The codex contains a part of the Gospel of John (2:7-8:12). The text is written in one column per page, 20 lines per page. Minuscule 2504, designated by siglum \mathfrak{M}2504, is a Greek minuscule manuscript of the New Testament, on parchment. Palaeographically it has been assigned to the 12th century. Minuscule 2505, designated by siglum \mathfrak{M}2505, is a Greek minuscule manuscript of the New Testament on parchment. Palaeographically it has been assigned to the 13th century. Minuscule 2506, designated by siglum \mathfrak{M}2506, is a Greek minuscule manuscript of the New Testament on parchment. Palaeographically it has been assigned to the 14th century. Minuscule 2507, designated by siglum \mathfrak{M}2507, is a Greek minuscule manuscript of the New Testament on parchment. Palaeographically it has been assigned to the 12th century. The codex contains a complete text of the four Gospels and the Apocalypse on 268 parchment leaves (size 35 cm by 27 cm). Minuscule 2508, designated by siglum \mathfrak{M}2508, is a Greek minuscule manuscript of the New Testament on parchment. Palaeographically it has been assigned to the 15th century. The codex contains a complete text of the four Gospels on 360 parchment leaves (56 cm by 43 cm). The subsequent manuscripts (minuscule 2509–2600) are similarly described, with their palaeographical details and contents. This list of New Testament minuscules (2501-2600) is provided as an aid to scholars researching the New Testament in its original Greek. The manuscripts are arranged numerically so that they may be easily located. Minuscules not included in this list may be found in the works of other scholars and in other manuscripts numbering catalogs. Accounts of berserk-like behavior were often associated with individuals or small groups of men, rather than an organized unit.

It was also believed that their ferocity and fearlessness could be beneficial in breaking an enemy's morale, leading to decisive victories.

Overall, the berserkers' reputation as ferocious and successful warriors is likely exaggerated in many historic accounts. Председателката на Българската социалистическа партия, Корнелия Нинова, подаде искане за вот на доверие от Народното събрание на БСП. Това стана след неуспеха на партията в местните избори през месец октомври и разногласията в партийното ръководство.

Според Нинова, тя поиска вот на доверие, за да получи мандат от партията за ръководство на БСП под променената политическа обстановка. Тя обясни, че не може да продължи да ръководи партията, ако не получи ясен знак от НС, че има доверие и подкрепа на партията.

Нинова проведе срещи с водещи членове на партията, като обясни своята позиция и посочи необходимостта от ясен курс и единен стратегически план за развитие на социалистическата партия.

„Трябва да имаме ясна стратегия за развитието на партията и ясна визия за нашето място в политическия живот на България“, коментира Нинова пред медиите.

Това обаче не беше първият път, в който се поставя изискването за вот на доверие. В началото на годината, след провалените президентски избори, същата идея беше изразена от част от партийните членове.

Подобно на тогавашните изказвания, сега също има разногласия в партийното ръководство. Някои членове на НС са категорично против идеята, като твърдят, че това ще влоши еще повече положението на партията.

Какво е лимон и сода?

Лимонът и содата са два естествени продукта, които са на разположение на всички. Лимонът е богат на витамини, антиоксиданти и е световно признат като един от най-мощните продукти от естествен произход, който може да бъде използван за лечение на много заболявания.

Содата, от друга страна, е състояща се от елементи като натрий и водород, които са важни за баланса на утайката, но има и друга уникална качества – да неутрализира киселини.

Как лимонът и содата могат да помогнат за борбата със рака?

Лимонът има антибактериални и антивирусни свойства, които подобряват имунната система и помагат на организма да се бори със злокачествени клетки. Той също така е богат на лимонената киселина, която е мощен антиоксидант и мощен защитник на здравата клетъчна структура.

Содата като неутрализиращ агент, може да помогне на лимонената киселина да работи с максимална ефективност.

Как се приготвя комбинацията лимон и сода?

За приготвяне на комбинацията лимон и сода, се използва един лимон и половин чайна лъжичка сода. Лимонът трябва да бъде стиснат за сока, към който да се добави содата. След като напитката е избъркана, трябва да бъде консумирана веднага. Тази комбинация може да бъде приемана ежедневно, за да поддържа здравето на тялото.

Може ли комбинацията лимон и сода да замени химиотерапията?

Преди да бъде обсъдена интензивно темата, трябва да се отбележи, че комбинацията лимон и сода не може да замени или да бъде заместена с химиотерапията. Лимонът и содата са продукти от естествен произход, които могат да помогнат за подсилване на имунната система, но не са екзактни или научно доказани методи за лечение на раковите заболявания и не са предназначени за заместване на официалните методи за лечение, като химиотерапията.

Независимо от това, комбинацията лимон и сода може да бъде полезна като естествен метод за лечение на заболявания, а също и като допълнение към официалните методи на лечение. Така че, ако страдате от ракови заболявания и се интересувате от алтернативни методи за лечение, комбинацията лимон и сода би могла да бъде един от тях. И така, комбинацията лимон и сода може да се окаже един от много полезните естествени методи за лечение на рак. This study examines the effects of a parameter quench on a extended quantum system and its correlation functions. We demonstrate that, by taking advantage of boundary critical phenomena in one higher dimension, correlation functions in d dimensions can be studied. For d=1, this offers the opportunity to employ the powerful tools of conformal field theory in cases of critical evolution. Results of the mean-field approximation are obtained in generic dimension and tested over real-time evolutions of solvable models, with the aim of understanding which elements are valid beyond the critical domain.

Our results are explained by a general trend, whereby quasiparticles, entangled throughout an area of a few correlation lengths in the initial state, spread at a finite speed through the system. Additionally, long-term effects are interpreted by a generalized Gibbs ensemble. We conclude this paper by bringing up several ideas for potential further improvements.

If you find yourself in the unfortunate circumstance of needing to jump-start a dead car battery, it can be daunting to know where to start. Thankfully, with the right tools and knowledge, it is possible to safely and effectively charge a dead car battery. Follow these steps to learn how to charge a dead car battery.

Part 1: Preparation

1. Open the hood or compartment on each vehicle in which the batteries are located. It's important to ensure that the batteries are in close enough proximity to connect the cables between them. 

2. Take note of the positive and negative terminals on each battery. This is important as you will need to know which cables to connect to each terminal.

3. Locate a set of jumper cables. These cables are typically black and red and can be found at most automotive stores or online.

Part 2: Connecting the Jumper Cables

1. Connect each end of the positive jumper cable to the positive terminals on each car battery. The positive terminal is typically marked with a plus (+) sign.

2. Connect one end of the negative jumper cable to the negative terminal on the functional, charged battery. The negative terminal is typically marked with a minus (-) sign.

3. Attach the other end of the negative jumper cable to a grounded metal component of the car that contains the dead battery. This could be a bolt or screw in the engine compartment.

Part 3: Charging the Dead Battery

1. Start the engine of the car with the charged battery. Allow it to run for at least five minutes before attempting to start the other car. 

2. Try to start the engine of the car that contains the dead battery. If it doesn't start after a few tries, turn off both engines and double check that the cables are connected correctly.

3. Disconnect and remove the jumper cables from each car after the engine has started in the reverse order in which you connected them. This means removing the negative cable from the dead battery first, followed by the negative cable from the charged battery. Then remove the positive cable from the charged battery, followed by the positive cable from the dead battery.

4. Allow the car which had the dead battery to continue running for at least another five minutes. This will help the battery recharge slightly and regain its strength.

5. Drive the jump-started car for at least 20 minutes or allow it to idle for the same amount of time. This will help the battery fully recharge and regain its strength.

In the event that the dead battery cannot be jump started, it may be necessary to replace the battery altogether. Always take the necessary precautions and follow this guide carefully to safely jump start a dead car battery.

This paper aims to resolve the computational complexity of computing Nash equilibria, a fundamental concept in game theory, particularly in two-player games. We are motivated to address this problem as Nash equilibria are central to predicting outcomes for economic and social systems. However, despite their theoretical importance, discovering Nash equilibria is computationally challenging and intractable, in general. 

Therefore, we propose a novel approach that culminates in a polynomial-time algorithm for computing two-player Nash equilibria. The proposed method leverages a combination of linear programming, Zero-Sum Games, and more. We demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of our approach with extensive computational simulations, which show that we achieve not only theoretical efficiency but also practical performance. Our work contributes to the theoretical and practical understanding of game theory and its applications, from economics to political science.

In summary, by filling the gap in the computational complexity of Nash equilibria, our approach provides new insights into efficient solutions for two-player games and beyond. Ultimately, this research has wide-reaching implications for how we can understand and simulate a wide range of strategic interactions in modern society.

It has been known for a long time that one can construct a simple systematic single parity check (SPCH) code that can approach the Shannon limit. However, constructing good random puncturing patterns is a difficult problem. In this paper, a pseudo-random puncturing pattern is proposed. The performance of turbo coding with this pattern is compared to conventional turbo coding with fixed puncturing patterns. It is shown that the new puncturing pattern significantly reduces the error floor without causing any noticeable performance degradation. This work was done at ETRI. Reference: 1. A. G. i. A. Almansoori, A. Al-Shater, and D. D. Falconer, "Pseudo-random Puncturing: A Technique to Lower the Error Floor of Turbo Codes," IEEE Communications Letters, vol. 17, no. 8, pp. 934-937, Aug. 2013.

The choice of green is mostly historical: 

Early special-effects films, such as The Matrix, often used blue screens. This was because film-makers needed a screen colour that was bright and distinct, but that also matched the tone and colour of human skin. 

The first full-colour special-effects film, The Wizard of Oz, was made in 1939. The film-makers used a turquoise screen instead of blue, because the costume of the main character, Dorothy, was turquoise. 

But by the time The Matrix was made in 1999, digital film-making was more common. The makers of The Matrix could choose any colour screen they wanted, so they chose green instead of blue. 

Green is not necessarily better than blue. Blue screens have their own advantages: 

Green screens need more light to work well.

The assassinations of three American presidents between 1865 and 1901 created a national shock and fear that reverberated throughout the nation and fundamentally changed the way many Americans viewed politics, insecurity, and the nation's place in the world. The shocking assassinations had a profound impact on the national psyche and were a stark reminder of the possibility that bad and unexpected things can happen even to the leaders of the most developed nation in the world. 

In the 36 years following these assassinations, much was said of their effect on the national psyche by both prominent and lesser-known American politicians and thinkers. In particular, Senator William Proctor of South Carolina expressed his dismay about the weakness of the nation’s security, writing in a speech to the Senate weeks after the death of President Lincoln that “if the Executive Mansion can be made so weakly defended as to be penetrated by violence and assassination, then there is no telling what may befall us in the future." Such statements rang true with many in the nation and led to a sense of insecurity that had not been witnessed in the United States before.

The three assassinations also inspired a sense of absolute dread in those that held the nation's power. In a letter to the New York Times, the Governor of Virginia declared after the assassination of President Garfield that the “infamy of this crime deeply wounds the sensibilities of all patriotic citizens by its manifest proofs of the weakness of public security.” The fear of assassins lurked in the minds of all public officials, as officially recorded during conversations with President McKinley days before his assassination in 1901, in which he reportedly declared “It’s a great responsibility to be President. I often wondered what it would feel like to be shot.”

The assassinations of three American presidents in the 36 years between 1865 and 1901 deeply wounded the national psyche and created a sense of insecurity, fear, and dread that was felt by all citizens. This shock gave rise to discussions among high-ranking officials and low-ranking commentators as to what it meant for the now oft-violated symbol of the nation's security: the Executive Mansion.

Die Bologneser Schule (auch: Schule von Bologna) ist ein kunsthistorischer Begriff, der eine Malschule in Bologna beschreibt, die im 16. Jahrhundert entstand. In dieser Zeit entstanden in Bologna bedeutende Kunstwerke, darunter der Stil der Familie Carracci, die im späten 16. bis frühen 17. Jahrhundert entstand. Die Bologneser Schule galt als der früheste Stil der Barockkunst, der Bilder aus dem Klassizismus in religiöse Kunstwerke einbezog.
Bekannt wurde die Bologneser Schule vor allem durch ihren emilianischen Stil, zu dem Künstler wie Guido Reni und Ludovico Carracci zählten und der sich auf idealisierte Formen und klassizistische Elemente konzentrierte. Die Familie Carracci, darunter Agostino, Annibale und Lodovico, war die führende Persönlichkeit der Bologneser Schule und maßgeblich an der Gründung der Accademia di San Luca beteiligt. Guido Reni war neben der Familie Carracci einer der bedeutendsten Maler der Schule und der berühmteste seiner Generation.
Die Bologneser Schule war für ihren didaktischen und kollaborativen Kunstansatz bekannt und wird oft als die erste akademische Kunstbewegung in Europa angesehen. Die meisten Künstler, die der Schule angehörten, hatten Erfahrung als Assistenten in anderen Ateliers, bevor sie ihre eigenen Werke gründeten. Sie studierten an der Accademia de Carracci, einer vielseitigen Akademie, die auch Elemente aus Literatur, Wissenschaft und Musik umfasste. Die Akademie war eine gemeinsame Anstrengung, sich vom Manierismus zu lösen und die traditionelle italienische Malerei und Architektur durch die Einbeziehung klassischer griechischer und römischer Kunsttechniken wiederzubeleben. Proportionen, Anatomie und die symmetrische Verwendung von Formen und Linien spielten eine wichtige Rolle im Unterricht der Bologneser Schule und führten innerhalb von zwei Jahrhunderten zu einer bemerkenswerten Kunstform, die heute als einer der wichtigsten Aspekte der Barockkunst gilt Europa.

We present a measurement of the aerosol phase function at the Pierre Auger Observatory. The measurement was carried out with the Mozart detector, a dedicated aerosol detector that has been operating at the Auger site since November 2018. The motivation for this work is to characterize the aerosols in the atmosphere over the Auger Observatory in order to better understand the atmosphere's contribution to the energy spectrum measured by the Auger surface detectors. The key idea is to measure the aerosol phase function using the radar technique, where a pulsed radar is used to measure the motion and velocity of aerosols in the atmosphere. The measurement was carried out in the daytime, during periods when the surface detectors are not taking data. The measurement results show that the aerosol phase function has a large positive bias, with values between 1 and 2, which indicates that the atmosphere is optically thick. This is in agreement with results from other aerosol detectors that have operated at the Auger site. The large positive bias in the aerosol phase function implies that the atmosphere is an important source of backgrounds for the Auger surface detectors, and it will be important to account for this contribution in the analysis of the Auger data. The practical application of this work is to provide a measure of the aerosol contribution to the background of the Auger surface detectors, which will be important for an optimal analysis of the Auger data. The theoretical application is to provide a measure of the aerosol phase function in the atmosphere, which is a fundamental property of the atmosphere that is important for understanding the behavior of light and radiation in the atmosphere.

Historically speaking, North and South Korea developed rather distinctive cultures and religions during the pre-modern period. They had different colonial overlords and distinct patterns of trade and political relationships with China and Japan.

Before the start of the 20th century, North and South Korea were part of the same country, called Joseon (or Choson). The southern part of the country controlled the main cities such as Seoul while the northern part remained largely a rural area.

During the mid 19th century, Korea came under the rule of Japan. During this period, Japan imposed its culture on Korea and was particularly oppressive in the north of Korea. This oppressive rule led to a strengthening of both ethnic and cultural values in the north which would later shape the way the North Korean nation would develop after the war.

After WWII, the Japanese had to leave Korea and the country was divided into North and South Korea. At this time, the North was more influenced by Soviet ideology than the South which was more influenced by US ideology. As a result, North Korea developed a strong sense of loyalty to the government and the leader, Kim Il Sung, while South Korea was more oriented towards democratic values and the economy.

Moreover, North Korea embraced a mostly communist version of socialism, while South Korea developed a capitalist form of economy. Although the South has more recently become somewhat more open to market reforms, North Korea maintains a highly centrally planned economy. In addition, North Korea was the first country in the world to declare absolute militarization and has used the military extensively to maintain the loyalty of its citizens and control its ideology.

In conclusion, North and South Korea have developed distinct cultures, religions, colonial overlords and economic systems, largely as a result of their different experiences before and after the Korean War. Even today, the two countries remain drastically different and do not have diplomatic relations with each other.

На 4 април се почита един от най-важните празници за жените - Денят на жената, на женската логика и страсти. Този ден е повод за всеки мъж да заповяда жената си и да и подари нещо специално, което да й напомни колко много я обича. Наистина, тази дата е насочена към почитането на жените и тяхната женственост, която завладява не само с първите коледни украси на балконите, но с простотата и естествеността на житейските емоции.

Женската логика е безспорно трудно разбираема от мъжете. Характерна е с помощта на чувствата и интуицията да подминава логиката, която приема и преработва факти и истина. За жените, често пъти най-важното е да „чувстват“ правилно и да имат добър контакт с емоциите си. Но това не означава, че липсва логика - напротив, тя е много по-сложна и интуиционна, отколкото онова, което се преподава в класните стаи.

Много често жените намират смисъл в голямата картина, когато мъжете търсят само решения на конкретни проблеми. Така например, мъжът може да се съсредоточи върху това, как да ремонтира радиатора, докато жената му вместо това може да почне да размишлява за това как да направи къщата по-уютна и атрактивна за живеене. Тези различия могат да доведат до конфликти и неразбирателства между двама партньори. Затова е много важно да се научим да ценим различията и да ги използваме за намиране на решения, като приемаме неразбирателствата като възможност да се проявим като по-добри хора.

За жените има два изключително важни аспекта, които ръководят поведението им – чувствата и страстите. Те по абсолютна концепция са много по-дълбоки нива от логиката и формалното мислене, и може би по този начин се появява липса на разбиране социалните сгради, заблужденията за женската слабост, често срещани съдебни и финансови бариери, които впоследствие може да доведат до неравнопоставеност.

Но въпреки тези различия елементите страст, усърдие и неизмерима жизненост са ключът към успеха в живота. Жените са от съществено значение за нашата култура, и не само като „източник на житейска мъдрост“, но и заради желанията си за постигане на успех и на хармонизиране на живота. От техния труд, креативност и интелект са създадени хиляди блестящи изобретения, многочислени дизайнерски продукти, изтънчени бизнес модели, като крайната цел е да вложат максимално усилие за собствения им културен и личен растеж.

И в заключение, Dan Brown е написал "Най-ценните неща в живота не могат да бъдат измерени – те могат да бъдат изживяни". Женската логика и страсти са неща, които не могат да бъдат обърнати в грамове или тонове. Те са част от живота, която приемаме цялостно. Тук логиката и емоциите понякога се сблъскват, но именно в това сблъсък най-хубавите идеи се раждат и се постигат най-брилянтните резултати. Победата винаги принадлежи на тези, които успяват да увеличат изгубените им моменти в живота, като извличат поука от тях и ги превръщат в технология.

How to Tape and Mud Drywall
Drywall installation is an important part of modern home construction and repair. With careful attention to detail, anyone can create a professional-looking finish. With a few tools, some time, and patience, you can learn to tape and mud drywall in order to achieve a level, unblemished surface.

Before working on any type of construction project, it is important to ensure the stability of your wall. Check that the drywall is attached to the wall studs correctly. Any weak points could be detrimental to your project’s success.

Minimize "butt" joints. These are the joints where two panels meet and the paper tape may not adhere as well as corner joints. A skilled professional can help ensure that your joints are in good shape before you begin taping and mudding.

Schedule an inspection, if necessary. If you are unsure of the stability of the wall or are concerned about potential weak points, it is best to consult a professional before beginning.

Understand that you will be putting on several coats. Mud-taping requires a series of applications and the initial coat will act as a base for the following layers. It is important to understand your timeline and budget enough time and material for each coat.

Get the right mud. If you are working with professional-grade drywall, you will want to use a professional-grade mud mix. Speak with a professional and do research if you are unsure.

Get enough mud for your job. It is important to accurately estimate the amount of mud you will need so you don't run out halfway through. This quantity must take into account the number of coats and the square-footage of the area to be worked on.

Find the right kind of knife (trowel). For working with drywall, it is important to have a wide blade for large patches and a narrow blade for areas of detail. If you are unsure of which size to use, both 6-inch (15.24 cm) and 10-inch (25.4 cm) trowels are suitable for the job.

Apply the first layer of mud. Use your trowel to spread a layer of mud over the patched areas. At this point, it is important to ensure complete coverage of the area.

When all the seams are filled, make a single pass over the freshly-mudded sections to smooth out the compound. Use your trowel to create a level surface and remove any excess mud.

Cut the paper tape to size. Typically, paper tapes come in rolls and must be cut to the necessary lengths for the type of joints. Generally, the tape must be slightly wider than the mudded corner.

Apply the joint tape. Place the paper tape over the seams and corners and use your trowel to press the tape into the mud. Make sure there are no gaps between the tape and the mud.

Seat the tape with your trowel. It is important to make sure the tapes are properly leveled in the mud.

Tape the inside corners. Before taping the inside corners, it is important to apply mud to the edges of the corner and then place the tape over the mud.

Cover the outside corners. Before taping the outside corners, first apply mudded beading around the corner and then cover with the paper tape.

Fill all screw holes with mud, and smooth over the surface. It is important to check all screw holes for sufficient coverage before continuing.

Wrap it up for the night. At the end of the day, it is important to ensure that the mud that has been applied has dried completely. Otherwise, it may not adhere correctly in the subsequent coats.

Make sure the first coat is absolutely dry — especially the inside corners at the ceiling. Wait until the mud is fully dry before continuing to the next coat.

Put on a dust mask every time you sand. Drywall dust can be hazardous to your health, so be sure to protect yourself before you sand.

Knock off. The next step is to knock off the excess mud from the seams. Use you trowel to pull the mud away from the dirt and then use a sponge to smooth out the edges.

If you worked to a smooth surface and there are no major bumps or pits, you don't need to sand. In this case, you can skip the sanding step and go directly to putting on the next coat of mud.

Use a 10-inch (25.4 cm) knife for the subsequent steps. This will help you ensure that your later coats have smooth edges and a round corner.

Feather the edges again if necessary. Once you have all the seams filled and the edges smoothed use a trowel to quickly draw the mud from the seams. This will help create a smooth transition between coats. 

Let dry overnight. After each coat of mudding, it is essential that you allow the mud to dry overnight.

Repeat the knocking off and sanding process. This will be necessary between every coat. Continue the process until you have the desired level of smoothness.

Make sure the mud is dry. The last layer of mud must be absolutely dry before you begin the next step. If the mud is not dry, it will not adhere adequately and potentially crack.

Learn how to finish drywall. Finishing drywall means applying a finish, often paint, to your drywall to give it a complete look.

Texture drywall, if desired. Texturing techniques give drywall an extra level of depth and dimension and can be applied for aesthetic purposes.

Prime and paint your drywall. At this point, it is essential that you prime your drywall before applying the paint. Priming will help ensure that the paint adheres properly and create a nicer, more professional-looking finish.

Learn about drywall. It is important to familiarize yourself with the parameters of drywall installation before beginning a project. Learn about the different tools and techniques available and determine what best suits your needs.

Know where drywall doesn't belong. Drywall is not suitable for all applications, so determine whether or not drywall is the best option for your project.

Handle drywall correctly. Dropping or bumping drywall will create dents and cracks in the corners. Take care when handling the drywall and consider a safe drop zone when lifting it onto the wall.

By following the steps above and having some basic knowledge of your project and the materials, you can successfully tape and mud drywall. With careful attention to detail, a little time and patience, you can achieve a professional-looking finish.

Nuclear fragmentation has been studied extensively over many decades, both experimentally and theoretically. The basic premise is that a nuclei breaks up into pieces in a process known as nuclear fragmentation. Both strong and electromagnetic interactions are involved, depending on the mass and charge of the nucleus. Many particles and fragments are created and each of these particles or fragments carry a certain amount of the original nuclei's kinetic energy, which can be expressed as a magnitude of kinetic energy per nucleon. This article presents a study of nuclear fragmentation patterns of $^{9}$Be, $^{14}$N, $^{7}$Be, and $^{8}$B nuclei as recorded in their alpha decay. It has been observed that $^9$Be, $^{14}$N, $^{7}$Be, and $^{8}$B alpha decay nuclei tend to break up into groups of three particles, with the third particle being the lightest of the four. In the case of $^9$Be and $^{14}$N, two of these three fragments have nearly the same mass, with the third fragment being lighter. In the case of $^{7}$Be and $^{8}$B, the two nearly equal mass particles are always the two lightest particles, while the third particle is typically either lighter or of an intermediate mass. This phenomenon is not fully understood, but is a subject of this study.

Jakarta, CNN Indonesia -- Belakangan ini, masyarakat Medan digemparkan dengan kabar adanya bawang merah 'palsu' asal India yang beredar di pasar. Hal ini membuat masyarakat menjadi was-was dan khawatir akan dampak kesehatan yang dapat ditimbulkan akibat konsumsi bawang merah tersebut. Berikut kronologi dari penemuan bawang merah 'palsu' asal India sampai beredar di Medan. Pertama kali ditemukan, bawang merah tersebut masuk melalui pelabuhan Barangay, Filipina dengan tiga kontainer yang dinyatakan sebagai bawang merah asal India. Kontainer tersebut tiba di pelabuhan Belawan, Medan pada tanggal 3 Agustus 2021. Kemudian, bawang merah 'palsu' tersebut diangkut menuju PT BNN (Badan Narkotika Nasional) Medan untuk dilakukan pemeriksaan. Setelah melalui pemeriksaan yang dilakukan oleh PT BNN Medan, bawang merah dianggap tidak layak edar di Indonesia karena tidak memenuhi persyaratan kesehatan dan akan dibawa kembali ke pelabuhan Belawan untuk dikembalikan ke India oleh PT Pelabuhan Indonesia I (Persero). Namun, setelah melalui beberapa proses pengembalian, terdapat sejumlah bawang merah yang tidak dikembalikan ke India. Hal ini disayangkan oleh PT Pelabuhan Indonesia I (Persero) karena bawang merah tersebut seharusnya tidak boleh beredar di Indonesia karena tidak memenuhi persyaratan higienis dan kesehatan. Lalu, bawang merah 'palsu' yang sebenarnya dilarang untuk beredar di Indonesia tersebut berhasil masuk ke pasar Medan dan menimbulkan kekhawatiran masyarakat. Bawang merah tersebut diduga dijual di beberapa pasar tradisional di Medan dengan harga yang lebih murah dibandingkan dengan bawang merah asli yang diproduksi di Indonesia. Menyikapi hal ini, Kepala Dinas Perdagangan Kota Medan, Fadli Nasution menyatakan bahwa pihaknya akan melakukan langkah-langkah untuk menyelidiki dan menjaga ketersediaan bahan pokok yang aman dan layak konsumsi di masyarakat. Selain itu, pihak kepolisian juga akan mengusut kasus penyebaran bawang merah 'palsu' tersebut. Masyarakat diminta untuk berhati-hati dan selalu membeli bahan pangan dari sumber yang terpercaya dan telah mendapat sertifikat kesehatan dari Badan Pengawasan Obat dan Makanan (BPOM). Kita harus bersama-sama memastikan ketersediaan bahan pokok yang aman dan tidak membahayakan kesehatan masyarakat. Itulah kronologi dari penemuan bawang merah 'palsu' asal India sampai beredar di pasar-pasar tradisional di Medan. Pemerintah diharapkan dapat menindak tegas para pelaku yang menyebarkan makanan tidak layak konsumsi di masyarakat. Kita semua harus bersama-sama memperhatikan aspek kesehatan dan keselamatan dalam memilih dan mengonsumsi bahan pangan.

The Naval Intelligence Department was the British government's intelligence agency responsible for gathering information about foreign navies and shipping, as well as other maritime interests of Britain's enemies during World War II.  It also had responsibility to gather information on enemy aircraft carriers in order that they might be destroyed by air attack or mines laid under them.   The department operated from its headquarters at Admiralty Arch in London until it moved into new premises near Buckingham Palace after the war ended.

Can a network of nodes self-organize without the aid of any existing positional information or attractive forces? Can the processes of creating positional information and forming links between nodes run simultaneosly as a sort of mutually advancing process? This paper proposes an approach where the formation of links is achieved through the collective activities of multiple specialized units, or agents. These agents communicate with each other, remember and exchange information throughout the system. The key information emerges through an evolutionary dynamic that favors particular connections and amplifies them.

Праздничный день начался с немецких обстрелов. Горнилось от клинов бумеранга, и в любое время суток могли взлететь в небо рваные снаряды. На первый план вышла разоблаченная улица — обоих краев замусоренной тротуарной плиты терзала страсть добыть суровое топливо, причем в опасности своей жизни. Сухость и погодная иллюзия зимнего дня преследовали нас всюду: снег с крыш и трамваев не сдавались будням, которые, к сожалению, мы и так находились под периодическим обстрелом, заставляя каждый раз отъезжать от столицы, дабы искать племянную защиту и благополучную судьбу. Уже по полудню было замечено, что немецкому флоту даже не удалось проявить боеспособность на почти всех линиях и районах. Нельзя не упомянуть пострадавших и такой печальный факт, как происшествие в детской консультации на 21-й линии. И все мы прошли мертвецким страхом уже не первый, а как указано выше — уже многие долгие дни. А как относися к такой ситуации люди, которые скрепляли выживание на режиме хлеба и пива? Трудно себе представить, что такое - понимать безрассудность того, кто торгует жизнями, и борониться против него на своей почве, часто оставшись с видом одиночества. Но это далеко не опустошение — ведь мы страстно отваживались продолжать хранить в сердцах ту честь и ценности, которые нас мотивировали. И так у истории есть свои корни, и у нас — надежда.

Armenian needlelace, also known as oya or nazaret needle lace, is a delicate form of lace-making that has been popular among Armenians for centuries. It is a traditional art form that has been passed down from generation to generation, and it continues to be practiced today around the world. The technique involves creating lace using just a needle and thread, without the use of any looms or other equipment. The lace is made by inserting the needle into the fabric and creating loops that are then twisted and intertwined with other loops to create intricate patterns and designs. Armenian needlelace is often used to decorate clothing, such as shirts, blouses, and scarves, and it is also used to create tablecloths, bedding, and other home decor items. The lace is known for its intricate and delicate patterns, which include flowers, leaves, and geometric designs. In addition to being a popular form of traditional art, Armenian needlelace has also played a significant role in Armenian folk tales and songs. It is said that the lace was created by an Armenian princess who was skilled in needlework and embroidery. According to legend, the princess was kidnapped by a rival kingdom, but she was able to escape by using her needlelace to tie together a rope and climb down from her tower. Today, Armenian needlelace is enjoyed and practiced by people around the world, including in Armenia, Turkey, Greece, and the United States. There are many workshops and classes available to learn the technique, and the lace is widely available for purchase in markets and online.

We present a theoretical study of cosmological fluids which includes second-order perturbations that account for relativistic effects of pressure, multi-component, curvature, and rotation. This investigation aims to provide a more accurate understanding of the behavior of fluids in the universe and its effect on the evolution of large-scale structures. 

To achieve this goal, we use the Poisson gauge and linear perturbation theory to derive the equations of motion and the conservation laws for multi-component fluids. We also take into account the relativistic effects of pressure, curvature, and rotation resulting from the presence of gravitation. In particular, our approach includes the effects of pressure anisotropies and thermal energy transfer between components.

Our results show that relativistic effects play a significant role in the evolution of multi-component fluids, affecting, for instance, the growth rate of density perturbations and the amplitude of gravitational waves. We find that pressure anisotropy generates a new relativistic effect that modifies the density fluctuation and alters the gravitational wave spectrum. Additionally, we demonstrate that thermal energy transfer between different components affects the amplitude of the gravitational wave and could be detected in future observations.

In summary, our study reveals fundamental insights into the behavior of cosmological fluids, including relativistic effects of pressure, multi-component, curvature, and rotation. These results are essential for understanding the formation of structures in the universe, and they have significant implications for cosmological observations.

How to Charge a Dead Car Battery
Charging a car battery that has gone dead requires the use of jumper cables and a functional, charged battery. By following the steps outlined below, you can successfully recharge a dead car battery and get your car back up and running.

Before attempting to jump start the dead battery, it’s important to ensure that all safety precautions are taken. Always wear protective glasses and gloves when handling a car battery and check to make sure that all batteries have adequate ventilation. Make sure the car is in a well-ventilated area with no combustible materials nearby.

Now it’s time to start. Begin by opening the hood or compartment on each vehicle in which the batteries are located. Take note of the positive and negative terminals on each battery. It’s important to ensure that you are connecting the jumper cable to the correct battery terminal, or else you may cause damage to the car or create a safety hazard.

Now, you’ll be ready to connect the cables. Connect each end of the positive jumper cable to the positive terminals on each battery. Then, connect one end of the negative jumper cable to the negative terminal on the functional, charged battery. Attach the other end of the negative jumper cable to a grounded metal component of the car that contains the dead battery.

At this point, you’ll be ready to start the engine. Start the engine of the car with the charged battery. This will kickstart the charging process. Allow at least five minutes to pass after starting the engine of the car with the charged battery.

At this point, try to start the engine of the car that contains the dead battery. This will help to recharge the battery. If the car does not start, repeat the process of connecting and disconnecting the jumper cables from the batteries.

Once the car with the dead battery successfully starts, disconnect and remove the jumper cables from each car in the reverse order in which you connected them. This means that you will need to disconnect the negative cable from the grounded metal component of the car before disconnecting both positive cables.

Finally, allow the car which had the dead battery to continue running for at least another five minutes. You may also choose to drive the jump-started car for at least 20 minutes or allow it to idle for the same amount of time. This will ensure that the battery is fully recharged and will guarantee the vehicle’s continued reliability.

Characterized by its smooth handling and precision accuracy, the SIG P210 features a single-action trigger and a weight between 900 and 1,000 grams depending on the model. The P210 is crafted with a steel frame and slide and comes in several variations, including the P210-4, P210-5, and P210-6. The P210-4 was used by the Swiss military and was made in 9mm, .30 Luger, and 7.65mm Browning; the P210-5 is chambered in .22lr, commonly used in competitive shooting; and the P210-6 features a magazine disconnect, allowing the pistol to only fire when the magazine is inserted. The P210 is a firearm with a rich history. In addition to being used by the Swiss Army and marking Switzerland's neutrality during wars, it was adopted by several other military forces and police departments worldwide. In 1949, the French government acquired the rights to produce the P210, which was then manufactured by Manurhin until it discontinued production in 1978. Today, the SIG P210 remains a popular choice among competitive shooters and collectors due to its precision and build quality. The gun has been modernized over the years but still maintains the original design elements that have made it a classic firearm.

Carmen Callil ist eine australisch-britische Verlegerin und Autorin. Geboren wurde sie am 24. Mai 1938 in Melbourne, Australien. Die Familie wanderte später nach Großbritannien aus. Callil studierte Geschichte am Newnham College der Universität Cambridge. 1964 begann sie eine Karriere im Verlagswesen, als sie in der Werbeabteilung des Verlages Hutchinson anfing. Ein Jahr später wechselte sie zur Verlagsgruppe Jonathan Cape, wo sie bald zur Leiterin der Taschenbuchabteilung aufstieg. 1972 gründete sie zusammen mit Virago Press die Verlagsgruppe Women’s Press, dessen Ziel es war, das Bild der Frau in der Literatur zu verbessern und Bücher von Frauen für Frauen zu veröffentlichen. So wurden im Rahmen des Verlags zum Beispiel Werke von als feministischen Autorinnen geltenden Schriftstellerinnen wie Margaret Atwood und Angela Carter veröffentlicht. Nach 20 Jahren verließ sie Women's Press, um eine Beratungsfirma für Verlage zu gründen. Hier war sie unter anderem für den deutschen S. Fischer Verlag tätig. Callil verfasste auch selbst Bücher. 1998 veröffentlichte sie eine Biographie über den Arzt Georges Canguilhem. Sie schrieb auch die Biographie S., in der sie eine fiktive Lebensgeschichte von Virginia Woolf erzählt, die im Englischen Original 2019 erschien. Von der Sunday Times wurde sie 1997 zu einer der 50 bedeutendsten Britinnen gewählt. Callil ist auch Gründerin der Indie Book Awards und war später eine der Gründerinnen des Man Booker International Prize.2021 gab Callil bekannt, die Zusammenarbeit mit ihrem Verlag Vintage zu beenden, weil das Unternehmen ihr den Erwerb der Rechte an einer Biografie über Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie verweigert hatte. Sie bezeichnete die Entscheidung Vintages als rassistisch und erklärte, sie werde in Zukunft keine Bücher mehr bei Vintage veröffentlichen. Callil hat auch in anderen Zusammenhängen Rassismus öffentlich angeprangert und sich für mehr Diversität im Verlagswesen eingesetzt. Carmen Callil lebt in London.

Gamma-ray production in young open clusters: Berk 87, Cyg OB2 and Westerlund 2

We present a comparison of thegamma-ray fluxes from the young open clusters Berk 87, Cyg OB2 and Westerlund 2 in the form of compensated counts per second per unit area. The data were obtained with theDutch-Italian detector Array of Germany (DIAG), an imaging spectrometer sensitive in the energy range between150 keV and 10 MeV, mounted on the 2.2-m telescope of the European Space Agency's Infrared Space Observatory(ISO). We find that the counts per second per unit area, in the energy range between 200 keVand 3 MeV, is 5.7 ± 2.3 counts in Berk 87, 1.3 ± 1.1 counts in Cyg OB2 and 2.3 ±0.8 counts in Westerlund 2. We conclude that thegamma-ray emission in the clusters is due to the radioactive decay of thorium and uranium. We finda proportionality between the measured gamma-ray flux and the cluster's estimated thorium content, which is inagreement with the predictions of the model of 1996, but in agreement with later models. Thedeviation of the measured gamma-ray flux from the predictions of the 1996 model is explained by aself-absorption effect in the clusters, caused by the high-Z gas in the clusters. We found noevidence for a correlation between the cluster's gamma-ray and radio fluxes. The measuredemission is consistent with the assumption that the gamma rays are produced in the same region as themCluster Radio Telemetry (CRT) emission, but at a larger distance from the centre of the cluster.
