Най-големите британски банки ще преминат през стрес тестове с дълбока рецесия: Investor.bg

Тази година най-големите британски банки ще преминат през стрес тестове, които са още по-тежки от тези, които са били провеждани в миналото. Целта е да се проверят техните финансови показатели в случай на дълбока рецесия или нагло намаление на Икономическия растеж. Тестовете ще помогнат на банките да установят допълнителни мерки за намаляване на рисковете и да получат по-детайлна представа за състоянието на портфейлите им.

Стрес тестовете са стандартен начин за оценка на финансовите институции. Те помагат на регулаторните организации да изяснят възможните рискове и да установят, дали банките имат достатъчно ликвидност и капитал, за да могат да издържат на кризи. През последните няколко години, тези тестове са се превърнали в неотменна част от рутината на британските банки, като се провеждат на всеки две години.

През 2021 година тестовете ще се провеждат под новите условия, които са възникнали в резултат на пандемията от Covid-19. Тъй като Съединеното кралство е прието към последвалите след това мерки за локдаун, голяма част от икономиката е била затворена за определен период от време, което е довело до сериозна спад на икономическата активност и нивата на безработицата.

В случай, че тази година не тръгнат нещата по очаквания начин за британската икономика, банките трябва да бъдат готови за евентуална икономическа рецесия. В тези условия най-големите британски банки - Barclays, HSBC, Lloyds Banking Group, NatWest Group (бившата Royal Bank of Scotland) и Standard Chartered ще бъдат подложени на тежки стрес тестове. Те ще трябва да покажат, че могат да издържат на значително намаление на икономическия растеж и други изменения в икономическата среда.

Тестовете ще бъдат проведени от Присъда на излишък (BoE) и Управлението на финансовата надзорност (PRA). Очаква се да бъдат оценени както устойчивостта на банките във финансови отношения, така и тяхната възможност да се изправят срещу негативните последици от икономическа рецесия. Ако резултатите на тестовете не са задоволителни, банките ще имат срок за изготвяне на планове за укрепване на финансовите си показатели.

Тестовете постигат две цели. Първо, те помагат на банките да намерят начини за намаляване на рисковете. Второ, те дават на инвеститорите повече представа за рисковете, които носи инвестирането в дадена банка. Тези цели са особено важни в момента, когато британската икономика се намира в несигурна ситуация.

Както и в миналото, най-големите британски банки ще бъдат на силно изпитание през тази година. Тестовете ще покажат дали те са подготвени за евентуалната дълбока икономическа рецесия и дали имат необходимите резерви, за да издържат на тези условия. За инвеститорите тези тестове представят възможност да се запознаят по-подробно с рисковете, които носят инвестициите в банките и да извлекат поуки за бъдещите си инвестиции.

The inelastic neutron scattering method has been used to analyze the thermal excitations of V-O and Y-Ba-Cu-O solid solutions. Features centered around 3meV and 5meV were observed in the neutron scattering spectra. These excitations can be explained through the creation of an effective potential of oxygen, resulting in a weakly upwards bottom at the xy plane of a tetragonal octahedron.After further examination, it was concluded that the O1 and O4 atoms of the Y-Ba-Cu-O, as well as the V-O system, were all located in a two-dimensional quantum-well, with a flat base formed by the surrounding atoms copper and barium. These observations suggest that the formation of gyration-like excitations, bolstered by exchange interactions in a matrix lattice, may be significant in modern solid state physics, particularly in explaining the high temperatures and superconducting transitions in high temperature superconductors.

Една от основните идеи на този проект е да се създаде стабилна структура, която може да издържи на променливото космическо около. Астероидите се движат непредсказуемо и не е лесно да се оцени кое място ще бъде най-подходящо за изграждането на небостъргача.

Това означава, че инженерите трябва да разработят система, която да позволява на стълбовете да се движат и да се адаптират към промените във външната среда. За да се постигне това, ще са необходими високотехнологични решения, които да бъдат интегрирани в структурата на сградата.

Въпреки тези технически трудности, идеята за проектиране на небостъргач, който да виси от астероид, има множество потенциални предимства. Тази концепция може да бъде използвана за изграждането на космически хотели и други структури, които да бъдат използвани от космически туристи.

Освен това, структурата може да бъде използвана като база за изследователски мисии в космоса. Ако структурата бъде изградена правилно, може да се използва като платформа за издигане на сензори, инструменти и други устройства, които да помогнат за научните изследвания.

Тази концепция може да има и важни приложения за бъдещето на човешката колонизация на други планети. Структурата може да бъде използвана като временна база за изграждане на други инфраструктури, които да подкрепят нашите усилия да изследваме и населим други планети.

We present a semi-analytic model of the evolution of terrestrial and habitable planets in multiple-star systems. We consider a wide range of system architectures, from simple binary to complex multi-major-body systems. We find that the gravitational interactions between the stars and the planets have a significant effect on the orbital dynamics of the planets, and in particular on the migration of planets to wider orbits. We find that these effects are so large that they can result in the ejection of terrestrial planets from the system, or their migration to orbits where they are unlikely to be habitable. We also consider the effects of the stellar and planetary masses, as well as the initial conditions. We find that the system evolutionary history has a significant effect on the outcome. In particular, we show that the planetary system is more likely to be stable if the planets are formed in a wide orbit, and subsequently migrate to their Habitable Zone (HZ). We also show that the system is more likely to be habitable if the planets are formed in a compact orbit and remain in that orbit throughout the system's evolution. We discuss the possibility that the long-term habitability of the planets in a given system can be improved by the controlled addition of new masses to the system, in order to drive the planets to wider orbits. We also discuss the effects of a system's evolution on the likelihood of the occurrence of habitual planets. We show that a system is less likely to contain habitable planets if the planets are formed in a wide orbit and subsequently migrate to their HZ, than if they are formed and remain in a compact orbit throughout the system's evolution.

In this study, we examined the temperature and frequency dependent impedance of an electroceramic functional oxide thermistor. Our motivation for conducting this research was to gain a deeper understanding of the impedance behavior of this thermistor and explore its potential applications in various electronic circuits. 

To achieve our research goals, we employed a series of measurements and analyses. First, we conducted a series of temperature-dependent impedance spectroscopy experiments to investigate the thermistor's impedance characteristics at different temperatures. Secondly, we performed a frequency sweep experiment to explore the frequency-dependent impedance behavior of the thermistor. Finally, we used the Cole-Cole plot to analyze the relaxation behavior of the thermistor impedance.

The results of our study revealed that the electroceramic functional oxide thermistor has a strong temperature dependence, exhibiting a typical negative temperature coefficient behavior. We also found that the impedance modulus of the thermistor decreased with increasing frequency. Furthermore, the Cole-Cole plot analysis showed that the thermistor exhibits a Debye-type relaxation behavior.

Overall, our research provides a comprehensive analysis of the temperature and frequency-dependent impedance behavior of the electroceramic functional oxide thermistor, which can serve as a foundation for future research on the development and application of this type of thermistor in electronic circuits and devices.

We present photometric, astrometric, and spectroscopic analysis of the possible triple system USCO160611.9-193532 AB, which has an unusually wide separation of approximately 1600 AU.  This system comprises two low-mass components (total mass of ~0.4 M_sun) that are associated with the nearby Upper Scorpius OB association. Our high-resolution observations suggest the primary be a close binary, further complicating the system. If confirmed, the triple system would represent a rare example of its kind. We also assess the likelihood of the system being physically associated by analysing the two-point correlation function of the association and find that 25% of Uppper Sco's low-mass members could be separated by 15" or less in projection. Ultimately, a systematic search for additional wide systems is required to establish an accurate picture of the wide binary population in Upper Sco. Detection of another such pair would provide evidence of excess with 98% confidence.

Anne Applebaum's assertion that The Gulag Archipleago effectively ended France's intellectual flirtation with Soviet communism is largely accurate. Given its publication in 1973 and its immense popularity, the book did have a large impact on the thinking of French intellectuals. It also created a large change in the way that intellectuals thought about Soviet processes and played a large part in the French people's evolving perceptions of the Soviet Union.

Prior to The Gulag Archipleago, French intellectuals, particularly those on the left of the political spectrum, had a great admiration for the Soviet Union, advocating the virtues of its egalitarian ideals and the justice its society supposedly provided. While it was well-known that the Soviet Union was not a democracy, intellectuals justified its actions under the guise of a ‘greater good’ and defended what it believed to be a more organized system than the chaos of capitalism.

The publication of The Gulag Archipleago, however, provided first-hand accounts of the oppressed state of Soviet citizens. This book exposed a grisly truth of harsh prison camps and an absolute lack of opportunity or freedom. It raised awareness of the reality of the Soviet Union, providing a stark contrast to the romantic view intellectuals had held faither to.

The impact of The Gulag Archipleago on French intellectuals was considerable as it told a different story than the one they had been fed by the Soviet Union. Western intellectuals who had defended Communism no longer could, as the book showed a much harsher element of the Soviet Union that had been hidden and manipulated by the state. 

Various thinkers such as Jean-Paul Sartre and Michel Foucault have since denounced Soviet communism and have since developed new theories and approaches to politics and the state. Whilst it was not the only factor, The Gulag Archipalago was a tipping point for French intellectuals, who saw it as a catalyst for change. 

In conclusion, due to the widespread influence it had and broke the romantic image of communism among intellectuals, Anne Applebaum's statement is largely accurate: The Gulag Archipleago certainly did have a significant impact on French intellectuals and effectively ended the long-standing French intellectual flirtation with Soviet communism.

This was, in part, to recognize the contributions and cultural significance of African American heritage, creating pride around African American heritage and history.

Many African American parents wanted to pass these traditions on to their children. Giving a baby “black” names like Jaquan and Damarius showed that African American families were proud of their heritage and history, and wanted to connect their children to those special African values.

The focus of the movement to use “black” names was to break the stereotypes around African American people and culture, and to encourage the acceptance and respect of the diversity of all people. We present a catalogue of low-resolution near-infrared photometry for 78 of the nearest stars to the Sun, drawn from a database of 5 million pixel images taken with the Hubble Space Telescope's Near Infrared Camera and Multi-Object Spectrometer. These data are used to derive the radii, temperatures, and ages of these stars. We find that the confirmed members of the Pleiades, or Seven Sisters, are between 200 and 400 million years old, but that there are many more members in this cluster than are currently listed. A new list of candidate members is presented, including many stars that are more than twice the age of the Sun. We show that many field stars with high proper motion that were previously considered to be members of the Pleiades are instead more distant stars. The ages of the suspected member stars are consistent with a Pleiades age of about 250 million years, with a margin of error of about 50%. This is in agreement with the results of an independent analysis of high-resolution spectroscopy of cluster members. The derived cluster properties are consistent with a simple model in which the cluster has grown by consecutive mergers of Horowitz-Ramsbottom (HR) clouds, the most recent of which was about 250 million years ago. We also present a catalog of mid-infrared photometry for this same group of 78 stars. We find that the mid-infrared colors are consistent with the stars being singly or doubly mantled by dust clouds.

The Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor on December 7, 1941, was a tactical masterstroke. It lured the United States into a two-front war in the Pacific and Europe and led to a long and bloody conflict in the Pacific. The Japanese Combined Fleet had attacked without warning, and the attack was a devastating success. In one day, the Japanese sank five battleships and damaged three. The attack killed 2,403 Americans and injured 1,178. The Japanese losses were less: 29 planes, five midget submarines, and fewer than 100 men.

However, the attack on Pearl Harbor was not the beginning of the war between Japan and the United States. Tensions had been growing between the two countries for more than a decade, fueled by Japanese aggression in China and the Pacific. The United States had placed an oil embargo on Japan in July 1941, after Japan invaded French Indochina (now Vietnam). The embargo meant that Japan could not import American oil. Without oil, the Japanese economy would grind to a halt. The United States demanded that Japan withdraw from China and Indochina and end its support for the Axis powers (Germany and Italy). Japan refused to back down. The two countries moved closer to war.

The Japanese had gambled that they could win a quick war against the United States. They were wrong. The Japanese had grossly overestimated the power of their navy and air force. The United States had more ships, planes, and soldiers. Japan had fewer resources and was poorly prepared for a long war. In the end, the United States won the war in the Pacific.

Eclipse is one of the most popular Integrated Development Environments (IDE) used for Java programming. It provides a variety of features such as code completion and debugging tools that make it easier for developers to create Java applications. If you're looking to download Eclipse IDE on a Windows operating system, then this guide is for you. Follow the steps below to download and install Eclipse IDE on your Windows machine.

Step 1: Go to the Eclipse Downloads website

The first step to download Eclipse IDE on a Windows operating system is to go to the Eclipse Downloads website. Simply open your web browser and type in https://www.eclipse.org/downloads/ in the address bar. Hit Enter, and the Eclipse Downloads page should open up.

Step 2: Choose the appropriate version of Eclipse IDE for your operating system and Java installation

Once you're on the Eclipse Downloads website, you'll see a list of different Eclipse IDE versions. Choose the appropriate version for your operating system and Java installation. For example, if you have a 64-bit version of Windows installed, then choose the 64-bit version of Eclipse IDE.

Step 3: Proceed with the download by clicking on the Green arrow pointing downward

After selecting the appropriate version of Eclipse IDE, you'll be directed to the mirror selection page. Choose a mirror and click on the green arrow pointing downwards to start the download.

Step 4: Unzip the file

The downloaded file will be a zipped folder, so in order to access its contents we need to unzip the file. Right-click on the file, choose "Extract All", and then follow the prompts to extract the files to a folder of your choice.

Step 5: Move Eclipse to the root of C:/ drive

Eclipse does not have an installer, so we need to move the extracted folder to the root of the C:/ drive. This makes it easier for us to access Eclipse later on.

Step 6: Run "eclipse", an application within the Eclipse folder

Open the Eclipse folder and look for the "eclipse" application. Double-click on it to run Eclipse.

Step 7: Create a shortcut to launch Eclipse with more ease

To launch Eclipse more quickly, create a shortcut on your desktop. Right-click on the eclipse application and select "Send to---> Desktop (Create short-cut)" OR "Pin to Start Menu" OR "Pin to Taskbar."

Step 8: Select workspace location

When you launch Eclipse for the first time, you'll be prompted to choose a workspace location. Browse and select the location of the workspace, then click OK. It is recommended to use the default location provided, but you can also select your own workspace. Check the box for "Use this as the default and do not ask again" and then click OK.

Step 9: Launch Eclipse and start coding

Once Eclipse finishes loading, the Welcome screen will open up. You have now successfully loaded Workbench, so go ahead and explore Eclipse. You can start coding Java applications by clicking on "File" > "New" > "Java Project."

Step 10: Restart your computer

Finally, restart your computer to ensure that all the changes take effect.

Congratulations! You have now successfully downloaded and installed Eclipse IDE on your Windows operating system.

Slaves in the United States were denied days off, holidays, and leisure time. This was due to the legal authority of the slaveholder and the power dynamics of the plantation. Generally, most slaves worked from sunrise to sundown, seven days a week. Slaves could be made to work most days of the year, with no holidays or vacations. 

Slaves in the United States were not allowed an allotted day off. This was due to the fact that their welfare was linked to the profitability of the plantation or estate for which they worked. Slaves could be made to work on days that were traditionally reserved for holidays, such as Christmas, Easter or Independence Day. In addition, slaves were not given paid vacations or weekends off. Even when the day's workload was done before sundown, slaves were expected to resume duties that evening, such as fixing meals and caring for livestock. 

However, some slaveholders did grant their slaves days off. For example, some slaveholders allowed slaves to have Sundays off, on the condition that they agreed to work on other days of the week. This form of 'compensatory labor' allowed slaves to have limited days off. Other slaveholders granted slaves a day off to visit family members on nearby plantations, as long as they returned on time and without any commotion. In addition, some slavery codes allowed Sunday afternoons off, and slaves were able to join in local religious observances. 

Overall, the majority of slaves did not have days off. Even when days off were given, they were not universally granted, and only happened at the discretion of the slaveholder. Days off for slaves were usually rare and infrequent, and lacked the full enjoyment of a rest day that free citizens enjoyed.

Evidence of simple mathematics, for example, counting, is widespread among pre-Columbian North American sites. Many of these sites contain large numeric systems with evidence of counting by twos, threes, fives, and units (e.g., rods and centimeters). Some sites contain evidence of complex mathematics, such as systems of linear measurement. Complex mathematics may have been used to model astronomical phenomena. Furthermore, some evidence suggests that pre-Columbian Native Americans may have used spatial reasoning to some extent. The earliest evidence of a sustained, organized society in the Americas has been dated to 12,000 years ago. This settlement, at Casas Grandes, Mexico, had a complex social and economic hierarchy, with an estimated population of 2,000 to 5,000 people. This complex society was able to develop and sustain a multi-tiered social and economic organization over a long period of time. Casas Grandes is one of the first urban centers in the pre-Columbian Americas. Around the beginning of the Common Era, based on archeological and ethnohistoric evidence, some Native American cultures in what is today the U.S. Southwest may have developed complex organization and trade in a context of warfare. This may have included the control of livestock herds, long-distance trading, and the storage of grain, some of which was cultivated. Recent evidence indicates that several Native American societies were capable of complex calculation and may have developed some form of mathematical thought. Analysis of artifacts at pre-Columbian Monte Verde, Chile, suggests that people there may have been able to perform simple geometrical calculations. The period circa A.D. 500–1000 in the northern Gulf Coast of the United States may have been a period of sustained mathematical activity. Several sites in this time period contain a remarkable number of counting sticks, an early precursor to the counting numbers of tens, twos, threes, and fours. Around A.D. 1000, the Onondaga people of the lower Susquehanna River valley in eastern New York may have been able to perform complex multi-step calculations, including several instances of triplets, which requires the use of three-step mathematical procedures. 热血动物和冷血动物的区别在于体温的维持方式。热血动物体内有恒温机制，可以自行维持体温，而冷血动物则受外界温度影响，其体温会随着环境温度的变化而变化。在内脏生理上，热血动物体内拥有心脏、血管、肺等器官，可以自行维持体温，而冷血动物则没有心脏、血管等器官，其体温受外界温度影响，无法自行维持体温。

عماطور أو البتولا (باللاتينية: Betula) هو جنس شجيرات وأشجار من عائلة البتولاوية (Betulaceae)، يتضمن ما يقارب 60 نوعاً موزعة حول العالم، منها الأنواع التي تنمو في المناطق المعتدلة والمتجمدة، ومنها التي تعيش في المناطق الصحراوية الجافة. يتميز شجر العماطور بأوراقه الرقيقة والمنشورة، وله ثلاثي الأغصان وله جذع ناعم ونحيف ولون اللون الفاتح للغاية. يمكن توفير الكثير من الفوائد الأنواع المختلفة من شجر العماطور في العلاج الطبيعي وفي الحرف اليدوية. وتحتوي الأوراق الرقيقة لشجر العماطور على مواد مغذية عديدة، تشمل الروتين والفلافونويد الذين يمكن أن يمنعوا تكون الجلطات في الدم، مما يخفض من خطر الإصابة بأمراض القلب والأوعية. كما تحتوي الأوراق على مضادات الأكسدة والأحماض الأمينية، التي تساعد على تحسين الهضم وتقليل التهاب المعدة. ويمكن أن يساعد العصير المستخرج من الأوراق في زيادة تدفق البول وخفض مستوى البوتاسيوم في الدم. ويمكن استخدام الشجيرات والأشجار الموجودة في جنس العماطور في العديد من الأغراض الحرفية والصناعية. فالخشب القوي وخفيف الوزن الموجود في شجر العماطور يمكن استخدامه في تصنيع الأدوات والأثاث، وفي صناعة المنتجات الورقية والكتب. كما تستخدم بعض الأنواع من العماطور في صنع الأشياء المنزلية والحرفية المزخرفة، مثل صناديق التخزين والأسرّة وحاويات الطعام. ويمكن أن تستخدم قشور شجر العماطور للحفاظ على الأمراض المزمنة، وتساعد أوراق العماطور في تهدئة النزلات البرد والمشاكل التنفسية بسبب خصائصها المضادة للالتهابات والتقيؤ. ويمكن زراعة العماطور بسهولة، إذ تنمو بمعدل سريع وعندما تكون ناضجة تكون مقاومة للعقرب والعث، مما يجعلها أحد الخيارات المفضلة للمزراعين وأصحاب الحدائق. كما يمكن استخدام شجر العماطور كنبات ديكور لإضفاء الطابع الطبيعي للمنزل أو الحديقة، بسبب فصل الشتاء الخاص به في الأوراق وتغير لون خشبه في الشمس. وهو جنس شجيرات وأشجار جميل يعد إضافة رائعة لأي مكان يتم زراعته فيه.

Нещо невероятно се случи в Германия с наш известен музикант и бежанец от Сирия - БЛИЦ

В музикалните кръгове на Германия и Европа младият музикант БЛИЦ си носи репутацията на талантлив и обещаващ изпълнител. Той има български корени и от малък ежедневно има усещането, че е свързан с източните земи. Но неговата история ще се промени, когато се запознае с Нуа, бежанец от Сирия.

БЛИЦ пътува далеч от родния си град, за да открие нови вдъхновения и постижения за своята музика, но съдбата го насочва към неотдавнашния бежанец Нуа. Двамата млади хора се запознават и започват да говорят за своите мечти, изживявания и музикални влияния.

Нуа търси нов живот в Германия, след като изгубва всичко в родната си Сирия. Той знае, че ще има трудности, но е настроен да се бори за благородната си кауза. Когато БЛИЦ чува за желанието му да стане музикант, решава да му помогне и му предлага да изпробва някои от своите инструменти.

Нуа е шокиран от ентусиазма на БЛИЦ и започва да учи да свири на китара. След няколко месеца той уже има своя банда и започва да свири на местни клубове и фестивали. БЛИЦ му помага да записва и публикува музиката си в интернет и споделя в социалните мрежи.

От съвместната им музика се ражда нов и неочакван жанр, който съчетава елементи от традиционната музика на изтока и съвременната електроника. Този нов жанр се оказва доста успешен и събира множество почитатели в цяла Европа.

Но историята на БЛИЦ и Нуа не приключва тук. Двамата музиканти започват да обикалят Германия и събират истории от хората, които са били принудени да напуснат домовете си в търсене на по-добър живот. Те записват музиката си на места, където хората живеят и работят, и отразяват реалността на една страна, която се променя бързо.

Но те не спират да се борят. Някои от песните им стават символ на надежда и мир и започват да се разпространяват в целия свят. БЛИЦ и Нуа стават своего рода посланици на музиката, която може да обедини хората в един глас и да превърне тъмните моменти в историята ни в светлина на мечтите.

То това, което започна като случайна среща на двама млади музиканти в Германия, се превърна в нещо невероятно. Техният ентусиазъм и теренен подход към музиката не само ги направи известни, но и направи разлика в живота на много хора. Те наистина показаха, че музиката може да бъде силна и единстваща сила, която може да преодолее границите и да помогне на хората да свържат душите си.

آخری دنوں سے ایک نئی تحقیق کے مطابق، ایفون پلس کے صارفین کو مختلف مسائل کا سامنا کرنا پڑ رہا ہے۔ اس تحقیق کے مطابق، ایفون پلس کے صارفین کو بطور ایک عام مسئلہ، بیٹری کی عمر کم ہونے کا سامنا کرنا پڑ رہا ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ، ایفون پلس کے صارفین کو ٹچ اسکرین کے مسائل، وائی فائی کنکشن کی کمزوری، اور ٹیکسٹ میسیجز کے مسائل کا سامنا بھی کرنا پڑ رہا ہے۔

Creating flames using Photobie is a fun way to spice up your pictures and projects. The great thing about this process is that it is relatively quick, and it doesn't require a lot of complicated tools or techniques. Plus, the results are often quite stunning. With a few simple steps, you can turn a boring picture into something spectacular. 

To create flames using Photobie, start by creating a new image with a white background; a typical size for this would be 400x300 pixels. Next, set the Primary Color to orange, and the Secondary color to red. From the small triangle next to the Fill Shape tool, choose Rectangle or Square, whichever you prefer. 

Adjust the settings for the rectangle in the top menu and check the gradient box. Then, drag out a rectangle or square on the white background. After that, use the Polygon Selection tool to click out the shape of a triangle over the gradient. Now, go to the triangle beside the Clone button in the Layer Manager and choose "Clone only the selected area on current layer". Add some definition to the triangle with a white line if desired. 

Next, switch out the primary color to white, and click on the small triangle beside the Draw Shapes selection. Choose Line this time. Uncheck the gradient option and lower the size to 5, then drag a line from the top of the triangle down at an angle to the base. Lower the opacity to about half. Pick up both the line and the triangle layers from the Layer Manager and select them. 

Click on the triangle beside the Merge button in the Layer Manager and choose Merge Remove. Go to Filter>Embedded Filters>Water and check the Smoothing option. Move the slider a little (either right or left) and click OK. Repeat a similar process in the Embedded Filters>Blur tab and choose the Gaussian Blur option, and move the slider a little to the right. 

Finally, use the Clone Tool in the Layer Manager and click it multiple times (5-6 or even more) to get as many flames as you need. Then, select each flame layer in the Layer Manager, one at a time, and use the Hand Move/Resize Tool to make each flame a different size. Make any necessary refinements to your graphic and then proceed to merge - remove all the parts except for the background. Voila, your flames are now ready to be used!

Апрель 2013 года запомнился Индии замедлением инфляции до минимального за 41 месяц уровня, который оказался в 4,89% в годовом выражении. Данные были представлены официальным источником, на который ссылается издание Bloomberg. По сравнению со значением мартовского индекса цен, который составлял 5,96%, это замедление говорит о улучшении возможностей Центробанка Индии по наращиванию мер монетарного стимулирования. Аналитики ожидали роста индекса почти на 5,54%, что свидетельствует о неожиданно низком показателе. 

Сообщается, что очередное снижение ключевой процентной ставки Резервного банка Индии на 0,25 процентного пункта до отметки в 7,25% было произведено 3 мая 2013 года. Это уже третье понижение за текущий год. 

Аналитики считают, что ослабление ценового давления и слабое экономическое развитие в стране позволят индийскому Центробанку продолжить стимулирование экономического подъема. Один из экспертов финансовой компании Religare Capital Markets Ltd., Тиртханкар Патнаик, уверен, что ключевая ставка института будет снижена еще на 0,75 процентного пункта до конца текущего финансового года, завершающегося в марте 2014 года. 

Несмотря на ожидаемый рост индекса оптовых цен на уровне 5,5%, Центробанк Индии предсказывает повышение ВВП на 5,7% в текущем финансовом году. Этот показатель выше, чем в предыдущем финансовом году, то есть в период с марта 2012 по март 2013 года. 

В целом, улучшение экономической ситуации в Индии благодаря мерам Центробанка, а также эффекту от замедления инфляции, позволяет стране уверенно выходить из сложной экономической ситуации.

Густонюз Пловдив - Новини | Извиха се опашки за хоби феста в Панаира

От момента, когато беше обявено, че Хоби Фест 2019 ще се проведе в град Панайор, град Пловдив се зареди с очаквания и надежди. Това беше последното издание на този мащабен хоби събитие и то представяше дребно време развлечение и веселие за всички любители на различните хоби в града.

На първият ден на фестивала излязоха доста опашки от глупости на неразрушима радост. Людете си изброиха любимите си сскачани хоби и започнаха да се наслаждават на играта. Игри като Magic The Gathering, Dungeons and Dragons, Role Playing са имали представители на сцената и търсеха феновете си.

От сцената също така се радваха и други целеви групи. Борснарите бяха радвали с игри и дадоха возможност на гостите да се убедят в последните им работи на реално място, магазините с геймърска обстановка предлагаха на посетителите своя богат избор от гейми и аксесоари, а без спирала между разнообразието от всякакви хоби беше налице и бойкотването вкъщи.

Фестивалът приключи на петият ден с хвърляне на първата хрона на терена и сватбено бīдце с маси на бившите участници. Фестивалът присъстваше в едно изискано и радостно ниво, с любовно и благонаказана публика, отлична музика и интересно възощщение на иновативните хоби. Стойността на това мащабно събитие е с небесно и защитно положение в град Пловдив и надяваме се, че ще се проведе по-често.

In this paper, we formulate the Hamiltonian cosmological dynamics in Friedmann universe using ADM decomposition. Since the total Hamiltonian is a constraint, we use the Abandoned Dirac procedure to introduce the time evolution for the phase space variables. The complete dynamics contains two secondary constraints, which can be used to eliminate two pairs of the canonical variables. After this process, the resulting system is described by one pair of the canonical variables and the symplectic two-form is completely defined. The quantization of the system is straightforward by using the correspondence between the classical and quantum variables. The physical inner product can be defined by two methods: one is using the conventional Schrödinger representation, and another is using the Berezin integral. In the former case, the Wheeler DeWitt equation is a Schrödinger-like equation. In the later case, the Wheeler DeWitt equation can be obtained by taking the normalization factor of the Berezin integral.

The detection and study of cosmic rays is one of the main goals for imaging atmospheric Cherenkov telescopes (IACTs). The background produced by these events can be reduced using different techniques, such as cuts on shower parameters or image cleaning algorithms. In this work we present an alternative method to reduce the background based on machine learning techniques. We use Random Forest classifiers trained with simulated data to identify cosmic-ray images among all recorded IACT images. This approach allows us to obtain results similar to those obtained with other methods but at lower computational cost. Finally, we apply our technique to real data taken with HESS-II telescope during its first year of operation. Our analysis shows that it is possible to improve the quality of reconstructed gamma-ray showers while reducing the number of rejected hadronic showers. 
 
 Keywords: Machine Learning; Cosmic Ray Identification; Image Cleaning; Gamma-ray Astrophysics; Hadronic Shower

Работодателите обвиниха регулатора за поскъпването на тока

Новите цени на електроенергията в България вдигнаха силно критиките на работодателите. Те обвиниха регулатора за поскъпването на тока и твърдят, че това ще доведе до сериозни проблеми за бизнеса.

Според работодателите новите цени на електроенергията ще предизвикат значително увеличение на разходите на фирмите и ще имат негативен ефект върху приблизително 40% от търговските и производствени дейности в страната.

Основната критика на работодателите е, че цените на електроенергията в сравнение с европейските са много високи, което прави бизнеса в България не конкурентоспособен на международния пазар. В същото време работодателите призовават регулатора да проведе допълнителни проверки и анализи, за да се определи дали новите цени на електроенергията са необходими и справедливи.

Един от най-големите проблеми е липсата на прозрачност в процеса на формиране на новите цени. Без ясни и разбираеми обяснения, работодателите трудно могат да разберат защо електроенергията в България е по-скъпа в сравнение с други страни в Европа.

Освен това, регулаторът може да намали разходите на електроенергията за бизнеса, като улесни конкуренцията в сектора. The generator coordinate method in time-dependent density-functional theory: memory made simple

We present a simple method to evaluate the exact eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the spatial Laplace operator in a time-dependent density-functional theory (TDDFT) calculation. The method, which we dub the generator coordinate method, is based on a formal similarity transformation of the time-dependent Kohn-Rostoker Green function (TDKGF) which yields a matrix representation of the Laplace operator in the basis of the coherent states of the TDKGF. The use of the generator coordinate method allows one to solve the eigenvalue and eigenvector problems in TDDFT calculations exactly, without the need for the introduction of any additional memory variables. We show that the method can be applied to both time-independent and time-dependent systems, and we present a thorough analysis of its application to a class of time-dependent systems for which the solution of the eigenvalue and eigenvector problems is particularly difficult.

Das Chateau de Commarque ist eine bedeutende mittelalterliche Felsenburg im Tal der Vézère in der französischen Region Nouvelle-Aquitaine. Die Anlage befindet sich in der Nähe des Dorfes Les Eyzies-de-Tayac, im Département Dordogne.
Die Chateau de Commarque war vor allem im 13. und 14. Jahrhundert ein wichtiger Verteidigungsposten im Südwesten Frankreichs und diente auch als Handels- und Kulturzentrum. Heute kann die Felsenburg besichtigt werden, der Besuch wird durch ein modernes Informationszentrum begleitet. Im Sommer finden zudem kulturgeschichtliche Veranstaltungen statt.
Die Burg, auf einem 80 Meter hohen Kalksteinfelsen gelegen, besteht aus mehreren Gebäuden, die in verschiedenen Jahrhunderten errichtet wurden. Die ältesten Überreste stammen aus dem 12. Jahrhundert. Der Komplex enthält eine Kapelle, Wohnräume und Stallungen sowie eine Zisternenanlage zur Wasserversorgung. Der Burggraben und Teile der Stadtmauer sind ebenfalls erhalten geblieben. Interessant sind auch die Felsenformationen, die das Chateau de Commarque umgeben und von denen aus ein Blick auf das Tal der Vézère möglich ist.
Im Laufe der Jahrhunderte wurde die Burg von verschiedenen Herrschaften bewohnt, darunter die Herren von Beynac und die Grafen von Périgord. In Kriegszeiten diente sie oft als Zuflucht für die umliegende Bevölkerung. Seit 1949 ist das Chateau de Commarque als Monument historique klassifiziert. Die Anlage ist ein beliebtes Ausflugsziel und wird von zahlreichen Touristen besucht.

The Japanese Supreme Council met to discuss the Potsdam Declaration, which demanded unconditional surrender.  They decided to ignore the Declaration, and instead asked the Soviet Union to act as an intermediary in negotiating a surrender.  The USSR was still at war with Japan, and agreed to negotiate on the condition that they would get territorial and economical concessions in return for their help.

August 9th, 1945: The United States dropped a second atomic bomb, this time on Nagasaki.  Emperor Hirohito decided to intervene and accept the terms of the Potsdam Declaration, rather than continue to fight a war that was clearly not going in their favor.  The Allies were now demanding unconditional surrender, so the Japanese government had to accept the terms, despite the Soviets backing out of the deal and not receiving the concessions they had wanted.  Many of Hirohito's advisers opposed surrender, but the Emperor made his wishes clear, and the decision was made to accept the Allied terms of surrender.

The decision to surrender was not easy for the Japanese government to make.  Many of Hirohito's advisers were opposed to surrender, and there was much disagreement about what the best course of action would be.  However, the Emperor made it clear that he favored surrender, and the government eventually agreed to accept the Allied terms.

It is believed that they were, at one point, aware that they were the first civilization and, therefore, named their settlements accordingly. Of course, this is just a theory. Either way, the exact circumstances of their discovery are lost to the mists of time. Either way, at some point between the years 3500 – 3000 BC, they began an inscription that spanned several thousand years and was discovered in 1952. The inscription was written in Sumerian cuneiform, and is now known as the "Diplodocus (Don’t Know How Many) Law," as it appears to be a form of legal code.

Jakarta, CNN Indonesia -- Kepolisian Daerah Sumatera Utara (Polda Sumut) berhasil menetapkan empat orang tersangka dalam kasus tenggelamnya Kapal Motor (KM) Sinar Bangun pada Juni 2018 lalu. Empat tersangka itu adalah Bosco, Suprapto alias Pato, Daryono, dan Hartanto alias Haji Udin. Polisi menjerat empat tersangka dengan Pasal 304 KUHP tentang kelalaian dalam pengawasan kendaraan bermotor yang mengakibatkan kematian. Kepala Bidang Humas Polda Sumut Kombes Tatan Dirsan Atmaja mengatakan, empat tersangka dijerat dengan Pasal tersebut karena tidak memenuhi persyaratan keamanan laut saat menjalankan usaha transportasi laut. "Tersangka kerap melakukan kelalaian saat berlayar dengan kapal yang mengakibatkan terjadinya kecelakaan laut," ujar Tatan dalam konferensi pers di Medan, Rabu (21/11). Tatan menjelaskan, pada saat kecelakaan KM Sinar Bangun, Bosco selaku pemilik kapal tidak menjamin keamanan penumpang dan tidak memeriksa fungsi peralatan keselamatan kapal. Selain itu, Suprapto dan Daryono selaku nakhoda dan juru mesin juga dinilai lalai dalam menjalankan kapal. "Hartanto alias Haji Udin, selaku pegawai pelabuhan, juga dinilai lalai dalam melakukan tugas pengawasan di pelabuhan," katanya. Tatan mengatakan, setelah dilakukan penyelidikan selama lima bulan, empat tersangka akhirnya ditetapkan sebagai tersangka dan ditangkap pada Selasa (20/11). "Empat tersangka Kami tangkap di lokasi yang berbeda-beda dengan barang bukti hasil penggeledahan yang cukup lumayan," tuturnya. Kasus tenggelamnya KM Sinar Bangun terjadi pada tanggal 19 Juni 2018 lalu. Kapal yang membawa puluhan penumpang ini tenggelam di Danau Toba Sumatera Utara. Saat itu, KM Sinar Bangun sedang melaju dengan kecepatan tinggi dan dihantam gelombang besar. Kejadian ini merenggut nyawa 21 orang penumpang dari total 79 orang yang berada dalam kapal. Selain itu, juga mengakibatkan 33 orang lainnya hilang dan empat orang dinyatakan selamat. Polisi menyelidiki kasus ini dengan cara yang cukup rumit. Setelah melakukan penyelidikan yang cukup lama, akhirnya empat tersangka berhasil ditetapkan pada hari ini. Kepolisian juga masih akan terus melakukan investigasi lebih lanjut dalam kasus ini.

In this study, we investigated the failure mechanisms and surface roughness statistics of fractured Fontainebleau sandstone using a combination of experimental and numerical techniques. The scientific motivation for this research is to improve our understanding of rock fracturing and to develop better models for predicting fracture patterns in large-scale engineering projects such as geothermal energy production and CO2 sequestration. Our results show that Fontainebleau sandstone exhibits a complex pattern of fractures that is strongly influenced by the orientation of pre-existing flaws and the strength of the rock matrix. We observed that fracture surfaces have a distinctive roughness pattern characterized by a power-law scaling behavior that is consistent with previous studies of other types of rock. However, we also found that the specific parameters of the power-law scaling depended on the type of loading and initial flaw geometry. To validate our experimental observations, we developed a numerical model based on the discrete element method that was able to reproduce the key features of the fracture patterns. Our study highlights the importance of accounting for heterogeneity and anisotropy in predicting rock fracturing behavior, and provides insights into the fundamental mechanisms governing this process.

Family Equality Council is an American non-profit organization that works to advance legal and lived equality for Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, and Queer (LGBTQ) families, and for those who wish to form them. Founded in 1979 as the National March on Washington for Lesbian and Gay Rights, the organization was originally a collection of advocacy groups representing the interests of bisexual, transsexual, and intersex people in the LGBT community. It has since grown to become America’s largest national organization with a focus on family equality. The organization is comprised of three main offices, located in Washington, D.C., Los Angeles, California and Boston, Massachusetts. Within these offices, professionals are dedicated to carrying out their mission to create a world in which all families are celebrated, respected and supported. By developing best practices and providing professional training, legal expertise, public education, and public policy initiatives. The Family Equality Council is also known for its annual Impact Awards, which celebrates individuals, organizations, and corporations doing groundbreaking work to advance LGBTQ family rights. The recognition ceremony is held each year in the spring. This event is held in lieu of the original National March on Washington for Lesbian and Gay Rights. In addition to advocating for LGBTQ family rights, Family Equality Council also supports a range of programs to strengthen and sustain LGBTQ families, such as their Family Builders Program. This program helps individuals and couples form families through either adoption or foster parenting. The Family Equality Council is also well known for their massive influencer and virtual outreach campaign, #WeAreFamily. This campaign works to raise awareness about the discrimination that LGBTQ families face and helps dispel common myths associated with LGBTQ families. The Family Equality Council has achieved success in the form of tangible legal change, with increasing levels of marriage equality achieved across states since their founding. Their ongoing commitment to making LGBTQ families visible and supported continues to have a positive impact on the families they serve. In 2020, the Family Equality Council celebrated their 40th anniversary. To commemorate this milestone, the organization is working to create a major network of virtual events, LGBTQ Resource Contact Centers, and community outreach initiatives. Through their advocacy, policy, and programs, Family Equality Council continues to work to ensure that all families and households in the US, regardless of their structure, are respected and protected.

India Pagan India Pagan (born December 8, 1979) is an American politician who is a member of the South Carolina House of Representatives, representing the 39th district. She was first elected in 2018, winning the Democratic primary with 67.9% of the vote and the general election with 65.5% of the vote. Pagan is the first openly LGBTQ+ woman to be elected to the South Carolina General Assembly. Pagan is a graduate of South Carolina State University and works as a program manager for the South Carolina Department of Health and Environmental Control. In 2015, she was appointed to the South Carolina Human Trafficking Task Force by then- governor Nikki Haley. In 2018, Pagan was the first person to come out as a lesbian in the South Carolina General Assembly. She was also the first person to have a same-sex wedding in the State House. Pagan married her wife, Jamie, in 2015. In 2019, Pagan was the only openly LGBTQ+ person to be elected to the South Carolina General Assembly. In 2021, she was one of four openly LGBTQ+ people serving in the General Assembly, alongside Rep. Todd Atwater (R-Spartanburg), Rep. John McColl (R-Spartanburg), and Sen. Mike Fanning (R-Chesterfield).

In distributed sensing, the amount of data generated is often proportional to the size of the region being sensed. One approach to scale sensing efforts is to partition the region into smaller segments, each with a small field of view (FOV). In this approach, computation is performed locally at each sensing node and data aggregation is only needed within a segment. Compared with the traditional approach that requires all sensing nodes to communicate with a fusion center, the estimation diversity and energy efficiency can be significantly improved by leveraging local computation at each node. However, it is not clear how to perform distributed optimization for parameter estimation without any global communication, which could potentially consume significant energy. In this work, we propose a novel distributed algorithm that performs estimation by locally computing the gradient of the cost function at each node and by efficiently communicating a small amount of information among neighboring nodes. Numerical results show that the proposed algorithm can achieve similar estimation accuracy as the centralized algorithm while reducing energy consumption by 60% for a network of nodes with homogeneous computation and communication capabilities.' The rest of the paper is organized as follows. Section II presents related work. Section III describes the network model and problem statement. Section IV presents the gradient computation and communication based algorithm. Section V presents the numerical results. Finally, Section VI concludes the paper.

This research examines the changes in the superconducting characteristics, as well as the crystal structure, of MgB2 single crystals which have been substituted with Li, and co-substituted with Li-C. It has been determined that the introduction of holes into the lattice through Li substitution decreases the critical transition temperature Tc of the crystal, albeit at a slower rate than in the case of electron doping with elements such as Al or C. Additionally, when both Li and C are involved together, the Tc of the MgB2 crystal decreases even more severely. Examination of the temperature dependences of the upper critical field Hc2 for crystals of equivalent Tc with differing substitution levels has revealed that the Hc2 behaviour is similar in both hole and electron doped crystals. It is thought that this may be due to holes from Li occupying the pi band, while electrons from C filling the sigma band. Transport measurements have demonstrated a subsequent increase in resistivity in both Li-substituted and Li-C co-substituted crystals, which could be attributed to the formation of defects arising from the lattice distortions caused by substitution. It appears that both the introduction of carriers and newly created scattering mechanisms play a role in seeing changes in both Tc and Hc2.

أوسركاف هو رجل دين مسلم تركي الأصل ولد في عام 1914 في قرية بكيركوي في منطقة "ديجارتاش"، التي تقع في جنوب شرق تركيا وتعد منطقة تشهد صراعاً بين الجيش التركي وحزب العمال الكردستاني. أوسركاف حصل على تعليمه الأولي في مدرسة المؤسسة الإسلامية العالية في العاصمة التركية أنقرة وحصل على الشهادة الثانوية من مدرسة "إيفادي" في مدينة أدانة. وقد تخرج في كلية اللاهوت الإسلامي في عام 1940. كان يعتبر المرجعية الروحية لكثير من المسلمين المحافظين في التركية. تلقى أوسركاف تدريبه الديني في مختلف الدول الإسلامية حول العالم ولهذا اكتسب معرفة بكثير من ثقافات المسلمين والعرف الإسلامي في دول أخرى. يعتبر أوسركاف من أهم رجال الدين الإسلاميين الذين نشروا الإسلام في تركيا، ودافع بشكل قوي عن الإسلام وعن حقوق الإخوة المسلمين في تركيا. يعتبر أوسركاف اليوم شخصية هامة في العالم الإسلامي، ويحظى بتقدير كبير في الأوساط الإسلامية والسياسية في تركيا. حيث اعتبره البعض بالزعيم الروحي لتيار الإسلام الحديث في تركيا وهو المعروف بـ"النورجول" أي "الربيع الإسلامي". واستطاع تأسيس أكثر من ألف مؤسسة إسلامية في المجتمع التركي من أجل إبراز الجوانب الإيجابية للإسلام وإعادة بناء الثقافة الدينية الإسلامية في تركيا. وقد أقام أوسركاف علاقات طيبة مع علماء المسلمين في العالم العربي والإسلامي بشكل عام ودعا العلماء الأمريكان إلى الإسلام، كما أثرت أفكاره في العديد من الحركات الإسلامية المعاصرة في تركيا، منها حزب العدالة والتنمية الذي وضع الأساس لإحداث تغييرات إيجابية في الحياة السياسية في تركيا. وبعد انتخاب أردوغان رئيساً لتركيا في عام 2003، تم دعوته للعديد من الاجتماعات العلنية واللقاءات الخاصة مع الرئيس وأفراد الحكومة. على إثر وفاته في عام 2017، شهدت تركيا والأعراف الإسلامية الإقليمية حالات من الحداد لفترات مختلفة.

The SIM PlanetQuest mission is the most promising near-term technique for detecting, finding masses, and determining three-dimensional orbits of nearby habitable planets.  This article describes how SIM PlanetQuest will find these planets by measuring their astrometric wobble as they transit in front of their parent stars.   It also discusses how SIM PlanetQuest can be used to detect other types of exoplanets such as those with large orbital eccentricities or that are on highly inclined orbits relative to our line-of-sight.    Finally, it presents some preliminary results showing what we might expect to learn about extrasolar planetary systems using this new instrumentation. There have now been more than 300 confirmed exo-planets discovered orbiting distant stars through various techniques including radial velocity measurements, photometric transits, direct imaging, and microlensing events [1] . However, all but two of these planets were found around relatively bright host stars (V < 12). These planets are typically massive gas giants with short periods of days to weeks [2] , making them difficult targets for detailed studies aimed at understanding the physical conditions necessary for life. Jakarta, CNN Indonesia -- Komisi Pemilihan Umum (KPU) Kabupaten Wonosobo menjalankan tugasnya dengan sangat serius saat merealisasikan distribusi logistik untuk Pemilihan Gubernur (Pilgub) Jawa Tengah yang akan digelar pada 27 Juni 2018 mendatang. Terutama di wilayah desa yang terpencil, KPU Kabupaten Wonosobo memastikan bahwa logistik sampai dengan aman. Meskipun jalan menuju desa-desa terpencil tersebut sangat terjal dan berbahaya, tak satu pun dari rapat topik yang diadakan oleh KPU serta kepolisian akan menyerah. Distribusi logistik Pilgub di Wonosobo diawasi ketat oleh kepolisian dengan mendatangkan personil yang ada, yang jumlahnya lebih dari cukup. "Kami sadar bahwa di Wonosobo, banyak desa yang berada di wilayah terpencil. Oleh karena itu, kami melakukan langkah yang cukup untuk memastikan bahwa logistik sampai aman setiap tempat," ujar Ketua KPU Kabupaten Wonosobo, Priyo Karsono. Ia menambahkan bahwa setiap daerah di Wonosobo telah memperoleh instruksi secara terperinci mengenai bagaimana menangani distribusi logistik yang akan diterima. Setiap instruksi harus dilakukan dengan teliti dan jangan melupakan situasi keamanan yang ada. Ada beberapa desa yang selama ini hanya bisa dijangkau dengan penggunaan kendaraan off-road. Jalur ini bisa sangat sulit dan membahayakan, dan sebagian besar pengemudi pengelola logistik mungkin tidak memilikinya sehingga perlu dimonitor dengan baik. Kepolisian menjaga sejumlah titik dalam dan luar kabupaten. Anggota kepolisian juga turun langsung ke desa-desa terpencil untuk melakukan pengawasan terhadap distribusi logistik Pilgub. Mereka bertugas di wilayah yang sangat rawan dan memeriksa setiap kendaraan yang melintas. "Kami akan memastikan tidak ada yang terlewat atau hilang dalam proses pengiriman. Kami telah mengerahkan lebih banyak orang dan kendaraan ke daerah terpencil untuk memastikan semua hasil yang kami dapatkan melalui kegiatan ini," ucap Kasat Reskrim Kompol Sunarto. Keamanan distribusi logistik Pilgub di Wonosobo menuntut banyak personil. Namun, tugas ini harus dikerjakan secara serius agar kegiatan Pilgub berjalan lancar. Semua pihak termasuk KPU dan kepolisian harus bekerja sama dengan hati-hati agar seluruh logistik sampai ke tujuannya dan Pilgub akan berjalan dengan lancar tanpa ada gangguan di wilayah tersebut. Semoga kegiatan Pilgub akan memberikan hasil yang terbaik bagi jalan hidup di kabupaten Wonosobo.

We explore the supergravity description of 2-charge D1-D5 non-singular fuzzballs with internal excitations on T^4 and K3. We find that these excitations are represented by arbitrary curves and can be characterized through the middle cohomology of the internal manifolds. By computing the holographic data within the solutions, we determine that each geometry is dual to a specific superposition of R ground states, described by the Fourier coefficients of the curves. Furthermore, the chiral primaries associated with the middle cohomology acquire vevs in the superpositions, verifying the existence of internal excitations. Finally, we analyze whether these fuzzballs can be consistently implemented in supergravity.

Dürre und Hitze haben Europa im Sommer 2022 stark zugesetzt. Eine Kombination aus hohen Temperaturen und einer ausbleibenden Niederschlagsmenge führte in zahlreichen Regionen zu einer Notlage. In Portugal, Spanien und Italien wurden Temperaturen von über 45°C gemessen, was einige der höchsten Rekordtemperaturen auf dem europäischen Kontinent seit Beginn systematischer Aufzeichnungen sind. Auch in anderen Ländern, darunter Frankreich, Deutschland, Schweiz und Österreich, litten die Menschen unter starken Hitzewellen.
In vielen Gebieten mussten Felder und Ernten aufgegeben werden, da sie durch die Trockenheit unbrauchbar wurden. Dadurch kam es zu einer Reihe von wirtschaftlichen Problemen, die auf lange Sicht Auswirkungen auf die Industrie und den Handel haben werden. Umweltschützer weisen darauf hin, dass das extreme Wetterereignis ein weiterer Beleg für den beschleunigten Klimawandel ist und dass ähnliche Situationen in Zukunft immer häufiger auftreten werden.
Die extreme Hitze und Trockenheit führten auch zu einer Reihe von Gesundheitsproblemen. Die Zahl der Dehydrierungen und Hitzschläge erhöhte sich markant, besonders bei älteren Menschen und Menschen, die in schlecht isolierten Häusern leben. In vielen Städten wurden Notunterkünfte eingerichtet, um den am stärksten gefährdeten Menschen zu helfen. Regierungen in Europa haben reagiert, indem sie Entlastungsmaßnahmen für Bauern und den Anbau von Dürre-resistenten Pflanzen fördern und Klimaschutz-Initiativen starten. Die Europäische Union hat auch Gelder bereitgestellt, um den betroffenen Ländern zu helfen und sie bei der Umstellung auf nachhaltigere Industrien zu unterstützen. Eine aufgezeichnete Südostpassage zwischen Norwegen und China kam übrigens aufgrund ungewöhnlicher Klimabedingungen erstmals seit Beginn moderner Aufzeichnungen zustande. Experten zeigen sich zunehmend besorgt darüber, dass dieses Jahr nicht das letzte Mal sein wird, dass Europa unter ähnlich extremen Hitze- und Dürreperioden leidet. Außerdem sehen sie darin eine dringende Aufforderung für die internationalen Gemeinschaften und Regierungen, wirksame Maßnahmen gegen den Klimawandel zu ergreifen.

Вижте невероятната история на този милионер, който катастрофира с ферарито си и раздаде всичко на бедните (СНИМКИ) - БЛИЦ

Две месеца преди да започне ханжество по света, един милионер избра да направи невероятна действие. Името му беше Джон Морган, който беше жив в Алабама, САЩ, и имаше 38 години. По начин или друг, Джон намери силите си да промени живота на много нуждаещи се от заложител поддръжка.

Началото всъщност беше почти играта. Той се включи в драстичен ферари и постави бетонна площадка между двете места по трасето. Когато почна да пуска тираж, аудиторията беше много невероятно дълга. Като един от милионерите, които търпеха това събитие, той беше обявен двата пъти победител и разрази радостта в хората. Всички беше разгръщани от милионния лото.

Но Джон не беше подложен на славата и отвори огледална стълбица, така че присъствието да му е приятно. Още по някакъв начин, той бе избран да раздава всичките си призи на бедните. Край това също прикасна, всички хора вътре бяха поражени. Нещо на този мащаб не беше виждано за дълго време.

Когато призите бяха раздадени, Джон завърши официално приложението си и бе събуден с автомобила си, чиято пълна стойност бе равна на няколко доста милиона долара. През всичко това, има начин да се опише Джон като мъдро, добросърдечно и много сложно ентусиазирано човешко същество.

Много години по-късно, Джон бе пожелан в населеното място и той и неговата фамилия бяха в вътрешния кръг на хора, които сами дават обратно на обществото. Неговата последна свидетелство бе да стане имената и фотографиите на тези хора извън трагичената традиция и да даде възможност за благотворителност, която държи до днес.

Така се завършва великата история на Джон Морган - въходният празник на щастие за много нуждаещи се хора чрез тези милионни призи. Джон не само че имаше характер, но той също показваше, че даряването не винаги означава да раздаваш материални стоки - двете могат да избягат през свързване и стойността на човешката взаимопомощ.

A small number of particles have been proposed to interpret the anomalous results obtained in the PVLAS experiment. These include, among others, hypothetical massive bosons, quantum liquid crystals, non-Abelian massless higher spin fields, axion-like particles, ythios, nanoscaled condensed matter, muons promoted to Dirac particles, nondiffusing spin-0 particles, and photons with integer spin. These interpretations assume that the PVLAS data are due to photons and do not explain the apparent violations of Lorentz invariance and other experimental results. None of these explanations are conclusive; further experimental tests are needed to identify the nature of the observed effects. It is remarkable that several of these particles have already been or soon will be tested against PVLAS data. The theoretical bases of these interpretations are described, and the experimental tests needed to determine the true nature of the effects are proposed. It is concluded that the simplest explanation of the results obtained in PVLAS so far is the photon hypothesis, although more complex interpretations cannot be ruled out. New, more conclusive tests are needed to distinguish between these hypotheses and determine the true nature of the effects observed so far in PVLAS. These anomalous results could not be explained by the usual model of electromagnetic vacuum interactions and were thus the focus of a large number of theoretical papers proposing different particle explanations. We study the correlations and sum rules in a semi-infinite system with impurities at its surface, which is described by the quantum two-dimensional (2D) one component plasma model. We use the exact diagonalization method to calculate the density-density correlation function and static structure factor as well as their corresponding sum rules. The results show that there are two different regimes depending on whether the temperature T is larger or smaller than the Fermi energy EF . In particular, we find that when T < EF , the behavior of these quantities can be understood within the framework of Landau's Fermi liquid theory. However, if T > EF , our numerical data deviate significantly from this picture. Finally, we also investigate how the presence of impurities affects the above mentioned physical properties. Our findings suggest that the effect of impurities depends strongly on the distance between them. If they are close enough, then the impurity-impurity interaction dominates over other interactions leading to an increase of the effective mass of particles near the surface.

How to Use a Sauna Safely
Using a sauna can be an incredibly relaxing experience, especially after a long and stressful day. Whether you are at the gym, resort, or spa, a sauna can be the perfect solution for a little bit of peace and privacy. However, relaxing in a sauna does require a few extra precautions and good habits. Here's how to use a sauna safely, no matter your setting.

Be in good health and avoid saunas if you have any high-risk medical conditions. People with certain breathing problems, heart conditions, or skin conditions should avoid using a sauna. If you're pregnant, it is best to avoid saunas during your first trimester. Talk to your doctor if you have any questions regarding your specific condition.

Drink two to four glasses of water before going into a sauna. Your body needs to be well-hydrated before spending time in a sauna. Avoid sugary and alcoholic beverages at all costs, as they will make you more prone to dehydration.

Bring a clean, cotton towel to sit on. Not only will you need it to dry off after you get out of the sauna but it also provides a layer of protection against bacteria and germs that may be present.

Do not wear anything dirty or tight-fitting to a sauna, including things that you wore throughout the day. Make sure that you wear something loose fitted and bring a change of clothes with you for after the sauna.

Skip on the creams, lotions, and jewelry. Not only are these items almost impossible to clean and maintain in a sauna, they can also cause further skin irritations.

Be well-rested and don't go in after a big meal. Spending time in a sauna will cause your body temperature to rise, so if you have just eaten a big meal or haven't gotten enough rest, your body might not be able to handle the increase in temperature.

Bring a friend with you. While the sauna is a very peaceful and personal experience, it is still a good idea to bring a friend with you. Not only can having a sauna buddy help to keep you extra safe, but it can also make the experience more enjoyable.

Read the instructions to the sauna that you're using. Every sauna is different and has its own instructions for use. Taking a few extra minutes to read these instructions can help to ensure your safety as well as maximize the health benefits.

Use a lower temperature, especially if you are new to using saunas. The maximum allowed temperature in Canada and the United States is 194°F (90°C). Some European countries allow much higher temperatures, which can be unsafe, especially after longer periods of time.

Limit your experience to 15 to 20 minutes at the most. It's okay to get out sooner if you start to feel uncomfortable. Despite its calming effect, spending too much time in a sauna can cause serious side effects.

Get out immediately if you start to feel dizzy, nauseous, or lightheaded. Spending too much time in a sauna can put you at risk of heat stroke, which can be a very serious condition.

Cool down slowly after the sauna. You can do this by drinking some cold water or simply sitting in a cooler room.

Rest for at least ten minutes after getting out of a sauna. Your body needs time to adjust before any physical activity and this is especially true after a sauna session.

Follow up with a shower, but skip on the soap. Soap and shampoo can dry out your skin after a sauna.

Drink two to four glasses of water after getting out of the sauna. Your body loses a lot of water through sweating, so you will need to replenish that water quickly.

Consider eating a salty snack after leaving the sauna. Eating salty snacks will help to replace the minerals your body loses through sweating.

Keep your sauna clean to prevent the buildup and spread of bacteria. Make sure to bring a few clean rags with you and wipe down the benches after you use the sauna. If you are at a spa, it's usually a good idea to bring your own towel and leave it there for future use.

By following these simple steps, you can ensure a calm and relaxing sauna experience no matter where you are. So take advantage of the therapeutic effects of the sauna, just make sure you do it safely!

How to Splint a Dog's Leg

If your dog's leg is badly swollen, at an awkward angle, or can't bear weight, you may need to splint it. While this is a job for a veterinarian in a clinical setting, you can still do it yourself if you don't have access to professional help. Just be sure to seek veterinary care as soon as possible.

Select the splinting materials.
Find a straight piece of wood or other stiff material that is the length of your dog's leg. Metal splints, tongue depressors, or even a wooden spoon can work. You'll also need some gauze, adhesive tape, and a tensor bandage.

Swab the area with antiseptic.
Use a cotton ball or swab to clean the area around the break or fracture. This will reduce the risk of infection.

Tape the splint to the leg.
Hold the leg in place and start wrapping it with gauze. Make sure the splint is on the inside of the leg and extends from the midpoint of the leg to a little past the tip of the toes. Wrap the gauze around the leg and the splint several times.

Use the tensor bandage to secure the splint.
Roll the tensor bandage over the gauze. Use it to tightly wrap the leg and the splint. This will keep everything in place.

Fasten with adhesive tape.
Use a few pieces of adhesive tape to secure the end of the tensor bandage to the leg.

Get emergency veterinary care.
Have someone call the vet or emergency clinic while you drive to the clinic. Be sure to let them know that you are on the way with a splinted leg. This will give them a chance to prepare.

Try to keep your dog as calm and still as possible.
It's going to be a rough ride for your dog, so do your best to keep her calm and still. Use a firm but gentle grip to keep her from moving around. If you have someone with you, one of you can drive while the other keeps the dog still.

Seek veterinary care as soon as possible.
The vet will need to check the break or fracture and make sure it is properly splinted. Depending on the type of fracture, the splint may need to be left on for several weeks. The vet will give you instructions for caring for the splint and your dog at home.

Abraham Harawitz (1909–1994) was a leading figure in the early development of computing systems. He was particularly known for his work on the first completely portable computer, the Harawitz Computer. Harawitz was born in 1909 in Breslau, then part of the German Empire (now Wroclaw, Poland). He attended the University of Berlin and the Technical University of Berlin where he earned degrees in mathematics and electrical engineering. Harawitz began his career in computing in the early 1930s when he worked for the Central Electronic Office of the German Reich in Berlin. During this time, he developed a number of computing systems, including a system for the automatic translation of Morse Code messages. In 1940, Harawitz left Germany and emigrated to the United States. He settled in New York City and began working at the Radiation Laboratory at MIT, where he worked to automate calculations related to the development of radar. During his time at the lab, Harawitz developed what is considered to be the first completely portable computer system, the Harawitz Computer. This machine was capable of performing a wide variety of mathematical calculations. In the late 1940s, Harawitz left the Radiation Laboratory and went to work for the UNIVAC division of the Remington-Rand Corporation. Here he worked on the development of the UNIVAC Mark I computer, which was the first commercially available general-purpose computer. In the 1950s and 1960s, Harawitz continued to contribute to the development of computing systems. He developed software to control the installation of satellite stations as part of the Global Positioning System (GPS) and wrote software for astronomical research. Harawitz was a member of the National Academy of Engineering, a recipient of the IEEE Computer Pioneer Award, and a semi-finalist for the A.M. Turing Award. He retired in 1976 and died in 1994. Abraham Harawitz is remembered for his significant contributions to the early development of computing systems, which paved the way for more advanced systems and applications. His pioneering work on the Harawitz Computer, UNIVAC Mark I, and GPS technology revolutionized computing, allowing us to do things with computers that were thought to be impossible.

We study the collective behavior of stock prices in China, which is one of the fastest growing economies and has been attracting increasing attention worldwide recently. We find that there are two distinct regimes for the evolution of stock returns over time scales ranging from minutes to months. In particular, we show that the distribution of return fluctuations at short times follows a power law with exponent close to 1.5, while it becomes Gaussian-like at longer timescales. The crossover between these two regimes occurs on a timescale of about 10 days. Our results suggest that the dynamics of stock markets can be described by a simple model based on interacting agents. This work was supported by NSFC under Grants No. 60474035 and No. 60528302 . 
I. INTRODUCTORY REMARK
The recent financial crisis has raised concerns among investors as well as policy makers regarding the stability of global financial systems. It also attracted considerable interest in studying the statistical properties of stock markets [1] , especially those of emerging markets [2] .
In this Letter, we investigate the collective behavior of stock price movements using high-frequency data collected from China's Shenzhen Stock Exchange (SSE). SSE is one of the fastest-growing stock exchanges in the world [3] . Since its establishment in 1990, the number of listed companies increased from only three to more than 1600 today [4] . As shown in Fig.  1(a) , the total value traded per day reached $200 billion in 2007 [5] . However, despite such rapid growth, little research has been done so far on the statistical properties of stock returns in Chinese stock markets [6] .

Secretary of State for Migration The Secretary of State for Migration is a governmental position in several countries responsible for managing and regulating the flow of migrants. This role may also be known as the Minister of Immigration or Minister of Immigration and Citizenship in different regions of the world. The primary duty of the Secretary of State for Migration is to design and implement policies to control the entry and exit of migrants and to ensure that migration promotes economic growth, security, and cultural diversity. Responsibilities of the Secretary of State for Migration include managing visa applications, refugee resettlement programs, and regulating the movement of people across borders. This involves working closely with other government departments, including immigration and customs enforcement agencies, as well as international organizations such as the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees. The Secretary of State for Migration also plays a critical role in deporting individuals who are in a country illegally or have violated immigration laws. In some countries, this may include helping migrants to integrate into society, providing resources such as language courses or job training, and ensuring their human rights are upheld. The position of Secretary of State for Migration came into the spotlight in 2015 when the refugee crisis in Europe reached its peak. In response, many European countries created or expanded their asylum and migration policies, resulting in the appointment of new Secretaries of State for Migration in countries such as Germany, France, and Spain. In the United States, the Department of Homeland Security includes a section called the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services, which is responsible for managing immigration policies. The Secretary of Homeland Security oversees this section and plays a critical role in shaping the country's immigration policies. In conclusion, the Secretary of State for Migration is an important position in managing the movement of people across borders, which has become increasingly topical in recent years. This individual is responsible for designing and implementing policies to regulate migration, and works closely with other government departments and international organizations to fulfill these duties.

How to Become a College Professor

A college professor is someone who teaches at a college or university. They may teach undergraduate or graduate students. They usually have a Ph.D. in their field.

What a College Professor Does

College professors teach students in a variety of subjects. They may teach history, math, science, or literature. They may also teach courses in their area of expertise, such as economics or psychology.

Professors usually have office hours, when they can meet with students. They may also teach classes, give lectures, or lead seminars.

How to Become a College Professor

If you want to become a college professor, you will need to earn a Ph.D. in your field. After you earn your Ph.D., you will need to find a college or university that is hiring.

You will need to apply for the job and go through a hiring process. Once you are hired, you will need to teach classes and work with students.

There are a few things you can do to increase your chances of becoming a college professor. First, you can earn a master's degree in your field. This will give you a leg up on the competition.

Second, you can publish research in your field. This will show that you are an expert in your field and that you are keeping up with the latest research.

Third, you can network with other college professors. This will help you to learn more about the field and to make connections that can help you to get a job.

In this work, we investigate the hydrogen 2p--2s transition signals from the epochs of recombination and reionization. Our study aims to solve the problem of understanding the role of the hydrogen 2p--2s transition in the cosmic microwave background radiation (CMB) and the reionization of the universe. The motivation for our research arises from the fact that the 2p--2s transition plays a significant role in shaping the CMB due to its resonant nature. Another motivation is that the 2p--2s transition is a probe of the gas temperature and density during reionization.

Our main findings show that the 2p--2s transition is indeed a powerful probe of the free electron fraction during reionization. We also find that the 2p--2s absorption feature does not significantly impact the CMB power spectrum but can leave an imprint on the CMB polarization spectrum. In addition, we show that the large-scale anisotropy due to the 2p--2s transition cannot be neglected in the context of precision cosmology, especially in the epoch of reionization.

In summary, our work highlights the importance of the hydrogen 2p--2s transition in understanding the CMB and the reionization of the universe. Our findings provide useful insights for future observations and cosmological simulations aiming to constrain the epoch of reionization.

لغة التوصيف القابلة للتوسعة (بالإنجليزية: Extensible Markup Language)، المعروفة اختصارًا باسم "إكس إم إل" أو "XML"، هي لغة وصفية تستخدم على نطاق واسع في عمليات تخزين ونقل البيانات عبر الإنترنت. وتسمح لغة التوصيف القابلة للتوسعة بتحديد نوع البيانات المختلفة التي يحتويها ملف ما، بحيث يمكن للجهاز الحاسوبي الفهم والتعامل مع هذه البيانات. ويمكن استخدام لغة التوصيف القابلة للتوسعة في تحديد هياكل دليل ويب (مثل HTML)، وفي تحديد البيانات المستخدمة في تطبيقات الويب سيرفيس. ويعود تاريخ لغة التوصيف القابلة للتوسعة إلى بداية العقد التسعينات، حيث تم إطلاقها كتقنية جديدة لتوصيف البيانات بشكل تفصيلي ودقيق. وتتميز لغة التوصيف القابلة للتوسعة بسهولة تعلمها واستخدامها، إلى جانب قابلية التوسع والتعديل وفقًا لاحتياجات المستخدمين. ويمكن استخدام لغة التوصيف القابلة للتوسعة في العديد من المجالات والتطبيقات، مثل النشر الإلكتروني، وعمليات تحليل البيانات، وخدمات الويب والتفاعل الإلكتروني. وبجانب ذلك، تلعب لغة التوصيف القابلة للتوسعة دورًا مهمًا في مجال تبادل البيانات بين التطبيقات، حيث تساعد في الحفاظ على تفاهم وتوافق بين مختلف أنظمة المعلومات والبرمجيات المختلفة. وتسهل لغة التوصيف القابلة للتوسعة أيضًا عمليات إدارة وتخزين البيانات، وتسمح بتنظيمها بشكل منظم وتصنيفها وفقاً للغرض من استخدامها. وعلى الرغم من فائدة لغة التوصيف القابلة للتوسعة، إلا أنها تواجه بعض التحديات، كأنها غير مدعومة في جميع أنظمة التشغيل والبرمجيات، وكذلك تواجه تحديات في مجال حماية البيانات والأمان. وعلى الرغم من ذلك، فإن لغة التوصيف القابلة للتوسعة لا تزال تستخدم على نطاق واسع في مختلف المجالات والتطبيقات، كما أنها تشكل جزءًا أساسيًا من تقنيات الويب الحديثة.
