През 2018 Красимир Златев спечели Наградата за млад художник на Международното биенале за изкуство на финалните школи, проведено в Босна и Херцеговина.

Но все още липсваше този голям приз, който да го постави в редиците на големите майстори на изобразителното изкуство. Това се случи през последната година, когато Красимир Златев спечели приза "Динко Петров", който се присъжда на най-талантливите млади художници в България.

Призът е наименован в чест на големия български художник Динко Петров, който остава символ на традиционалния реализъм в изобразителното изкуство. Това е един от най-престижните призове в България за млади таланти, а Красимир Златев е горд да бъде сред първите носители на тази награда.

Творбите на Красимир Златев са невероятна комбинация от експресия, чувствителност и опит да се разказва история чрез изявления на цветнисти пространства. Той винаги търси нови начини да представи своето възприемане на света и да предизвика емоции в зрителя. Тези техники го отличават, като желан художник, както от любителите, така и от колегите му.

За Красимир Златев спечелването на приза "Динко Петров" е знак за постигнат успех, и допълнителна мотивация да продължи да изследва света на изобразителното изкуство. Видните награди, които той получава , са признанието, че творбите му обогатяват изкуството и предизвикват емоции и впечатления сред зрителите.

СКратката казва, че Красимир Златев е изключително талантлив млад художник, който има всичко необходимо да успее в кариерата си. Призът "Динко Петров" е още един доказателство за таланта и труда му. Ние поред раз честитим на Красимир Златев за спечелването на тази голяма награда и му пожелаваме още много творчески успехи и отличия.

Jakarta, CNN Indonesia -- Badan Intelijen Negara (BIN) membantah tudingan yang dilontarkan oleh Ketua Umum Partai Demokrat, Susilo Bambang Yudhoyono (SBY), terkait netralitas BIN dalam pemilihan kepala daerah (Pilkada) serentak pada 2020. BIN memastikan bahwa mereka tetap netral dan bekerja sesuai dengan tugas dan fungsi yang diamanahkan oleh negara. Sebelumnya, SBY menuding BIN tidak netral dalam Pilkada. Ia mengkritisi peran BIN dalam pilkada Pemilihan Gubernur DKI Jakarta 2017 lalu. Menurut SBY, BIN saat itu mempengaruhi hasil pemilihan untuk kepentingan politik tertentu. Namun, Kepala BIN Budi Gunawan menegaskan bahwa BIN tidak pernah terlibat dalam kepentingan politik tertentu. "Kami sebagai lembaga negara bekerja untuk kepentingan nasional. Sebagai lembaga negara, kami harus dipercaya dan ditunjuk oleh kepresidenan," kata Budi dalam konferensi pers di kantor BIN, Jakarta, Selasa (15/9). Budi menjelaskan bahwa tugas BIN selama pilkada adalah melakukan pengamatan dan analisis terhadap situasi keamanan dan ketertiban masyarakat. "Kami melakukan pengamatan terkait kondisi keamanan, juga isu-isu yang berkembang terkait pilkada," kata Budi. Ia menambahkan bahwa pengamatan tersebut didasarkan pada instruksi dari Presiden Joko Widodo dan merupakan bagian dari upaya untuk menjaga stabilitas keamanan dan ketertiban masyarakat di daerah. "Kami melakukan pengamatan di seluruh Indonesia untuk menjaga stabilitas keamanan dan ketertiban masyarakat, yang tentunya merupakan tugas yang sangat dibutuhkan oleh negara," ujarnya. Budi juga menegaskan bahwa BIN tidak pernah terlibat dalam kepentingan politik tertentu dalam pilkada. "Kami tidak pernah terlibat dalam kepentingan politik tertentu. Kami selalu mengikuti instruksi dari Presiden dan menjalankan tugas sesuai dengan fungsinya sebagai lembaga negara," kata Budi. Sementara itu, untuk menghindari tudingan seperti yang dilontarkan oleh SBY, Budi mengatakan bahwa BIN akan membuka ruang bagi masyarakat dan para calon kepala daerah untuk berdialog dengan BIN terkait situasi keamanan dan ketertiban masyarakat di daerah masing-masing. "Kami membuka ruang bagi masyarakat dan calon kepala daerah untuk berdialog dengan BIN terkait situasi keamanan dan ketertiban masyarakat di daerah mereka. Hal ini dilakukan guna mencegah adanya tudingan yang tidak benar terhadap BIN di masa depan," kata Budi. Demikianlah, BIN menegaskan bahwa netralitas merupakan prinsip yang dipegang teguh oleh lembaga tersebut dan diharapkan tidak terjadi tudingan seperti apa yang dialamatkan oleh SBY terhadap BIN. menjadi suatu pembinaan dalam menjaga situasi keamanan dan ketertiban masyarakat di Pilkada serentak pada 2020 nanti.

The elusive nature of the progenitors of long duration gamma-ray bursts (LGRBs) has been an intriguing mystery for some time. Much of the current thinking suggests that these blasts originate from the core collapse of massive stars in type Ic supernovae, but the details of their formation, initial masses and pathways remain unknown. Experts believe that, in order for LGRBs to be produced, rapid rotation and the formation of a black hole are both necessary. Therefore, this paper proposes that progenitors of this type of gamma-ray burst could be composed of very massive stars (>20 solar masses) within tight binary systems. Through the use of simple models, this hypothesis is compared to observations and it appears that the GRB locations on their host galaxies are indicative of main-sequence masses that surpass 20 solar masses, while up to 50% of binary systems were thought to have close enough proximity to have the appropriate velocity for GRB production. Consequently, massive stars in binary systems are believed to be a primary publisher of at least a portion of LGRBs.

Die Globalisierung der Wirtschaft beschreibt eine weltweite Öffnung der Märkte und die wachsende Verflechtung von Unternehmen, Nationen und Märkten. Sie geht mit einem schnellen Austausch von Gütern und Dienstleistungen sowie einem Anstieg des internationalen Handels einher, was zu einem radikalen Wandel im Weltgeschehen geführt hat. Ein Merkmal des Trends zur Globalisierung ist die Tatsache, dass Investitionen und Produktionen zunehmend über nationale Grenzen hinweg erfolgen, und dies hat Auswirkungen auf alle Aspekte des Wirtschaftslebens.

Die größte Veränderung durch die Globalisierung der Wirtschaft besteht in einem hohen Zuwachs an internationalen Wirtschaftsaktivitäten zwischen den Ländern, was auf eine rasche Entwicklung der Handelsliberalisierung und Deregulierung zurückzuführen ist. Abschottung und Protektionismus haben weltweit an Bedeutung verloren und wurden durch eine verstärkte Kooperation und Zusammenarbeit auf regionaler und globaler Ebene ersetzt. Diese Entwicklung hat viele Länder begünstigt, indem sie wirtschaftliche Chancen auf globaler Ebene eröffnet hat.

Der Siegeszug der Globalisierung hat aber auch negative Aspekte mit sich gebracht, so zum Beispiel eine erhöhte Konkurrenz und dadurch sinkende Preise für Güter und Dienstleistungen. Firmen und Multisucher haben hinzugewonnen, während landwirtschaftliche Familienbetriebe oder kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen meist auf der Strecke blieben. Ein weiterer Nachteil der Globalisierung ist das Ansteigen des weltweiten Umweltverschmutzungsgrades, das durch den rapiden Anstieg der Produktion und des Gütertransportes verstärkt wurde. Politisch hat die Globalisierung auch zu großen Veränderungen geführt, indem sie nationale Souveränität und staatliche Kontrolle in Bereichen wie Handel und Wirtschaft geschmälert hat. Letztlich wird die Globalisierung weiterhin die Art und Weise beeinflussen, wie Unternehmen operieren, wie Regierungen handeln und wie Menschen in Zukunft leben und arbeiten werden. Es ist deshalb sinnvoll, sich mit ihren Vor- und Nachteilen auseinanderzusetzen, um eine informierte Meinung zu dieser wichtigen Entwicklung zu bilden.

За формално отменяне на наредбата за интеграция на бежанците в България българският Служебен Кабинет публикува нова официална наредба – SHUM-BG. Документът, който съдържа действия за прилагане на правната политика на България в отношение на възможностите и предложенията за интеграция на бежанци и имигранти, бе ратифициран от президент Райцев.

В наредбата отбелязват, че Властите ще предоставят подкрепа и помощ за интеграция на мигрантите и бежанците, които имат право да живеят безпорочно на територията на България. Наредбата трябва да се базира на принципа на легалното и справедливо лекуване на обществото и цялостното отношение към миграцията.

В документът се представят цяла серия правила и решения, които ще послужат за предоставяне на удобствата и подкрепата за интеграцията на миграционните групи. Най-напред стои изграждане на инфраструктура, която да подкрепя достъп до достъпно пространство, гражданско положение, заплащане и осигуряване на правата и привилегиите на миграционните групи.

Наредбата също така съдържа срочни препоръки за специални програми, които ще послужат за активните измеждународни потребители да имат възможност за по-лесна и по-ефективна интеграция в обществото. Те са предназначени да подпомагат развитието на местните социални услуги, както и осигуряването на базови достъпности на средства за равен достъп на всички местни потребители.

Наредбата ЩУМ-БГ представлява важен шаг за интеграцията на представители на миграционни групи в България, като предлага процедури и планове за подкрепа на интеграционната политика за увеличаване на правната грамотност, справедливост и свобода на всички потребители на правни български услуги.

"Диабета ще изчезне само за 5 дни! Имате нужда само от две съставки и тази проста рецепта!" - това твърдение може да даде надежда на малко да всеки хора, страдащ от диабет. Диабетът включва дисфункция на панкреасите и може да доведе до рискове за живота като инсулти, инфаркти и предизвикани хронична болест. За да предотвратите развитието на диабет и да изчезне за 5 дни е необходимо да се вземат две добри и прости съставки - хапчета с хранителна трева и домашен сос с ниско съдържание на сол.

Хапчето с трева се прави от плодове и други натурални съставки, включително ацесулфат, церебралка, амарант, пирит, акорела и други. Ацесулфатът е една от най-добрите съставки в това хапче, което подобрява химичната балансираност трикорини и подновява енергията на организма.

Сосът, за който е необходимо да се използва за зацвяване на диабетът, които бива приготвян дома, може да бъде направен от праскови, боби, картофи, и ацерол. Това съчетание включва много витамини и минерали които повишават химичната балансираност и компенсират неизмеримите нива на панкреатин.

С тази рецепта може да се постигне по-високо качество на живот и да се предотврати развитието на диабет. Хапчето с трева и домашния сос с ниско съдържание на сол са добри и прости, и тяхното многостранно приложение може да предпази от диабет. Ако започнете да ги приемате веднага и свършите процеса правилно, диабетът ще изчезне за 5 дни!

The Runaway Skyscraper is a 1922 American silent adventure film directed by James W. Horne. It was adapted from a short story of the same name by Arthur Somers Roche and produced by Hal Roach in association with Louis B. Mayer. The film stars Harold Lloyd, Mildred Davis, and Roy Brooks. It is about the plight of two brothers whose skyscraper becomes operational prematurely and begins to travel across the city. The skyscraper in question is owned by two brothers, Enoch (Harold Lloyd) and Jotham Rooley (Roy Brooks). After hard work, they have built the skyscraper to exceptional standards, thinking it will become a great success. They rent the upper levels of the building to a wealthy architect, Lance Hanwell (George Siegmann), who has promised to make the building into a profitable business. Unfortunately, their plans take a turn for the worse when the skyscraper activates prematurely due to a malfunction and begins to move around the city, powered by its multitude of motors. The brothers must then race against time to try and stop the skyscraper before it reaches its final destination, the bridge to Brooklyn. To make matters worse, Hanwell is on board the skyscraper with his assistant, Dolores (Mildred Davis), and if the brothers fail, Hanwell will gain control of the skyscraper and reap all the profits. The brothers must use their wits and ingenuity to fix the skyscraper and restore it to its safe location before Hanwell can steal their business from them. Along the way, there are plenty of high-flying stunts and comedic hijinks as the brothers race against time. The film yet another remarkable addition to Harold Lloyd's silent comedy repertoire, and has been praised for its outrageous comedy and thrilling visual stunts. It was a success both commercially and critically, and it stands as one of Lloyd's most iconic silent films.

Ytterbium-doped materials are a very promising solution for solid-state lasers, in particular for fiber lasers, thanks to their high transition probabilities between the 4f3[combining macron]5 manifold and the lower laser level, the 4f2 manifold, which gives high saturation intensities. Moreover, the thermal properties of these materials make them very attractive for hybrid systems with other heating sources such as diode lasers or optical fibers. These so-called “hybrid lasers” already exhibit very high laser powers, however their performance is still limited by two thermal effects: thermal lensing and thermal stabilization of the gain medium. In this article, we present an in-depth study of these thermal effects, which have not yet been thoroughly investigated in the Yb-doped material community. First, we describe the theoretical models that can be used to describe these thermal effects. Then, we propose an original method based on time-resolved spectroscopy of the so-called “black-body radiation” emitted by the laser cavity to characterize the influence of the thermal effects on the laser performance. We validate this method using 1W hybrid lasers based on theærnan® fiber, for which we obtained very good agreement between experiments and models. The uncertainties related to thermal effects must then be taken into account to increase the laser performance. This article presents the theoretical and experimental results of this study and we conclude by presenting a list of perspectives, both on the theoretical and experimental sides, for the improvement of these hybrid lasers based on Yb-doped material.

We present here results of a study of the distribution of gas and dust in supernova (SN) remnants, based on observations made with the Gamma-Ray Large Area Space Telescope (GLAST), and of the interaction of these remnants with the interstellar medium. We find that the gas in all of the remnants we have studied is expanding, and that the gas in some of the remnants is rotating. We find that the gas in the remnants is not optically thick, in the sense that the optical depth of the gas is generally less than 2. We discuss a simple model in which the gas in the remnants is described by a multiphase Maxwellian with a mean velocity and a standard deviation of the velocity that are related to the explosion energy of the supernova and the viewing angle of the telescope, respectively. We also discuss a model in which the gas in the remnant is described by a Lagrangian-assimilated bubbly flow model. We compare the model predictions with the observations, and we find that both models are successful in describing the observations. We also discuss the interaction of the remnants with the interstellar medium, and we find that the gas in the remnants is not well mixed with the gas in the interstellar medium. We also present observations of the radio source 3C 391, and we find that the radio source is expanding, and that it has a bow shock.

أوكرانيا هي دولة في شرق أوروبا، تقع إلى الشمال من بحر الأسود وتحدها روسيا من الشرق وبيلاروسيا من الشمال، وبولندا وسلوفاكيا والمجر ورومانيا ومولدوفا من الغرب والجنوب. يزيد عدد سكانها عن 42 مليون نسمة، ويتحدث الأغلبية الكبيرة من السكان اللغة الأوكرانية، وهي اللغة الرسمية في البلاد. تأسست أوكرانيا كدولة مستقلة في عام 1991، عقب انهيار الاتحاد السوفيتي، وقد انضمت إلى الأمم المتحدة في عام 1945 كجزء من الاتحاد السوفيتي. تتمتع أوكرانيا بإقتصاد يتميز بالتنوع، إذ تشكل الزراعة والصناعة والخدمات الأساس لاقتصادها. ومن أبرز المنتجات الزراعية المصدرة من البلاد: الحبوب والسكر واللحوم والمنتجات الألبانية، بالإضافة إلى ذلك، تعتبر صناعة التعدين والفحم والحديد والصلب والتعدين وصناعة النفط والغاز مؤثرة في الاقتصاد الأوكراني. تشتهر أوكرانيا أيضاً بثقافتها الغنية والتي تمتزج فيها العديد من التأثيرات، حيث التقت المأكولات والرقصات والأزياء والعادات المحلية والفنون والصناعات اليدوية لتشكل ثراء وتنوعاً لا يمكن إيجازه. ويشتهر الكثير من الفنانين والكتاب والموسيقيين والرياضيين الأوكرانيين في الساحة الدولية، وسطع نجم البلاد خلال السنوات الأخيرة في الرياضات الفردية والجماعية مثل كرة القدم والمصارعة والتنس والملاكمة والجمباز. تضم أوكرانيا أيضاً العديد من المعالم السياحية الجميلة والتاريخية والطبيعية، حيث تتميز بطقس معتدل نسبياً في فصل الصيف وعاصف وبارد في فصل الشتاء، مما يجعل طبيعتها خلابة وتعرض واحدة من أتربة رفيف العالم. ولدى السياح الراغبين في زيارة البلاد، العديد من الأماكن المفضلة كشبه الجزيرة القرم، سومي، كييف، ولفيف، وأوديسا ، إضافة إلى العديد من الأماكن الطبيعية والمنتزهات المختلفة.

How to Make a Map With Valve Hammer Editor

Valve Hammer Editor is a software tool that enables you to create custom maps for games like Counter-Strike and Half-Life. If you're interested in making your own maps, this guide will walk you through the process step by step.

1. Get to know what brushes do.
Brushes are the basic building blocks of any level. They are used to create walls, floors, ceilings, and other features. Understanding how to use them is crucial to creating a successful map.

2. Understand entities.
Entities are objects that you can place in your map to add functionality, such as weapons, doors, and triggers. You need to understand how they work to create dynamic and interactive maps.

3. Become familiar with textures.
Textures are the skins that you can apply to the brushes in your map. There are hundreds of textures to choose from, so it's important to understand how to use them and how they can affect the look and feel of your map.

4. Consider what game you're building for.
Different games have different requirements and limitations when it comes to maps. Make sure you understand what you can and can't do in the game you're building for.

5. Go to File -> New (or Control + N) to create a new map.
Creating a new map is the first step in the process. Give your map a name and set the dimensions.

6. Select the "tools/toolsnodraw" texture from the texture browser.
Toolsnodraw is a special texture that tells the game engine not to render a surface. You'll use this texture to create a "hollow" space for your map.

7. Select the "Block Tool."
The Block Tool is used to create new brushes. Click and drag to create the floor of your map.

8. With the "Block Tool" still active, drag the left mouse button along the perimeter of the floor to make the walls.
Click and drag the Block Tool along the edges of your floor to create walls. This will create a "hollow" space for your map.

9. Equip the "Select Tool" and select the wall brush.
Use the Select Tool to highlight the wall brush. Press Control and left-click to make a copy of the brush.

10. Select both wall brushes by holding the "Control" key and left-clicking the original wall (assuming the cloned wall is still selected) and Shift+Drag again to create a total of four walls.
Press Control and left-click to make a copy of the copied wall brush. Use Shift+Drag to create a total of four walls.

11. Select the floor and Shift+Drag the floor up 256 units to create the ceiling.
Use Shift+Drag to raise the floor brush, creating a ceiling.

12. Take the time now to browse the textures to find something appealing for the room.
Select different textures and apply them to your brushes. This will help give your map a unique look and feel.

13. Start with a spawn point.
Place a spawn point where players will start the game. Make sure it's placed in a logical location.

14. Make sure your spawn point is looking where it needs to go/look, so the player will automatically know what to do.
Use the Look At tab to make sure your spawn point is looking in the right direction. This will help guide players through the map.

15. Create a basic light entity (simply called "light") at the center of the map.
Place a light entity at the center of your map. Use the Light tab to adjust its properties.

16. Make lots of interactions.
Add interactions and objects to your map to make it more engaging and immersive. This could include triggers, buttons, and other types of entities.

17. Buy zones for a CS:S map.
If you're building a Counter-Strike: Source map, consider creating buy zones where players can purchase weapons and equipment.

18. Save your map by selecting File->Save (or hitting Control+S) and give it a name, then compile it by hitting F9.
Once you're finished with your map, save it and compile it so you can test it in the game. Make sure you go through and test every aspect of your map before you release it to the public.

От познатите проблемите за свободата на мнение и медийните права в Турция до твърденията за различен вид хинтерентски или включващ избирателни райони за изборите, протестите в тази малка държава на Балканите не спират. Всичко започване на 26 март, когато Турция проведе национални избори, които завършиха с множество анализи на резултата. Целта на изборите беше да се избере нов президент, а изборните райно имаха да приемат гласуването на 26 март.

Но изгнаници от Бултюрк разбират, че ДОСТ има отговорност за провала на изборите. Много голосуващи не били информирани за правото си или имаха натоварвания от страна на силовите структури до изборните места. Такива примери привлячат за по-доброто понимане на провала на изборите допълнително до анализите на местните обществени дейности.

Гласуващи от Бултюрк утвърдили, че има много нарушения на канцелариите, и че дори доклади за техните граждански права, достъп до медиите и избори не осигуряват достатъчно достоверна информация. Те се обръщат към ДОСТ за бързо и задълбочено изследване за подробна информация за тяхното изследване.

Въпреки разпространените нарушения за изборите, тя застава вярна на бързо и успешно провеждане на изборите. Край март и дните преди изборите местните органи изпълнително право са отворили приемници активисти за предпазване на процеса. Но много изследвания показват, че така не бе достатъчно.

Строителите на процеса също са указали, че построяването на демокрация не е само избори, а и транспарантност, справедливост и право на мнение. Затова изследванията на процеса ще представляват важното на политически права, вид на избирателните права и административни райно.

На крайна сметка, целта е да бъде предоставена правилна отговорност за провала на изборите и да се постигне държавата социален и политически стабилен. Това включва на изследване на постиганията и задовлетворяване на правата на много голосуващи. Затова изследванията на ДОСТ и други органи за промяна се привеждат до съществено подобряване на условията за избори. Така ще може да се премине през по-четлив процес и бързо да се информират гласуващите, за да могат да прогласят на своите мнения и направят информирана избор.

Under some conditions, we show that the test statistic converges in distribution to the Tracy-Widom distribution, which is well known in the literature of random matrix theory. An application to a fractional Brownian motion with Hurst parameter H<0.5 is given to demonstrate the proposed method. Our proposed test is based on the maximum likelihood estimator of the Hurst parameter, and the LSEE for the underlying diffusion process is derived. An exponential inequality for the LSEE is also established. Numerical studies show that the empirical size of the test is well controlled and the power is close to one under various scenarios. A real data example is also provided to demonstrate the applicability of the proposed method. Във втория кръг на Суперлигата по волейбол "Нефтохимик" от Бургас успя да победи ЦСКА със 2:0 гейма в мач, който се игра в зала "Диана" в Бургас.

"Нефтохимик" имаше отлично представяне на домашен терен. След като спечели първия гейм с 25:22, те продължиха да доминират във втория гейм. Крайният резултат беше 25:23.

Поредната победа на бургаския тим заслужено го поведе на второ място в класирането, зад актуалния шампион на Суперлигата мъже "Левски". 

В момента "Левски" е единственият отбор, който има пълен успех в турнира след победите си над "Ботев" (Враца) и "Спортист" (Своге). 

В последните години волейболните фенове имат възможността да гледат на живо мачовете от Суперлигата както от басейните на клубовете, така и от телевизионните екрани. Това прави турнира още по-популярен и следен. 

В Суперлигата мъже участват осем отбора, които се борят за определяне на шампиона на България. В този турнир участват отбори като "Левски", "ЦСКА", "Нефтохимик", "Ботев" (Враца), "Спортист" (Своге), "Ямбол", "Дунав" (Русе) и "Черно море" (Варна). 

Като цяло, това е турнир, който нашите волейболисти познават много добре. Нашият национален отбор по волейбол е през последните години бил между най-добрите в света. 

За да се постигне тази цел, трябва да има добре функционираща волейболна култура и традиции в нашата страна. Турнирите като Суперлигата помагат за това, тъй като залите са пълни на зрители, които на свой ред подкрепят местните отбори. 

Класирането в момента показва, че този турнир ще бъде много труден и много екипи имат шанс да се класират на високи позиции. 

В близко бъдеще се очаква да бъдат изиграни още много мачове в този турнир, като всички фенове на волейбола ще имат възможност да следят зрелищните мачове на живо. 

Турнирът може да бъде гледан и по телевизията, което е допълнителна възможност за феновете да следят надбягванията на отборите. 

Както винаги, мачовете на Суперлигата са гаранция за зрелищни моменти и емоционални изпитания за всички, които следят надбягванията на най-добрите волейболисти в страната. 

След успеха на "Нефтохимик" над ЦСКА, феновете на бургаския отбор очакват с нетърпение следващият мач в Суперлигата. Те вярват, че техният отбор може да постигне още по-високо класиране в надпреварата.

The Spanish conquest of the Aztec Empire in the early 16th century marked a pivotal moment in global history. But it also raises questions about how the Spanish viewed the indigenous people of Mexico.

When it comes to the question of whether the Spanish viewed the Aztecs as racially inferior or merely religiously and culturally inferior, the answer is not quite clear-cut. On the one hand, it's hard to argue that the Spanish did not view the Aztecs as racially inferior, given their widespread practice of enslaving and subjugating the indigenous population.

It's also worth noting that the Spanish viewed themselves as superior to the Aztecs in virtually every way, from their language and technology to their religion and worldview. In many cases, this superiority was rooted in a belief in the supposed superiority of European "civilization" over what the Spanish saw as the primitive, barbaric culture of the Aztecs.

However, it's also true that the Spanish were largely motivated by religious and cultural factors in their conquest of the Aztecs. From the outset, the Spanish saw themselves as bringing the "true" religion of Christianity to the "heathen" people of Mexico. They were also motivated by a desire to spread European culture and civilization to the New World.

So, in short, it's not entirely accurate to say that the Spanish saw the Aztecs as solely racially inferior. Rather, their views were informed by a complex mix of religious, cultural, and racial factors, all of which played a role in the conquest and subjugation of the indigenous population of Mexico.

Making a film in a week is no mean feat, but with the right knowledge and preparation it is certainly achievable. It is all about knowing what you want to do and then building on it day by day.

Day 1: Know what you want to do. This phase can never be skipped as it is just too important. Make a list of ideas and brainstorm; come up with something that is feasible in the time that you have.

Day 2: Now that you know what you want to do, it is time to turn it into a script. Once you have got a basic premise and structure jotted down, go out and acquire any props or items that you may require. Don’t be afraid to improvise if the need arises.

Day 3: Get everyone together before lunch and begin recording. This is the most crucial day of production as it will set the tone for the rest of the week and should give you an idea of what sort of editing and re-shoots you will have to do in the future.

Day 4: Finish filming if it isn't finished already. At this stage you should have a rough cut of the film which you can go back to and straighten out any of the problems that you may have encountered throughout the shoot.

Day 5: Carry on editing. This is where the magic really happens, so don’t be afraid to take your time and make lots of changes if necessary.

Day 6: Ensure you have all permission, and copyright, then burn a few disks, write the title on the disk (and the company of course) then pop them into boxes or sleeves, depending on budgets.

Day 7: Have a huge party celebrating your massive success!

If you follow the above steps, you can make a professional looking film in a week. Making a film takes courage, passion and determination so, with a little luck, you can make it in just a week. Make sure to use the right camera equipment, have the right crew and sufficient equipment. Also make sure that you don’t rush into it, but take the necessary time to plan properly. Last but not least, make sure that you have fun!

This assertion is largely false, as Great Britain has never invaded all but 22 countries in the world. The list of countries which Great Britain has not invaded is actually much longer.

In total, there are 195 recognised countries in the world, and of which Great Britain has only invaded a fraction. Granted, Great Britain was at one point an expansive empire which had colonies across the globe and they have certainly invaded numerous countries during their time, but the assertion that there are only 22 countries which they have not invaded is untrue. 

In fact, some notable countries which Great Britain has yet to invade include the Netherlands, Belgium, Denmark, Norway, Sweden, Finland, Russia and even many of the United States, particularly in the southern regions. 

One must also remember that although Great Britain has not technically invaded many of these aforementioned countries, they have certainly had involvement in many wars in which these countries were involved, but this does not constitute a formal invasion. 

To give an example, in World War II Great Britain were involved in a conflict against Nazi Germany, yet Nazi Germany occupied many countries which were a part of the British Empire, such as France and Belgium, but these would not be classed as a Great Britain invasion as they had no authority to do so. 

In addition to this, it could be argued that Great Britain has not 'invaded' countries in which they had colonies, such as Australia and New Zealand, as they merely colonised them, although this could be debated. 

In conclusion, Great Britain has most certainly invaded many countries in their history and have had a presence in many more, but the assertion that all but 22 countries have been invaded is false.

Robert S. Welch (November 27, 1889 – November 10, 1959) was an American businessman, best known as the founder of the Welch's grape juice company. Welch was born in Brooklyn, New York, the son of Frederick Welch and Helen LouiseProtchett. His father, a successful lawyer, died in 1898, leaving the family in straitened circumstances. Welch attended public schools in Brooklyn, and graduated from high school in 1908. He worked as a messenger for a bank, but was laid off in 1909 due to recession. He was able to secure a position with a wholesale drug company, Johnson & Johnson, where he learned the bottle manufacturing business. In 1911, he founded his own business, the Welch Bottle Company, to manufacture and sell glass bottles to the wine and champagne industries. The company grew to become the largest manufacturer of champagne bottles in the United States. In the early 1920s, Welch's business encountered financial difficulties, and he was forced to declare bankruptcy. As a result, he sold his company to the Crown Cork & Seal Company for $1.5 million. He then began to look for other business opportunities, and soon focused his attention on the emerging market for grape juice. In 1924, he founded the Welch Fruit Company, which initially sold grape juice under the name "Welch's Vinic", and soon afterwards began selling a non-alcoholic champagne called "Methuen champagne". Delta F508 (oder ∆F508) ist eine Mutation des CFTR-Gens, die zur Bildung eines falsch gefalteten, nuklearen Membranproteins bei menschlichen Trägern führt und die Zystische Fibrose (Mukoviszidose) verursacht. Sie ist die am häufigsten vorkommende Mutation. Diese Mutation entsteht durch den Austausch von drei DNA-Basen in der Nukleotidsequenz des Gens. Dadurch wechselt das codierte Aminosäurerest, ein Phenylalanin, zu einem Asparagin. Das mutierte Protein kann nur noch in geringer Menge ausgeschieden werden und staut sich innerhalb der Zellen. Dies verursacht die Symptome von Mukoviszidose.
Mukoviszidose ist die häufigste autosomal rezessive Erbkrankheit bei Europäern. Sie betrifft etwa 1 von 2500 Neugeborenen, wobei ca. 1 in 25 Träger sind. Aufgrund der hohen Prävalenz dieser Krankheit ist es wichtig, diese Mutation zu identifizieren, um eine frühe Diagnose und Behandlung zu ermöglichen.
Die Symptome von Mukoviszidose können sich in unterschiedlicher Intensität bemerkbar machen. Die typischen Symptome umfassen chronischen Husten, Infektionen der Lunge, salzigen Schweiß, Probleme mit der Verdauung und Gewichtsverlust. Die Schwere der Symptome hängt vom Grad der Mutation ab. Bei den betroffenen Patienten ist das körpereigene Wiederherstellungssystem beeinträchtigt, was die Schwere der Krankheit erhöht. Eine Früherkennung der Krankheit ist wichtig, um eine potenzielle Therapie durchführen und ein mögliches Fortschreiten der Symptome aufhalten und kontrollieren zu können. Es gibt eine Vielzahl von Behandlungsmöglichkeiten, von Medikamenten, die auf Symptome abzielen, bis hin zu Stammzelltherapien und Lungentransplantationen. Die meisten dieser Behandlungen konzentrieren sich darauf, die Symptome zu bekämpfen, anstatt die Krankheit selbst zu kurieren. Neue Behandlungsmöglichkeiten wie die CRISPR-Cas9-Methode bieten jedoch die Hoffnung, dass eine Heilung möglich sein wird.

We examine the optical line emissivity of Brightest Cluster Galaxies (BCGs) taken from the National Optical Astronomy Observatory (NOAO) Fundamental Plane Survey (NFPS) and the C4 catalogue of optically-selected clusters from the Sloan Digital Sky Survey Data Release 3 (SDSS DR3). Our objective is to gain an understanding of how optical line emission in BCGs are associated with the characteristics of the galaxy and host cluster. We compare the optical line emissions of the BCGs to a control sample comprising the other bright galaxies near the cluster core. Overall, both the NFPS and SDSS demonstrate a small proportion of BCGs with line emissions with no observable pattern in relation to the mass of the galaxy or velocity dispersion of the cluster. However, we found that the fraction of BCGs with emission lines is much higher for those situated in cooling flow clusters, up to 100% within 50kpc of the X-ray centre. Excluding cooling flow clusters, only 10% of BCGs exhibited line emission, similar to the control sample of galaxies. We determined that the source of the line activity changed from case to case; some had line ratios like those of a LINER while others featured a blend of star formation and LINER activity. We concluded that the presence of optical line emissions in BCGs is linked to the cooling of X-ray gas near the cluster centre.

Partai HDP yang dipimpin oleh Demirtas telah berjuang keras untuk memperjuangkan hak-hak minoritas di Turki, seperti kaum Kurd dan LGBT. Berbagai pihak terutama dari dunia internasional telah mengecam kejahatan ini dan menyerukan untuk mencari keadilan bagi Demirtas dan keluarganya. Selain itu, sejumlah politikus oposisi juga menuntut agar pemerintahan Turki memberikan perlindungan bagi politikus oposisi dan memperbaiki demokrasi di negara tersebut. Dalam momentum yang sulit ini, apa yang dibutuhkan oleh Turki adalah persatuan dan kesatuan dalam menciptakan keamanan dan stabilitas di negara tersebut. Demirtas meninggal dunia dalam situasi yang menyulitkan, namun semangat perjuangan dan keadilan yang ia perjuangkan harus terus diteruskan oleh para politikus oposisi dan masyarakat Turki. Semoga keadilan dapat diraih untuk Demirtas dan keluarganya, serta semoga Turki dapat terus menjadi negara yang demokratis dan menghargai hak asasi manusia.

How to Set up a Fundraising Event

Are you interested in making a difference for a cause you care about? Setting up a fundraising event is a great way to raise money and awareness for a charity of your choice. However, planning an event can be a daunting task. You want to make sure you are effectively collecting donations, advertising your event to the right audience, and creating an enjoyable experience for attendees. In this article, we will guide you through the steps to set up a successful fundraising event.

Part 1: Preparations

1. Decide which charity you are going to help: Before you begin planning your event, you must first decide which charity or cause you want to support.

2. Set your fundraising goal: Determine how much money you want to raise and be realistic about your expectations.

3. Determine your audience: Think about the type of people you can get to attend your fundraiser. Who is your target audience?

4. Decide what the event is going to be: Consider what type of event best fits your audience and fundraising goals. Will you host a gala, concert, or a bake sale?

5. Set a budget: Determine how much money you are willing to spend on the event.

6. Find out if the cause you are championing has a list of people who would be open to being contacted.

7. Consider opening a bank account: You may want to open a separate bank account for the event to help track donations and expenses.

8. Find a place to hold the event: Look for a space that can accommodate your expected guest count and any activities planned.

9. Tour the facilities to determine if there is adequate space and to find out what supplies are available to use.

10. Determine a date and time: Choose a date and time that is convenient for your guests and does not conflict with other major events.

11. Decide what types of payment you will accept: Will you only accept cash or will you also accept credit cards?

12. Check with proper authorities to see if you need to complete any paperwork: Depending on the location and nature of your event, you may need to complete certain legal procedures.

13. Determine if your event will be free admission or require tickets: Depending on your fundraising goals and planned activities, you may decide to charge admission.

14. Get cash for change and a lockbox to hold cash and checks as people pay: You will need cash to give change to attendees.

15. Purchase necessary supplies: Determine what supplies you need for the event and make sure to purchase them in advance.

Part 2: Advertising

1. Get the word out: You need to advertise your event to garner interest and attendance.

2. Make up flyers and post them around the area: Creating flyers and posting them around the area will help create a buzz for your event.

3. Pre-sell tickets if you are charging admission: Pre-selling tickets can give guests reason to plan ahead and commit to attending.

4. Start well in advance: Start promoting your event well in advance to give people time to plan and attend.

Part 3: The Event

1. Keep it fun: Make sure the event is enjoyable to your attendees. Consider providing food and drinks, games, music, and other entertainment.

2. Make things clear: Make sure guests understand the goal of the event and how they can contribute towards it.

3. Start the event!: Begin the event on time and make sure guests feel welcome and comfortable.

4. Clean up as much as possible after the event: Make sure to clean up the space, so it looks better than when you arrived.

5. Take the money you have collected to the charity: Follow through by donating the money collected to your chosen charity.

Hosting a successful fundraising event requires planning, preparation, and promotion. By following the steps outlined in this article, you can set up a fun and successful event while making a difference in the world.

In this study, our aim was to investigate the interplay between electron-phonon coupling and strain coupling in manganites. Our research is motivated by the fact that while both coupling types are known to be important factors in various physical phenomena, the relationship between them is not yet well understood. We carried out a series of density functional theory calculations on magnanites with different compositions and structures. Our results indicate that for certain materials, the electron-phonon coupling is very weak, while the strain coupling is strong. This suggests that for these materials, strain coupling may play a more significant role than electron-phonon coupling in determining their physical properties. We also found that the strength of the electron-phonon coupling depends not only on the composition of the material, but also on the specific phonon mode involved. Our methodology involved a careful analysis of the electronic structure, as well as a detailed study of the lattice dynamics. Our work sheds new light on the complex interplay between electron-phonon coupling and strain coupling, and provides a basis for future investigations in this area.

Someone to Watch Over Me (TV series) Some to Watch Over Me is a British television drama series, produced by the BBC and transmitted on BBC One from 28 September 1998 to 1 May 2002, although the final episode was postponed due to the death of Princess Margaret. The series starred Francesca Annis as Julia, a former MI5 agent who has been forced into retirement due to her age and a back injury. To make ends meet, Julia takes a job as a dinner lady at a local school, and is also offered a small flat by her old friend and colleague George (Nia Roberts). Although Julia is keen to start a new life, she is unable to shake off her previous career as a spy, and finds herself drawn into a world of intrigue and danger when she discovers that George's flat is actually a front for a local spy cell, and that her friends are not all who they seem. The series was originally conceived as a vehicle for Francesca Annis, who had previously appeared in another BBC spy drama, The New Avengers, in the mid-1970s. The New Avengers had been a success in Britain, but had not been particularly well-received by the American networks, who had therefore refused to consider any spin-off series featuring the character of Cathy Gale. This left British writer David Collison (who had also written for The New Avengers) to develop a new concept for a thriller series, which eventually became Someone to Watch Over Me. The series was initially produced by independent company Spooksville, but after the first series was completed, the BBC took over production. The series was shot on location in London, with many scenes being filmed around the city's Docklands area. Someone to Watch Over Me was not a major critical success, but it did gain a small cult following, and the first series was released on Region 1 DVD in the United States. The series was also screened on cable channel Bravo. A novelisation of the series, written by Barry Vanes, was published by BBC Books in 1999.

590 was a significant year in history, marked by pivotal events and transitions in various fields and regions of the world. In Europe, the year is notable for the beginning of the reign of Gregory the Great as Pope. During his pontificate, Gregory profoundly influenced the development of the Catholic Church and its mission, as well as its relationship with secular authority. He also helped spread Christianity to new regions, including England. Gregory is remembered as one of the most important popes in history, and he was later canonized as a saint. In Asia, the year marked the ascendancy of the Sui dynasty in China under the rule of Emperor Wen. The Sui dynasty was known for its grand projects, including the construction of the Grand Canal, which connected northern and southern China and facilitated trade and transportation. The Sui dynasty also brought stability and unification to China after centuries of fragmentation and conflict, paving the way for the golden age of the Tang dynasty. In the Americas, the year is significant for the founding of Teotihuacan, a major city-state in ancient Mexico. Teotihuacan would go on to become one of the greatest cities of the pre-Columbian era, with a population estimated at over 100,000 inhabitants. The city is known for its monumental architecture and art, including the iconic pyramids of the Sun and Moon. Overall, 590 was a year of great change and potential, with new leaders and institutions rising to prominence and shaping the course of history in their regions and beyond. These developments laid the foundations for centuries of cultural, religious, and political developments, demonstrating the lasting impact of this pivotal year.

Власти Москвы вынесли решение об уничтожении нескольких исторических зданий на Садовнической набережной и Садовнической улице в районе Замоскворечье. В соответствии с этим решением, вначале было снесено старое здание на Садовнической набережной, 17/80, о котором сообщалось в июне этого года. Следующими зданиями, подлежащими сносу, стали двухэтажный жилой дом по адресу Садовническая набережная, дом 5, строение 1, и одноэтажное нежилое здание по адресу Садовническая набережная, дом 7.

По словам представителя мэрии, Комиссия по вопросам сохранения зданий в исторически сложившихся районах Москвы разрешила снести эти здания и заменить их на новый многофункциональный комплекс с подземным паркингом общей площадью 42 тысячи квадратных метров. Кроме того, будет построен новый жилой дом переменной этажности вместо двух зданий (18 и 20, строение 3) на Садовнической улице. Двухэтажное строение по адресу Садовническая улица, дом 73, строение 17, также будет ликвидировано в рамках реорганизации Краснохолмского камвольного комбината, а на территории предприятия будет построен новый многофункциональный комплекс.

В связи с этим, участники движения "Архнадзор" выступают против сноса одного из зданий, которое по их мнению входит в исторический ансамбль комплексной застройки района Замоскворечье. Ранее в этом здании находились уникальные интерьеры лестничных клеток с коваными решетками и перилами лестниц. Тем не менее, власти Москвы настаивают на сносе здания в связи с необходимостью развития инфраструктуры и создания нового многофункционального комплекса, а также муниципального жилья для жителей района.

Adolf Szyszko-Bohusz (1891-1948) war ein polnischer Architekt und Designer. Sein Lebenslauf verläuft wie das Zickzackmuster der Geschichte Polens im 20. Jahrhundert. Szyszko-Bohusz wurde zunächst als Architekt ausgebildet und beruflich erfolgreich, später wandte er sich dem Design und der Kunst zu. Zwischen den beiden Weltkriegen war Polen ein aufstrebender Staat, der in der Moderne einen nationalen Stil erläuterte. Adolf Szyszko-Bohusz war einer der Künstler, die durch ihre Ideen die Entwicklung dieses Stils inspirierten. Er entwarf Möbel, Geschirr und Textilien, die für Polens Industrie des 20. Jahrhunderts prägend waren. Sein schlichter und eleganter Stil war auch außerhalb Polens sehr erfolgreich, Szyszko-Bohuzs hatte Einfluss auf die Entwicklung des international anerkannten Bauhaus-Stils. 
Doch als der Krieg ausbrach, wandte sich das Schicksal. Szyszko-Bohusz wurde ins Exil gezwungen. In Italien und Frankreich versuchte er, seine Arbeit fortzusetzen, hatte jedoch Schwierigkeiten, in diesen Ländern in der Kunstszene Fuß zu fassen. Im Zweiten Weltkrieg wurde den Polen im Ausland der Status als "Nicht-Gefangene" verwehrt, sie waren nun Bürger des von Deutschen besetzten Polens und mussten, wie andere Polen auch, die katastrophalen Bedingungen des Kriegs überstehen. Szyszko-Bohusz wurde in ein Konzentrationslager deportiert, wo er schließlich starb. Seine Arbeit als Architekt und Designer wurde jedoch nach seinem Tod wiederentdeckt. Szyszko-Bohusz ist heute bekannt als eine der wichtigsten Figuren bei der Entwicklung des polnischen nationalen Stils. Sein Andenken wird als wichtiger Teil der polnischen Kunstgeschichte gepflegt und seine Arbeit hat auch heute noch Einfluss auf die Ästhetik in Polen und der Welt.

We consider monoid generalizations of the Richard Thompson groups, that is, groups $G$ with a set of generators $\mathcal S$ and a map $\alpha$ of the set $\mathcal S$ to itself such that for all $s$, $t$, and $u$ in $\mathcal S$, the following properties hold: (1) $\alpha(s)$ and $\alpha(t)$ commute with $u$; (2) $\alpha(st)$ and $\alpha(ts)$ are equal to $\alpha(s)$ and $\alpha(t)$, respectively; and (3) $\alpha(s^m)$ is equal to $\alpha(s)^m$ for all $m$ and all $s$ in $\mathcal S$. We show that if $\mathcal S$ is any monoid, the map $\alpha$ is a homomorphism if and only if $\mathcal S$ is a group. We then consider the case in which $\mathcal S$ is the set of all monomials in $\mathbb C[x]$ of degree $\leqslant n$ and $\alpha$ is the map that takes $s$ to $xs$. This leads to the concept of a monoid polytope, a generalization of the polytope associated with a finite semigroups. We show that a monoid polytope is the convex hull of a set of points in $\mathbb C^n$ and that it is always a simplicial complex. We also show that every simplicial complex is the convex hull of a set of points in $\mathbb C^n$, and hence that every simplicial complex is a monoid polytope.

Alexis-François Rio (7 December 1773 – 18 August 1851) was a French architect and city planner active in Paris during the first half of the 19th century. Rio is best known for his major restorations of the Louvre, the National Library of France, and other Parisian landmarks as well as his long-term vision for the urban built environment of Paris, which he laid out in his monumental 1833 plan entitled Plan de Paris et Environs par Alexis François Rio. The plan proposed a number of large boulevards radiating from the Louvre and extending the city's boundaries. This plan was a much needed proposal for urban renewal in the chaotic Paris urban environment of the period. Rio's other well-known projects include the restoration of the Louvre (1817–30), the construction of the Petit Palais and Grand Palais, the restoration of the Hotel de Ville, the construction of the Bibliotheque Nationale, and his plans for the modernization of the city waterways. He was also responsible for the restoration of many historic sites in and around Paris and is remembered today for his great contributions to the cityscape. Throughout his long and fruitful career, Rio was involved in every aspect of urban and architectural design, from the large scale plans of the city, to detailed designs of interiors and public monuments. His work was a major influence on the design of later Parisian monuments such as the Opera Garnier, the Arc de Triomphe, and new structures along the boulevards proposed in his famous plan. Rio's career was long and prolific, his works ranging from major urban plans to tiny details of interior design, but his lasting legacy was his vision for the future of the French capital. He was an ardent believer in the possibility of a harmonious yet complex urban space, and his concepts of urbanism, with its emphasis on large scale public parks, boulevards, and parks, would prove to be hugely influential in later French urban planning.

Vermont Statutes Annotated The Vermont Statutes Annotated are the codified statutory laws of the U.S. state of Vermont. Each volume is annotated with marginal notes and indices. The statutes are organized into several numbered chapters, which are further divided into sections. The Vermont Statutes Annotated are considered official only when they are printed by the Secretary of State's Office or by a private publisher under contract with the state. The official version of the Vermont Statutes Annotated is kept in the Office of the Secretary of State in the state capital, Montpelier. In this paper, we examine the connections between star-forming galaxies, AGN host galaxies, and typical early-type galaxies from the Sloan Digital Sky Survey (SDSS) DR5 and DR4plus datasets. We categorized the spectral types of our chosen early-type galaxies into normal, star-forming, Seyfert, and LINER classes based on various spectral line flux ratios. We then investigated the slope in the fundamental space of each class of early-types in order to observe any distinctions in the slopes of the fundamental planes (FPs) between the various classes. We found that there are clear differences in the FPs among the various subclasses of early-type galaxies, in which the slopes of Seyferts and star-forming galaxies were flatter than those of normal galaxiess and LINERs. This marks the first detection of systematic variations of the FP slopes among subclasses of early-type galaxies. The differing FP slopes may be linked to discrepancies in the amount of nonhomology among distinct classes, or to contrasts in gas contents in their progenitor mergers. One potential explanation is that AGN host galaxies and star-forming galaxies developed from gas-rich mergers and may subsequently evolve into normal early-type galaxies when their star formation or AGN activity been concluded.

На Международном Арктическом форуме было объявлено, что компания "Газпром нефть шельф" успешно добыла свою десятимиллионную тонну нефти на Приразломном месторождении. По словам заместителя генерального директора по развитию шельфовых проектов "Газпром нефти" Андрея Патрушева, достижение юбилейной отметки и пятилетней бесперебойной промышленной эксплуатации платформы в сложнейших погодных условиях подтверждают лидерство компании в промышленном освоении арктического шельфа.

Уникальный опыт и накопленная компанией "Газпром нефть" экспертиза в области добычи нефти на Приразломном месторождении будут использованы в работе над перспективными проектами на арктическом шельфе. Юбилейная тонна нефти будет отгружена на арктический челночный танкер "Михаил Ульянов", который вместе с танкером "Кирилл Лавров" обеспечивает круглогодичный вывоз нефти с месторождения. Транспортировка нефти марки ARCO (Arctic oil), добываемой на Приразломном, будет осуществляться другими танкерами в Европу после перекачки на танкер-накопитель "Умба", установленный на рейде в незамерзающих водах Кольского залива недалеко от Мурманска.

С начала промышленной эксплуатации платформы "Приразломная" до настоящего времени на месторождении было пробурено 17 скважин, включая самую протяженную скважину в истории бурения компании (6474 м). Компания планирует завершить строительство еще двух скважин до конца 2019 года, а затем постепенно увеличивать фонд скважин до достижения проектного уровня в 32 скважины. На пике добычи объем извлекаемой нефти на Приразломном месторождении составит 4,8 миллиона тонн в год.

We present a detailed analysis of the properties of (65489) Ceto/Phorcys, a binary Centaur orbiting in the outer Solar System. Our study aims to determine the orbit, mass, size, albedo, and density of the system using a combination of observational data and numerical simulations. The motivation for this research lies in the need to understand the physical properties and evolutionary history of Centaurs, a population of small bodies that have been dynamically scattered into their current orbits from the Kuiper belt by the giant planets.

6. Take another, more generous handful of clay and flatten the sphere.

7. Hold the rectangle against the base, on the side not folded up. This will allow you to mold the clay around the cradle and provide support.

8. Fold the edges upward around the remaining sides of the rectangular cradle piece. This will create a stable structure to hold your phone.

9. Take your phone and put it on the stand. Make sure it fits comfortably and doesn't wobble.

10. Smooth the clay out using your thumbs or the clay smoother tool. This will give the stand a neat and polished finish.

11. Add decorative effects, if wished. Stick the clay shapes onto the stand to create a unique design.

12. Let the whole stand dry for about 48 hours or until the stand is completely white. This will ensure that the clay is dry and ready to paint.

Part 2: Painting the Stand

1. Choose the color(s) that you wish to use for the inside of the phone stand. Make sure it complements your phone's color.

2. Paint the inside of the stand using a brush. This will add a nice touch to the overall look of your stand.

3. Take the color(s) you wish to use for the outside of the phone stand. You can either use the same color as the inside or mix it up.

4. Paint the stand on the outside. Be careful not to paint over the cradle piece as this will affect the stability of the stand.

5. Paint the decorations any color you want. This is your chance to get creative and personalize the stand to your liking.

6. Add more decorative effects if wished. Use different colored clay to create shapes and stick them onto the stand.

7. Allow the paint to dry completely before use. This will prevent the colors from smudging or rubbing off.

8. You are finished! Enjoy your new phone stand and use it to comfortably watch your favorite shows or videos.

Creating a phone stand from clay is a fun and easy DIY project that anyone can do with a little patience and creativity. So why not give it a try and make your very own stand today!

Разследване на БНТ в шивашката промишленост

Днес замерваме дълбоко в доста известната промишленост - шивашката. Дали БНТ може да се използва за подобряване на процесите в тази промишленост? Да разгледаме подробно. 

Когато посещаваме производство на ширни са иновативни технологии, от двигателна автоматизация до разработване на интелигентни машини. В последните години, развитието на БНТ позволи ни да видим още големи прогреси в тази сфера. Въпреки това, доста бизнеси все още успяват да работят без прилагането на БНТ и тя може да не бъде задължителна за някои производни процеси. 

Един от такива процеси, до които може да се приложи БНТ е работа да се шие. Например, БНТ би могъл да се използва за автоматизиране на процеса на крафтване на шиващи проекти, така че да може да се постигне все по-голяма производителност, с по-малко грешки и в по-кратки срокове. Друга възможност за използване на БНТ би била в процеса на подреждане на материалите, които да са необходими за шиването. Това ще бъде особено полезно ако се изискват огромни масиви или дори уникални проекти. 

Освен това, дори и да са използвани такива иновативни технологии, широко използваната структура на процеса в производството може да бъде значително поискачена с помощта на БНТ. Автоматизирани системи могат да правят различни типове шиване, което ще предизвика существено оптимизиране на даден процес. Всички тези гледни точки могат да дадат значително подробни и неповторими услуги в промишлеността на шиване. 

В края на край можем да кажем, че използването на БНТ в шивашката промишленост може да има значителни предимства. С подобрено планиране и автоматизиран процес, можем да осигурим по-бързо и с по-малки грешки изработка на проекти, със запазване на основния идейни процес. В сравнение с обикновенните рутинни и дори машиночиви процеси, БНТ може да работи добре с уникални и поредни задачи. Ако искаме да засилим и оптимизираме процесите в шивашката промишленост, използването на БНТ трябва да бъде разгледано.

Panzerotti are a delicious Italian stuffed pastry that can be served as an appetizer, snack, or even as a main course. These crispy and savory treats are easy to make at home and are a great way to impress your friends and family. Here's how to make panzerotti:

Ingredients:

- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/4 cup warm water
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- Salt and pepper to taste
- 1/2 cup chopped tomatoes
- 1 can of anchovies
- 1 ball of mozzarella cheese
- Vegetable oil for frying

Instructions:

1. Pour 1/4 cup of warm water into a large bowl.

2. Add the olive oil and a sprinkle of salt and pepper to the bowl.

3. Add the all-purpose flour to the mixture one-half cup at a time.

4. Continue stirring with the spoon until the dough starts to come away from the sides of your bowl.

5. Flour a clean hard surface lightly.

6. Roll the flour into a ball.

7. Set the dough aside in a warm place for one hour to rise.

8. Chop your tomatoes with a very sharp knife.

9. Sprinkle the mixture with salt.

10. Drain your anchovies and set them in a mixture nearby.

11. Slice your mozzarella into 16 pieces; one for each panzerotti.

12. Remove the dough from the bowl.

13. Divide each of the quarters into four even quarters.

14. Roll each piece into a four inch (10 cm) circle on your lightly floured surface.

15. Spoon one tsp of the tomato mixture into the center of each dough circle.

16. Add an anchovy on top of the tomato mixture.

17. Add one piece of mozzarella on top of the anchovy.

18. Turn one side of the circle to meet the opposite side in a half moon shape.

19. Press down the edges with a fork to seal the panzerotti.

20. Repeat with the remaining pastries.

21. Heat two cups of vegetable oil in a deep fryer, heavy frying pan or cast iron skillet.

22. Heat to 370 degrees Fahrenheit (180 Celsius).

23. Drop two to four panzerotti into the frying pan.

24. Fry for about a minute and a half on each side.

25. Remove from the oil and place them on the plate covered in paper towels.

26. Serve hot and enjoy!

Making panzerotti is a fun and delicious way to get creative in the kitchen. Give this recipe a try for your next party or as a special treat for your family. With crispy fried dough and a flavorful filling, they're sure to be a hit!

Jakarta, CNN Indonesia -- Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS) menyatakan bahwa ekspor sawit Indonesia mengalami penurunan yang signifikan dalam beberapa bulan terakhir akibat kebijakan impor yang diterapkan oleh Uni Eropa dan India. Penurunan ekspor sawit ini berdampak pada pertumbuhan ekonomi Indonesia. Menurut data yang dikeluarkan oleh BPS, ekspor sawit Indonesia mengalami penurunan sebesar 9,9 persen pada bulan Mei 2019 karena banyak negara yang mulai membatasi impor sawit dari Indonesia. Langkah ini dilakukan sebagai bentuk protes atas isu-isu keberlanjutan dan kerusakan lingkungan yang dibawa oleh industri minyak kelapa sawit. Sektor perkebunan kelapa sawit adalah salah satu tulang punggung perekonomian Indonesia. Namun, beberapa negara termasuk Uni Eropa telah memutuskan untuk membatasi impor sawit dan produk turunannya karena alasan lingkungan. Presiden RI, Joko Widodo menyatakan bahwa kebijakan Uni Eropa dan India terhadap sawit Indonesia sangat merugikan. Kebijakan ini bukan hanya berdampak pada perekonomian Indonesia, tetapi juga menciptakan ketidakadilan ekonomi dan perdagangan global. Menanggapi hal ini, Kementerian Perdagangan RI menyatakan bahwa pemerintah telah melakukan sejumlah upaya yang efektif untuk memastikan bahwa ekspor sawit tetap berjalan. Salah satu upaya yang dilakukan oleh pemerintah adalah dengan membangun kemitraan dengan negara-negara ASEAN serta China, Jepang, Korea Selatan, dan India. "Kami akan bekerja sama dengan negara-negara ASEAN dan juga negara-negara non-ASEAN seperti China, Jepang, Korea Selatan, dan India untuk menumbuhkan pasar baru bagi produk sawit Indonesia," kata Mentri Perdagangan, Enggartiasto Lukita. Indonesia adalah salah satu produsen minyak kelapa sawit terbesar di dunia. Industri ini menyumbang sekitar 12 persen dari seluruh ekspor komoditas Indonesia dan memberikan devisa sebesar 23 miliar USD pada tahun 2018. Industri ini juga menyerap banyak tenaga kerja, baik langsung maupun tidak langsung. Meskipun ada penurunan ekspor, pemerintah Indonesia tidak akan menyerah. Pemerintah akan terus bekerja sama dengan negara-negara ASEAN dan Amerika Latin, dan berupaya untuk membuka pasar baru di negara-negara yang sensitif terhadap impor sawit. Pemerintah juga akan menjaga dan meningkatkan produksi sawit secara berkelanjutan dan bertanggung jawab.

How to Give a Basic Toddler Bed a Designer Look - Make Your Toddler's Bed Unique

Every parent wants their child's bedroom to be a special place where they can feel comfortable and happy. One way to make your toddler's room extra special is by giving their bed a designer look. With a little bit of creativity and effort, you can turn a basic toddler bed into a stylish centerpiece that will make your child's room stand out. Follow these simple steps to give your toddler's bed a designer look.

Consider What Kind of Material Your Toddler's Bed Is Made From

Before giving your toddler's bed a designer look, you have to consider the type of material the bed is made from. Is it made of wood, metal, or plastic? Knowing the material will help you choose the right kind of paint and fabric.

Choose a Suitable Type of Paint

For wooden beds, you can use either oil-based or water-based paint. Oil-based paint is great for wooden beds because it's durable and resistant to scratches and stains. Water-based paint is a good choice if you want to keep the natural wood color visible. For metal or plastic beds, you should use a paint that's designed for these materials.

Pick a Paint Color

Choosing the right color is important for giving your toddler's bed a designer look. You can either match the color scheme of the room or choose a contrasting color to make the bed stand out. Consult with your child to see what colors they prefer.

Look Into Fabrics

Adding fabric to your toddler's bed can instantly add a designer touch. You can add a bed skirt or a canopy made from pretty fabrics. Look for fabrics that will complement the color of the bed and the room.

Think About Pillows

Pillows are an easy way to add a special touch to a toddler bed. Look for decorative pillows with fun prints that your child will love. You can also make your own pillow covers to match the color of the bed.

Select Some Complimentary Decorations

Adding some decorative elements to your toddler's bed can make it feel even more special. Look for items such as wall stickers, a colorful rug, or a cute lamp. Just be sure not to go overboard with the decorations.

Consider Renting a Spray Painter

If you want a more polished look, you can rent a spray painter to paint the bed frame. Spray painters can help achieve a smoother finish and save you time.

Place the Bed Frame in a Well-Ventilated Area

It's important to paint the bed frame in a well-ventilated area. This will ensure that the paint dries properly and doesn't cause any allergies or health problems.

Sand the Bed Frame

Before painting, sand the bed frame to remove any bumps or rough areas. Sandpaper with a grit of 120-150 should work well.

Clean the Bed Frame and Apply Primer

Clean the bed frame thoroughly and apply a coat of primer. The primer will help the paint adhere to the surface and provide additional protection.

Sand the Frame Again After Applying the Primer

After applying the primer, sand the bed frame again with a fine-grit sandpaper to remove any rough areas that may have been created during the priming process.

Apply Two Coats of Your Chosen Paint

Apply two coats of your chosen paint to the bed frame, allowing the first coat to dry before applying the second. Use a brush or roller for the best results.

Review Your Work

After painting, review your work for any touch-ups that may be necessary. You may need to sand down any rough spots or paint over areas that need more coverage.

Embellish the Duvet

Adding a decorative duvet can give your toddler's bed an extra touch of elegance. Look for duvets with fun prints and colors that will complement the color of the bed.

Embellish the Pillow Cover or the Pillow

Embellishing the pillow cover or the pillow can give your toddler's bed a designer look. Add a pom pom fringe or other decorative elements to make the pillow stand out.

Add the Decorations

Adding a few decorative elements to the bed frame can really make it pop. You can add stickers, wall hangings, or even personalize the bed with your child's name.

Add a Head Board

Adding a headboard can give your toddler's bed a polished look. You can either purchase a pre-made headboard or make one yourself using fabric and padding.

Consider Hiring Professional Decorators to Design Your Toddler's Bed

If you're not confident in your DIY skills, you can always hire a professional decorator to design your toddler's bed for you. This can be more expensive than doing it yourself, but the results can be stunning.

Think About Buying a Loft Bed When Your Toddler Gets a Bit Older

A loft bed can provide extra space and give your child a designer feel. Consider purchasing one when your child gets a bit older.

Consider Decorating a Trundle Bed

A trundle bed can be a great addition to your toddler's room. You can decorate it in the same style as the main bed, or create a different look altogether.

Think About How Much Time and Effort Is Needed

Transforming a basic toddler bed into a designer bed takes time and effort. Make sure you have the time and energy to complete the project before you start.

Consider the Cost of Your Materials

The cost of materials for the project can add up quickly. Consider how much you want to spend before starting the project.

Figure Out If There Is Any Risk Involved in the Project

Some DIY projects come with risks, such as using power tools or hazardous chemicals. Make sure you're aware of any risks involved before starting the project.

Make Sure That You Have All of the Necessary Equipment

Make a list of all the equipment and tools you'll need before starting the project. This will ensure that you have everything you need to complete the job.

Think About Whether You Have the Necessary DIY Skills to Complete the Project

If you're not confident in your DIY skills, consider asking for help or taking a class to improve your skills. Alternatively, consider hiring a professional to do the job for you.

By following these simple steps, you can give your toddler's bed a designer look that will make their room feel extra special. Remember to have fun and be creative!

The role of the first lady of the United States has been evolving over time. To date, no first lady has had an official job while living in the White House. The position of the first lady is an unofficial one, and as such, there are no specific requirements or expectations beyond those established by each individual first lady. However, this does not mean that first ladies have not pursued professional interests while in the White House.

For example, Hillary Clinton was a practicing lawyer before she became first lady, and she continued to work as a lawyer while living in the White House. She also led a task force on health care reform during her husband’s administration. Michelle Obama also worked as a lawyer and hospital administrator before becoming first lady, and she used her position to promote healthy eating and physical activity through her “Let’s Move” campaign.

Despite the absence of an official job title, the first lady is often a highly visible and influential figure in American politics and society. As such, the first lady’s platform and advocacy can have a significant impact on social and policy issues. While no first lady has held a formal job while living in the White House, many have used their position to pursue professional interests and create meaningful change.

Lolium perenne is the common name of several species in the genus Lolium, including L. perenne and L. rigidum.
The term "perennial ryegrass" refers to one or more varieties within this group that are used as pasture grasses (forage) and/or turfgrasses.  The most widely cultivated variety is L. perenne var. multiflorum.   Other popular types include L. perenne var. denticulatum which has been bred into many modern lawns because it tolerates foot traffic better than other forms.    Perennial rye grass was introduced from Europe by early settlers who brought seeds along on their ships during colonization efforts across North America.

We introduce and study a class of domain systems, which we call statistical behavior domain systems. We give a motivation for their study by formulating several problems in statistics and probability theory in which the considered domain systems are employed. We show that the behavior of the domain systems is closely related to the statistical behavior of the observed quantities. This approach allows us to introduce and study a general setting of domain systems which are endowed with a statistical behavior and to consider statistical problems as problems of domain systems. In this way, we obtain a generalization of the classical theory of dynamical systems in the spirit of G. D. Birkhoff. The approach also allows us to study stochastic processes by means of the theory of domain systems. As an example, we consider a stochastic process which describes the statistical behavior of the trajectory of a domain system. The study of statistical behavior domain systems is an important and active field of research in the theory of dynamical systems and is related to many problems in statistics, probability theory, and mathematical physics.

Adding a background to a website is an important element in website design. Backgrounds can be used to convey emotions, provide context for content, or simply add a touch of personality to your site. While a solid colored background is the most basic type of background, it's just the beginning. Adding a background to your website can be done in a variety of ways, depending on your needs and the tools you have available. In this article, we’ll show you how to add a background to your website using HTML and CSS.

Step 1: Open your web code (source) 
The first step in adding a background to a website is to open your web code or markup language source. This can be done using an HTML or CSS editor. For more advanced users, you can open the source code using a text editor. 

Step 2: Add an attribute called bgcolor to the body tag 
To create a solid color background, add an attribute called bgcolor to the body tag. The value of the bgcolor attribute is a color name or a hex value for the color.

<body bgcolor="COLORNAME">

Step 3: Use RGB and # for more color options 
Experimenting with RGB and # can lead to many more color shades. To use this method, add the style attribute to the body tag. Here's how your body tag should look like:

<body style="background-color: COLORNAME;">

Step 4: Add the background property to the body tag 
If you want to add an image background, add the background property to the body tag. The value of the background property should be the image file source (SRC). Here's the code:

<body background="SRC">

Remember to type the file extension (.gif/ .jpeg /.bmp) when adding the image source.

Step 5: Add the style attribute to the body tag for a more advanced image background 
For a more advanced image background, you can add the style attribute to the body tag. Here's the code to do that:

<body style="background-image: url('SRC');">

Remember to include the file extension (.gif/ .jpeg /.bmp) when adding the image source.

Step 6: Add a repeated pattern background 
To add a repeated pattern background, use the same steps as mentioned above. However, instead of using a static image, use a smaller pattern that can be repeated to form the complete background.

Step 7: Add a fixed image background 
To add a fixed image background, use the same code as mentioned before but add the "background-attachment: fixed;" to the body tag. This will make the image stay in place as the user scrolls down.

<body style="background-image: url('SRC'); background-attachment: fixed;">

Conclusion:
In conclusion, adding a background to a website can be done in a few easy steps. Whether it's a solid color, image, repeated pattern, or fixed image background, there are various ways to add a background to your site. Using HTML and CSS, you can take full control of the design and aesthetic of your website.

Советский кинематограф - это удивительная вещь, которая занимает особое место в истории кинематографа. В последнее время он раскрылся во всей своей красе, появились талантливые режиссеры, которые стали настоящими знаменитостями. Многие из них, такие как Никита Михалков, Данелия, Рязанов и Тарковский, сделали огромный вклад в развитие кинематографа.

Однако, как и в любой области искусства, со временем появляются копии, подражания и стилизаторские подделки. Одним из таких примеров является фильм "Полеты во сне и наяву". Этот фильм не добавляет ничего существенного в жанр кинематографа, он является вторичным как по драматургическому сюжету, так и по кинематографическому стилю.

Хотя тема фильма достаточно серьезна - это проблема мужика, замучившегося с тремя бабами - она не находит своей реализации на экране. Вместо того, чтобы использовать эту тему для критики условий, порождающих подобных лишних людей, фильм ограничивается лишь поверхностной проработкой этой проблемы.

Несмотря на мастерство актеров и красивые кадры фильма, он не способен подняться до уровня других знаковых фильмов в истории кинематографа. Характеры героев не выдерживают серьезной социально-психологической нагрузки, а взаимоотношения главного героя с дамами остаются главенствующими на экране.

Критики обычно стараются искать глубину и смысл в фильмах, но в случае с "Полетами во сне и наяву" этого не так много. Большинство обзоров просто мелет воду в ступе и не обращают должного внимания на те проблемы, которые на самом деле были затронуты в фильме.

В целом, несмотря на всю сложность и уникальность советского кинематографа, фильм "Полеты во сне и наяву" не стал исключением и остается вторичным и достаточно малозначимым фильмом в истории кинематографа.
