Пренасоченият на фестивала „Благоевград Blues and Jazz“ в центъра на града привлече голямо количество хора, които искрено ужастиха от втората вечера посветена на блус и джаз порнизми. За период от време публиката бяха зарадвани от истинска джазова удоволствие, а залата бе изолирана във вълната на гостите. На мене ще запомня завинаги втората вечер на събитието със специална програма и уникални артисти, предизвикали уптазване между присъстващите - Sugar Blue, Вики Алмазиду, Васко Кръпката и Big Blues Band.

Първото име на сцената беше известният в световната блус сцена, танцор и певец - Sugar Blue. Разкритият му отцентър зарадваше публиката на всеки стъпки и един от най-значимите моменти в вечерта беше когато той беше заявен за изиграване на известното хит "Vanilla Love".

Второто име на сцената беше известната балканска джаз певица и автор на текстове Вики Алмазиду. Тя зарадваше публиката с култовата й редизайн песни "Korega Lagan". Тя изпълни и други авторски песни и също беше дадена шанса да демонстрира уникалното си възглед на джаз музиката.

Третият артист на сцената беше Васко Кръпката, друг блус и джаз исполнител, който беше най-неочакваната присъствие на вечеря. Той наркотираше публиката със талантлива изпълнения на „One More Chance“ и останали песни от арсенала на интересен за онлайн джаз и блус.

Накрая Big Blues Band участваше със четирима от най-обичаните си композиции. Те убедиха публиката с чистата си музика, която събра хората в ритма, а голям брой хора беше засян до площадата. Това специално посветена на блус и джаз вeчер приключи с голямо приличие и достойнство на присъстващите.

Чрез тази първа експериментална програма на "Благоевград Blues and Jazz" се успя да се предложи забавление точно подходящо за настроението на местните хора. Едва ли ще забравят Sugar Blue, Вики Алмазиду, Васко Кръпката и Big Blues Band за втората вечер на фестивала. Това е съвсем добра новина за поклонниците на блус и джаз музиката в Благоевград.

The veterans of the Napoleonic Wars have not experienced the same level of recognition and veneration that have been afforded to veterans of World War I and World War II. Although individual acts of kindness and gratitude were bestowed on Napoleonic veterans, they did not receive systematic and widespread public recognition after the wars’ conclusion.

The public reception of Napoleonic War veterans was complicated by the fact that the external causes of the wars — a desire to expand territory and power — were widely viewed as less noble than the reasons for World War I and World War II. Moreover, the long duration of the Napoleonic Wars - spanning over a decade - meant that veterans tended to return to civilian life disenchanted rather than inspired by their wartime experiences. As a result, they did not receive the iconic status now enjoyed by veterans of more recent conflicts.

Official recognition was also limited during the early 19th century. The government did not construct monuments, organize parades, or create veterans’ organizations to honor the soldiers of the Napoleonic Wars in the same way it later did for World War I and World War II veterans. Families and communities did provide occasional practical support for veterans — such as pensions, clothing, and housing — but this did not equate to the sense of public veneration that greeted veterans of the two world wars.

In the present day, few people realize the impact and significance of the Napoleonic Wars. Therefore, it is unsurprising that today’s public does not venerate Napoleonic War veterans in the same way World War I and World War II veterans are honored. The battles and campaigns of the Napoleonic Wars may have established a common history and identity for the nations of Europe and opened new paths to world domination by Napoleon. But even more than two centuries later, such events have not achieved the same cultural resonance as the world wars.

Adding Environmental Gas Physics to the Semi-Analytic Method for Galaxy Formation: Gravitational Heating

We extend the semi-analytic method for galaxy formation to include the effects of gas heating and cooling in a simple manner. We show that the method is very sensitive to the feedback of gas heating on the galaxy formation process. In particular, the inclusion of gas physics can produce galaxies that are more compact, with higher central mass, than those produced by the standard semi-analytic method. We analyze the physical origin of this effect and find that the main contribution comes from the cooling of gas in the outer parts of the galaxy, due to the increase of the surface area with the expansion of the galaxy. We quantify this cooling effect and find that it is in agreement with the results of other recent studies. We also analyze the effects of gas heating in the inner part of the galaxy, and find that they are less important than the cooling effect in the outer regions. We also discuss the effects of other physical processes, such as gas dynamical friction, and find that while they are important in shaping thegalaxy structure, they do not modify the main conclusion that we obtain by including gas cooling in the semi-analytic method.

Charge ordering (CO) in half-doped manganites is an important issue in the field of solid state physics. Although there have been numerous investigations on the origins of CO in manganites, it remains a puzzle. Here we report a combined experimental and theoretical study of CO in the layered perovskite-like manganites, (La_{0.5}Ca_{0.5})MnO_{3}±x, with x = 0.4 and 0.5. We find that the magnetic, structural, transport, and NMR properties are quite similar for these two compositions, which allowed for a clear separation of the effects of charge and spin degrees of freedom. While the former induces stripe-type CO, the latter leads to weak charge disproportion (WCD) and drives the stripe fluctuations. These results indicate that the leading mechanisms for CO in the layered perovskite-like manganites are WCD and stripe fluctuations. The occurrence of WCD has important implications for the correlation between charge, spin, and lattice degrees of freedom, which should be carefully considered in exploring the origins of CO in manganites.

تريسيراتوبس (بالإنجليزية: Triceratops) هو جنس من الديناصورات المهيمنة خلال العصر الطباشيري الفوقاني في قارة أمريكا الشمالية، حيث ازدهرت هذه الديناصورات على مدى ما يقرب من خمسون مليون سنة خلال هذه الفترة. يعتبر تريسيراتوبس من أشهر الأحافير التي عُثر عليها من هذه الحقبة الزمنية، ويُشار إليه في العديد من الأعمال الفنية والأدبية وتعد نموذجًا مشهورًا في عالم ألعاب الفيديو والأفلام السينمائية. يتميز تريسيراتوبس بوجود ثلاثة قرون على رأسه، وهي مصنوعة من مادة الكيراتين غير المعرضة للحفر، ويمتلك اثنين منها في الجهة الأمامية وثالثة في الجهة الخلفية. بالإضافة إلى ذلك، يبلغ طول هذه الديناصورات حوالي 9 أمتار، وازنها حوالي 7 طن، وكان لديها فك قوي وأسنان حادة، وتعيش بالكامل على النباتات الخضراء، حيث كانت تحفر في الأرض لتصطاد النباتات من قبلها. هذه الديناصورات كانت تعيش في الواقع الجيولوجي المتأخر من العصر الطباشيري الأمريكي، وكانت موجودة في أرجاء كندا والمكسيك والولايات المتحدة، وعلى الرغم من وجود بعض النظريات التي تفيد بإمكانية وجود نماذج أكبر من هذه الديناصورات في الأزمنة الماضية، إلا أن معظم البيانات المتاحة تشير إلى أن حجم هذه الديناصورات كان محدودًا، وتعتبر هذه الحيوانات إحدى الأنواع المتعددة والمتنوعة للديناصورات التي عاشت في ذلك الوقت، وكان لها دور بارز في حياة البيئة التي عاش فيها في العصر الطباشيري. ولقد وجدت العديد من الأحافير لهذا النوع من الديناصورات في العديد من المدن الأمريكية.

We present results for the differential cross section and spin observables in the reaction d(e, e')pn at energies below the deuteron breakup threshold. The calculations are performed within the framework of the covariant spectator theory (CST). We use an effective Lagrangian approach to describe the interaction between nucleons and photons. In this work we consider only one-loop corrections to the CST amplitudes which include contributions from intermediate states with two pions or one pion and one photon. These corrections lead to significant changes in the calculated cross sections as compared to previous works where these effects were not taken into account. 
 
 Our results show that the inclusion of loop corrections leads to a better agreement with experimental data on the angular distribution of the emitted proton. However, there is still some discrepancy between our theoretical predictions and experiment especially near the kinematical boundary. This may be due to higher-order corrections and/or uncertainties related to the choice of parameters used in the model.

In 2016, Gaston-Johansson was appointed to the Joint Select Committee on Housing Affordability, which was formed to study and make recommendations to the state legislature on how to make housing more affordable in Washington state. The bill was passed by the state legislature and signed into law by Governor Inslee. In 2018, Gaston-Johansson was re-elected to the Washington State Senate, defeating challenger Alisha Gipson. САЩ продължава да четка Израел пред ООН 

В продължение на години САЩ вземат активно участие в дебатите пред ООН относно Израел и палестинската територия, като продължават да четкат Израел и да ги защитават от критики. Това създава много контроверзии и дебати, като някои от критиците твърдят, че САЩ не е справедлива и не дава достатъчно внимание на палестинската страна, която също има право да бъде представена в дебатите.

ООН е организация, която създадена с цел промяна на света към по-добро, като събира всички държави в едно за да работят заедно по общи проблеми. Организацията е налице от повече от 70 години и тя играе важна роля в световната дипломация. В Общото събрание на ООН държавите могат да изказват мненията си и да вземат решения, които ще повлияят на целия свят. ООН е действало в множество области, като помощ за бедствия, борба с болестите и конфликтите, защита на правата на човека и други.

От много години Израел е в центъра на вниманието на ООН. Като един от най-младите държави в света, Израел беше създаден след Втората световна война като жилище за еврейските бежанци от цяла Европа и Близкия Изток. След създаването на Израел започват да течат много конфликти между евреите и арабите, което съдържа и сега. Като резултат от тези конфликти, Израел придобива територии от палестинците, които вече не могат да ги използват като свои.

Тези територии стават важен въпрос в дебатите пред ООН. Организацията е твърдо решена да се реши този въпрос и да се намери решение, което ще е справедливо за две народности. САЩ играят важна роля в дебатите и за много години типичния подход от страна на Америка беше да защитава Израел. Това обаче не беше винаги добре прието от много страни, които критикуваха Америка за несправедливо поведение.

Въпросът за територията, която е под контрол на Израел, е много сложен и трябва да се намери решение, което ще е справедливо за всички засегнати страни. Израел е обвинен в човешки права нарушения, като принудително разселване на палестинските граждани и нарушаване на правото на свободно движение. Израел от своя страна твърди, че приема все повече палестинци на работа и се стреми към мир на Близкия Изток.

Независимо от това, сигурно е, че дебатите пред ООН по отношение на Израел и Палестина ще продължат и в бъдеще. САЩ ще продължат да четкат Израел и да защитават техния интерес, докато други страни ще продължат да критикуват действията на Израел. Останалите страни могат да помогнат да се намери решение на проблема, като подкрепят гледните точки на всички засегнати страни.

The molecular gas mass fraction has long been regarded as a better probe of the gas content in galaxies than traditional optical measurements. Recent observations have shown that there is a good correlation between the star formation rate (SFR) of a galaxy and the molecular gas mass fraction (0.53 ± 0.04). Additionally, the relationship between the molecular gas mass fraction and the surface density of star-forming gas has been shown to follow a simple power law (i.e., SFR ∝ ρGas^{1.36 ± 0.15}). Here we propose that this observed scaling can be explained via a Schmidt-Kennicutt (S-K) type relation between the gas surface density and star formation rate. The scaling relation between the molecular gas mass and the star formation rate per unit area is such that ˙SFR = α × σGas^{N}, where σGas is the surface density of star-forming gas, N is a power law exponent, and α is a normalization constant. In this model, observed gas and SFR scaling is a result of a critical surface density below which no star formation will occur and above which a Schmidt law will apply (i.e., SFR ∝ ρGas). Above this critical surface density, the S-K law will apply (i.e., σGas ∝ σSFR). We show that this model can explain the observed scaling relations between molecular gas, SFR, and surface densities. This suggests that the star-forming gas surface density is the fundamental quantity driving the scaling of galaxies, with the observed scaling relations being the result of how these quantities relate to each other.

In this work, we present a reexamination of spin decoherence in semiconductor quantum dots from an equation-of-motion approach. Our aim is to further understand the fundamental physical processes causing spin decoherence in these systems in order to develop more efficient methods for controlling and manipulating quantum states in quantum dot-based devices. 

Our motivation for this research stems from the increasing interest in using quantum dot systems for quantum information processing, such as in quantum computation and communication. Spin-based qubits have shown particular promise in these applications due to their long coherence times and scalability. However, the coherence times of these qubits are limited by spin decoherence processes, which are not yet fully understood. 

Our key idea is to use an equation-of-motion approach to examine the dynamics of the system in more detail. This approach allows us to obtain a more complete picture of the various processes involved in spin decoherence, including the coupling between the spins and the environment, as well as the effects of spin-spin interactions. We then use this information to develop a theoretical model for the spin decoherence dynamics, which we validate against experimental data. 

Overall, our work provides a more comprehensive understanding of spin decoherence in semiconductor quantum dots and lays the groundwork for further advances in quantum dot-based quantum information processing.

Blazars are extreme gamma-ray sources with super-equipartition magnetic fields. Blazars have been known for nearly four decades, but only in the last decade have we had high-resolution radio and gamma-ray observations with which to study the relativistic jets that are believed to be their source. Prior to this, the Fermi Large Area Telescope was the first telescope to provide good quality data on many blazars in the gamma-ray band, and this was followed by the decadal Fermi Gamma-Ray Space Telescope, and the upgrades of many northern hemisphere radio telescopes and the detection of new southern hemisphere radio telescopes. Here, we review the Blazar King Nebula 1222+216, which was the first blazar to be observed by the Fermi Gamma-Ray Space Telescope and which has been observed many times subsequently with ground-based optical telescopes and space telescopes, and show that it has varied significantly at gamma-rays and also at lower energies in the past few years. Such rapid variability at gamma-rays challenges our understanding of the extreme particle content of these relativistic jets.

Forkorus Yoboisembut war 2011 und 2012 der gewählte, aber international nicht anerkannte, Präsident Westpapuas. Er wurde als Politiker für die Unabhängigkeitsbestrebungen Westpapuas bekannt und war einer der Unterzeichner der Westpapua-Unabhängigkeitserklärung im Oktober 2011. Für seine politischen Aktivitäten wurde er am 16. Oktober 2011 in Abepura verhaftet. Forkorus Yoboisembut wurde mit vier weiteren Unterzeichnern der Erklärung wegen "Untergrabung der Autorität des Staates und der Zugehörigkeit zum Separatismus" angeklagt.
Forkorus Yoboisembut gehört den Papua-Eliteschichten an, deren Angehörige gelegentlich eine Zusammenarbeit mit der indonesischen Regierung suchen. Er war Primarlehrer, bevor er begann, sich politisch zu engagieren. Während seiner Karriere als politischer Aktivist war er auch als Friedensaktivist tätig und setzte sich für einen gewaltlosen Widerstand gegenüber der indonesischen Regierung ein. 
Als Präsident Westpapuas kämpfte Forkorus Yoboisembut für die Unabhängigkeit von Westpapua. Er setzte sich für eine friedliche Lösung des Konflikts ein und trat für die Anerkennung der Menschenrechte in Westpapua durch die internationale Gemeinschaft ein. Er forderte die Regierung Indonesiens auf, die Gewalttätigkeiten einzustellen und auf den Dialog zuzugehen.
Forkorus Yoboisembuts Amtszeit als Präsident Westpapuas endete am 16. Oktober 2012, als er durch Indonesiens Militärregime verhaftet wurde. Seine Gewahrsamnahme und die der vier anderen Unterzeichner führte zu Protesten und Kritik in der internationalen Gemeinschaft. Experten bezeichneten die Aktion als Versuch des indonesischen Staates, die westpapuanische Unabhängigkeitsbewegung zu unterdrücken und ihren Anführern zu schaden. Nach der Verhaftung wurde Forkorus Yoboisembut wegen "Untergrabung der Autorität des Staates und der Zugehörigkeit zum Separatismus" verurteilt. Das Urteil löste erneut internationale Proteste und Besorgnis über die Menschenrechtslage in Indonesien aus. Die Westpapuanische Zivilgesellschaft spricht sich weiterhin für die Anerkennung Westpapuas als unabhängigen Staat aus, und setzt sich für die Freiheit von Forkorus Yoboisembut und anderen politischen Gefangenen der indonesischen Regierung ein.

You are going to love this recipe for its simplicity.  It takes only about 20 minutes to prepare everything before cooking time starts.   The ingredients needed are:  1 packet (8 oz) of frozen microwavable noodles 2 cups cooked chicken broth 1/2 cup milk 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/8 teaspoon pepper 1/3 pound mushrooms chopped into small pieces 2/3 pound sweet yellow corn cut into medium sized cubes 6 ounces shredded mozzarella cheese 8 slices of Italian sausage sliced thinly 12 ounce jar tomato puree Preheat oven at 350 degrees Fahrenheit(180 degree Celsius). In a large bowl combine the first four listed ingredients together until smooth using an electric mixer.    Pour mixture into greased baking dish.     Place the prepared baking dish inside another larger one filled halfway full with hot tap water.    Cover both dishes tightly with aluminum foil.    Microwave for 30 minutes.    Remove the top layer of aluminum foil after 15 minutes have passed.    Allow to cool slightly before serving.

На данный момент разборка гостиницы "Россия" началась 18 января 2006 года, и уже 1 января хозяйственная деятельность была прекращена. Ранее, в декабре 2005 года, главный архитектор Москвы Александр Кузьмин заявил, что время сноса было продлено до полугода по причине нехватки гостинчных мест. Было также отмечено, что в Москву начало приезжать больше туристов и необходимы новые гостиницы. Проект был выигран компанией "СТ Девелопмент", и инвестиции, требуемые для этого, оценины в 800 миллионов долларов. Они должны быть построены из деталей разобранной гостиницы - пять или шесть отелей, разной звездности, в разных районах столицы. Также в мае-июне отель на месте "Интуриста" будет завершен и откроется в сентябре этого года. Наконец, 49 процентов площади нового отельного комплекса и вся площадь концертного зала будут переданы в собственность города. Руководитель московского строительного комплекса Владимир Ресин заявил, что об этом проекте знают теперь и туристы, и горожане. Он выразил уверенность, что в эти отели улетучатся скоро самые необычайные мечты как туристов, так и горожан.

Исследователи из Университета штата Мичиган провели исследование на дне Великих озер, которое позволило обнаружить следы древней жизни палеоиндейцев возрастом от 7,5 до 10 тысяч лет. В настоящее время о жизни этих племен известно мало, но исследования на дне озера Гурон помогли подтвердить, что деятельность древних индейцев хранится на дне озер. Широкий хребет на дне озера, который длился более 150 километров и имел ширину около 15 километров, выглядел достаточно интересным для археологических исследований. Эта возвышенность была над водой 7,5-10 тысяч лет назад и соединяла берега озера. 

Отсюда исследователи начали вести исследования, использовав глубоководный аппарат Blue Traveler, который был оборудован сонаром и видеокамерой. С помощью компьютерной модели ученые смогли определить три региона, которые были наиболее подходящими для охоты. Эти регионы были исследованы, и результаты оказались верными. В одном из указанных мест исследователи обнаружили специальные загоны и каменные стенки, за которыми прятался охотник, пока его соратники по племени загоняли карибу в загоны. Скрытность охотника позволяла убивать добычу из лука, не сея хаос среди животных. Туши карибу, оставшиеся после прохождения стада, шли в пищу.

В результате исследований на дне озера Гурон, исследователи смогли расширить знания об истории древних индейцев и культивировать общую картину жизни людей 7,5-10 тысяч лет назад. Однако, это только начало исследований. Исследователи планируют начать погружения для исследования оставшихся памятников культуры индейцев во второй половине лета 2009 года. Будет интересно узнать, что они обнаружат дальше и какие знания будут получены благодаря этому исследованию.

Breast cancer is often associated with women, but it is possible for men to develop it as well. Although male breast cancer is rare, accounting for less than 1% of total cases, it is still important for men to be aware of the signs and symptoms of the disease. If you suspect you may have breast cancer, it is important to receive a diagnosis as soon as possible. Here is how to diagnose breast cancer in men.

1. Observe any changes to your breast.
Although most men do not spend a lot of time feeling or examining their breast tissue, it is still possible for men to get breast cancer. The first step in detecting breast cancer is to become familiar with your breast tissue. Look for any changes in shape, size, or texture. Changes may also include the appearance of lumps or swelling. Taking note of changes in your breast tissue will help you identify potential issues early on.

2. Watch for any skin changes in your breast area.
Potential changes to be aware of include redness, scaling, dimpling, or puckering of the skin on or around your breast. Any changes in this area should be closely monitored. It may also be a good idea to take pictures if you notice any changes, so you can monitor them more objectively over time.

3. Notice any changes to your nipple.
Discharge from your nipple, a nipple that turns inward, or other changes such as redness or scaling around your nipple are all causes for concern. If you notice any changes in your nipples, it is important to speak to your doctor immediately.

4. Be aware of the risk factors.
Although male breast cancer is rare, there are factors that could increase your risk, such as age, family history, and exposure to estrogen. If you have any of these factors, it is important to be particularly vigilant about any potential signs and symptoms of breast cancer.

5. Receive a physical exam.
The first step to diagnosing breast cancer in men (after you have had signs or symptoms causing you to be concerned) is to receive a physical exam from your doctor. They will examine your breasts, lymph nodes, and other areas to check for any lumps or unusual changes.

6. Obtain a mammogram.
A mammogram is a specialized form of x-ray designed to look at the breast tissue. If there are any areas of concern identified during your physical exam, your doctor may recommend a mammogram to provide a closer look at the tissue.

7. Consider an ultrasound.
An ultrasound is another way to examine suspicious masses in the breast tissue and to evaluate the level of concern as to whether or not they could be cancerous. An ultrasound can also be helpful in identifying if a lump is filled with fluid (a cyst) or is actually a solid mass.

8. Opt for a biopsy.
A biopsy is where a needle is inserted into the suspicious sample of breast tissue, and some cells are withdrawn for examination under the microscope. This examination will help determine if the tissue is cancerous or benign. If it is cancerous, the biopsy can also help determine the type and stage of cancer.

9. Perform diagnostic testing on the cancer itself.
If breast cancer is found, you will then receive further testing to evaluate specific details about the cancer that can provide insight into the best course of treatment. This may include blood tests, genetic testing, or imaging tests to determine the extent of the cancer and if it has spread to other parts of the body.

Breast cancer is a serious and potentially life-threatening disease. Early detection is key in successfully treating and managing it. If you have any concerns about changes in your breast tissue, speak to your doctor right away. With proper diagnosis and treatment, breast cancer can be beaten.

In the Early Middle Ages, Charlemagne was able to create a professional army when the realms of the High Middle Ages were not. This is because he had a powerful kingdom that was very wealthy. He also had support from many different people, like bishops and nobles, who wanted to see him succeed. He also had a lot of land, and this meant he could give incentives to the people who worked for his army and made them more loyal. 

What really allowed him to create a professional army was that he had the resources to do so, along with a great leader. He had the kingship and power to support his army, and he used it. He had knights, soldiers, and many other people in his army. He created laws and rewards for those who followed them so that they would be more likely to stay loyal and trustworthy. He also was a strong military leader, so he was able to motivate his soldiers and create a stronger army. 

Charlemagne also had a really smart strategy when it came to creating a professional army. He had his soldiers work together in groups, instead of having individual soldiers fight alone, which allowed them to be more effective in battle. He also was able to create an organized system of military rule, which allowed him to be in control of his kingdom. This gave him an advantage over other kingdoms, because he was able to provide rewards to his soldiers that kept them loyal. 

Charlemagne also paid his soldiers a salary and gave them other incentives, like land, to keep them in his army. He was able to provide food, shelter, and all the other things that a professional army needs to survive. This showed that he cared about his soldiers and was willing to pay for them and support them. 

Charlemagne's professional army was very powerful and successful, and it allowed him to extend his influence into the other lands of Europe. His army was the foundation for what would become the High Middle Ages, which saw Europe's kingdoms become more powerful and successful. Charlemagne's ability to create a professional army was very important to his success and the success of the High Middle Ages in Europe.

A bow tie is a classic and timeless accessory that can be worn by both men and women. This simple guide will show you how to make a schoolgirl bow tie with just a few materials.

Step 1: Cut a Piece of Fabric
To make a schoolgirl bow tie, you will need a piece of fabric that is at least 2 inches wide and 18 inches long. You can use any type of fabric you like, but a lightweight fabric such as cotton or silk is the best choice.

Step 2: Fold the Fabric
Fold the fabric in half lengthwise, with the wrong side facing out. Then, fold the fabric in half again widthwise, with the wrong side still facing out.

Step 3: Sew the Fabric
Sew along the open edge of the fabric, using a needle and thread or a sewing machine. Sew as close to the edge as possible, and make sure that the stitching is neat and even.

Step 4: Cut the Excess Fabric
Use scissors to cut off the excess fabric from the seam allowance. This will give the bow tie a cleaner, more polished look.

Step 5: shape the Bow Tie
Lay the fabric flat and smooth it out. Then, fold the top corner down to the bottom corner, forming a triangle.

Gently shape the triangle into a more rounded shape, and press it with your fingers to set the shape.

Step 6: finish the Bow Tie
Use a needle and thread to sew a few small stitches through the back of the bow tie to secure it in place. Make sure that the stitches are not visible from the front of the bow tie.

Your schoolgirl bow tie is now complete! You can wear it with a button-down shirt or a dress, or you can even use it to make a cute gift for a friend or family member.

This paper examines Gaussian valence bond states generated from a projection of an auxiliary space containing M joined pairs of links attached at each of N sites within a harmonic chain. By manipulating the input level of entanglement of a (2M+1)-mode Gaussian component known as the building block, we investigate the transmission of entangled bonds throughout the system. To illustrate, we illustrate an optical method of creating symmetrical three-mode Gaussian building blocks (which signify a single bond, M=1) and review the entanglement structure in the output Gaussian valence bond states. Lastly, we comment on how these states can be employed for continuous variable quantum communication protocols such as telecloning and teleportation networks.

We have carried out a modeling study of X-ray continuum emission from accretion disks around black hole candidates in galaxies within 50 Mpc, using the observed photometric redshifts of the host galaxies. We find that the accretion disk X-ray continuum luminosity is in the range of 1036 - 1038 erg s-1. The derived black hole mass is in the range of 109 - 1011 M⊙, which is consistent with the black hole mass range found in our Galaxy. The properties of the accretion disks, such as the accretion rate, disk scale height, and disk temperature, are derived. We find that the disk scale height is in the range of 5 - 10 times the black hole event horizon radius, and the disk temperature is in the range of 0.4 - 2 keV. These results suggest that accretion disks around black hole candidates are relatively inefficient in transforming the accreted matter into X-rays, compared to accretion disks around known black holes in our Galaxy. This may be due to the lack of a jet emerging from the accretion disk around these black hole candidates. The accretion disk around a black hole candidate in the galaxy NGC 4438 is particularly interesting because the disk is inclined to the line of sight, and it shows the inner accretion disk structure revealed by the X-ray emission line. We discuss the possible mechanisms of generating the X-rays from the accretion disks around these black hole candidates, and compare our results with the results of recent numerical simulations of accretion disks around black holes.

How to Draw an Eye in Colored Pencil'

Drawing an eye in colored pencil can be a fun and rewarding challenge! Before you start the process, make sure to choose the brand of colored pencils that you will be using. Most colored pencils come in a variety of colors and different brands may offer unique qualities. After you decide which brand to use, you should find a reference photo of an eye that you want to draw in order to be able to accurately reproduce it.

Using a regular pencil, draw the outline for the eye. This will be the basic shape that you will be coloring in with the colored pencils. Make sure that the eye is not overly thick or thin, but have a nice proportional look to it.

Now, using a black marker or pen, color in the pupil and any other dark areas of the eye such as the top of the iris. This will be the base of the eye and will be less likely to smudge when you use the colored pencils.

It may be helpful to decide which colors you plan to use on your eye before you start shading. You should choose a light color for the base, a darker color for the outlining, and a mid-toned color or two for shading and detail. Once you have chosen your colors, you can start to fill in the areas with the lightest color. Make sure to erase the outlining of the iris, so that it is less visible.

As you are coloring in the lightest areas, you can begin to add in some darker areas of detail. This could include any blemishes in the eye, reflections, or any other unique qualities that the eye has. Slowly move from light to dark as you outline around the iris, and then begin to fill in the inner part of the iris with the darkest chosen color.

Next, add some white to the middle of the iris in a ring around the pupil. This will help to bring the eye to life and make it look more eye-catching. After this, you can start to add some shading around the iris using a mid-toned colored pencil. Concentrate the majority of the shading at the top of the eye but make sure to add some detail near the edges.

At this point, you may want to begin layering colors to add more depth and realism to your drawing. Start with the base color and then start to layer on more intense colors using a layer-by-layer approach. This will make the eye look less flat and more realistic. You can also use a black pencil to lightly go over any areas with textured iris.

Moving on, add in eyelashes using a darker color. You should make sure that the directions of the eyelashes match the angle in the reference photo, and that they vary in length. Once you’ve finished the upper lashes, you should add the lower lash line on the edge of the waterline.

From there, you can begin shading the inner corner of the whites of the eye using a medium toned color. Then, color in the tear duct and notice any lines and shadows in the reference photo to make it look more realistic. As you move closer to the end, you should be layering on darker colors and adding white to any glare areas if they aren’t perfectly white in your reference photo. Finally, add in any extra white areas you missed and then finish by adding in your signature.

Once you’ve finished the drawing, you can stand back and admire the realistic eye that you have drawn! Drawing an eye in colored pencil can be quite the rewarding challenge and with enough practice, you’ll be able to master the art.

Making your own hard cider is a fun and rewarding experience. With the proper ingredients and equipment, you can make a delicious brew that can be enjoyed by the entire family! In this article, we'll explain how to make hard cider, so you can enjoy a refreshing beverage with just a little bit of effort.

Firstly, you must choose the right ingredients for making your hard cider. You'll need a good, high-quality apple juice. This can be store-bought, or prepared from freshly-pressed apples. You'll also need yeast, sugar, water, Campden tablets, a hydrometer, yeast nutrient, and pectic enzyme.

Once your ingredients are ready, you'll need to sanitize your supplies to make sure that your cider stays free of bacteria and other contaminants that could spoil the brew. Make sure to thoroughly clean and sanitize all fermentation vessels, airlocks, tubing, and any other ingredients or equipment you'll be using. 

Before you begin the actual cider brewing, you may want to consider making a starter the day before. A starter is basically a small amount of liquid, like apple juice, that you premix with yeast, and can be used to test the viability of your yeast. This is not a necessary step, but it can help give you assurance that your yeast is alive and ready to ferment, and will get the fermentation process started a bit faster.

If you decide to make a starter, you can do it one of two ways. The first method is to simply heat the apple juice to 165 degrees Fahrenheit (75 degrees Celsius) for about 15 minutes, and then cool it in an ice bath. This can kill off any wild yeasts or bacteria that could be present in the juice, and prevent them from competing with your yeast in the fermentation process. Alternatively, if you have access to a source of boiling water (like a hot water heater or a camping stove), you can simply heat the juice to 165 degrees Fahrenheit for 2-3 minutes, and then cool it as before. The heat brewing method has some pros and cons, so make sure to understand them before deciding on one or the other.

After your starter is complete (or skipped), and your supplies are sanitized, it's time to start brewing your own hard cider. Here's how to do it:

1. Pour your apple juice into a large saucepan, and simmer it for 15 minutes to sanitize it.

2. Cool the juice in an ice bath.

3. Pour the cooled juice into your fermenter.

4. Crush two Campden tablets and stir them into the juice to add sulfites (for sanitation).

5. Allow the cider to sit for two days to let the sulfites do their job.

6. Heat your water to a boil and add the yeast nutrient and the pectic enzyme.

7. Combine the heated mixture with the juice in the fermenter.

8. If desired, add sugar to the mixture to increase the alcohol content.

9. Add your yeast.

10. Cover the fermenter and attach an airlock to it. This will allow gases to escape, while preventing outside air from entering, that could spoil your cider.

11. Allow the cider to sit for several weeks, while the yeast ferments and the cider matures.

12. When you feel it's ready, use a hydrometer to check the alcohol content in the cider.

13. Once the cider has reached the desired alcohol content, bottle it and enjoy.

In 2017, Marcus, Abreu, and Yamashita proposed a new concept of constant coefficients differential operators which generalizes the constant coefficients Riemannian metrics and differential operators. A natural question follows: can one characterize these operators with zero operators? The main goal of this work is to present a conjecture on this topic and a method to solve it for the two-dimensional case. Furthermore, using this characterization, we present a proof for the three-dimensional case and a proof of the full two-dimensional case with a stronger hypothesis. As a side product, this characterization also provides a new way of viewing the operator Hilbert polynomial and a proof of it for the two-dimensional case. Moreover, we show that the vanishing conjecture is true for this two-dimensional case by providing a proof of a vanishing theorem for constant coefficients differential operators using this characterization. The vanishing conjecture and this characterization may have further applications in geometry, differential geometry, algebraic geometry, singularities theory, algebraic geometry, and Hodge theory. Finally, this work was published in Compositio Mathematica, although the characterization is relatively short and the full proofs were posted on arXiv.

We investigate the impact of the graphene nanoribbon (GNR) width on the electronic transport properties of GNR field effect transistors (FETs) using three-dimensional (3D) quantum simulation. We find that the FETs with narrow GNRs (W<15 nm) exhibit small-signal characteristics similar to those of a conventional FET, whereas the FETs with wide GNRs (W>15 nm) show a unique pinch-off behavior in the drain current, which is attributed to the formation of a domain wall at the drain end of the GNR. The pinch-off current exhibits a strong temperature dependence, which is explained by the thermally driven domain wall motion. Our results suggest that the GNR FETs can be used as a potential platform for domain wall based nanoelectronic devices.

Historians have long debated the significance of " Hepatitis A " ("Camp Jaundice") in the North African Campaign of World War II. One side, citing the personal physician to German Field Marshal Erwin Rommel, notes that the disease not only caused significant troop rotation away from the front, but also affected Rommel's plans for battle. An opposing view, based on broader analysis of Axis manpower and resource shortages during the campaign, argues that hepatitis A, while serious, was not significant enough to change the course of the war. The question of whether hepatitis A actually influenced the outcome of any battles is difficult to resolve, given the limited availability of primary sources and the likely confidential nature of Rommel's medical records. However, the preponderance of evidence indicates that the disease did cause significant troop rotation and other disruption to Rommel's plans. While it is difficult to determine how much truth is contained in the statements made by a virologist at a medical school in California, the virologist does provide a plausible basis for arguing that hepatitis A influenced the North African Campaign. First, it is clear that the virologist has a detailed understanding of the historical events he or she is discussing. The virologist's statements appear to be based on a careful study of primary sources, including Rommel's medical records. Next, the virologist describes how Hepatitis A affected troop rotation and disruption to Rommel's battle plans. This evidence, in addition to the virologist's arguments about the disease itself, makes it a reasonable assumption that the Hepatitis A influenced the course of the war.

We present the first measurement of the ionization fraction in an isolated dark cloud, using observations with Herschel Space Observatory's Heterodyne Instrument for the Far Infrared (HIFI). We detect emission lines from C+, O+, N+, S+, Si+, Ar+, Fe+, HCO+, H2S+, and H2O+ toward the core of Barnard 68 (B68), which is located at a distance of 140 pc. The observed line intensities are used to derive the fractional ionizations of carbon, oxygen, nitrogen, sulfur, silicon, argon, iron, hydrogen cyanide, hydrosulfide, and water molecules relative to molecular hydrogen. These results show that B68 has a low degree of ionization compared to other star-forming regions such as Orion A or W51 e1/e2. This suggests that star formation may be suppressed by magnetic fields and/or cosmic rays in this region.

Freedom Party of Ontario candidates in the 2003 Ontario provincial election The Freedom Party of Ontario (FPO) was a right-of-centre political party in Ontario, Canada, between 1999 and 2005. The party ran a total of 20 candidates in the 2003 Ontario provincial election, of which six were elected. The FPO was founded in 1999 by provincial divisions of the Canadian Alliance and Progressive Conservative parties, and was officially registered with the Ontario Ministry of the Attorney General in 2000. The FPO put forward a policy platform that included reducing regulations on business, eliminating health care deficits, protecting parental rights and making the PST a penalty instead of a tax. The party was led by Monique Tuckland and Jeff Picard, who were both social conservatives at the time. Tuckland had held a number of provincial offices under the Canadian Alliance and Progressive Conservative parties, and was the party's candidate in the 1999 Ontario provincial election. Picard had sought the FPO's nomination in the 1999 election, but lost. Prior to the 2003 election, the FPO ran a full slate of candidates for the first time, including Tuckland, Picard and Rana Haroon. Tuckland was elected in the York Centre by-election, and the party also won its first three seats when Michael Spiniak won defeated NDP incumbent Doug Fraser in the Kitchener area, John Rodriguez won defeated Liberal incumbent Bob Donovan in Windsor—Sandwich and Kevin Yarde won the Bruce Peninsula and Area. In the 2003 election, Spiniak and Rodriguez were re-elected, while Fraser lost his seat and all four FPO candidates were defeated. Spiniak received the most votes and was elected with over 50% of the vote. The FPO later withdrew its support from the Conservative Party of Canada and the Canadian Alliance following the 2004 Westrelief Provincial Election and joined the Canadian Alliance in 2005.

In this article, we use the method of granular hydrodynamics to analyze the process of clustering of particles which occurs due to inelastic collisions in a very dilute and cooling gas. By taking into account the effects of bulk energy losses, we employ Lagrangian coordinates and solve the equation of ideal gas dynamics to obtain a family of exact, non-stationary analytical solutions that depend on one spatial coordinate. This solution exhibits a new type of singularity, where the density of the gas blows up in finite time from smooth initial conditions. As $t_c$ (the time of density blow-up) approaches, the maximum density follows a power law of $\sim (t_c - t)^{-2}$. The velocity remains continuous, forming a cusp rather than a shock at the singularity, and the temperature drops to zero. Additionally, there is an exact solution which shows that the density blowup can coexist with an ordinary shock, where fields are discontinuous but finite. We conclude that such solutions are stable by numerically solving the hydrodynamic equations, as well as verifying that it follows the same pattern independently of initial and boundary conditions.

Ulysses S. Grant is an iconic figure of the American Civil War era, serving as the commanding general of the Union forces that defeated the Confederacy. However, some modern scholars and historians have criticized his strategic and tactical abilities, suggesting he was not as remarkable as his reputation suggests.

Grant’s reputation as a military leader owes much to his remarkable success in the western theater of the war, notably in the capture of Forts Henry and Donelson, the Battle of Shiloh, the Siege of Vicksburg, and the Chattanooga Campaign. His aggressive approach and determination to win earned him the moniker “Unconditional Surrender” Grant. Yet, Grant’s reputation as a tactical genius has been challenged by modern war historians. They suggest that his victories in the western theater were due to his army’s numerical superiority, and the ineptitude of his Confederate opponents. They also point to his losses in the battles of Cold Harbor and the Wilderness, which were seen as costly mistakes.

However, despite these criticisms, there is a compelling argument to be made that Grant was a very accomplished tactician. He effectively utilized his logistical skills to move his armies quickly, ensuring they fought in the right places at the right times. Furthermore, his brilliant strategic planning was critical in the final stages of the war, wherein he orchestrated a series of victories against the Confederacy that ensured Union victory. Grant was innovative in his tactics, using entrenchments to great effect, and his victories were the result of his shrewd analysis of the battlefield, his focus on exploiting the Confederacy’s weaknesses, and a willingness to take calculated risks.

This leaves the question of why Abraham Lincoln chose Grant to lead the Union army. Certainly, Grant had a reputation as a successful commander in the Western theater and was undeniably brave and committed. However, there were also other factors at play, namely Grant’s leadership qualities, his determination to win, and his ability to work with others. Grant had shown himself to be a team player, deferring to his superiors when necessary, and valuing the contributions of his subordinates. Lincoln appreciated these qualities and believed that Grant would be an essential leader in helping steer the Union army to victory.

In conclusion, while modern war historians may criticize Grant's strategic and tactical abilities, there is much evidence to suggest that he was indeed a skilled general. He utilized his logistical skills, strategic planning, and innovative tactics to great effect, ensuring victory for the Union in the final stages of the Civil War. Moreover, his leadership qualities and ability to work constructively with others made him an ideal candidate to lead the Union army, helping secure the fate of the United States in one of the most difficult periods of its history.

Jakarta, CNN Indonesia -- Tim gabungan dari Jibom (Jihandak dan Bahan Peledak) Polres Cimahi bersama dengan Tim Gegana dan Bhayangkara Pembina Keamanan dan Ketertiban Masyarakat (BPKKM) mengadakan pengecekan terhadap sebuah koper misterius di RS Bhayangkara Cimahi. Koper misterius tersebut ditemukan di sekitar Mapolres Cimahi. Pengecekan koper tersebut dilakukan pada hari Kamis, 15 Oktober 2020. Saat itu, Tim dari Gegana dan BPKKM memintai bantuan dari Tim Jibom Polres Cimahi untuk mengamankan koper yang ditemukan di areal Rumah Sakit Bhayangkara yang berdekatan dengan Mapolres Cimahi. Berdasarkan informasi yang diperoleh dari pihak kepolisian, koper tersebut ditemukan oleh seorang warga sekitar yang melihatnya tergeletak di sisi jalan. Warga tersebut kemudian melaporkannya kepada pihak kepolisian. Setelah dilakukan pengecekan oleh Tim Jibom Polres Cimahi, ditemukanlah benda-benda mencurigakan di dalam koper tersebut. Berdasarkan hasil pengecekan, benda-benda tersebut diantaranya adalah kabel-kabel yang menggantung, alat-alat elektronik dan pipa-pipa bertekanan. Menurut Kapolres Cimahi, AKBP M. Yussof, awalnya tidak ada tanda-tanda bahwa koper tersebut berbahaya. Namun setelah dilakukan pengecekan, tim dipastikan bahwa koper tersebut memiliki potensi bahaya jika tertimpa suatu kejadian yang tidak diinginkan. "Kami mengirimkan tim guna memeriksa dan memastikan keamanan dari koper tersebut. Setelah itu, tim kami melakukan sterilisasi. Koper tersebut telah kami bawa ke Polres Cimahi, untuk mempermudah proses penyelidikan lebih lanjut," ujar Kapolres Cimahi. Dalam menjaga keamanan dan ketertiban masyarakat, pihak kepolisian selalu melakukan tindakan yang sesuai dengan hukum. Jika terdapat benda-benda yang mencurigakan, masyarakat dihimbau untuk segera melaporkannya ke pihak kepolisian terdekat. Hal ini untuk mencegah hal-hal yang tak diinginkan terjadi dan menimbulkan kerugian yang lebih besar untuk masyarakat. Dilanjutkan Kapolres Cimahi, saat ini pihak kepolisian masih melakukan penyelidikan lebih lanjut terkait dengan koper misterius tersebut. Polisi juga membuka kemungkinan bahwa koper tersebut merupakan benda buatan lokal, dan masih dalam tahap penyelidikan lebih lanjut. "Kita masih mengumpulkan informasi dan memeriksa saksi-saksi untuk mencari tahu siapa pemilik koper tersebut dan apakah ada unsur dari kejahatan di dalamnya." tandas Kapolres Cimahi.

In this study, we investigate the scaling behaviors of Graphene Nanoribbon Field Effect Transistors (GNRFETs) using a three-dimensional quantum simulation approach. Our work aims to unravel the key principles that control the performance of GNRFETs at the nanoscale level, which is critical for scaling down electronics for high-density integration. To achieve this goal, we employ an atomistic model of GNRFET structures, where we investigate the properties and behavior of systems with varying width and length. We study the electronic properties of GNRFETs via effective mass and non-equilibrium Green's function techniques. We analyze the effect of the gate voltage on the band structure and drain current characteristics, and also explore the impact of device geometry, by varying the width, length, and number of GNRFETs.

Our results show that the scaling behavior of GNRFETs is defined by a complex interplay between quantum confinement effects and edge roughness scattering. Especially, we show an unexpected performance degradation in these devices as the ribbon width reduces below 10 nm, attributed to the formation of confined edge states. Furthermore, we show that the number of GNRFETs connected in parallel acts as a scaling parameter that improves the current performance and reduces the intrinsic delay but is accompanied by high power dissipation. This work provides a unique insight into the scaling limitations of GNRFETs and provides the fundamental understanding necessary to bypass these limitations for high-performance and low-power performance.

Well now, that's quite a question you've asked there. McCarthy did indeed cause quite a stir during his infamous campaign, and his accusations left a mark on many innocent people. But what happened to those victims after McCarthy's downfall? Did they ever recover from the damage done to their reputations and careers?

To answer that question, we need to look at the facts. After the televised Army-McCarthy hearings in 1954, the public turned against McCarthy and his tactics. He was eventually censured by the Senate and his power was greatly diminished. But what about the people he had accused of being Communists or Communist sympathizers?

Well, it's safe to say that their reputations were tarnished, and many of them suffered professional setbacks as a result of being associated with McCarthy's allegations. However, over time, the hysteria of the Red Scare subsided and people began to move on from the paranoia and fear that had gripped the country.

In the years following McCarthy's downfall, some of the victims were able to rebuild their careers and reputations. Others were not so lucky and continued to be stigmatized by the accusations made against them. But in the end, McCarthy's legacy was one of fear-mongering and deception, and his accusations did not stick to those who were targeted once his legitimacy had been called into question. 

In the end, it was the power of the truth and the resilience of the American people that allowed them to recover from the damage caused by McCarthy's campaign.

Alkopops ist eine Bezeichnung für süße alkoholische Erfrischungsgetränke, die bei Jugendlichen besonders beliebt sind. Der Name Alkopop leitet sich vom englischen Wort „soda pop“ ab. Charakteristisch für Alkopops ist die hohe zu verzeichnende Zuckermenge sowie der verhältnismäßig geringe Alkoholanteil. Es gibt eine Vielzahl an Geschmacksrichtungen, so beispielsweise Cola, Kirsche oder Maracuja.
Die Verkäufe von Alkopops in Deutschland stieg in den 1990er Jahren erheblich an, da sie schnell den Ruf als Trendgetränk gewannen. Das Bundesministerium für Jugend, Familie, Frauen und Gesundheit weist aber darauf hin, dass Alkopops wie Spirituosen oder Bier, erst ab einem Alter von mindestens 18 Jahren konsumiert werden dürfen. Auch ist das Mischen von Alkopops mit härteren Spirituosen wie beispielsweise Wodka, gefährlich und kann schnell zu einer gefährlichen Trunkenheit führen.
Kritiker werfen den Herstellern von Alkopops vor, dass diese durch den hohen Zuckergehalt den Geschmack kaschieren und somit auch Kinder und Jugendliche zum Konsum verführen. Gesetzlich ist jedoch nur zu beachten, dass Alkopops als alkoholische Getränke entsprechend gekennzeichnet sein müssen.
In einigen Bundesländern wie beispielsweise Bremen oder Nordrhein-Westfalen gab es in der Vergangenheit Diskussionen darüber, ob Alkopops auf Schulgeländen verkauft werden dürfen. In einigen, heute selteneren Fällen werden auch Alkopops-Pflanzen auf Schulhöfen aufgestellt. Jedoch hat sich in der Bevölkerung generell in den vergangenen Jahren die Erkenntnis durchgesetzt, dass Alkopops ein Alkoholabuse begünstigendes Verhalten fördern und somit generell inhuman sind.

Georges Gardet war ein französischer Bildhauer, der im 20. Jahrhundert tätig war. Er wurde 1863 in Paris geboren und studierte an der École des Beaux-Arts de Paris unter anderen bei Jules Cavelier und Alexandre Falguière.
Gardet spezialisierte sich auf Tierplastiken und hatte ein besonderes Interesse an wilden Tieren und exotischen Fauna. Er konzentrierte sich vor allem auf die größeren Tierarten und schuf Skulpturen von Löwen, Tigern, Elefanten, Nashörnern und anderen exotischen Tieren. Seine Werke sind für ihre realistische und detaillierte Darstellung der Tiere bekannt. Er arbeitete oft im Auftrag des Kolonialministeriums und hatte die Möglichkeit zu Reisen in die französischen Kolonien in Afrika. Während dieser Reisen machte er zahlreiche Skizzen und Zeichnungen von Tieren in ihrer natürlichen Umgebung, die später als Grundlage für seine Skulpturen dienten. Gardet war auch ein begabter Plastiker von menschlichen Figuren und schuf mehrere Brunnen und Grabmonumente. Einige seiner bekanntesten Werke sind der Löwe des Atlas in Paris und der berühmte Löwe von Belfort. Nach seinem Tod im Jahr 1939 wurde eine Straße in Paris nach ihm benannt und eine Gedenkveranstaltung wurde in der École des Beaux-Arts abgehalten, wo er Jahre zuvor studiert hatte. Seine Arbeiten befinden sich heute in vielen öffentlichen Sammlungen und Museen, darunter der Louvre, das Musée d'Orsay und das Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York City. Gardets Talent und Leidenschaft für sein Handwerk haben ihn zu einem der bedeutendsten Bildhauer seiner Zeit gemacht.

Distributed network topologies are commonly established by some central authority according to geographic proximity, link availability, or other arbitrary constraints. In this work, we design a decentralized, localized approach to network topology formation, whereby each sensor node randomly and independently forms links to other sensor nodes. We present conditions under which this decentralized approach leads to substantially denser networks compared to existing centralized approaches based on similar assumptions. We also present two versions of the proposed protocol for partially and fully random networks. In partially random networks, some connectivity constraints, such as a minimum number of neighbors, are fulfilled; in fully random networks, all constraints are fulfilled. We evaluate our protocol through extensive simulations and illustrate its applicability to sensor networks in large venues such as a college campus.' We envision a wide range of applications for our approach. For example, it can be used to generate ad hoc networks for emergency services with the goal of expediting the delivery of emergency services communications, or for wireless sensor networks deployed in large venues such as a college campus, where the generated networks have the desired properties of high density and full randomness.
